cards.audioText: SIA 123, cleared to SIA via flight planned route, LKO-01 departure, initial climb to 1,800 meters, cruising level 10,400 meters, Runway 36R, contact departure on 119.7, squawk 6325.
cards.audioTextZh: SIA 123，许可按飞行计划航路飞往 SIA，LKO-01 离场，初始爬升至 1,800 米，巡航高度 10,400 米，Runway 36R，离场频率 119.7，应答机 6325。
cards.referenceText: cleared to SIA via flight planned route; LKO-01 departure; initial climb 1800 meters; cruising level 1400 meters; Runway 36R; 119.7; squawk 6325, SIA 123.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可按飞行计划航路飞往 SIA；LKO-01 离场；初始爬升 1800 米；巡航高度 1400 米；Runway 36R；119.7；应答机 6325，SIA 123。

cards.audioText: B: You are now ready, contact Ground to request push back and start up.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在准备好了，联系地面请求推出和开车。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA 123, request push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，SIA 123，请求推出和开车。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 123, push back and start up approved, facing east.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 123，推出和开车批准，机头向东。
cards.referenceText: Push back and start up approved, facing east, SIA 123.
cards.referenceTextZh: 推出和开车批准，机头向东，SIA 123。

cards.audioText: while being pushed back, your tow bar bent, contact Ground controller to request another tow bar.
cards.audioTextZh: 推出期间，你的牵引杆弯曲，联系地面管制员请求另一根牵引杆。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA 123, our tow bar was bent, request another tow bar request new tow bar request replacement.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，SIA 123，我们的牵引杆弯曲，请求另一根牵引杆，请求新牵引杆，请求更换。

cards.audioText: B: While taxiing, you notice the wind sock shows a strong tailwind, contact Tower to check the wind.
cards.audioTextZh: B：滑行时，你注意到风向袋显示强顺风，联系塔台检查风。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA 123, wind sock shows strong tailwind, request wind check.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，SIA 123，风向袋显示强顺风，请求风向风速检查。

cards.audioText:
SIA 123, wind 220 degrees, 8 meters per second.
the tailwind exceeds your takeoff limit, contact tower to change to Runway 18L and state the reason.
cards.audioTextZh:
SIA 123，风向 220 度，风速 8 米/秒。
顺风超过你的起飞限制，联系塔台更换至 Runway 18L 并说明原因。
cards.referenceText: Tower, SIA 123, the tailwind exceeds our takeoff limit, request change to Runway 18L. the tailwind exceeds our takeoff limit, request change to Runway 18L, SIA 123.
cards.referenceTextZh: 塔台，SIA 123，顺风超过我们的起飞限制，请求更换至 Runway 18L。顺风超过我们的起飞限制，请求更换至 Runway 18L，SIA 123。

cards.audioText: you have departed from 18 Left, shortly after liftoff, you encounter a bird strike, your right engine has failed, make an urgency call, request to maintain runway heading.
cards.audioTextZh: 你已从 Runway 18L 起飞，离地后不久遭遇鸟击，右发失效，发出紧急呼叫，请求保持跑道航向。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Tower, SIA 123, bird strike, right engine failed, request maintain runway heading.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN，PANPAN，PANPAN，塔台，SIA 123，鸟击，右发失效，请求保持跑道航向。

cards.audioText: tell Tower you want to dump fuel and return to Wuhan Airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 告诉塔台你想放油并返回武汉机场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA 123, request dump fuel and return for landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，SIA 123，请求放油并返场落地。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 123, roger, turn right heading 240 to intercept LKO VOR 030 radial inbound, climb to 3000 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 123，收到，右转航向 240，截获 LKO VOR 030 径向线入航，爬升至 3000 米。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 240 to intercept LKO VOR 030 radio inbound, climb to 3000 meters, SIA 123.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 240，截获 LKO VOR 030 径向线入航，爬升至 3000 米，SIA 123。

cards.audioText:
C: SIA 123, advise the time required for fuel jettison.
B: Tell the controller you need approximately 25 minutes.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：SIA 123，告知所需放油时间。
B：告诉管制员你大约需要 25 分钟。
cards.referenceText: We need approximately 25 minutes, SIA 123.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们大约需要 25 分钟，SIA 123。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 123, after passing LKO, heading 220, maintain 3000 meters, report when over LKO.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 123，飞越 LKO 后，航向 220，保持 3000 米，飞越 LKO 时报告。
cards.referenceText: After passing LKO, heading 220, maintain 3000 meters, report when over LKO, SIA 123.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞越 LKO 后，航向 220，保持 3000 米，飞越 LKO 时报告，SIA 123。

cards.audioText: You are over LKO, call Wuhan Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 你位于 LKO 上空，呼叫武汉进近。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, SIA 123, LKO.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，SIA 123，LKO。

cards.audioText: B: Tell Wuhan Approach fuel dumping is now completed, request radar vectors for Runway 22.
cards.audioTextZh: B：告诉武汉进近放油现已完成，请求跑道 22 雷达引导。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, SIA 123, fuel dumping completed, request radar vectors for Runway 22.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，SIA 123，放油完成，请求跑道 22 雷达引导。

cards.audioText: SIA 123, turn right, track direct to DAL A, descend and maintain 2,100 meters on QNH 1015, expect Runway 22.
cards.audioTextZh: SIA 123，右转，直飞 DAL A，下降并在 QNH 1015 上保持 2,100 米，预计 Runway 22。
cards.referenceText: turn right, direct to DAL A, descend and maintain 2100 meters, QNH 1015, Runway 22, SIA 123.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转，直飞 DAL A，下降并保持 2100 米，QNH 1015，Runway 22，SIA 123。

cards.audioText: B: You are now established on ILS approach Runway 22, contact Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在已建立跑道 22 ILS 进近，联系塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA 123, established on ILS approach Runway 22.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，SIA 123，已建立跑道 22 ILS 进近。

topics.name: SIA 497 起落架问题 TCAS机动

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is SIA 497, you are parking at gate 215, you have got information P, request ATC clearance to Singapore.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 SIA 497，停在 215 号登机口，已收到 P 情报，请求前往新加坡的 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, SIA 497, gate 215, information P, request ATC clearance to Singapore.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，SIA 497，215 号登机口，收到 P 情报，申请前往新加坡的 ATC 放行许可。

cards.audioText: SIA 497, cleared to SIA via flight planned route. LKO-01 departure, initial altitude 1800 meters, cruising level 10700m. departure frequency 118.9, squawk 2706.
cards.audioTextZh: SIA 497，许可按飞行计划航路飞往 SIA。LKO-01 离场，初始高度 1800 米，巡航高度 10700m。离场频率 118.9，应答机 2706。
cards.referenceText: cleared to SIA via flight planned route. LKO-01 departure, initial altitude 1800 meters, cruising level 1700 meters. departure frequency 118.9, squawk 2706, SIA 497.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可按飞行计划航路飞往 SIA。LKO-01 离场，初始高度 1800 米，巡航高度 1700 米。离场频率 118.9，应答机 2706，SIA 497。

cards.audioText: tell ATC 10700 meters is not acceptable due to heavy weight, request 9500 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 告诉 ATC，由于重量大，10700 米不可接受，请求 9500 米。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, SIA 497, 1700 is not acceptable due to heavy weight, request 9500 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，SIA 497，由于重量大，1700 不可接受，请求 9500 米。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 497, cleared cruising level 9500 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 497，许可巡航高度 9500 米。
cards.referenceText: Cleared cruising level 9500 meters, SIA 497.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可巡航高度 9500 米，SIA 497。

cards.audioText: B: You are on the taxiway A with engine running, contact Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你在 A 滑行道上，发动机运转，联系地面。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA 497, taxiway A, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，SIA 497，A 滑行道，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: SIA 497, taxi to holding point Runway 36R via Z4 and A, hold short of E7.
cards.audioTextZh: SIA 497，经 Z4 和 A 滑行至 Runway 36R 等待点，在 E7 前等待。
cards.referenceText: taxi to holding point Runway 36R via Z four and A, hold short of E seven, SIA 497.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 Z4 和 A 滑行至 Runway 36R 等待点，在 E7 前等待，SIA 497。

cards.audioText: Contact Wuhan Tower and request intersection departure E5 Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 联系武汉塔台，请求从 E5 交叉口使用 Runway 36R 起飞。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA 497, request intersection departure E five Runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，SIA 497，请求从 E5 交叉口使用 Runway 36R 起飞。

cards.audioText: SIA 497, Negative due sequencing, continue to holding point Runway 36R, hold short of E7.
cards.audioTextZh: SIA 497，不行，因排序需要，继续前往 Runway 36R 等待点，在 E7 前等待。
cards.referenceText: roger, continue to holding point Runway 36R, hold short of E seven, SIA 497.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，继续前往 Runway 36R 等待点，在 E7 前等待，SIA 497。

cards.audioText: SIA 497, cleared for takeoff Runway 36R, surface wind 350, five knots.
cards.audioTextZh: SIA 497，许可从 Runway 36R 起飞，地面风 350，5 节。
cards.referenceText: cleared for takeoff Runway 36R, SIA 497.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可从 Runway 36R 起飞，SIA 497。

cards.audioText: SIA 497, contact departure on 118.9.
cards.audioTextZh: SIA 497，联系离场 118.9。

cards.audioText: now you are airborne, passing 600m, contact Wuhan Departure.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已离地，正通过 600m，联系武汉离场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, SIA 497, airborne, passing 600 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，SIA 497，已离地，正通过 600 米。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 497, Wuhan Departure, radar contact, turn left direct to DA, climb and maintain 3000 meters on QNH 1021.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 497，武汉离场，雷达识别，左转直飞 DA，爬升并保持 QNH 1021 上 3000 米。
cards.referenceText: Turn left direct to DA, climb and maintain 3000 meters on QNH 1021, SIA 497.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转直飞 DA，爬升并保持 QNH 1021 上 3000 米，SIA 497。

cards.audioText: B: Your landing gear can't be extended normally, report this situation to ATC.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的起落架不能正常放下，向 ATC 报告这个情况。
cards.referenceText: Singapore Approach, SIA 497, our landing gear can't be extended normally.
cards.referenceTextZh: 新加坡进近，SIA 497，我们的起落架不能正常放下。

cards.audioText: Tell ATC you want to terminate the approach, maintain 600 meters on runway heading, to complete the abnormal procedures.
cards.audioTextZh: 告诉 ATC，你想终止进近，在跑道航向上保持 600 米，以完成非正常程序。
cards.referenceText: request terminate the approach, maintain 600 meters on runway heading, SIA 497.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求终止进近，在跑道航向上保持 600 米，SIA 497。

cards.audioText: B: Your landing gear has been extended manually, but nose wheel steering is lost, request a tug after landing.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的起落架已手动放下，但前轮转弯失效，请求落地后牵引车。
cards.referenceText: Singapore Approach, SIA 497, our landing gear has been extended manually, but nose wheel steering is lost, request a tug after landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 新加坡进近，SIA 497，我们的起落架已手动放下，但前轮转弯失效，请求落地后牵引车。

cards.audioText: roger, SIA 497, the tug will be ready upon landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 收到，SIA 497，牵引车将在落地时就位。
cards.referenceText: SIA 497.
cards.referenceTextZh: SIA 497。

cards.audioText: SIA 497, you are No. 1 to land, cleared ILS approach Runway 18L, report established.
cards.audioTextZh: SIA 497，你是第一架落地航空器，许可 ILS 进近 Runway 18L，建立后报告。
cards.referenceText: cleared ILS approach Runway 18L, report established, SIA 497.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可 ILS 进近 Runway 18L，建立后报告，SIA 497。

topics.name: SIA 615 鸟击 积冰/防冰 烟雾

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is SIA 615, from Wuhan to Singapore, you are parking at gate 232, you are fully ready for push back and start up.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 SIA 615，从武汉飞往新加坡，停在 232 号登机口，已完全准备好推出和开车。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA 615, gate 232, ready for push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，SIA 615，232 号登机口，准备好推出和开车。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 615, push back and start up approved, push back onto taxiway Z4, abeam gate 234.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 615，推出和开车批准，推出至 Z4 滑行道，正对 234 号登机口。
cards.referenceText: Push back and start up approved, push back onto taxiway Z4, abeam gate 234, SIA 615.
cards.referenceTextZh: 推出和开车批准，推出至 Z4 滑行道，正对 234 号登机口，SIA 615。

cards.audioText: B: During engine start, you have 1 engine starter failure, you wish to have more time to start the engine on taxiway Z4.
cards.audioTextZh: B：发动机启动期间，你有 1 个发动机启动机故障，希望有更多时间在 Z4 滑行道上启动发动机。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA 615, we have 1 engine starter failure, we need more time to start the engine on taxiway Z4.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，SIA 615，我们有 1 个发动机启动机故障，需要更多时间在 Z4 滑行道上启动发动机。

cards.audioText:
C: SIA 615, how long do you need?
B: Tell the controller you need approximately 5 minutes.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：SIA 615，你需要多长时间？
B：告诉管制员你大约需要 5 分钟。
cards.referenceText: We need approximately 5 minutes, SIA 615.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们大约需要 5 分钟，SIA 615。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have completed push back and start up, you are ready for taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已完成推出和开车，准备好滑行。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA 615, ready for taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，SIA 615，准备好滑行。

cards.audioText: SIA 615, taxi to holding point Runway 36R via taxiway Z4, A3 and A.
cards.audioTextZh: SIA 615，经 Z4、A3 和 A 滑行道滑行至 Runway 36R 等待点。
cards.referenceText: taxi to holding point Runway 36R via taxiway Z four, A tree and A, SIA 615.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 Z4、A3 和 A 滑行道滑行至 Runway 36R 等待点，SIA 615。

cards.audioText: there is a Boeing 7 37 approaching you on E3, ask the controller who has the right of the way.
cards.audioTextZh: 一架 Boeing 737 正在 E3 上向你接近，询问管制员谁有优先通行权。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA 615, there is a Boeing 737 approaching us on E tree, who has the right of the way?
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，SIA 615，一架 Boeing 737 正在 E3 上向我们接近，谁有优先通行权？

cards.audioText: SIA 615, hold at present position, give way to Boeing 7 37 from your right, he is No. 1 for departure.
cards.audioTextZh: SIA 615，在当前位置等待，给来自你右侧的 Boeing 737 让行，该机离场顺序第一。
cards.referenceText: roger, hold at present position, traffic in sight, SIA 615.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，在当前位置等待，已看到相关航空器，SIA 615。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 615, caution work in progress in the vicinity of E3.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 615，注意 E3 附近有施工。
cards.referenceText: Roger, thanks, SIA 615.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，SIA 615。

cards.audioText: Now you are at holding point Runway 36R, you are ready for departure, contact Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你位于 Runway 36R 等待点，已准备好离场，联系武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA 615, holding point Runway 36R, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，SIA 615，Runway 36R 等待点，已准备好离场。

cards.audioText: SIA 615, cleared for takeoff Runway 36R, caution birds on the vicinity of airport.
cards.audioTextZh: SIA 615，许可从 Runway 36R 起飞，注意机场附近有鸟群。
cards.referenceText: cleared for takeoff Runway 36R, roger, thanks, SIA 615.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可从 Runway 36R 起飞，收到，谢谢，SIA 615。

cards.audioText: C: Now you are passing 800 meters, contact Wuhan Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: C：现在你正通过 800 米，联系武汉进近。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, SIA 615, passing 800 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，SIA 615，正通过 800 米。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 615, climb to and maintain 3000 meters on QNH 1016.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 615，爬升并保持 QNH 1016 上 3000 米。
cards.referenceText: Climb to and maintain 3000 meters on QNH 1016, SIA 615.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升并保持 QNH 1016 上 3000 米，SIA 615。

cards.audioText: B: During cruise, the flight attendant reports there is smoke coming from the air conditioning system in the cabin, make an Urgency call and advise ATC you want to level off at present level.
cards.audioTextZh: B：巡航期间，乘务员报告客舱空调系统冒烟，发出紧急呼叫，并告知 ATC 你想在当前高度改平。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Control, SIA 615, the flight attendant reports there is smoke coming from the air conditioning system in the cabin, request level off at present level.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，武汉管制，SIA 615，乘务员报告客舱空调系统冒烟，请求在当前高度改平。

cards.audioText:
SIA 615, say your further intention?
the smoke is removed, you have turned off the air conditioning system, you want radar guidance to return to land at Wuhan Airport.
cards.audioTextZh:
SIA 615，请说明你的后续意图？
烟雾已消除，你已关闭空调系统，想请求雷达引导返回武汉机场落地。
cards.referenceText: we have removed smoke and turned off the air conditioning system, request radar vectors to return to land at Wuhan Airport, SIA 615.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们已消除烟雾并关闭空调系统，请求雷达引导返回武汉机场落地，SIA 615。

cards.audioText: B: You turned off the air conditioning system to avoid high cabin altitude, asked to descend below 3000 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你关闭了空调系统，为避免客舱高度过高，请求下降到 3000 米以下。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, SIA 615, we have turned off the air conditioning system, request descend below 3000 meters to avoid high cabin altitude.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，SIA 615，我们已关闭空调系统，为避免客舱高度过高，请求下降到 3000 米以下。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 615, descend to 2700 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 615，下降至 2700 米。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 2700 meters, SIA 615.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降至 2700 米，SIA 615。

cards.audioText:
C: SIA 615, do you need any emergency services?
B: Tell the controller you don't need any emergency services, because there is no damage to the aircraft or no injuries on board.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：SIA 615，你是否需要任何应急服务？
B：告诉管制员你不需要任何应急服务，因为飞机没有损伤，机上也没有人员受伤。
cards.referenceText: Negative, there is no damage to the aircraft or no injuries on board, SIA 615.
cards.referenceTextZh: 否定，飞机没有损伤，机上也没有人员受伤，SIA 615。

topics.name: SIA 852 起落架问题 积冰/防冰 TCAS机动

cards.audioText: your call sign is SIA 852, at Wuhan airport, stand 7, you have received information M, request clearance to SIA.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是 SIA 852，位于武汉机场 7 号停机位，已收到 M 情报，请求前往 SIA 的放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, SIA 852, Stand seven, information M, request clearance to SIA.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，SIA 852，7 号停机位，M 情报，请求前往 SIA 的放行许可。

cards.audioText: SIA 852, Wuhan Delivery, cleared to SIA via flight planned route, follow Z Foxtrot03D, initial climb to 1,800 meters, cruising level at 10,400 meters, Runway 18L, departure frequency 124.7, squawk 4615.
cards.audioTextZh: SIA 852，武汉放行，许可按飞行计划航路飞往 SIA，执行 ZF-03D 离场，初始爬升至 1,800 米，巡航高度 10,400 米，Runway 18L，离场频率 124.7，应答机 4615。
cards.referenceText: cleared to SIA via flight planned route, follow ZF-03 departure, initial climb to 1800 meters, cruising level 1400 meters, Runway 18L, after departure, contact 124.7, squawk 4615, SIA 852.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可按飞行计划航路飞往 SIA，执行 ZF-03 离场，初始爬升至 1800 米，巡航高度 1400 米，Runway 18L，离场后联系 124.7，应答机 4615，SIA 852。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for push back and start up, contact Wuhan Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你准备好推出和开车，联系武汉地面。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA 852, ready for push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，SIA 852，准备好推出和开车。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 852, push back and start up at your own discretion.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 852，自行决定推出和开车。
cards.referenceText: Push back and start up at our own discretion, SIA 852.
cards.referenceTextZh: 自行决定推出和开车，SIA 852。

cards.audioText: you have completed pushback and startup procedures, you decided to make an intersection departure from E2, contact Ground to request intersection departure from E2.
cards.audioTextZh: 你已完成推出和开车程序，决定从 E2 交叉口离场，联系地面请求从 E2 交叉口离场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA 852, request intersection departure from E two.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，SIA 852，请求从 E2 交叉口离场。

cards.audioText: SIA 852, Intersection departure from E2 is approved. Taxi to E2 via A6, A, A2, hold short of Runway 18L.
cards.audioTextZh: SIA 852，批准从 E2 交叉口离场。经 A6、A、A2 滑行至 E2，在 Runway 18L 前等待。
cards.referenceText: Intersection departure from E two is approved. Taxi to E two via A six, A, A two, hold short of Runway 18L, SIA 852.
cards.referenceTextZh: 批准从 E2 交叉口离场。经 A6、A、A2 滑行至 E2，在 Runway 18L 前等待，SIA 852。

cards.audioText: B: During taxiing you find a vehicle broken down on taxiway A, you have stopped the aircraft, inform ATC about the situation and request airport services to tow away the vehicle.
cards.audioTextZh: B：滑行期间，你发现一辆车在 A 滑行道上故障，你已停止飞机，通知 ATC 情况，并请求机场服务将车辆拖走。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA 852, a vehicle has broken down on taxiway A, we have to stop our aircraft and request airport service to tow the vehicle away.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，SIA 852，一辆车在 A 滑行道上故障，我们必须停止飞机，请求机场服务将车辆拖走。

cards.audioText: SIA 852, hold at present position, the ramp services will be there in a few minutes.
cards.audioTextZh: SIA 852，在当前位置等待，机坪保障人员将在几分钟后到达。
cards.referenceText: hold at present position, roger, SIA 852.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在当前位置等待，收到，SIA 852。

cards.audioText: Now you are holding short of Runway 18L on E2, request departure.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你在 E2 上的 Runway 18L 前等待，请求离场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA 852, holding short of Runway 18L on E two, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，SIA 852，在 E2 上的 Runway 18L 前等待，已准备好离场。

cards.audioText: SIA 852, Cleared for takeoff, Runway 18L.
cards.audioTextZh: SIA 852，许可从 Runway 18L 起飞。
cards.referenceText: Cleared for takeoff, Runway 18L, SIA 852.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可从 Runway 18L 起飞，SIA 852。

cards.audioText: B: During the takeoff role, your nose will run over a sharp object on the runway surface and the nose wheel tire burst, you aborted the takeoff, notify Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B：起飞滑跑期间，你的前轮压过跑道表面的尖锐物，前轮轮胎爆胎，你中断起飞，通知武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA 852, our nose wheel has run over a sharp object on the runway, the tire got burst, we aborted takeoff.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，SIA 852，我们的前轮压过跑道上的尖锐物，轮胎爆胎，我们中断起飞。

cards.audioText: B: Inform ATC about the situation and request fire trucks and maintenance.
cards.audioTextZh: B：通知 ATC 情况，并请求消防车和维修。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA 852, we have run over a sharp object, and our nose wheel tire got burst, request fire service and maintenance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，SIA 852，我们压过尖锐物，前轮轮胎爆胎，请求消防和维修。

cards.audioText:
C: SIA 852, do you need anything else?
B: Tell ATC that you require a tug to tow your aircraft back to the apron after the inspection.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： SIA 852，你还需要其他帮助吗？
B： 告诉 ATC，你需要一辆牵引车在检查后将航空器拖回机坪。
cards.referenceText: request a tug to tow us back to the apron, SIA 852. Wuhan Tower, SIA 852, request a tug to tow us back to the apron.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求一辆牵引车将我们拖回机坪，SIA 852。武汉塔台，SIA 852，请求一辆牵引车将我们拖回机坪。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 852, tug is on the way.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 852，牵引车正在路上。
cards.referenceText: Roger, thanks, SIA 852.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，SIA 852。

cards.audioText: B: Request passenger stairs and shuttle bus to be ready at the apron.
cards.audioTextZh: B：请求客梯和摆渡车在停机坪准备好。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA 852, request passenger stairs and shuttle bus to be ready at the apron.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，SIA 852，请求客梯和摆渡车在停机坪准备好。

topics.name: SIA 308 烟雾 TCAS机动 备降/返航

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is SIA 308, a flight from Wuhan to Frankfurt, you are parking at gate M5, you have got the latest ATIS G, contact Wuhan Delivery for ATC clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 SIA 308，从武汉飞往法兰克福，停在 M5 登机口，已收到最新 ATIS G，联系武汉放行申请 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, SIA 308, gate M5, information G, request ATC clearance to Frankfurt.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，SIA 308，M5 登机口，收到 G 情报，申请前往法兰克福的 ATC 放行许可。

cards.audioText: SIA 308, Wuhan Delivery, cleared to Frankfurt via flight planned route, departure Runway 04, initial climb 1,500 meters, ZF-05 departure, cruising level 11,000 meters, departure frequency 119.45, squawk 3763.
cards.audioTextZh: SIA 308，武汉放行，许可按飞行计划航路飞往法兰克福，离场使用 Runway 04，初始爬升至 1,500 米，执行 ZF-05 离场，巡航高度 11,000 米，离场频率 119.45，应答机 3763。
cards.referenceText: cleared to Frankfurt via flight planned route, departure Runway 04, initial climb 1500 meters, ZF-05 departure, cruising level 2000 meters, departure frequency 119.45, squawk 3763, SIA 308.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可按飞行计划航路飞往法兰克福，离场使用 Runway 04，初始爬升至 1500 米，执行 ZF-05 离场，巡航高度 2000 米，离场频率 119.45，应答机 3763，SIA 308。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have completed push back and start up, you are ready for taxi, contact Wuhan Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已完成推出和开车，准备好滑行，联系武汉地面。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA 308, push back and start up completed, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，SIA 308，推出和开车完成，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: SIA 308, Wuhan Ground, taxi via taxiway Z4, A2, A to holding point E5 Runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: SIA 308，武汉地面，经 Z4、A2、A 滑行道滑行至 Runway 04 的 E5 等待点。
cards.referenceText: taxi via taxiway Z four, A two, A to holding point E five Runway 04, SIA 308.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 Z4、A2、A 滑行道滑行至 Runway 04 的 E5 等待点，SIA 308。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are holding at holding point E5, Runway 04, contact Wuhan Tower, and tell controller you are ready for departure.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在 E5 等待点，跑道 04，联系武汉塔台并告诉管制员你准备好离场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA 308, holding point E5, Runway 04, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，SIA 308，E5 等待点，跑道 04，准备好离场。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 308, line up Runway 04 and cleared for immediate takeoff, traffic on final.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 308，进入跑道 04 并立即起飞，五边有航空器。
cards.referenceText: Roger, line up Runway 04 and cleared for immediate takeoff, SIA 308.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，进入跑道 04 并立即起飞，SIA 308。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are airborne, passing 600 meters, climbing to 1500 meters, contact Wuhan Departure and ask to cancel SID and proceed to ZF.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已离地，正通过 600 米，爬升至 1500 米，联系武汉离场并请求取消 SID，直飞 ZF。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, SIA 308, airborne, passing 600 meters, climbing to 1500 meters, request cancel SID and proceed to ZF.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，SIA 308，已离地，正通过 600 米，爬升至 1500 米，请求取消 SID，直飞 ZF。

cards.audioText: SIA 308, Wuhan Departure, radar contact, cancel SID, turn right, direct to ZF, climb to and maintain 4,500 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: SIA 308，武汉离场，雷达识别，取消 SID，右转直飞 ZF，爬升至并保持 4,500 米。
cards.referenceText: cancel SID, turn right, direct to ZF, climb to and maintain four thounsand 500 meters, SIA 308.
cards.referenceTextZh: 取消 SID，右转直飞 ZF，爬升至并保持 four thounsand 500 米，SIA 308。

cards.audioText: Now you are en route in Germany, Rhein Radar Control, you are cruising at FL360, make initial contact with Rhein Radar Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你正在德国航路上飞行，处于莱茵雷达管制区，巡航高度为 FL360，与莱茵雷达管制首次联系。
cards.referenceText: Rhein Radar, SIA 308, en route, cruising at FL360.
cards.referenceTextZh: 莱茵雷达，SIA 308，正在航路飞行，巡航高度 FL360。

cards.audioText: SIA 308, maintain FL360, offset 3 miles right of track due weather ahead.
cards.audioTextZh: SIA 308，保持 FL360，因前方天气向航迹右侧偏置 3 英里。
cards.referenceText: Maintaining FL360, offset tree miles right of track, SIA 308.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持 FL360，向航迹右侧偏置 3 英里，SIA 308。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have smoke in the cockpit, make a Distress call to Rhein Radar and request emergency descent to remove the smoke.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在驾驶舱有烟雾，向 Rhein Radar 发出遇险呼叫，请求紧急下降以排除烟雾。
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, Rhein Radar, SIA 308, we have smoke in the cockpit, request emergency descent for smoke removal.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，Rhein Radar，SIA 308，驾驶舱有烟雾，请求紧急下降以排烟。

cards.audioText:
C: SIA 308, roger MAYDAY, descend to and maintain FL100, keep us advised the situation on board and your intention.
B: read back the instructions and tell the controller you are working the checklist and will advise.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： SIA 308，收到 MAYDAY，下降至并保持 FL100，随时通报机上情况和你的意图。
B： 复诵指令，并告诉管制员你正在执行检查单，稍后报告。
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain FL110, we are working the checklist, will advise, SIA 308.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降至并保持 FL110，我们正在执行检查单，稍后报告，SIA 308。

cards.audioText: B: After completing the checklist, the smoke can't be removed and you decide to divert to Paris, inform the controller your situation and intention.
cards.audioTextZh: B：完成检查单后，烟雾无法消除，你决定备降巴黎，通知管制员你的情况和意图。
cards.referenceText: Rhein Radar, SIA 308, the smoke can't be removed, request divert to Paris.
cards.referenceTextZh: Rhein Radar，SIA 308，烟雾无法消除，请求备降巴黎。

cards.audioText: SIA 308, roger, turn left heading 350, descend to and maintain 8000 feet, contact Paris Approach on 119.4.
cards.audioTextZh: SIA 308，收到，左转航向 350，下降至并保持 8000 英尺，联系巴黎进近 119.4。
cards.referenceText: turn left heading 350, descend to and maintain 8000 feet, 119.4, SIA 308.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 350，下降至并保持 8000 英尺，119.4，SIA 308。

cards.audioText: SIA 308, descend to and maintain 6000 feet, cleared for ILS approach Runway 08L.
cards.audioTextZh: SIA 308，下降至并保持 6000 英尺，许可 ILS 进近 Runway 08L。
cards.referenceText: descend to and maintain 6000 feet, cleared for ILS approach Runway 08L, SIA 308.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降至并保持 6000 英尺，许可 ILS 进近 Runway 08L，SIA 308。

cards.audioText: Now you have landed on Runway 08L, but you missed the first rapid exit, report it to Paris Tower and request vacate via the second rapid exit.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已在 Runway 08L 落地，但错过了第一个快速脱离道，向巴黎塔台报告并请求经第二个快速脱离道脱离。
cards.referenceText: Paris Tower, SIA 308, we have missed the first rapid exit, request vacate via second rapid exit.
cards.referenceTextZh: 巴黎塔台，SIA 308，我们错过了第一个快速脱离道，请求经第二个快速脱离道脱离。

cards.audioText: SIA 308, roger, take second rapid exit, when vacated, contact Paris Ground on 118.5.
cards.audioTextZh: SIA 308，收到，使用第二个快速脱离道，脱离后联系巴黎地面 118.5。
cards.referenceText: Take second rapid exit, when vacated, contact Paris Ground on 118.5, SIA 308.
cards.referenceTextZh: 使用第二个快速脱离道，脱离后联系巴黎地面 118.5，SIA 308。

topics.name: SIA 323 发动机失效 积冰/防冰 TCAS机动

cards.audioText: Your call sign is SIA 323, a flight from Wuhan to SIA, you are at gate 215, with information C, request ATC clearance from Wuhan Delivery.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是 SIA 323，航班从武汉飞往 SIA，位于 215 号停机位，已收到 C 情报，向武汉放行请求空中交通管制许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, SIA 323, Gate 215, information C, request ATC clearance to SIA.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，SIA 323，215 号停机位，C 情报，请求飞往 SIA 的空中交通管制许可。

cards.audioText: SIA 323, Wuhan Delivery, cleared to SIA via flight planned route, departure Runway 36R, follow LKO-01 departure, initial climb 1,800 meters, cruising level 10,400 meters, departure frequency 119.7, squawk 3763.
cards.audioTextZh: SIA 323，武汉放行，许可按飞行计划航路飞往 SIA，离场使用 Runway 36R，执行 LKO-01 离场，初始爬升至 1,800 米，巡航高度 10,400 米，离场频率 119.7，应答机 3763。
cards.referenceText: cleared to SIA via flight planned route, departure Runway 36R, LKO-01 departure, 1800 meters, cruising level 10400 meters, 119.7, squawk 3763, SIA 323.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可按飞行计划航路飞往 SIA，离场使用 Runway 36R，执行 LKO-01 离场，1800 米，巡航高度 10400 米，119.7，应答机 3763，SIA 323。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for push back and start up, contact Wuhan Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你准备好推出和开车，联系武汉地面。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA 323, request push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，SIA 323，请求推出和开车。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 323, push back and start up approved, facing east.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 323，推出和开车批准，机头向东。
cards.referenceText: Push back and start up approved, facing east, SIA 323.
cards.referenceTextZh: 推出和开车批准，机头向东，SIA 323。

cards.audioText: During pushback, a ground truck has broken down ahead of you and blocked your way, you have stopped the aircraft, ask Wuhan Ground for a tug to tow the vehicle away.
cards.audioTextZh: 推出期间，前方一辆地面车辆发生故障并挡住去路。你已停住航空器，向武汉地面请求拖车将车辆拖走。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA 323, a ground truck has broken down ahead of us and blocked our way, we have stopped the aircraft, request a tug to tow the vehicle away.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，SIA 323，前方一辆地面车辆发生故障并挡住我们的去路，我们已停住航空器，请求拖车将车辆拖走。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 323, hold position, the tug will come soon.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 323，保持位置，牵引车很快会来。
cards.referenceText: Roger, hold position, SIA 323.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，保持位置，SIA 323。

cards.audioText: now you are at holding point Runway 36R, you notice the wind sock shows strong tailwind, ask Wuhan Tower to check the wind.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你位于 Runway 36R 等待点，发现风向袋显示强顺风，请武汉塔台检查风况。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA 323, holding point Runway 36R, the wind sock shows strong tailwind, request wind check.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，SIA 323，位于 Runway 36R 等待点，风向袋显示强顺风，请求检查风况。

cards.audioText:
C: SIA 323, wind 200 degrees, 8 meters per second.
B: the tailwind exceeds your takeoff limit, ask Wuhan Tower to change to Runway 18L for departure.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： SIA 323，风向 200 度，风速 8 米/秒。
B： 顺风超过你的起飞限制，请求武汉塔台改用 Runway 18L 离场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA 323, roger, the tailwind exceeds our takeoff limit, request change to Runway 18L.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，SIA 323，收到，顺风超过我们的起飞限制，请求改用 Runway 18L。

cards.audioText: SIA 323, taxi via A, A3, T and N to Runway 18L.
cards.audioTextZh: SIA 323，经 A、A3、T 和 N 滑行至 Runway 18L。
cards.referenceText: taxi via A, A3, T and N to Runway 18L, SIA 323.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 A、A3、T 和 N 滑行至 Runway 18L，SIA 323。

cards.audioText:
SIA 323, can you accept intersection departure from J Runway 18L?
tell the controller you can't accept it because of performance limitation and you need full length departure Runway 18L.
cards.audioTextZh:
SIA 323，能否接受从 J 进入 Runway 18L 做交叉口离场？
告诉管制员，因性能限制你不能接受，需要使用 Runway 18L 全跑道长度离场。
cards.referenceText: negative intersection departure from J due performance, request full length departure Runway 18L, SIA 323.
cards.referenceTextZh: 不行，因性能原因不能从 J 做交叉口离场，请求使用 Runway 18L 全跑道长度离场，SIA 323。

cards.audioText: SIA 323, roger, taxi via J, line up Runway 18L and backtrack.
cards.audioTextZh: SIA 323，收到，经 J 滑行，进入 Runway 18L 对正并反向滑行。
cards.referenceText: taxi via J, line up Runway 18L and backtrack, SIA 323.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 J 滑行，进入 Runway 18L 对正并反向滑行，SIA 323。

cards.audioText: Now you are holding short of Runway 18L, you are ready for departure.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你在 Runway 18L 外等待，已准备好离场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA 323, holding short of Runway 18L, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，SIA 323，在 Runway 18L 外等待，已准备好离场。

cards.audioText: now you are airborne, passing 600 meters, contact Wuhan Departure.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已升空，正通过 600 米，联系武汉离场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, SIA 323, passing 600 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，SIA 323，正通过 600 米。

cards.audioText: SIA 323, Wuhan Departure, radar contact, turn right, direct to WHA, climb to and maintain 3000 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: SIA 323，武汉离场，雷达已识别，右转直飞 WHA，爬升至并保持 3000 米。
cards.referenceText: turn right, direct to WHA, climb to and maintain 3000 meters, SIA 323.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转直飞 WHA，爬升至并保持 3000 米，SIA 323。

cards.audioText: B: During climb, you hear loud noise coming from the left engine, and the instrument shows the EGT of port engine exceeds temperature limit, report this situation to ATC and hold for check.
cards.audioTextZh: B：爬升过程中，你听到左发有巨大噪音，仪表显示左发 EGT 超温，向 ATC 报告情况并请求等待检查。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, SIA 323, we hear loud noise coming from the left engine, and the instrument shows the EGT of port engine exceeds temperature limit, request hold for check.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，SIA 323，我们听到左发有巨大噪音，仪表显示左发 EGT 超温，请求等待检查。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 323, hold at WHA VOR as published.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 323，按公布程序在 WHA VOR 等待。
cards.referenceText: Hold at WHA VOR as published, SIA 323.
cards.referenceTextZh: 按公布程序在 WHA VOR 等待，SIA 323。

cards.audioText: you have shut down the port engine, request leave the hold and return for landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 你已关停左发动机，请求退出等待并返场着陆。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, SIA 323, we have shut down the port engine, request leave the hold and return for landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，SIA 323，我们已关停左发动机，请求退出等待并返场着陆。

topics.name: SIA 223 起落架问题 TCAS机动 复飞

cards.audioText: Your call sign is SIA 223. You have an undercarriage problem, you'd like to go around, inform Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是 SIA 223。你的起落架出现问题，希望复飞，通知武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA 223, undercarriage problem, go around.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，SIA 223，起落架出现问题，复飞。

cards.audioText: SIA 223, climb and maintain 900 meters, turn left heading 330.
cards.audioTextZh: SIA 223，爬升至并保持 900 米，左转航向 330。
cards.referenceText: climbing to 900 meters, left turn heading 330, SIA 223.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升至 900 米，左转航向 330，SIA 223。

cards.audioText:
C: SIA 223, confirm you want to make another approach or join holding pattern?
B: Tell the controller you will have to hold for a while to sort out the problem.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： SIA 223，确认你希望再次进近还是加入等待航线？
B： 告诉管制员，你必须等待一段时间以排除故障。
cards.referenceText: request hold, sort out the problem, SIA 223.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求等待以排除故障，SIA 223。

cards.audioText: SIA 223, maintain 900 meters, direct to DAL A, contact approach 119.35.
cards.audioTextZh: SIA 223，保持 900 米，直飞 DAL A，联系进近 119.35。
cards.referenceText: maintain 900 meters, proceed to DAL A and contact approach on 119.35, SIA 223.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持 900 米，前往 DAL A，联系进近 119.35，SIA 223。

cards.audioText: now you are on emergency, you are unable to lower the nose gear, report it to Wuhan Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你处于紧急状态，无法放下前起落架，向武汉进近报告。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, SIA 223, emergency, unable to lower nose gear.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，SIA 223，紧急情况，无法放下前起落架。

cards.audioText:
C: SIA 223, roger, fly heading 080.
B: read back the instructions and tell the controller you would like to make a low pass for visual check.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： SIA 223，收到，飞航向 080。
B： 复诵指令，并告诉管制员你希望实施低空通场，以便进行目视检查。
cards.referenceText: heading 080, request low pass for visual check, SIA 223.
cards.referenceTextZh: 航向 080，请求低空通场进行目视检查，SIA 223。

cards.audioText: SIA 223, cleared low pass left of Runway 36R over the apron, expect Runway 04for emergency landing.
cards.audioTextZh: SIA 223，许可在 Runway 36R 左侧、机坪上空实施低空通场，预计使用 Runway 04 紧急着陆。
cards.referenceText: cleared low pass on the left side of Runway 36R over the apron, emergency landing Runway 04, SIA 223.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可在 Runway 36R 左侧、机坪上空实施低空通场，使用 Runway 04 紧急着陆，SIA 223。

cards.audioText: Tell Wuhan Tower you are turning onto the ILS for a low pass for Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 告诉武汉塔台，你正在切入 Runway 36R 的 ILS，以实施低空通场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA 223, ILS for a low pass Runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，SIA 223，正在切入 Runway 36R 的 ILS，以实施低空通场。

cards.audioText: SIA 223, Wuhan tower, report on final approach.
cards.audioTextZh: SIA 223，武汉塔台，最后进近时报告。
cards.referenceText: wilco, SIA 223.
cards.referenceTextZh: 照办，SIA 223。

cards.audioText: Now you are on short final.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你正在短五边。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA 223, short final.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，SIA 223，短五边。

cards.audioText: SIA 223, I say again, cleared low pass over the left of Runway 36R, I'll keep you advised.
cards.audioTextZh: SIA 223，我再说一遍，许可从 Runway 36R 左侧低空通场，我会随时向你通报。
cards.referenceText: roer, cleared low pass on the left hand side of runway, SIA 223.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，许可从跑道左侧低空通场，SIA 223。

cards.audioText:
C: SIA 223, the nose wheel doesn't appear to be down, say your intention.
B: Tell the controller you ask for touch and go and you intend to jar the wheel down.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： SIA 223，前轮看起来没有放下，报告你的意图。
B： 告诉管制员你请求接地复飞，并打算通过震动将机轮放下。
cards.referenceText: SIA 223, request touch and go, jar down.
cards.referenceTextZh: SIA 223，请求接地复飞，尝试通过震动将机轮放下。

cards.audioText: SIA 223, cleared touch and go, heading 330, report established.
cards.audioTextZh: SIA 223，许可接地复飞，航向 330，建立后报告。
cards.referenceText: cleared touch and go Runway 36R, turn left heading 330, SIA 223.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可在 Runway 36R 接地复飞，左转航向 330，SIA 223。

cards.audioText: you are going around, report it to Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: 你正在复飞，向武汉塔台报告。
cards.referenceText: SIA 223, going around.
cards.referenceTextZh: SIA 223，正在复飞。

cards.audioText: SIA 223, roger, climb and maintain 600 meters, heading 330.
cards.audioTextZh: SIA 223，收到，爬升至并保持 600 米，航向 330。
cards.referenceText: left turn heading 330, climb to 600 meters, SIA 223.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 330，爬升至 600 米，SIA 223。

cards.audioText: your nose wheel still appears to be jammed, tell the controller you have to make an emergency landing on Runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的前轮看起来仍然卡住，告诉管制员你必须在 Runway 04 紧急着陆。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA 223, nose wheel still appears to be jammed, we have to make an emergency landing Runway 04.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，SIA 223，前轮看起来仍然卡住，我们必须在 Runway 04 紧急着陆。

cards.audioText: SIA 223, cleared for emergency landing on Runway 04, the emergency group is ready.
cards.audioTextZh: SIA 223，许可在 Runway 04 紧急着陆，紧急救援组已就位。
cards.referenceText: roger, cleared for emergency landing on Runway 04, SIA 223.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，许可在 Runway 04 紧急着陆，SIA 223。

topics.name: AFR 113 左发失效 乘客中风

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is AFR 113, you're holding at holding point E1, Runway 04, you are fully ready.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 AFR 113，你在 E1 等待点，跑道 04，已完全准备好。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, AFR 113, holding at holding point E1, Runway 04, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，AFR 113，在 E1 等待点，跑道 04，准备好离场。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 113, hold at present position.
cards.audioTextZh: C：AFR 113，在当前位置等待。
cards.referenceText: Hold at present position, AFR 113.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在当前位置等待，AFR 113。

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 113, hold at present position, do you have the traffic on short final in sight?
B: Tell the controller yes.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：AFR 113，在当前位置等待，你看到短五边航空器了吗？
B：告诉管制员看到了。
cards.referenceText: Affirm, traffic in sight, AFR 113.
cards.referenceTextZh: 肯定，看到航空器，AFR 113。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 113, behind the CES 737 on short final, line up behind.
cards.audioTextZh: C：AFR 113，跟在短五边的 CES 737 后面，跟随其后进跑道。
cards.referenceText: Behind the CES 737 on short final, line up behind, AFR 113.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跟在短五边的 CES 737 后面，跟随其后进跑道，AFR 113。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 113, cleared for takeoff, when airborne, contact Departure 120.2.
cards.audioTextZh: C：AFR 113，可以起飞，离地后联系离场 120.2。
cards.referenceText: Cleared for takeoff, when airborne, contact Departure 120.2, AFR 113.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以起飞，离地后联系离场 120.2，AFR 113。

cards.audioText: B: You are passing 900 meters, contact Wuhan Departure, ask if you can cancel the SID and proceed to LKO.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你正通过 900 米，联系武汉离场，询问是否可以取消 SID 并直飞 LKO。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, AFR 113, passing 900 meters, request cancel the SID and proceed to LKO.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，AFR 113，正通过 900 米，请求取消 SID 并直飞 LKO。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 113, radar identified, continue climb to 2400 meters, turn right to LKO.
cards.audioTextZh: C：AFR 113，雷达识别，继续爬升至 2400 米，右转至 LKO。
cards.referenceText: Continue climb to 2400 meters, turn right to LKO, AFR 113.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续爬升至 2400 米，右转至 LKO，AFR 113。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 113, climb to 4500 meters and contact Wuhan Control 119.7.
cards.audioTextZh: C：AFR 113，爬升至 4500 米并联系武汉管制119.7。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 4500 meters and contact Wuhan Control 119.7, AFR 113.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升至 4500 米并联系武汉管制119.7，AFR 113。

cards.audioText: B: Your position is just over LKO, the next waypoint is DAPRO, ETA at time 34, make the standard position report and request climb.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的位置刚好在 LKO 上空，下一个航路点是 DAPRO，预计到达时间 34，做标准位置报告并请求爬升。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, AFR 113, over LKO, ETA DAPRO 34, request climb.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，AFR 113，飞越 LKO，预计 DAPRO 34，请求爬升。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 113, climb to 5100 meters, no speed restriction.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 113，爬升至5100米，无速度限制。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 5100 meters, no speed restriction, AFR 113.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升至5100米，无速度限制，AFR 113。

cards.audioText: B: During the climb, your port engine fails, tell the controller this situation and you would like to return to land.
cards.audioTextZh: 爬升过程中左发失效，请向管制员报告情况并申请返航着陆。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Control, AFR 113, our port engine fails, request return to land.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，武汉管制，AFR 113，我们左发失效，申请返航着陆。

cards.audioText: C: Roger PAN, AFR 113, descend to 1800 meters, turn right heading 360.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：收到紧急信号，AFR 113，下降至1800米，右转航向360。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 1800 meters, turn right heading 360, AFR 113.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降至1800米，右转航向360，AFR 113。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 113, contact Approach 119.85.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 113，联系进近119.85。

cards.audioText: B: Your altitude is 1800 meters, you have information S, contact Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 你当前高度1800米，已收到通播S，请联系进近。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR 113, 1800 meters, information S.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，AFR 113，1800米，通播S。

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 113, current information is T, descend to 900 meters, expect radar vectors for ILS Runway 36L.
B: Read back and ask to use Runway 36R to land due to performance limitations.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 113，当前通播为T，下降至900米，预计雷达引导ILS进近36左跑道。请复诵，并因性能限制申请使用36右跑道落地。
cards.referenceText: Information T, descend to 900 meters, expect radar vectors for ILS Runway 36L, request Runway 36R due performance, AFR 113.
cards.referenceTextZh: 通播T，下降至900米，预计雷达引导ILS进近36L；因性能限制申请36R，AFR 113。

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 113, change landing Runway 36R.
B: You have just got the information from the cabin that 1 of your passengers suffered a stroke during the incident, informed the controller and ask for ambulance after landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 113，改为36右跑道落地。你刚从客舱获知，一名旅客在事件中突发中风，请通知管制员并申请落地后救护车保障。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR 113, 1 of our passengers suffered stroke, request ambulance after landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，AFR 113，我们有一名旅客中风，申请落地后救护车保障。

cards.audioText: C: Roger, AFR 113, we will notify airport medical assistance, now turn left heading 330, descend to 600 meters, cleared ILS approach Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：收到，AFR 113，我们会通知机场医疗保障。现在左转航向330，下降至600米，可以ILS进近36右跑道。
cards.referenceText: Roger, thanks, turn left heading 330, descend to 600 meters, cleared ILS approach Runway 36R, AFR 113.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，左转航向330，下降至600米，可以ILS进近36R，AFR 113。

cards.audioText: B: Report that you have intercepted the localizer for Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 报告你已截获36右跑道航向道。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR 113, established on the localizer Runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，AFR 113，已建立36R航向道。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 113, contact Tower 124.35.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 113，联系塔台124.35。

topics.name: AFR 782 厕所冒烟 作PA 乘客烟熏

cards.audioText: B: You are the pilot of AFR 782 which is bound for Wuhan, you have just been handed over from Guangzhou Control, you are over DAPRO at time 35 and your level is 9500 meters, call Wuhan Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 你是飞往武汉的AFR 782，刚由广州管制移交，35分过DAPRO，高度9500米，请呼叫武汉管制。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, AFR 782, over DAPRO at 35, maintain 9500 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，AFR 782，35分过DAPRO，保持9500米。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 782, Wuhan Control, radar identified, descend to 5100 meters before reaching LKO.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 782，武汉管制，雷达识别，在到达LKO前下降至5100米。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 5100 meters before LKO, AFR 782.
cards.referenceTextZh: 到LKO前下降至5100米，AFR 782。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are over LKO at 5100 meters, you have copied the latest ATIS K, call Wuhan Approach control.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你在LKO上空，高度5100米，已收到最新通播K，请呼叫武汉进近。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR 782, maintaining 5100 meters, over LKO, information K.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，AFR 782，保持5100米，过LKO，通播K。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 782, Wuhan Approach, radar contact, follow LKO-1A arrival, descend and maintain 3300 meters on QNH 1004.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 782，武汉进近，雷达联系，执行LKO-1A 进场，按QNH 1004下降并保持3300米。
cards.referenceText: Follow LKO-1A arrival, descend and maintain 3300 meters on QNH 1004, AFR 782.
cards.referenceTextZh: 执行LKO-1A 进场，按QNH 1004下降并保持3300米，AFR 782。

cards.audioText: B: You've received a report from the flight attendant saying that there is smoke coming from the lavatory, you think it may develop into fire, so you declare distress to the ATC.
cards.audioTextZh: 乘务员报告洗手间有烟，你认为可能发展成火情，因此向空管宣布遇险。
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, Wuhan Approach, AFR 782, there is smoke coming from the lavatory, request priority landing and emergency services.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，武汉进近，AFR 782，洗手间有烟，申请优先落地和应急保障。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 782, Wuhan Approach, roger MAYDAY, turn right heading 040, descend to 2100 meters, radar vector to ILS approach Runway 36R, you have first priority.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 782，武汉进近，收到遇险信号，右转航向040，下降至2100米，雷达引导ILS进近36右跑道，你享有第一优先。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 040, descend to 2100 meters, radar vector to ILS approach Runway 36R, AFR 782.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向040，下降至2100米，雷达引导ILS进近36R，AFR 782。

cards.audioText: B: As the captain of the flight, you may want to make a passenger address. The PA may include: don't be panic, remain seated, the flight crew are experienced, ATC assistance is available to us, etc.
cards.audioTextZh: 作为机长，你可以向旅客广播。内容可包括：不要惊慌、保持就座、机组经验丰富、空管正在提供协助等。
cards.referenceText: Ladies and gentlemen, this is your captain speaking, fasten your seatbelt and remain seated. Don't worry. Believe us, we are a very experienced flight crew, and we can control this situation, and air controller is ready to help us.
cards.referenceTextZh: 女士们、先生们，我是机长。请系好安全带并保持就座。请不要担心，相信我们，机组经验丰富，能够控制当前情况，空管也已准备好协助我们。

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 782, Wuhan Approach, what is the situation on board now? keep us advised.
B: You are grateful for the reminding, report to ATC that more smoke accumulated in the passenger cabin and the passengers are coughing hard.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 782，武汉进近，目前机上情况如何？请随时通报。感谢提醒，并向空管报告客舱内烟雾越来越浓，旅客咳嗽严重。
cards.referenceText: Roger, the smoke is becoming more and more dense in the passenger cabin and the passengers are coughing more and more, AFR 782.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，客舱内烟雾越来越浓，旅客咳嗽越来越严重，AFR 782。

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 782, Wuhan Approach, continue to descend to 1200 meters on QNH 1005, fire service and ambulance will be with you upon your landing.
B: You are required to read back the clearance and show your gratitude.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 782，武汉进近，按QNH 1005继续下降至1200米，消防和救护车将在你落地时待命。请复诵许可并表示感谢。
cards.referenceText: Continue to descend to 1200 meters on QNH 1005, thank you very much, AFR 782.
cards.referenceTextZh: 按QNH 1005继续下降至1200米，非常感谢，AFR 782。

cards.audioText: B: Now you report to ATC that you have already removed the dense smoke, 2 aged people and 1 baby are nearly suffocated, others are not seriously harmed.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在向空管报告，你们已经排除了浓烟，但两名老人和一名婴儿接近窒息，其他人没有严重受伤。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR 782, we have removed the dense smoke, but 2 aged people and 1 baby are nearly suffocated, others are not seriously harmed.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，AFR 782，我们已排除浓烟，但两名老人和一名婴儿接近窒息，其他人没有严重受伤。

cards.audioText:
C: Roger, we'll relay this information to the parties concerned.
C: AFR 782, descend to 900 meters, expect ILS approach Runway 36R, you are Number 1.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：收到，我们会把信息转告相关单位。管制员：AFR 782，下降至900米，预计ILS进近36右跑道，你是第一架。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 900 meters, expect ILS approach Runway 36R, AFR 782.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降至900米，预计ILS进近36R，AFR 782。

cards.audioText: B: You are fully established on the ILS Runway 36R and your position is 12 Kilometers from touchdown, call Wuhan Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 你已完全建立36右跑道ILS，距离接地点12公里，请呼叫武汉进近。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR 782, established on the ILS Runway 36R, 12 km from touchdown.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，AFR 782，已建立36R ILS，距接地点12公里。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 782, continue approach and contact Tower 118.6, good day.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 782，继续进近，联系塔台118.6，再见。
cards.referenceText: Continue approach, 118.6, AFR 782.

cards.audioText: B: Now contact Wuhan Tower, report to ATC that you are 11 Kilometers from touchdown on final, and you are emergency landing aircraft.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在联系武汉塔台，向空管报告你在五边，距接地点11公里，并且是紧急落地航空器。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, AFR 782, 11 km on final, we have declared emergency.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，AFR 782，五边11公里，我们已宣布紧急情况。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 782, radar identified, continue ILS approach Runway 36R, you are Number 1, report outer marker.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 782，雷达识别，继续ILS进近36右跑道，你是第一架，报告外指点标。
cards.referenceText: Continue ILS approach Runway 36R, report outer marker, AFR 782.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续ILS进近36R，报告外指点标，AFR 782。

cards.audioText: B: Now you're over outer marker, call Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你飞越外指点标，请呼叫武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, AFR 782, over outer marker.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，AFR 782，飞越外指点标。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 782, cleared to land Runway 36R, wind 340 degrees at 9 meters per second, QNH 1005.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 782，可以36右跑道落地，风向340度，风速9米/秒，QNH 1005。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to land Runway 36R, QNH 1005, AFR 782.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以36R落地，QNH 1005，AFR 782。

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 782, taxi to Number 5 Apron via taxiway E3, A, A8, the fire services and medical teams are waiting for you on the Apron.
B: You are required to read back the clearance and show your gratitude.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 782，经滑行道E3、A、A8滑行至5号机坪，消防和医疗队已在机坪等待。请复诵许可并表示感谢。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to No.5 Apron via taxiway E3, A, A8, thank you very much, AFR 782.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道E3、A、A8滑行至5号机坪，非常感谢，AFR 782。

topics.name: AFR 941 右EGT波动 滑油压力下降 右发失效

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is AFR 941, you are descending through 3900 meters for 3600 meters, contact Wuhan Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是AFR 941，正在从3900米下降至3600米，请联系武汉进近。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR 941, leaving 3900 meters for 3600 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，AFR 941，离开3900米下降至3600米。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 941, Wuhan Approach, radar identified, information E is current, descend to and maintain 3000 meters on QNH 1004.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 941，武汉进近，雷达识别，当前通播为E，按QNH 1004下降并保持3000米。
cards.referenceText: Information E, descend to and maintain 3000 meters on QNH 1004, AFR 941.
cards.referenceTextZh: 通播E，按QNH 1004下降并保持3000米，AFR 941。

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 941, descend and maintain 2400 meters, reduce to minimum clean speed.
B: Read back the instruction and tell the controller that the clean configuration speed of your aircraft is 200 knots.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 941，下降并保持2400米，减至最小光洁速度。请复诵指令，并告诉管制员你机型的光洁形态速度是200节。
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 2400 meters, reduce to minimum clean speed, our clean configuration speed is 200 knots, AFR 941.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降并保持2400米，减至最小光洁速度，我们的光洁形态速度是200节，AFR 941。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 941, turn right heading 300, you are number 3, 25 miles from touchdown.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 941，右转航向300，你是第三架，距接地点25海里。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 300, roger, AFR 941.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向300，收到，AFR 941。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 941, turn left proceed direct DA, descend to and maintain 2100 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 941，左转直飞DA，下降并保持2100米。
cards.referenceText: Turn left proceed direct DA, descend to and maintain 2100 meters, AFR 941.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转直飞DA，下降并保持2100米，AFR 941。

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 941, hold at DA as published.
B: Read back and ask the reason for holding.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 941，在DA按公布程序等待。请复诵并询问等待原因。
cards.referenceText: Hold at DA as published, what's the reason for holding? AFR 941.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在DA按公布程序等待，请问等待原因？AFR 941。

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 941, there are having a runway inspection at the moment, expect to delay more than 15 minutes.
B: Read back the ATC instruction and report that you are entering the hold.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 941，目前正在进行跑道检查，预计延误超过15分钟。请复诵空管指令，并报告你正在进入等待。
cards.referenceText: Roger, we are entering the hold, AFR 941.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，我们正在进入等待，AFR 941。

cards.audioText: B: The EGT of your starboard engine is fluctuating, state the situation to the controller, ask to leave the holding pattern right away.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的右发排气温度波动，请向管制员说明情况，并申请立即脱离等待程序。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR 941, the EGT of our starboard engine is fluctuating, request leave the holding pattern immediately.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，AFR 941，我们右发排气温度波动，申请立即脱离等待程序。

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 941, roger, stand by, continue your hold, we're changing the landing sequence, expect call you in 2 minutes.
B: The oil pressure of your starboard engine is rapidly decreasing, state the situation to the controller, request immediate exit and request descent.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 941，收到，请稍等，继续等待。我们正在调整落地顺序，预计2分钟后呼叫你。你的右发滑油压力正在快速下降，请向管制员说明情况，申请立即退出等待并下降。
cards.referenceText: The oil pressure of our starboard engine is rapidly decreasing, request immediate exit and descent, AFR 941.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们右发滑油压力正在快速下降，申请立即退出等待并下降，AFR 941。

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 941, stand by, a traffic at your 3 o'clock position, is maintaining 1800 meters, crossing from your right to the left, report visual.
B: Tell the controller you have seen the conflicting aircraft.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 941，请稍等。你三点钟方向有冲突飞机，保持1800米，从你右侧向左侧穿越，看到请报告。告诉管制员你已看到冲突飞机。
cards.referenceText: Traffic in sight, AFR 941.
cards.referenceTextZh: 看到该飞机，AFR 941。

cards.audioText: B: Your starboard engine has failed, make an Urgency call and ask for landing priority.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的右发已经失效，请发出紧急信号并申请优先落地。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Approach, AFR 941, our starboard engine has failed, request priority landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，武汉进近，AFR 941，我们右发失效，申请优先落地。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 941, roger PAN, turn left heading 060, descend to 900 meters, cleared ILS approach Runway 36L.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 941，收到紧急信号，左转航向060，下降至900米，可以ILS进近36左跑道。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 060, descend to 900 meters, cleared ILS approach Runway 36L, AFR 941.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向060，下降至900米，可以ILS进近36L，AFR 941。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 941, contact Wuhan Tower, frequency 124.35, goodbye.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 941，联系武汉塔台，频率124.35，再见。

cards.audioText: B: Your heading is 060 and your altitude is 900 meters, contact Wuhan Tower and tell him about the condition of the aircraft.
cards.audioTextZh: 你当前航向060，高度900米，请联系武汉塔台并说明飞机状况。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, AFR 941, heading 060, 900 meters, our starboard engine has failed, request priority landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，AFR 941，航向060，900米，我们右发失效，申请优先落地。

cards.audioText: C: Roger, AFR 941, maintain present heading.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：收到，AFR 941，保持当前航向。
cards.referenceText: Maintain present heading, AFR 941.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持当前航向，AFR 941。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 941, turn left heading 030 to intercept the localizer for Runway 36L.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 941，左转航向030，截获36左跑道航向道。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 030 to intercept the localizer for Runway 36L, AFR 941.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向030，截获36L航向道，AFR 941。

cards.audioText: B: Report you have established localizer Runway 36L.
cards.audioTextZh: 报告你已建立36左跑道航向道。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, AFR 941, established localizer Runway 36L.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，AFR 941，已建立36L航向道。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 941, cleared to land.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 941，可以落地。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to land, AFR 941.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以落地，AFR 941。

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is AFR 126, destination Beijing, 8900 meters maintaining, over TMR, TZH10, squawk 6021, now contact Beijing Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是AFR 126，目的地北京，保持8900米，过TMR，TZH 10，squawk 6021，现在联系北京管制。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, AFR 126, 8900m maintaining, over TMR, TZH 10, squawk 6021.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，AFR 126，保持8900米，过TMR，TZH 10，squawk 6021。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 126, Beijing Control, squawk 6021, radar contact, negative short cut, over fly TZH due to Air Force activity.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 126，北京管制，squawk 6021，雷达联系。因空军活动，不能直飞，需飞越TZH。
cards.referenceText: Radar contact, over fly TZH due to Air Force movement, AFR 126.
cards.referenceTextZh: 雷达联系，因空军活动飞越TZH，AFR 126。

cards.audioText: B: Ask the controller which runway is in use.
cards.audioTextZh: 询问管制员当前使用跑道。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, AFR 126, request runway in use.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，AFR 126，请问使用跑道。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 126, expect KM-01 arrival, runway in use 36L.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 126，预计KM-01 进场，使用跑道36左。
cards.referenceText: Expect KM-01 arrival, Runway 36L, AFR 126.
cards.referenceTextZh: 预计KM-01 进场，使用跑道36L，AFR 126。

cards.audioText: B: Ask whether you can use KM-03 arrival and land on Runway 01.
cards.audioTextZh: 询问是否可以使用KM-03 进场并在01跑道落地。
cards.referenceText: If available, request KM-03 arrival, land on Runway 01, AFR 126.
cards.referenceTextZh: 如可用，申请KM-03 进场，01跑道落地，AFR 126。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 126, after KM, you can request Beijing Approach for change of runway.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 126，过KM后可以向北京进近申请更换跑道。
cards.referenceText: After KM, request change runway, AFR 126.
cards.referenceTextZh: 过KM后申请更换跑道，AFR 126。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 126, descend to and maintain 4500 meters over KM.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 126，过KM下降并保持4500米。
cards.referenceText: Descend to and maintain 4500 meters over KM, AFR 126.
cards.referenceTextZh: 过KM下降并保持4500米，AFR 126。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 126, contact Beijing Approach 119.7, good day.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 126，联系北京进近119.7，再见。
cards.referenceText: 119.7, good day, AFR 126.

cards.audioText: B: Over KM, maintaining 4500 meters, contact Beijing Approach and request Runway 01, KM-03 arrival.
cards.audioTextZh: 过KM，保持4500米，联系北京进近并申请01跑道、KM-03 进场。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, AFR 126, over KM, 4500 meters maintaining, request Runway 01 KM-03 arrival.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，AFR 126，过KM，保持4500米，申请01跑道KM-03 进场。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 126, negative due to spacing, KM-01 arrival, runway in use 36L, information A.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 126，因间隔原因不能同意。执行KM-01 进场，使用跑道36左，通播A。
cards.referenceText: KM-01 arrival, runway in use 36L, information A, AFR 126.
cards.referenceTextZh: KM-01 进场，使用跑道36L，通播A，AFR 126。

cards.audioText: B: Tell the controller that your flap has some problem.
cards.audioTextZh: 告诉管制员你的襟翼有故障。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, AFR 126, we're having trouble with our flaps.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，AFR 126，我们襟翼有故障。

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 126, roger, say intention.
B: You have to hold for a check.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 126，收到，报告意图。你需要等待检查。
cards.referenceText: Request holing for a check, AFR 126.
cards.referenceTextZh: 申请等待检查，AFR 126。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 126, descend to and maintain 3000 meters on QNH 1012, turn left direct to HUR, hold as published.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 126，按QNH 1012下降并保持3000米，左转直飞HUR，按公布程序等待。
cards.referenceText: Descend to and maintain 3000 meters on QNH 1012, turn left direct to HUR, hold as published, AFR 126.
cards.referenceTextZh: 按QNH 1012下降并保持3000米，左转直飞HUR，按公布程序等待，AFR 126。

cards.audioText: B: Operations are now normal, request landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 操作已恢复正常，申请落地。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, AFR 126, operations are now normal, request landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，AFR 126，操作已恢复正常，申请落地。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 126, Beijing Approach, continue holding, runway is being cleaned due thick snow, landing action poor.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 126，北京进近，继续等待。因大雪，跑道正在清扫，着陆性能差。
cards.referenceText: Holding position, AFR 126.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持等待，AFR 126。

cards.audioText: B: There is something wrong with the nose wheel steering system, request a tug after landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 前轮转弯系统故障，申请落地后牵引车。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, AFR 126, request a tug after landing, our nose wheel steering system failed.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，AFR 126，前轮转弯系统失效，申请落地后牵引车。

cards.audioText:
C: Roger, AFR 126, is there anything else abnormal?
B: Other systems normal, ask the controller how long the delay is.
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：收到，AFR 126，还有其他异常吗？
其他系统正常，询问管制员延误多久。
cards.referenceText: Negative, other systems normal, how long is the delay? AFR 126.
cards.referenceTextZh: 没有，其他系统正常，请问延误多久？AFR 126。

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 126, snow is getting heavier, you have to hold about 1 hour.
B: The remaining fuel can hold for half hour, you have to request diversion.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 126，雪越来越大，你们需要等待约1小时。剩余油量只能等待半小时，你必须申请备降。
cards.referenceText: Our endurance is 30 minutes, request  diversion, AFR 126.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们续航时间30分钟，申请备降，AFR 126。

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 126, stand by.
B: Your fuel temperature indicates
abnormal, you can only hold 10 minutes, request diversion to Dalian airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 126，请稍等。你的燃油温度指示异常，只能再等待10分钟，申请备降大连机场。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, AFR 126, our fuel temperature indicates abnormal,  endurance only 10 minutes, request divert to Dalian airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，AFR 126，我们燃油温度指示异常，续航只剩10分钟，申请备降大连机场。

cards.audioText: C: Standby 1, we will ask Air Force to use a temporary route.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：请稍等，我们将向空军申请使用临时航路。
cards.referenceText: Roger, AFR 126.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，AFR 126。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 126, climb to and maintain 8100 meters on standard.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 126，按标准气压爬升并保持8100米。
cards.referenceText: Climb to and maintain 8100 meters on standard, AFR 126.
cards.referenceTextZh: 按标准气压爬升并保持8100米，AFR 126。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 126, direct to Dalian airport, contact Beijing Control 120.35.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 126，直飞大连机场，联系北京管制120.35。
cards.referenceText: Direct to Dalian airport, 120.35, AFR 126.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞大连机场，120.35，AFR 126。

topics.name: AFR 101 携带爆炸物 伤2人

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is AFR 101, your destination is Paris, you are going to depart from Beijing airport at Gate 301. Now call Beijing Delivery, and request ATC clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是AFR 101，目的地巴黎，准备从北京机场301号登机口出发。现在呼叫北京放行，申请空管放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Delivery, AFR 101, Gate 301, request ATC clearance to Paris.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京放行，AFR 101，301号登机口，申请前往巴黎的空管放行许可。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 101, cleared to Paris via flight planned route, initial climb 6600 meters, RENOB-32 departure, request level change for 10400 meters en route, squawk 1725, Runway 36R, departure frequency 127.75.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 101，按计划航路放行至巴黎，初始爬升至6600米，RENOB-32 离场，航路中申请改平10400米，squawk 1725，36右跑道，离场频率127.75。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Paris via flight planned route, initially climb to 6600 meters, RENOB-32 departure, request level change for 10400 meters en route, squawk 1725, Runway 36R, departure frequency 127.75, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 按计划航路放行至巴黎，初始爬升至6600米，RENOB-32 离场，航路中申请改平10400米，squawk 1725，36R跑道，离场频率127.75，AFR 101。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 101, correct, contact Ground 121.9 for pushback and startup.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 101，正确，联系地面121.9申请推出和开车。

cards.audioText: B: Contact Ground 121.9 for pushback and startup.
cards.audioTextZh: 联系地面121.9申请推出和开车。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, AFR 101, Gate 301, request pushback and startup.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，AFR 101，301号登机口，申请推出和开车。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 101, Beijing Ground, short delay for pushback, an Airbus 340 inbound for Gate 302.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 101，北京地面，推出稍有延误，一架Airbus 340正进302号登机口。
cards.referenceText: Roger, stand by, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，等待，AFR 101。

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 101, pushback approved.
B: Ask ATC the direction of pushback.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 101，可以推出。询问空管推出方向。
cards.referenceText: Roger, in which direction should we pushback? AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，请问推出方向？AFR 101。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 101, my apologies, pushback and startup approved, facing east.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 101，抱歉，可以推出和开车，机头向东。
cards.referenceText: Pushback and startup approved, facing east, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以推出和开车，机头向东，AFR 101。

cards.audioText: B: All engines have been started, everything checked out normal, received information G, request taxi for Beijing Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: 所有发动机已启动，各项检查正常，已收到通播G，向北京地面申请滑行。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, AFR 101, information G, ready for taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，AFR 101，通播G，准备好滑行。

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 101, information G changed, intersection departure from H is available.
B: Report that you have received H but you want to change Runway 01 for a short course.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 101，通播已变为H，可从H交叉口离场。报告已收到H，但因航程较短，希望改用01跑道。
cards.referenceText: Roger, information H received, request Runway 01 for a short course, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，已收到通播H，申请01跑道，因航程较短，AFR 101。

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 101, roger, Boeing 737 inbound approaching from left for Gate 303, once that aircraft is cleared, taxi via B and D, hold short of Runway 01.
B: You received report from information H that B is closed.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 101，收到。一架Boeing 737从左侧进近303号登机口，待该机通过后，经B和D滑行，01跑道外等待。你从通播H获知B关闭。
cards.referenceText: Indications say that taxiway B is closed, confirm taxi via B, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 通播显示滑行道B关闭，请确认是否经B滑行，AFR 101。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 101, correction taxi via M and D, hold short of Runway 01.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 101，更正，经M和D滑行，01跑道外等待。
cards.referenceText: Taxi via M and D, hold short of Runway 01, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经M和D滑行，01跑道外等待，AFR 101。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are airborne. Contact Beijing Departure, you are passing 1200 meters and climbing to 1800 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已离地。联系北京离场，报告正在通过1200米爬升至1800米。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Departure, AFR 101, passing 1200 meters and climbing to 1800 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京离场，AFR 101，正在通过1200米爬升至1800米。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 101, Beijing Departure, identified, climb to 6000 meters on standard.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 101，北京离场，雷达识别，按标准气压爬升至6000米。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 6000 meters on standard, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 按标准气压爬升至6000米，AFR 101。

cards.audioText: B: Flight attendant reports that there is a man carrying explosives on his body and attempting to detonate them. Require emergency descent to 3000 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 乘务员报告一名男子身上携带爆炸物并试图引爆。请求紧急下降至3000米。
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, Beijing Departure, AFR 101, flight attendant reports that there is a man carrying explosives on his body and attempting to detonate them, request descent to 3000 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，北京离场，AFR 101，乘务员报告一名男子身上携带爆炸物并试图引爆，申请下降至3000米。

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 101, roger, descend to 3000 meters on QNH 1011, say endurance.
B: Read back and report that you can hold for 2 hours more.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 101，收到，按QNH 1011下降至3000米，报告续航时间。请复诵并报告还能等待2小时。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 3000 meters on QNH 1011, endurance 0200, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 按QNH 1011下降至3000米，续航0200，AFR 101。

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 101, divert immediately to Tongzhou.
B: Request radar vector to Tongzhou.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 101，立即备降通州。申请雷达引导至通州。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, AFR 101, request reader vector to Tongzhou.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，AFR 101，申请雷达引导至通州。

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 101, turn right heading 180, maintain 3000 meters. When able, report current conditions on board.
B: Read back and then give a report that the dangerous man is still struggling and has hurt 2 passengers.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 101，右转航向180，保持3000米。条件允许时报告机上当前情况。请复诵，并报告危险男子仍在挣扎，已伤及两名旅客。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 180, maintain 3000 metres, the dangerous man is still struggling and has hurt 2 passengers, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向180，保持3000米，危险男子仍在挣扎，已伤及两名旅客，AFR 101。

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 101, roger, say intentions.
B: Tell the ATC that the man has finally surrendered, the 2 passengers are in dangerous situation, request return to Beijing airport and priority landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 101，收到，报告意图。告诉空管该男子已被控制，两名旅客情况危急，申请返回北京机场并优先落地。
cards.referenceText: The man is under control, request return to Beijing airport and priority landing, 2 passengers are in dangerous situation, Request medical assistance on arrival, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 该男子已被控制，申请返回北京机场并优先落地，两名旅客情况危急，请求到达后医疗协助，AFR 101。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 101, roger. Cleared Runway 18R, you are number 1. Police officers and medical services will be ready on arrival.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 101，收到。可以18右跑道落地，你是第一架。警方和医疗保障将在到达时待命。
cards.referenceText: Cleared Runway 18R, thanks, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以18R落地，谢谢，AFR 101。

topics.name: AFR 101 中度积冰 左发失效

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is AFR 101, you are at Wuhan Airport, at Gate 215, information G received, request ATC clearance to Paris.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是AFR 101，位于武汉机场215号登机口，已收到通播G，申请前往巴黎的空管放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, AFR 101, gate 215, information G, request ATC clearance to Paris.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，AFR 101，215号登机口，通播G，申请前往巴黎的空管放行许可。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 101, cleared to Paris via flight planned route, LKO-01 departure, initial climb to 1800 meters, cruising level 10700 meters, Runway 04, contact departure on 119.7, squawk 2521.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 101，按计划航路放行至巴黎，LKO-01 离场，初始爬升至1800米，巡航高度10700米，04跑道，离场联系119.7，squawk 2521。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Paris via flight planned route, LKO-01 departure, initial climb to 1800 meters, cruising level 10700 meters, Runway 04, contact departure on 119.7, squawk 2521, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 按计划航路放行至巴黎，LKO-01 离场，初始爬升至1800米，巡航高度10700米，04跑道，离场联系119.7，squawk 2521，AFR 101。

cards.audioText: B: You decide 10700 meters is not acceptable due to heavy weight, ask if 9500 meters is available.
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为因重量较大，10700米不可接受，询问9500米是否可用。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, AFR 101, 10700 meters is not acceptable due to heavy weight, is 9500 meters available ?
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，AFR 101，因重量较大，10700米不可接受，请问9500米是否可用？

cards.audioText: C: AFR 101, cleared cruising level 9500 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 101，巡航高度改为9500米。
cards.referenceText: Cleared cruising level 9500 meters, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 巡航高度9500米，AFR 101。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for push back and start up, contact Ground control.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已准备好推出和开车，请联系地面管制。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, AFR 101, request push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，AFR 101，申请推出和开车。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 101, push back and start up approved, facing east.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 101，可以推出和开车，机头向东。
cards.referenceText: Push back and start up approved, facing east, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以推出和开车，机头向东，AFR 101。

cards.audioText: B: You are now on taxiway Z4 with your engines running, ask Ground control for taxi instructions.
cards.audioTextZh: 你现在在Z4滑行道，发动机已启动，请向地面管制申请滑行指令。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, AFR 101, taxiway Z4, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，AFR 101，Z4滑行道，申请滑行。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 101, taxi to holding point Runway 04 via taxiway Z4 and A, hold short of A4.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 101，经滑行道Z4和A滑行至04跑道等待点，A4外等待。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point Runway 04 via taxiway Z4 and A, hold short of A4, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道Z4和A滑行至04跑道等待点，A4外等待，AFR 101。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 101, give way to the Boeing 737 vacating on E3, after traffic is clear, continue taxi via taxiway A and A9, hold short of Runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 101，让行正在E3脱离的Boeing 737，冲突消除后，继续经滑行道A和A9滑行，04跑道外等待。
cards.referenceText: Give way to the B737 vacating on E3, after traffic is clear, continue taxi via taxiway A and A9, hold short of Runway 04, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 让行正在E3脱离的B737，冲突消除后继续经滑行道A和A9滑行，04跑道外等待，AFR 101。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are airborne at 600 meters climbing, contact Departure.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已离地，600米爬升中，请联系离场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, AFR 101, airborne, 600 meters climbing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，AFR 101，已离地，600米爬升中。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 101, radar contact, turn left, direct to DA, climb to 3000 meters on QNH 1015.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 101，雷达联系，左转直飞DA，按QNH 1015爬升至3000米。
cards.referenceText: Turn left, direct to DA, climb to 3000 meters on QNH 1015, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转直飞DA，按QNH 1015爬升至3000米，AFR 101。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 101, climb to and maintain 6000 meters, expedite until passing 3900 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 101，爬升并保持6000米，通过3900米前加快爬升。
cards.referenceText: Climb to and maintain 6000 meters, expedite until passing  3900 meters, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升并保持6000米，通过3900米前加快爬升，AFR 101。

cards.audioText: B: You are experiencing moderate icing while maintaining 6000 meters, request higher level and state the reason.
cards.audioTextZh: 保持6000米时遇到中度结冰，请申请更高高度并说明原因。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, AFR 101, we are experiencing moderate icing at 6000 meters, request higher level.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，AFR 101，我们在6000米遇到中度结冰，申请更高高度。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 101, negative due traffic, maintain 6000 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 101，因冲突飞机不能同意，保持6000米。
cards.referenceText: Roger, maintain 6000 meters, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，保持6000米，AFR 101。

cards.audioText: B: Suddenly, your left engine failed at 6000 meters, make an Urgency call to ATC and request descent and return to Wuhan Airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 突然，你的左发在6000米失效，请向空管发出紧急信号并申请下降、返回武汉机场。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Departure, AFR 101, our left engine failed at 6000 meters, request descent and return to Wuhan Airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，武汉离场，AFR 101，我们左发在6000米失效，申请下降并返回武汉机场。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 101, roger your PAN call, descend to 4200 meters, turn left heading 010, expect radar vectors for Runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 101，收到你的紧急呼叫，下降至4200米，左转航向010，预计雷达引导至04跑道。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 4200 meters, turn left heading 010, expect radar vectors for Runway 04, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降至4200米，左转航向010，预计雷达引导至04跑道，AFR 101。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 101, continue descent to 3000 meters on QNH 1015.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 101，按QNH 1015继续下降至3000米。
cards.referenceText: Continue descent to 3000 meters on QNH 1015, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 按QNH 1015继续下降至3000米，AFR 101。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have successfully restarted the left engine, but you still decide to return to Wuhan for safety concerns, inform ATC about the current situation and cancel the Urgency call.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已成功重启左发，但出于安全考虑仍决定返回武汉，请告知空管当前情况并取消紧急状态。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR 101, cancel urgency, we have restarted our left engine, but we still want to return to land for safety concerns.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，AFR 101，取消紧急状态，我们已重启左发，但出于安全考虑仍希望返回落地。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are established on the ILS approach Runway 04, contact Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已建立04跑道ILS进近，请联系武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, AFR 101, established on the ILS approach Runway 04.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，AFR 101，已建立04跑道ILS进近。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 101, surface wind 070 degrees, 5 meters per second, Runway 04, cleared to land.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 101，地面风070度，5米/秒，04跑道，可以落地。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to land Runway 04, AFR 101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以04跑道落地，AFR 101。

topics.name: AFR 675 襟翼卡阻 滑出跑道 前轮陷地

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is AFR 675, a flight from Guangzhou to Wuhan, you have just been handed over from Guangzhou Control to Wuhan Control, you are over DAPRO, maintaining 10100 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是AFR 675，从广州飞往武汉，刚由广州管制移交至武汉管制，过DAPRO，保持10100米。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, AFR 675, over DAPRO, maintaining 10100 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，AFR 675，过DAPRO，保持10100米。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 675, omit position reports.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 675，免报位置。
cards.referenceText: Omit position reports, AFR 675.
cards.referenceTextZh: 免报位置，AFR 675。

cards.audioText: B: Your weather radar indicates there is a cumulonimbus ahead, report the situation to Wuhan Control and ask for 20 miles deviation to the west.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的气象雷达显示前方有积雨云，请向武汉管制报告情况，并申请向西偏航20海里。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, AFR 675, our weather radar indicates there is a cumulonimbus ahead, request 20 miles deviation to the west.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，AFR 675，我们气象雷达显示前方有积雨云，申请向西偏航20海里。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 675, negative due prohibited area.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 675，因禁区不能同意。
cards.referenceText: Roger, AFR 675.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，AFR 675。

cards.audioText: B: Now you find the navigation performance has been downgraded, report this to ATC and ask them to verify your flight track.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你发现导航性能下降，请向空管报告，并请他们核实你的飞行航迹。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, AFR 675, the navigation performance has been downgraded, request verify our flight track.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，AFR 675，导航性能下降，请核实我们的飞行航迹。

cards.audioText: C: AFR 675, you are still on track.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：AFR 675，你仍在航迹上。
cards.referenceText: Roger, AFR 675.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，AFR 675。

cards.audioText: B: Your weather radar has failed, tell Wuhan Control you'd like to divert to Wuhan Airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的气象雷达失效，请告诉武汉管制你希望备降武汉机场。
