cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是BAW 203，刚过ZF。管制员：BAW 203，武汉进近，爬升保持4800米，联系武汉管制118.1。
cards.referenceText: Climb to maintain 4800 meters, 118.1, BAW 203.

cards.audioText: B: Make an initial contact with Wuhan Control, ask for 8900 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 首次联系武汉管制，申请8900米。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, BAW 203, maintaining 4800 meters, request climb to 8900 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，BAW 203，保持4800米，申请爬升至8900米。

cards.audioText: C: BAW 203, Wuhan Control, radar contact, climb to 7500 meters, expect 8900 meters at 16.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：BAW 203，武汉管制，雷达联系，爬升至7500米，预计16分给8900米。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 7500 meters, BAW 203.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升至7500米，BAW 203。

cards.audioText: B: Inform the controller that you have encountered severe clear air turbulence, and ask for 8900 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 告知管制员你遇到严重晴空颠簸，并申请8900米。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, BAW 203, we have encountered severe clear air turbulence, request 8900 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，BAW 203，我们遇到严重晴空颠簸，申请8900米。

cards.audioText: C: Roger, BAW 203, climb to 8900 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：收到，BAW 203，爬升至8900米。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 8900 meters, BAW 203.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升至8900米，BAW 203。

cards.audioText:
C: BAW 203, Wuhan Control, is there any damage to the aircraft or are there any passengers injured?
B: Tell the controller that there isn't any aircraft damage, and the purser told you that passengers are OK.
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：BAW 203，武汉管制，飞机是否受损，是否有旅客受伤？
告诉管制员飞机没有受损，乘务长报告旅客都没事。
cards.referenceText: There isn't any damage to the aircraft and the purser reported that the passengers are just fine, BAW 203.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞机没有受损，乘务长报告旅客情况都正常，BAW 203。

cards.audioText: B: Inform Wuhan Control that you have just been told an old passenger has been seriously injured.
cards.audioTextZh: 通知武汉管制，你刚得知一名老年旅客严重受伤。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, BAW 203, we have just told that an old passenger has been seriously injured.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，BAW 203，我们刚得知一名老年旅客严重受伤。

cards.audioText:
C: BAW 203, roger, report your intention.
B: Tell the controller that you want to land at Wuhan Airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：BAW 203，收到，报告意图。告诉管制员你希望在武汉机场落地。
cards.referenceText: We would like to land at Wuhan Airport, BAW 203.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们希望在武汉机场落地，BAW 203。

cards.audioText: C: BAW 203, turn left direct to ZF and descend to 5100 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：BAW 203，左转直飞ZF，下降至5100米。
cards.referenceText: Turn left direct to ZF, descend to 5100 meters, BAW 203.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转直飞ZF，下降至5100米，BAW 203。

cards.audioText:
C: BAW 203, do you need any assistance?
B: Inform the controller that you need an ambulance and first aid on arrival.
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：BAW 203，是否需要任何协助？
告知管制员到达后需要救护车和急救。
cards.referenceText: We will need an ambulance and first aid on arrival, BAW 203.
cards.referenceTextZh: 到达后我们需要救护车和急救，BAW 203。

cards.audioText: C: BAW 203, maintain 5100 meters, contact Wuhan Approach on 118.9.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：BAW 203，保持5100米，联系武汉进近118.9。
cards.referenceText: Maintain 5100 meters, 118.9, BAW 203.

cards.audioText: B: Make an initial contact with Wuhan Approach, inform the controller that you have an injured passenger on board.
cards.audioTextZh: 首次联系武汉进近，告知管制员机上有受伤旅客。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, BAW 203, maintaining 5100 meters, over ZF, we have an injured passenger on board.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，BAW 203，保持5100米，过ZF，机上有一名受伤旅客。

cards.audioText:
C: BAW 203, Wuhan Approach, radar contact, follow ZF-1A arrival, descend to 2700 meters on QNH 1017, information C.
B: Read back the controller's instruction and inform controller that you have received the Information.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：BAW 203，武汉进近，雷达联系，执行ZF-1A 进场，按QNH 1017下降至2700米，通播C。请复诵管制指令，并告知管制员已收到通播。
cards.referenceText: Follow ZF-1A arrival, descend to 2700 meters on QNH 1017, we have received Information C, BAW 203.
cards.referenceTextZh: 执行ZF-1A 进场，按QNH 1017下降至2700米，已收到通播C，BAW 203。

cards.audioText:
C: BAW 203, descend to 900 meters, expect ILS approach Runway 36R.
B: Read back the controller's instruction and tell the controller that the passenger has died.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：BAW 203，下降至900米，预计ILS进近36右跑道。请复诵管制指令，并告诉管制员该旅客已经死亡。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 900 meters, expect ILS approach Runway 36R, the old passenger has died, BAW 203.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降至900米，预计ILS进近36R，那名老年旅客已经死亡，BAW 203。

cards.audioText: C: BAW 203, roger, reduce speed to 200 knots, turn left heading 030.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：BAW 203，收到，减速至200节，左转航向030。
cards.referenceText: Reduce speed to 200 knots, turn left heading 030, BAW 203.
cards.referenceTextZh: 减速至200节，左转航向030，BAW 203。

cards.audioText: C: BAW 203, intercept the localizer of Runway 36R, report established.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：BAW 203，截获36右跑道航向道，建立后报告。
cards.referenceText: Intercept the localizer of Runway 36R, report established, BAW 203.
cards.referenceTextZh: 截获36R航向道，建立后报告，BAW 203。

cards.audioText: B: Inform the controller, you have captured the localizer.
cards.audioTextZh: 通知管制员，你已截获航向道。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, BAW 203, ILS established.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，BAW 203，ILS已建立。

cards.audioText: C: Roger, cleared ILS approach Runway 36R, 13 kilometers from touchdown, radar service terminated, contact Wuhan Tower on 124.35.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：收到，可以ILS进近36右跑道，距接地点13公里，雷达服务终止，联系武汉塔台124.35。
cards.referenceText: Cleared ILS approach Runway 36R, 124.35, BAW 203.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以ILS进近36R，124.35，BAW 203。

cards.audioText: B: Later, you cannot see the runway at decision altitude during the approach, inform Tower controller that you need to make another approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 稍后，进近至决断高度时你看不到跑道，通知塔台管制员你需要再次进近。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, BAW 203, no contact at minimum, going around.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，BAW 203，最低标准无目视，正在复飞。

topics.name: BAW 931 乘客重病 引擎起火

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is BAW 931, you are parking at stand 702, with information L, request ATC clearance to London.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是BAW 931，停在702号机位，已收到通播L，申请前往伦敦的空管放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, BAW 931, stand 702, information L, request ATC clearance to London.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，BAW 931，702号机位，通播L，申请前往伦敦的空管放行许可。

cards.audioText: C: BAW 931, Wuhan Ground, cleared to London via flight planned route, ZF-05D departure, initial climb to 1500 meters, cruising level 10700 meters, runway in use 18L, after departure, contact 124.7, squawk 4503.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：BAW 931，武汉地面，按计划航路放行至伦敦，ZF-05D 离场，初始爬升至1500米，巡航高度10700米，使用跑道18左，离场后联系124.7，squawk 4503。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to London via flight planned route, ZF-05D departure, initial climb to 1500 meters, cruising level 10700 meters, runway in use 18L, after departure, contact 124.7, squawk 4503, BAW 931.
cards.referenceTextZh: 按计划航路放行至伦敦，ZF-05D 离场，初始爬升至1500米，巡航高度10700米，使用跑道18L，离场后联系124.7，squawk 4503，BAW 931。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for push back and start up, contact Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已准备好推出和开车，请联系地面。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, BAW 931, ready for push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，BAW 931，准备好推出和开车。

cards.audioText: C: BAW 931, Wuhan Ground, push back and start up approved, facing north.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：BAW 931，武汉地面，可以推出和开车，机头向北。
cards.referenceText: Push back and start up approved, facing north, BAW 931.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以推出和开车，机头向北，BAW 931。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have a problem, 1 of your passengers is seriously ill, you inform ATC and request to disembark the passenger, you have to delay the push back due to disembark the passenger.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在出现问题，一名旅客病情严重。请通知空管并申请让该旅客下机，因此需要推迟推出。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, BAW 931, 1 of our passengers is seriously ill, request delay the push back to disembark the passenger.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，BAW 931，我们有一名旅客病情严重，申请推迟推出，让该旅客下机。

cards.audioText: B: This time, contact your Company to inform this situation, and also request medical assistance.
cards.audioTextZh: 这次联系公司，告知该情况，并申请医疗协助。
cards.referenceText: Dispatch, BAW 931, 1 of our passengers is seriously ill, request medical assistance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 签派，BAW 931，我们有一名旅客病情严重，请求医疗协助。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have disembark this passenger, request taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在该旅客已下机，申请滑行。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, BAW 931, we have disembarked this passenger, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，BAW 931，该旅客已下机，申请滑行。

cards.audioText: C: BAW 931, taxi to the holding point of Runway 18L via taxiway A7 and A, hold short of A5.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：BAW 931，经滑行道A7和A滑行至18左跑道等待点，A5外等待。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to the holding point of Runway 18L via taxiway A7 and A, hold short of A5, BAW 931.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道A7和A滑行至18L跑道等待点，A5外等待，BAW 931。

cards.audioText: C: BAW 931, follow company Boeing 777, continue taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：BAW 931，跟随同公司Boeing 777，继续滑行。
cards.referenceText: Follow company B777, continue taxi, BAW 931.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跟随同公司B777，继续滑行，BAW 931。

cards.audioText: C: BAW 931, give way to the Airbus 320 coming from left to right, when the traffic is clear, continue taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：BAW 931，让行从左向右的Airbus 320，冲突解除后继续滑行。
cards.referenceText: Traffic in sight, when the traffic is clear, continue taxi, BAW 931.
cards.referenceTextZh: 看到冲突飞机，冲突解除后继续滑行，BAW 931。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for departure, contact Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已准备好离场，请联系武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, BAW 931, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，BAW 931，准备好离场。

cards.audioText: C: BAW 931, line up and wait, Runway 18L.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：BAW 931，18左跑道进跑道等待。
cards.referenceText: Line up and wait, Runway 18L, BAW 931.
cards.referenceTextZh: 18L跑道进跑道等待，BAW 931。

cards.audioText: C: BAW 931, cleared for takeoff 18 left, surface wind 160, 3 meters per second.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：BAW 931，18左跑道可以起飞，地面风160度，3米/秒。
cards.referenceText: Cleared for takeoff Runway 18L, BAW 931.
cards.referenceTextZh: 18L跑道可以起飞，BAW 931。

cards.audioText: B: During takeoff roll, your right engine suddenly got fire, you have to abort takeoff, report ATC this situation.
cards.audioTextZh: 起飞滑跑过程中，右发突然起火，你必须中断起飞，请向空管报告情况。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, BAW 931, takeoff aborted due right engine fire.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，BAW 931，因右发起火，中断起飞。

cards.audioText: B: The fire cannot be extinguished, inform this to ATC, this is a Distress call, also you want to carry out evacuation and request emergency equipment.
cards.audioTextZh: 火情无法扑灭，请通知空管。这是遇险呼叫，同时你希望实施撤离并申请应急设备。
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, Wuhan Tower, BAW 931, the fire cannot be extinguished, we are evacuating, request emergency equipment.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，武汉塔台，BAW 931，火情无法扑灭，我们正在撤离，申请应急设备。

topics.name: BAW 141 进云 雷击 领航

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is BAW 141, destination Beijing, estimate GUPAD 20, level 8900 meters, TYN35, next ISGOD, contact Beijing Control, report in cloud at 10100 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是BAW 141，目的地北京，预计20分到GUPAD，高度8900米，TYN 35，下一点ISGOD，联系北京管制，并报告在10100米云中飞行。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, BAW 141, estimate GUPAD 20, maintaining 8900 meters, in cloud, TYN 35, next ISGOD.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，BAW 141，预计20分到GUPAD，保持8900米，云中飞行，TYN 35，下一点ISGOD。

cards.audioText:
C: BAW 141, Beijing Control, previous aircraft have required diversions right of track due to weather, please advise if you require the same.
B: Meteorological radar shows that you are fine at this stage
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：BAW 141，北京管制，前机因天气曾要求向航迹右侧绕飞，如你也需要请告知。气象雷达显示你目前情况正常。
cards.referenceText: Radar shows that we are normal at this stage, BAW 141.
cards.referenceTextZh: 雷达显示我们目前正常，BAW 141。

cards.audioText: C: BAW 141, Beijing roger, contact me if require diversion.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：BAW 141，北京收到，如需绕飞请联系我。
cards.referenceText: Roger, thanks, BAW 141.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，BAW 141。

cards.audioText: B: There is CB ahead of you, request diversion 5 miles right of track.
cards.audioTextZh: 前方有CB，申请向航迹右侧绕飞5海里。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, BAW 141, request diversion 5 miles right of track due to CB ahead of us.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，BAW 141，因前方有CB，申请向航迹右侧绕飞5海里。

cards.audioText: C: BAW 141, deviate 5 miles right of track approved.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：BAW 141，同意向航迹右侧偏航5海里。
cards.referenceText: 5 miles right of track approved, BAW 141.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意向航迹右侧偏航5海里，BAW 141。

cards.audioText:
C: BAW 141, traffic information, detect primary radar signal at 1 o'clock, 50 kilometres, northwest bound, altitude unknown, we are unable to communicate with the aircraft.
B: Tell the controller that your TCAS has no indication of that aircraft, and confirm whether the traffic is in conflict with you.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：BAW 141，通报冲突信息，探测到一次雷达信号，方位1点钟，距离50公里，向西北飞行，高度不明，我们无法与该航空器通信。告诉管制员，你的TCAS没有该航空器显示，并确认该冲突飞机是否与你有冲突。
cards.referenceText: Roger, we do not have that aircraft on TCAS, confirm that the unidentified aircraft will not be in conflict with us, BAW 141.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，我们TCAS上没有该航空器，请确认该不明航空器不会与我们发生冲突，BAW 141。

cards.audioText:
C: BAW 141, the aircraft is currently parallel to your track. You are closing on that aircraft, report sighting.
B: Tell the controller that you are closing cloud and you can't see the aircraft.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：BAW 141，该机目前与你航迹平行。你正在接近该机，看到后报告。
B：告诉管制员你正进入云中，无法看见该机。
cards.referenceText: We are closing cloud and we can't see the aircraft, BAW 141.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们正进入云中，无法看见该机，BAW 141。

cards.audioText: C: BAW 141, Beijing Control, probable false signal, proceed normally.
cards.audioTextZh: C：BAW 141，北京管制，可能是假信号，正常飞行。
cards.referenceText: Roger, BAW 141.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，BAW 141。

cards.audioText: B: You suffered lightning strike, make a distress call and request descent to 4200 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你遭遇雷击，发出遇险呼叫并请求下降至 4200 米。
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, Beijing Control, BAW 141, lightning strike, request descend to 4200 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，北京管制，BAW 141，遭遇雷击，请求下降至 4200 米。

cards.audioText:
C: BAW 141, descend to 4200 meters, report conditions.
B: You are checking and now suspect navigation system is malfunctioning.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：BAW 141，下降至 4200 米，报告情况。
B：你正在检查，目前怀疑导航系统故障。
cards.referenceText: We are assessing the situation, but have no real navigation guidance, BAW 141.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们正在评估情况，但目前没有可靠的导航引导，BAW 141。

cards.audioText:
C: BAW 141, Beijing roger, when ready, advise intention.
B: You lost directional indication, if weather permits, request navigation assistance to Beijing airport
cards.audioTextZh:
C：BAW 141，北京收到，准备好后报告意图。
B：你失去方向指示，如天气允许，请求导航协助飞往北京机场。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, BAW 141, if weather permits, request navigation assistance due directional indication failure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，BAW 141，如天气允许，因方向指示故障，请求导航协助。

cards.audioText: C: BAW 141, Beijing roger, Beijing CAVOK, your position is 25 miles northeast of VYK ON a heading of about 070, expect small correcting turns to the left in 5 miles.
cards.audioTextZh: C：BAW 141，北京收到，北京 CAVOK，你的位置在 VYK 东北 25 海里，航向约 070，预计 5 海里后小幅左转修正。
cards.referenceText: Expect small correcting turns to the left in 5 miles, BAW 141.
cards.referenceTextZh: 预计 5 海里后小幅左转修正，BAW 141。

cards.audioText: C: BAW 141, this is Beijing Approach, descend to 1800 meters on QNH 1011, expect Runway 36L.
cards.audioTextZh: C：BAW 141，这里是北京进近，按 QNH 1011 下降至 1800 米，预计使用跑道 36 左。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 1800 meters on QNH 1011, expect Runway 36L, BAW 141.
cards.referenceTextZh: 按 QNH 1011 下降至 1800 米，预计跑道 36L，BAW 141。

cards.audioText: C: BAW 141, you are 15 miles to touchdown on Runway 36L, descend to 900 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：BAW 141，距跑道 36 左接地点 15 海里，下降至 900 米。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 900 meters, BAW 141.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降至 900 米，BAW 141。

cards.audioText: C: BAW 141, position 10 miles northeast of the field, 3 miles north of the extended center line of Runway 36L, a correcting heading won't be necessary, descend to 600 meters, report visual.
cards.audioTextZh: C：BAW 141，位置在机场东北 10 海里、跑道 36 左延长中心线以北 3 海里，无需修正航向，下降至 600 米，看到地面后报告。
cards.referenceText: Roger, descend to 600 meters, report visual, BAW 141.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，下降至 600 米，看到地面后报告，BAW 141。

cards.audioText: B: Tell the ATC that you have sighted the field.
cards.audioTextZh: B：告诉管制员你已看到机场。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, BAW 141, field in sight.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，BAW 141，已看到机场。

cards.audioText: C: BAW 141, roger, cleared visual approach, join final for Runway 36L, you are number 1, contact Tower 118.1.
cards.audioTextZh: C：BAW 141，收到，可以目视进近，加入跑道 36 左最后进近，你是第一架，联系塔台 118.1。
cards.referenceText: Cleared visual approach, join final for Runway 36L, 118.1, BAW 141.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以目视进近，加入跑道 36L 最后进近，118.1，BAW 141。

topics.name: BAW 817 鸟击 左风挡裂

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is BAW 817, you are at stand 215, contact Wuhan Ground and request a tug.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 BAW 817，停在 215 机位，联系武汉地面，请求拖车。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, BAW 817, stand 215, request a tug.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，BAW 817，215 机位，请求拖车。

cards.audioText:
C: BAW 817, what type of aircraft is it?
B: Tell the controller its Airbus 330.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：BAW 817，机型是什么？
B：告诉管制员是 Airbus 330。
cards.referenceText: It's A330, BAW 817.
cards.referenceTextZh: 机型 A330，BAW 817。

cards.audioText: C: BAW 817, the tug is on the way.
cards.audioTextZh: C：BAW 817，拖车正在过来。
cards.referenceText: Roger, thanks, BAW 817.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，BAW 817。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for push back and start up, request facing east.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在准备好推出和开车，请求机头朝东。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, BAW 817, request push back and start up, facing east.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，BAW 817，请求推出开车，机头朝东。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are at holding point Runway 04, you notice the wind sock shows strong wind, contact Wuhan Tower and check the wind.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在在跑道 04 等待点，发现风向袋显示风较强，联系武汉塔台核实风况。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, BAW 817, holding point Runway 04, the wind sock shows strong wind, request wind check.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，BAW 817，跑道 04 等待点，风向袋显示风较强，请求风况检查。

cards.audioText:
C: BAW 817, wind 200, 8 meters per second.
B: The tailwind exceeds your takeoff limit, contact Wuhan Tower to change to Runway 22 and state the reason.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：BAW 817，风 200，8 米/秒。
B：顺风超过你的起飞限制，联系武汉塔台请求改用跑道 22，并说明原因。
cards.referenceText: The tailwind exceeds our takeoff limit, request change to Runway 22, BAW 817.
cards.referenceTextZh: 顺风超过我们的起飞限制，请求改用跑道 22，BAW 817。

cards.audioText: B: After departure, you encountered bird strike, left wind shield cracked, this is an Urgency call.
cards.audioTextZh: B：离场后你遭遇鸟击，左风挡裂纹，发出紧急呼叫。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Departure/Approach, BAW 817, we encountered bird strike, left wind shield cracked.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，武汉离场/进近，BAW 817，遭遇鸟击，左风挡裂纹。

cards.audioText:
C: BAW 817, roger PAN, say your intention.
B: Tell the controller you want to dump fuel and return to land.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：BAW 817，收到 PAN，报告意图。
B：告诉管制员你想放油并返场着陆。
cards.referenceText: Request dump fuel and return to land, BAW 817.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求放油并返场着陆，BAW 817。

cards.audioText: C: BAW 817, turn right, heading 240 to intercept LKO030 radial inbound, climb to 3300 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：BAW 817，右转航向 240，切入 LKO030 径向线向台，爬升至 3300 米。
cards.referenceText: Turn right, heading 240 to intercept LKO 030 radio inbound, climb to 3300 meters, BAW 817.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 240，切入 LKO 030 径向线向台，爬升至 3300 米，BAW 817。

cards.audioText: C: BAW 817, after passing LKO, turn right heading 220, maintain 3300 meters, report over LKO.
cards.audioTextZh: C：BAW 817，过 LKO 后右转航向 220，保持 3300 米，飞越 LKO 报告。
cards.referenceText: After passing LKO, turn right heading 220, maintain 3300 meters, report over LKO, BAW 817.
cards.referenceTextZh: 过 LKO 后右转航向 220，保持 3300 米，飞越 LKO 报告，BAW 817。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are over LKO, report it to Wuhan Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在飞越 LKO，向武汉进近报告。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, BAW 817, over LKO.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，BAW 817，飞越 LKO。

cards.audioText:
C: BAW 817, how long do you need to dump fuel?
B: Tell the controller you need approximately 25 minutes.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：BAW 817，你需要多长时间放油？
B：告诉管制员大约需要 25 分钟。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, BAW 817, we need approximately 25 minutes.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，BAW 817，我们大约需要 25 分钟。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have completed fuel dumping, report it to the controller and request radar vectors for Runway 22.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在已完成放油，向管制员报告并请求雷达引导至跑道 22。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, BAW 817, fuel dumping completed, request radar vectors for Runway 22.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，BAW 817，放油完成，请求雷达引导至跑道 22。

cards.audioText: C: BAW 817, turn right, direct to DA, descend and maintain 2100 meters on QNH 1015, expect ILS approach Runway 22.
cards.audioTextZh: C：BAW 817，右转直飞 DA，按 QNH 1015 下降并保持 2100 米，预计 ILS 进近跑道 22。
cards.referenceText: Turn right, direct to DA, descend and maintain 2100 meters on QNH 1015, expect ILS approach Runway 22, BAW 817.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转直飞 DA，按 QNH 1015 下降并保持 2100 米，预计 ILS 进近跑道 22，BAW 817。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have established ILS Runway 22, report it to Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在已建立跑道 22 ILS，向武汉塔台报告。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, BAW 817, established ILS Runway 22.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，BAW 817，已建立跑道 22 ILS。

cards.audioText: B: During landing, you encountered strong wind between 400 meters and the surface, report it to Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B：着陆过程中，你在 400 米至地面之间遭遇强风，向武汉塔台报告。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, BAW 817, we encountered strong wind between 400 meters and the surface.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，BAW 817，我们在 400 米至地面之间遭遇强风。

cards.audioText: B: After landing, you find the APU is inoperative, report this situation to Wuhan Ground and request ground power unit ready at the gate.
cards.audioTextZh: B：落地后，你发现 APU 失效，向武汉地面报告并请求到达停机位时准备地面电源车。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, BAW 817, our APU is inoperative, request ground power unit ready at the gate.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，BAW 817，APU 失效，请求到达停机位时准备地面电源车。

topics.name: BAW 2352 询问两地天气 复飞

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is BAW 352, you are maintaining 11000 meters, over XIA, squawking 3567, make an initial contact with Wuhan Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 BAW 352，保持 11000 米，飞越 XIA，应答机 3567，首次联系武汉管制。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, BAW 2352, maintaining 11000 meters, over XIA, squawking 3567.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，BAW 2352，保持 11000 米，飞越 XIA，应答机 3567。

cards.audioText: C: BAW 352, Wuhan Control, radar contact, descend and maintain 10400 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：BAW 352，武汉管制，雷达识别，下降并保持 10400 米。
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 10400 meters, BAW 2352.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降并保持 10400 米，BAW 2352。

cards.audioText: C: BAW 352, Wuhan Control, descend to 9200 meters, reduced speed to 270 knots until advised.
cards.audioTextZh: C：BAW 352，武汉管制，下降至 9200 米，减速至 270 节，保持至另行通知。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 9200 meters, reduce speed to 270 knots until advised, BAW 2352.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降至 9200 米，减速至 270 节，保持至另行通知，BAW 2352。

cards.audioText: B: Your weather radar observed there was a cumulonimbus ahead, contact Wuhan Control and request offset 25 miles left of track for 30 minutes.
cards.audioTextZh: B：气象雷达显示前方有积雨云，联系武汉管制，请求向航迹左侧偏航 25 海里，持续 30 分钟。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, BAW 2352, request offset 25 miles left of track for 30 minutes due CB ahead.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，BAW 2352，前方有 CB，请求向航迹左侧偏航 25 海里，持续 30 分钟。

cards.audioText: C: BAW 352, cleared offset 25 miles left of track for 30 minutes, report clear of CB.
cards.audioTextZh: C：BAW 352，可以向航迹左侧偏航 25 海里，持续 30 分钟，脱离 CB 后报告。
cards.referenceText: Cleared offset 25 miles left of track for 30 minutes, report clear of CB, BAW 2352.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以向航迹左侧偏航 25 海里，持续 30 分钟，脱离 CB 后报告，BAW 2352。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are clear of CB, ask Wuhan Control to resume flight route.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在已脱离 CB，请求武汉管制恢复航路飞行。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, BAW 2352, clear of CB, request resume flight route.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，BAW 2352，已脱离 CB，请求恢复航路。

cards.audioText: B: You have received the latest ATIS, saying that the visibility of Wuhan is low, ask Wuhan Approach if your alternate airport Hefei is available for diversion.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你已收到最新 ATIS，显示武汉能见度低，询问武汉进近备降场合肥是否可用。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, BAW 2352, the latest ATIS, saying that the visibility of Wuhan is low, is our alternate airport Hefei is available for diversion ?
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，BAW 2352，最新 ATIS 显示武汉能见度低，请问我们的备降场合肥是否可用于备降？

cards.audioText:
C: BAW 352, Hefei Airport is available, confirm you are diverting to Hefei?
B: Tell the controller you are not diverting to Hefei at the moment, and you still want to fly to Wuhan.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：BAW 352，合肥机场可用，确认你们备降合肥吗？
B：告诉管制员目前不备降合肥，仍希望飞往武汉。
cards.referenceText: We are not diverting to Hefei now, we still want to fly to Wuhan, BAW 2352.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们目前不备降合肥，仍希望飞往武汉，BAW 2352。

cards.audioText: C: BAW 352, roger, track direct to ZF, follow ZF-2A arrival, expect ILS approach Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C：BAW 352，收到，直飞 ZF，执行 ZF-2A 进场，预计 ILS 进近跑道 36 右。
cards.referenceText: Track direct to ZF, follow ZF-2A arrival, expect ILS approach Runway 36R, BAW 2352.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞 ZF，执行 ZF-2A 进场，预计 ILS 进近跑道 36R，BAW 2352。

cards.audioText: C: BAW 352, descend and maintain 4200 meters, reduce speed to minimum clean speed.
cards.audioTextZh: C：BAW 352，下降并保持 4200 米，减速至最低光洁速度。
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 4200 meters, reduce speed to minimum clean speed, BAW 2352.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降并保持 4200 米，减速至最低光洁速度，BAW 2352。

cards.audioText: C: BAW 352, contact Wuhan Tower 119.6.
cards.audioTextZh: C：BAW 352，联系武汉塔台119.6。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are established on ILS approach Runway 36R, you are 15 miles from touchdown, contact Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在已建立跑道 36 右 ILS 进近，距接地点 15 海里，联系武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, BAW 2352, established ILS approach Runway 36R, 15 miles from touchdown.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，BAW 2352，已建立跑道 36R ILS 进近，距接地点 15 海里。

cards.audioText: C: BAW 352, roger, surface wind calm, RVR touchdown 550 meters, midpoint 600 meters, rollout 500 meters, continue approach Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C：BAW 352，收到，地面风静风，RVR 接地点 550 米、中段 600 米、末端 500 米，继续进近跑道 36 右。
cards.referenceText: Roger, continue approach Runway 36R, BAW 2352.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，继续进近跑道 36R，BAW 2352。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are 10 miles from touchdown, ask Wuhan Tower for the cloud information.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在距接地点 10 海里，向武汉塔台询问云况。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, BAW 2352, 10 miles from touchdown, request cloud information.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，BAW 2352，距接地点 10 海里，请求云况信息。

cards.audioText: C: BAW 352, cloud broken 700 meters, cleared to land Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C：BAW 352，疏云 700 米，可以落地跑道 36 右。
cards.referenceText: Cloud broken 700 metres, cleared to land Runway 36R, BAW 2352.
cards.referenceTextZh: 疏云 700 米，可以落地跑道 36R，BAW 2352。

cards.audioText: B: The weather is deteriorating and below your landing minima, you executed a missed approach, advised Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B：天气正在恶化并低于你的着陆最低标准，你执行复飞，通知塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, BAW 2352, the weather is deteriorating and below our landing minima, going around.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，BAW 2352，天气正在恶化并低于我们的着陆最低标准，正在复飞。

cards.audioText: C: BAW 352, roger, follow the standard missed approach procedure, advise intentions when able.
cards.audioTextZh: C：BAW 352，收到，执行标准复飞程序，条件允许时报告意图。
cards.referenceText: Follow the standard missed approach procedure, BAW 2352.
cards.referenceTextZh: 执行标准复飞程序，BAW 2352。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are climbing to missed approach altitude, you decide to divert to Hefei Airport, informed Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在爬升至复飞高度，决定备降合肥机场，通知塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, BAW 2352, request divert to Hefei Airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，BAW 2352，请求备降合肥机场。

cards.audioText: C: BAW 352, roger, turn right, direct to LKO, climb to and maintain 2400 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：BAW 352，收到，右转直飞 LKO，爬升并保持 2400 米。
cards.referenceText: Turn right, direct to LKO, climb to and maintain 2400 meters, BAW 2352.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转直飞 LKO，爬升并保持 2400 米，BAW 2352。

topics.name: BAW 871 鸟击 左风挡裂 APU

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is BAW 871, from Beijing to London, you are at stand 215, request ATC clearance to London.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 BAW 871，从北京飞往伦敦，停在 215 机位，请求飞往伦敦的 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Delivery, BAW 871, stand 215, request ATC clearance to London.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京放行，BAW 871，215 机位，请求飞往伦敦的 ATC 放行许可。

cards.audioText: C: BAW 871, cleared to London via flight planned route, follow VYK-05D departure, initial climb 9800 meters on 1023, cruising level 10400 meters, after departure contact 120.6, squawk 4523.
cards.audioTextZh: C：BAW 871，按计划航路放行至伦敦，执行 VYK-05D 离场，1023 修压上初始爬升 9800 米，巡航高度 10400 米，离场后联系 120.6，应答机 4523。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to London via flight planned route, follow VYK-05D departure, initial climb 9800m on 1023, cruising level 10400m, after departure contact 120.6, squawk 4523, BAW 871.
cards.referenceTextZh: 按计划航路放行至伦敦，执行 VYK-05D 离场，1023 修压上初始爬升 9800 米，巡航高度 10400 米，离场后联系 120.6，应答机 4523，BAW 871。

cards.audioText: B: You are now ready, contact Ground to request push back and start up.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在已准备好，联系地面请求推出和开车。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, BAW 871, ready for push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，BAW 871，准备好推出和开车。

cards.audioText: C: BAW 871, push back and start up approved, facing west.
cards.audioTextZh: C：BAW 871，可以推出开车，机头朝西。
cards.referenceText: Push back and start up approved, facing west, BAW 871.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以推出开车，机头朝西，BAW 871。

cards.audioText: B: You noticed the tug is not in position yet, ask Ground control for a tug.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你注意到拖车尚未就位，向地面管制请求拖车。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, BAW 871, request a tug.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，BAW 871，请求拖车。

cards.audioText:
C: BAW 871, roger, the tug on the way.
B: While taxiing, you notices the wind sock shows a strong tail wind, contact Ground to check the wind.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：BAW 871，收到，拖车正在过来。
B：滑行时你注意到风向袋显示强顺风，联系地面核实风况。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, BAW 871, request wind check.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，BAW 871，请求风况检查。

cards.audioText: C: BAW 871, surface wind 220 degrees, 8 meters per second.
cards.audioTextZh: C：BAW 871，地面风 220 度，8 米/秒。
cards.referenceText: Roger, thanks, BAW 871.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，BAW 871。

cards.audioText: B: The tailwind exceeds your takeoff limit, contact Tower to change to Runway 22 and state the reason.
cards.audioTextZh: B：顺风超过你的起飞限制，联系塔台请求改用跑道 22，并说明原因。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, BAW 871, the tailwind exceeds takeoff limit, request change to Runway 22.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，BAW 871，顺风超过起飞限制，请求改用跑道 22。

cards.audioText: B: After airborne, you fly into a flock of birds, the left windshield was cracked, request fuel dump and return for landing. This is an Urgency call.
cards.audioTextZh: B：起飞后你飞入鸟群，左风挡裂纹，请求放油并返场着陆。这是紧急呼叫。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Beijing Departure, BAW 871, we encountered bird strike and our left windshield was cracked, request fuel dump and return for landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，北京离场，BAW 871，我们遭遇鸟击，左风挡裂纹，请求放油并返场着陆。

cards.audioText: C: BAW 871, roger your PAN, turn right heading 240, intercept LKO030 radial inbound, climb to 3300 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：BAW 871，收到 PAN，右转航向 240，切入 LKO030 径向线向台，爬升至 3300 米。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 240, intercept LKO 030 radio inbound, climb to 3300m, BAW 871.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 240，切入 LKO 030 径向线向台，爬升至 3300 米，BAW 871。

cards.audioText: C: BAW 871, after LKO, turn right heading 220, maintain 3300 meters, report over LKO.
cards.audioTextZh: C：BAW 871，过 LKO 后右转航向 220，保持 3300 米，飞越 LKO 报告。
cards.referenceText: After LKO, turn right heading 220, maintaining 3300m, report over LKO, BAW 871.
cards.referenceTextZh: 过 LKO 后右转航向 220，保持 3300 米，飞越 LKO 报告，BAW 871。

cards.audioText: B: Now you finished fuel dumping, ask for radar vectors to Runway 22.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在已完成放油，请求雷达引导至跑道 22。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Departure, BAW 871, fuel dump completed, request radar vector to Runway 22.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京离场，BAW 871，放油完成，请求雷达引导至跑道 22。

cards.audioText: C: BAW 871, turn right direct to DA, descend to 2100 meters, QNH 1015, expect Runway 22.
cards.audioTextZh: C：BAW 871，右转直飞 DA，下降至 2100 米，QNH 1015，预计跑道 22。
cards.referenceText: Turn right direct to DA, descend to 2100m, QNH 1015, expect Runway 22, BAW 871.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转直飞 DA，下降至 2100 米，QNH 1015，预计跑道 22，BAW 871。

cards.audioText: B: Your APU has failed, tell this situation to Beijing Tower and ask for Ground Power Unit.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的 APU 失效，向北京塔台报告并请求地面电源车。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, BAW 871, request ground power unit due APU failure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，BAW 871，因 APU 故障，请求地面电源车。

topics.name: BAW 931 鸟击 发动机起火 乘客医疗

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is BAW 931, you are parking at stand 702, with information L, request ATC clearance to London.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是BAW 931，停在702号机位，已收到通播L，申请前往伦敦的空管放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, BAW 931, stand 702, information L, request ATC clearance to London.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，BAW 931，702号机位，通播L，申请前往伦敦的空管放行许可。

cards.audioText: BAW 931, Wuhan Delivery, cleared to London, via flight planned route. ZF05 DAL departure, initial climb to 1,500 meters, cruising level 10,700 meters. runway in use 18 Left, after departure, contact 124.7, squawk 4503.
cards.audioTextZh: BAW 931，武汉放行，许可按飞行计划航路飞往伦敦。执行 ZF-05 DAL 离场，初始爬升至 1,500 米，巡航高度 10,700 米。使用 Runway 18L，离场后联系 124.7，应答机 4503。
cards.referenceText: cleared to London, via flight planned route, ZF05 DAL departure, initial climb to 1005 hudnred meters, cruising level 1700 meters. runway in use 18 Left, after departure, contact 124.7, squawk 4503, BAW 931.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可按飞行计划航路飞往伦敦，执行 ZF-05 DAL 离场，初始爬升至 1005 hudnred 米，巡航高度 1700 米。使用 Runway 18L，离场后联系 124.7，应答机 4503，BAW 931。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for push back and start up, contact Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已准备好推出和开车，请联系地面。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, BAW 931, ready for push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，BAW 931，准备好推出和开车。

cards.audioText: C: BAW 931, Wuhan Ground, push back and start up approved, facing north.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：BAW 931，武汉地面，可以推出和开车，机头向北。
cards.referenceText: Push back and start up approved, facing north, BAW 931.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以推出和开车，机头向北，BAW 931。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have a problem, 1 of your passengers is seriously ill, you inform ATC and request to disembark the passenger, you have to delay the push back due to disembark the passenger.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在出现问题，一名旅客病情严重。请通知空管并申请让该旅客下机，因此需要推迟推出。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, BAW 931, 1 of our passengers is seriously ill, request delay the push back to disembark the passenger.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，BAW 931，我们有一名旅客病情严重，申请推迟推出，让该旅客下机。

cards.audioText: B: This time, contact your Company to inform this situation, and also request medical assistance.
cards.audioTextZh: 这次联系公司，告知该情况，并申请医疗协助。
cards.referenceText: Dispatch, BAW 931, 1 of our passengers is seriously ill, request medical assistance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 签派，BAW 931，我们有一名旅客病情严重，请求医疗协助。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have disembark this passenger, request taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在该旅客已下机，申请滑行。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, BAW 931, we have disembarked this passenger, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，BAW 931，该旅客已下机，申请滑行。

cards.audioText: BAW 931, taxi to the holding point of Runway 18L, via taxiway A7 and A, hold short of A5.
cards.audioTextZh: BAW 931，经 A7 和 A 滑行道滑行至 Runway 18L 等待点，在 A5 前等待。
cards.referenceText: taxi to the holding point of Runway 18L via taxiway A seven and A, hold short of A five, BAW 931.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 A7 和 A 滑行道滑行至 Runway 18L 等待点，在 A5 前等待，BAW 931。

cards.audioText: C: BAW 931, follow company Boeing 777, continue taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：BAW 931，跟随同公司Boeing 777，继续滑行。
cards.referenceText: Follow company B777, continue taxi, BAW 931.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跟随同公司B777，继续滑行，BAW 931。

cards.audioText: BAW 931, give way to the Airbus 3 20 coming from left to right, When the traffic is clear, continue taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: BAW 931，给从左向右驶来的 Airbus 320 让行，相关航空器通过后继续滑行。
cards.referenceText:
give way to the Airbus 320 coming from left to right, When the traffic is clear, continue taxi, BAW 931.
or
traffic in sight, when the traffic is clear, continue taxi, BAW 931.
cards.referenceTextZh:
给从左向右驶来的 Airbus 320 让行，相关航空器通过后继续滑行，BAW 931。
或
已看到相关航空器，相关航空器通过后继续滑行，BAW 931。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for departure, contact Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已准备好离场，请联系武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, BAW 931, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，BAW 931，准备好离场。

cards.audioText: BAW 931, line up and wait Runway 18L.
cards.audioTextZh: BAW 931，进入 Runway 18L 等待。
cards.referenceText: line up and wait Runway 18L, BAW 931.
cards.referenceTextZh: 进入 Runway 18L 等待，BAW 931。

cards.audioText: BAW 931, cleared for takeoff Runway 18L, surface wind 160, 3 meters per second.
cards.audioTextZh: BAW 931，许可从 Runway 18L 起飞，地面风向 160，风速 3 米/秒。
cards.referenceText: cleared for takeoff Runway 18L, BAW 931.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可从 Runway 18L 起飞，BAW 931。

cards.audioText: B: During takeoff roll, your right engine suddenly got fire, you have to abort takeoff, report ATC this situation.
cards.audioTextZh: 起飞滑跑过程中，右发突然起火，你必须中断起飞，请向空管报告情况。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, BAW 931, takeoff aborted due right engine fire.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，BAW 931，因右发起火，中断起飞。

cards.audioText: B: The fire cannot be extinguished, inform this to ATC, this is a Distress call, also you want to carry out evacuation and request emergency equipment.
cards.audioTextZh: 火情无法扑灭，请通知空管。这是遇险呼叫，同时你希望实施撤离并申请应急设备。
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, Wuhan Tower, BAW 931, the fire cannot be extinguished, we are evacuating, request emergency equipment.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，武汉塔台，BAW 931，火情无法扑灭，我们正在撤离，申请应急设备。

topics.name: BAW 2352 鸟击 雷暴绕飞 TCAS机动

cards.audioText: Your call sign is BAW 352, you are maintaining 11,000 meters, over XIA, squawking 3567, make an initial contact with Wuhan Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是 BAW 352，正保持 11,000 米，飞越 XIA，应答机 3567，与武汉管制首次联系。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, BAW 352, maintaining 2000 meters, XIA, squawking 3567.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，BAW 352，正保持 2000 米，XIA，应答机 3567。

cards.audioText: BAW 352, Wuhan Control, radar contact, descend and maintain 10,400 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: BAW 352，武汉管制，雷达识别，下降并保持 10,400 米。
cards.referenceText: descend and maintain 1400 meters, BAW 352.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降并保持 1400 米，BAW 352。

cards.audioText: BAW 352, Wuhan Control, descend to 9,200 meters, reduce speed to 270 knots until advised.
cards.audioTextZh: BAW 352，武汉管制，下降至 9,200 米，将速度减至 270 节直至通知。
cards.referenceText: descend to 9002 hudnred meters, reduce speed to less than 270 knots until advised, BAW 352.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降至 9002 hudnred 米，将速度减至低于 270 节直至通知，BAW 352。

cards.audioText: your weather radar observed there was a cumulonimbus ahead, contact Wuhan Control and request offset 25 miles left of track for 30 minutes.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的气象雷达观察到前方有积雨云，联系武汉管制，请求向航迹左侧偏置 25 英里，持续 30 分钟。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, BAW 352, request offset 25 miles left of track for 30 minutes due CB ahead.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，BAW 352，因前方有 CB，请求向航迹左侧偏置 25 英里，持续 30 分钟。

cards.audioText: BAW 352, cleared offset 25 miles left of track for 30 minutes, report clear of CB.
cards.audioTextZh: BAW 352，批准向航迹左侧偏置 25 英里，持续 30 分钟，脱离 CB 后报告。
cards.referenceText: cleared offset 25 miles left of track for 30 minutes, BAW 352.
cards.referenceTextZh: 批准向航迹左侧偏置 25 英里，持续 30 分钟，BAW 352。

cards.audioText: now you are clear of CB, ask Wuhan Control to resume flight route.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已脱离 CB，向武汉管制申请恢复原航路。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, BAW 352, clear of CB, request resume flight route.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，BAW 352，已脱离 CB，请求恢复原航路。

cards.audioText: You have received the latest ATIS, saying that the visibility at Wuhan is low, ask Wuhan Approach if your alternate airport Hefei is available for diversion.
cards.audioTextZh: 你已收到最新 ATIS，其中称武汉能见度较低，询问武汉进近你的备降机场合肥是否可用于备降。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, BAW 352, the latest ATIS, saying that the visibility at Wuhan is low, is our alternate airport Hefei available for diversion?
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，BAW 352，最新 ATIS 称武汉能见度较低，我们的备降机场合肥是否可用于备降？

cards.audioText:
C: BAW 352, Hefei airport is available, confirm you are diverting to Hefei?
B: tell the controller you are not diverting to Hefei at the moment and you still want to fly to Wuhan.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： BAW 352，合肥机场可用，确认你正备降合肥？
B： 告诉管制员你目前不备降合肥，仍想飞往武汉。
cards.referenceText: we are not diverting to Hefei now, we still want to fly to Wuhan, BAW 352.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们现在不备降合肥，仍想飞往武汉，BAW 352。

cards.audioText: BAW 352, roger, track direct to ZF, follow Z FOXTROT-2A arrival, expect ILS approach Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: BAW 352，收到，直飞 ZF，执行 ZF-2A 进场，预计 ILS 进近 Runway 36R。
cards.referenceText: track direct to ZF, follow ZF two A Arrival, expect ILS approach Runway 36R, BAW 352.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞 ZF，执行 ZF-2A 进场，预计 ILS 进近 Runway 36R，BAW 352。

cards.audioText: BAW 352, descend and maintain 4,200 meters, reduce speed to minimum clean speed.
cards.audioTextZh: BAW 352，下降并保持 4,200 米，将速度减至最小光洁构型速度。
cards.referenceText: descend and maintain 4200 meters, reduce speed to minimum clean speed, BAW 352.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降并保持 4200 米，将速度减至最小光洁构型速度，BAW 352。

cards.audioText: BAW 352, contact Wuhan Tower 119.6.
cards.audioTextZh: BAW 352，联系武汉塔台 119.6。
cards.referenceText: 11 ninder decimal six, BAW 352.
cards.referenceTextZh: 11 ninder decimal six，BAW 352。

cards.audioText: Now you are established on ILS approach Runway 36R, you are 15 miles from touchdown, contact Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已建立 ILS 进近 Runway 36R，距接地点 15 英里，联系武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, BAW 352, established ILS Runway 36R, 15 miles from touchdown.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，BAW 352，已建立 ILS Runway 36R，距接地点 15 英里。

cards.audioText: BAW 352, roger, surface wind calm, RVR touchdown 550 meters, midpoint 600 meters, rollout 500 meters, continue approach Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: BAW 352，收到，地面静风，RVR 接地区 550 米、中段 600 米、滑跑端 500 米，继续进近 Runway 36R。
cards.referenceText: roger, continue approach Runway 36R, BAW 352.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，继续进近 Runway 36R，BAW 352。

cards.audioText: now you are 10 miles from touchdown, ask Wuhan Tower for the cloud information.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你距接地点 10 英里，向武汉塔台询问云况。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, BAW 352, 10 miles from touchdown, request cloud information.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，BAW 352，距接地点 10 英里，请求云况信息。

cards.audioText: BAW 352, cloud broken 700 meters, cleared to land Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: BAW 352，碎云 700 米，许可在 Runway 36R 落地。
cards.referenceText: cloud broken 700 meters, cleared to land Runway 36R, BAW 352.
cards.referenceTextZh: 碎云 700 米，许可在 Runway 36R 落地，BAW 352。

cards.audioText: the weather is deteriorating and below your landing minima, you executed a missed approach, advise tower.
cards.audioTextZh: 天气正在恶化并低于你的着陆最低标准，你已执行复飞，通知塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, BAW 352, the weather is deteriorating and below our landing minima, going around.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，BAW 352，天气正在恶化并低于我们的着陆最低标准，正在复飞。

cards.audioText: BAW 352, roger, follow the standard missed approach procedure, advise intentions when able.
cards.audioTextZh: BAW 352，收到，执行标准复飞程序，可以时报告意图。
cards.referenceText: follow the standard missed approach procedure, BAW 352.
cards.referenceTextZh: 执行标准复飞程序，BAW 352。

cards.audioText: now you are climbing to missed approach altitude, you decide to divert to Hefei Airport, inform Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你正爬升至复飞高度，决定备降合肥机场，通知塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, BAW 352, request divert to Hefei.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，BAW 352，请求备降合肥。

cards.audioText: BAW 352, roger, turn right, direct to LKO, climb to and maintain 2,400 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: BAW 352，收到，右转直飞 LKO，爬升至并保持 2,400 米。
cards.referenceText: turn right, direct to LKO, climb to and maintain 2400 meters, BAW 352.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转，直飞 LKO，爬升至并保持 2400 米，BAW 352。

topics.name: BAW 120 鸟击 积冰/防冰 TCAS机动

cards.audioText: Your call sign is BAW 120, you are maintaining 11,000 meters, over WXI, squawking 4521, make initial contact with Zhengzhou Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是 BAW 120，正保持 11,000 米，飞越 WXI，应答机 4521，与郑州管制首次联系。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, BAW 120, maintaining 2000 meters, over WXI, squawking 4521.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州管制，BAW 120，正保持 2000 米，飞越 WXI，应答机 4521。

cards.audioText: you want to maintain present level, and descent after passing AKOMA
cards.audioTextZh: 你想保持当前高度，并在飞越 AKOMA 后下降。
cards.referenceText: request maintain present level, and expect descent after passing AKOMA, BAW 120.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求保持当前高度，预计飞越 AKOMA 后下降，BAW 120。

cards.audioText:
C: BAW 120, you can either descend now without speed restrictions or maintain 11,000 meters and fly heading 260 for 5 minutes, which do you prefer?
B: Tell the controller you prefer to descend to 9200 meters
cards.audioTextZh:
C： BAW 120，你可以现在不受速度限制下降，或者保持 11,000 米并以航向 260 飞行 5 分钟，你选择哪一种？
B： 告诉管制员你选择下降至 9200 米。
cards.referenceText: request desend to 9200 meters, BAW 120.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求下降至 9200 米，BAW 120。

cards.audioText: BAW 120, descend to 9,200 meters rate of descent 2000 feet per minute or greater, offset 3 miles right.
cards.audioTextZh: BAW 120，下降至 9,200 米，下降率每分钟 2000 英尺或更大，向右偏置 3 英里。
cards.referenceText: descend to 9200 meters at 2000 feet per minute or greater, offset tree miles right, BAW 120.
cards.referenceTextZh: 以每分钟 2000 英尺或更大的下降率下降至 9200 米，向右偏置 3 英里，BAW 120。

cards.audioText: now you are maintaining 9200 meters, in icing condition, the instrument shows your pitot tube heating system failed, your airspeed indications appear to be inaccurate, report it to Zhengzhou Control and request descent to lower level to avoid icing.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你正保持 9200 米，处于结冰条件下，仪表显示空速管加温系统失效，空速指示似乎不准确，向郑州管制报告并请求下降至较低高度以避开结冰。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, BAW 120, maintaining 9200 meters, icing condition, our pitot tube heating system failed, our airspeed inaccurate, request descent to lower level to avoid icing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州管制，BAW 120，正保持 9200 米，处于结冰条件下，我们的空速管加温系统失效，空速指示不准确，请求下降至较低高度以避开结冰。

cards.audioText: BAW 120, descend to 7800 meters, cancel offset, direct to AKOMA, reduce to minimum clean speed due flow control.
cards.audioTextZh: BAW 120，下降至 7800 米，取消偏置，直飞 AKOMA，因流量控制将速度减至最小光洁构型速度。
cards.referenceText: descend to 7800 meters, cancel offset, direct to AKOMA, reduce to minimum clean speed, BAW 120.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降至 7800 米，取消偏置，直飞 AKOMA，将速度减至最小光洁构型速度，BAW 120。

cards.audioText: BAW 120, speed restrictions cancelled, descend to and maintain 6,600 meters, contact Wuhan Control on 119.7.
cards.audioTextZh: BAW 120，取消速度限制，下降至并保持 6,600 米，联系武汉管制 119.7。
cards.referenceText: cancel speed restrictions, descend to and maintain 6600 meters, contact Wuhan Control on 119.7, BAW 120.
cards.referenceTextZh: 取消速度限制，下降至并保持 6600 米，联系武汉管制 119.7，BAW 120。

cards.audioText: you are leaving 7200 meters for 6,600 meters, squawking 4521, contact Wuhan Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 你正离开 7200 米下降至 6,600 米，应答机 4521，联系武汉管制。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, BAW onw 20, leaving 7200 meters for 6600 meters, squawking 4521.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，BAW 120，正离开 7200 米下降至 6600 米，应答机 4521。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are maintaining 4800 meters, you have got information I, contact Wuhan Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你保持4800米，已收到通播I，联系武汉进近。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, BAW 120, maintaining 4800 meters, information I.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，BAW 120，保持4800米，通播I。

cards.audioText: BAW 120, Wuhan Approach, radar contact, follow ZF-12 arrival, expect ILS approach Runway 18R.
cards.audioTextZh: BAW 120，武汉进近，雷达识别，执行 ZF-12 进场，预计 ILS 进近 Runway 18R。
cards.referenceText: follow ZF-12 arrival, expect ILS approach Runway 18R, BAW 120.
cards.referenceTextZh: 执行 ZF-12 进场，预计 ILS 进近 Runway 18R，BAW 120。

cards.audioText: Now you have intercepted the localizer Runway 18R, you are 10 miles from touchdown.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已截获 Runway 18R 航向道，距接地点 10 英里。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, BAW 120, established on the localizer Runway 18R, 10 miles from touchdown.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，BAW 120，已建立在 Runway 18R 航向道上，距接地点 10 英里。

cards.audioText: BAW 120, wind 220, 10 meters per second, gusting to 15, cleared to land Runway 18R
cards.audioTextZh: BAW 120，风向 220，风速 10 米/秒，阵风 15 米/秒，许可在 Runway 18R 落地。
cards.referenceText: cleared to land Runway 18R, BAW 120.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可在 Runway 18R 落地，BAW 120。

cards.audioText: you encountered strong wind shear on short final, you made a missed approach, report it to Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: 你在短五边遭遇强风切变，已执行复飞，向武汉塔台报告。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, BAW 120, strong wind shear on short final, going around.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，BAW 120，短五边遭遇强风切变，正在复飞。

cards.audioText: BAW 120, follow standard missed approach procedure, climb to 1,800 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: BAW 120，执行标准复飞程序，爬升至 1,800 米。
cards.referenceText: follow standard missed approach procedure, climb to 1800 meters, BAW 120.
cards.referenceTextZh: 执行标准复飞程序，爬升至 1800 米，BAW 120。

cards.audioText: ask Wuhan Approach for ILS approach Runway 22.
cards.audioTextZh: 向武汉进近请求 ILS 进近 Runway 22。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, BAW 120, request ILS approach Runway 22.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，BAW 120，请求 ILS 进近 Runway 22。

cards.audioText: BAW 120, contact Wuhan Tower on 120.45.
cards.audioTextZh: BAW 120，联系武汉塔台 120.45。

topics.name: BAW 817 鸟击 积冰/防冰 TCAS机动

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is BAW 817, you are at stand 215, contact Wuhan Ground and request a tug.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 BAW 817，停在 215 机位，联系武汉地面，请求拖车。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, BAW 817, stand 215, request a tug.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，BAW 817，215 机位，请求拖车。

cards.audioText: Tell the controller it's Airbus 3 30.
cards.audioTextZh: 告诉管制员，这是 Airbus 330。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, BAW 817, it's Airbus 330. It's Airbus 330, BAW 817
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，BAW 817，这是 Airbus 330。这是 Airbus 330，BAW 817。

cards.audioText: C: BAW 817, the tug is on the way.
cards.audioTextZh: C：BAW 817，拖车正在过来。
cards.referenceText: Roger, thanks, BAW 817.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，BAW 817。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for push back and start up, request facing east.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在准备好推出和开车，请求机头朝东。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, BAW 817, request push back and start up, facing east.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，BAW 817，请求推出开车，机头朝东。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are at holding point Runway 04, you notice the wind sock shows strong wind, contact Wuhan Tower and check the wind.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在在跑道 04 等待点，发现风向袋显示风较强，联系武汉塔台核实风况。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, BAW 817, holding point Runway 04, the wind sock shows strong wind, request wind check.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，BAW 817，跑道 04 等待点，风向袋显示风较强，请求风况检查。

cards.audioText:
C: BAW 817, wind 200, 8 meters per second.
B: the tailwind exceeds your takeoff limit, contact Wuhan Tower to change to Runway 22and state the reason.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： BAW 817，风向 200，风速 8 米/秒。
B： 顺风超过你的起飞限制，联系武汉塔台请求更换至 Runway 22 并说明原因。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, BAW 817, the tailwind exceeds our takeoff limit, request change to Runway 22. the tailwind exceeds our takeoff limit, request change to Runway 22, BAW 817.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，BAW 817，顺风超过我们的起飞限制，请求更换至 Runway 22。顺风超过我们的起飞限制，请求更换至 Runway 22，BAW 817。

cards.audioText: B: After departure, you encountered bird strike, left wind shield cracked, this is an Urgency call.
cards.audioTextZh: B：离场后你遭遇鸟击，左风挡裂纹，发出紧急呼叫。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Departure/Approach, BAW 817, we encountered bird strike, left wind shield cracked.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，武汉离场/进近，BAW 817，遭遇鸟击，左风挡裂纹。

cards.audioText: tell the controller you want to dump fuel and return to land.
cards.audioTextZh: 告诉管制员你想放油并返场落地。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, BAW 817, request dump fuel and return to land. request dump fuel and return to land, BAW 817.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，BAW 817，请求放油并返场落地。请求放油并返场落地，BAW 817。

cards.audioText: BAW 817, turn right heading 240 to intercept LKO030 radial inbound, climb to 3,300 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: BAW 817，右转航向 240，切入 LKO030 向台径向线，爬升至 3,300 米。
cards.referenceText: turn right heading 240 to intercept LKO030 radial inbound, climb to 3300 meters, BAW 817.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 240，切入 LKO030 向台径向线，爬升至 3300 米，BAW 817。

cards.audioText: C: BAW 817, after passing LKO, turn right heading 220, maintain 3300 meters, report over LKO.
cards.audioTextZh: C：BAW 817，过 LKO 后右转航向 220，保持 3300 米，飞越 LKO 报告。
cards.referenceText: After passing LKO, turn right heading 220, maintain 3300 meters, report over LKO, BAW 817.
cards.referenceTextZh: 过 LKO 后右转航向 220，保持 3300 米，飞越 LKO 报告，BAW 817。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are over LKO, report it to Wuhan Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在飞越 LKO，向武汉进近报告。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, BAW 817, over LKO.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，BAW 817，飞越 LKO。

cards.audioText:
C: BAW 817, how long do you need to dump fuel?
B: tell the controller you need approximately 25 minutes.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： BAW 817，你需要多长时间放油？
B： 告诉管制员你大约需要 25 分钟。
cards.referenceText: BAW 817, we need about 25 minutes. We need about 25 minutes, BAW 817.
cards.referenceTextZh: BAW 817，我们大约需要 25 分钟。我们大约需要 25 分钟，BAW 817。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have completed fuel dumping, report it to the controller and request radar vectors for Runway 22.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在已完成放油，向管制员报告并请求雷达引导至跑道 22。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, BAW 817, fuel dumping completed, request radar vectors for Runway 22.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，BAW 817，放油完成，请求雷达引导至跑道 22。

cards.audioText: C: BAW 817, turn right, direct to DA, descend and maintain 2100 meters on QNH 1015, expect ILS approach Runway 22.
cards.audioTextZh: C：BAW 817，右转直飞 DA，按 QNH 1015 下降并保持 2100 米，预计 ILS 进近跑道 22。
cards.referenceText: Turn right, direct to DA, descend and maintain 2100 meters on QNH 1015, expect ILS approach Runway 22, BAW 817.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转直飞 DA，按 QNH 1015 下降并保持 2100 米，预计 ILS 进近跑道 22，BAW 817。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have established ILS Runway 22, report it to Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在已建立跑道 22 ILS，向武汉塔台报告。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, BAW 817, established ILS Runway 22.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，BAW 817，已建立跑道 22 ILS。

cards.audioText: B: During landing, you encountered strong wind between 400 meters and the surface, report it to Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B：着陆过程中，你在 400 米至地面之间遭遇强风，向武汉塔台报告。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, BAW 817, we encountered strong wind between 400 meters and the surface.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，BAW 817，我们在 400 米至地面之间遭遇强风。

cards.audioText: B: After landing, you find the APU is inoperative, report this situation to Wuhan Ground and request ground power unit ready at the gate.
cards.audioTextZh: B：落地后，你发现 APU 失效，向武汉地面报告并请求到达停机位时准备地面电源车。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, BAW 817, our APU is inoperative, request ground power unit ready at the gate.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，BAW 817，APU 失效，请求到达停机位时准备地面电源车。

topics.name: UAL 221 乘客心脏病 乘客不舒服

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is UAL 221, you are maintaining 9200 meters, over IKUBA, squawking 5536, make initial contact with Shanghai Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 UAL 221，保持 9200 米，飞越 IKUBA，应答机 5536，首次联系上海管制。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Control, UAL 221, maintaining 9200 meters, over IKUBA, squawking 5536.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海管制，UAL 221，保持 9200 米，飞越 IKUBA，应答机 5536。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 221, maintain 9200 meters, direct to XSH.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 221，保持 9200 米，直飞 XSH。
cards.referenceText: Maintain 9200 meters, direct to XSH, UAL 221.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持 9200 米，直飞 XSH，UAL 221。

cards.audioText: B: You are encountering severe turbulence at 9200 meters, contact Shanghai Control and check if any higher level is available.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你在 9200 米遭遇严重颠簸，联系上海管制，询问是否有更高高度可用。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Control, UAL 221, we are encountering severe turbulence at 9200 meters, is higher level available ?
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海管制，UAL 221，我们在 9200 米遭遇严重颠簸，是否有更高高度可用？

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 221, 11600 meters is available now, say your intention.
B: Tell the controller you are unable to accept 11600 meters because of performance.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：UAL 221，11600 米现在可用，报告意图。
B：告诉管制员因性能原因无法接受 11600 米。
cards.referenceText: Negative, we are unable to accept 11600 meters due performance, UAL 221.
cards.referenceTextZh: 不能接受，因性能原因无法接受 11600 米，UAL 221。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 221, maintain present level, expect higher level after XSH.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 221，保持当前高度，过 XSH 后预计可上升至更高高度。
cards.referenceText: Maintain present level, expect higher level after XSH, UAL 221.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持当前高度，过 XSH 后预计可上升至更高高度，UAL 221。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are over XSH, maintaining 9200 meters, contact Wuhan Control and request higher level.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在飞越 XSH，保持 9200 米，联系武汉管制请求更高高度。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, UAL 221, over XSH, maintaining 9200 meters, request higher level.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，UAL 221，飞越 XSH，保持 9200 米，请求更高高度。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 221, Wuhan Control, radar contact, climb to and maintain 10400 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 221，武汉管制，雷达识别，爬升并保持 10400 米。
cards.referenceText: Climb to and maintain 10400 meters, UAL 221.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升并保持 10400 米，UAL 221。

cards.audioText: B: Suddenly, 1 of the passengers suffered from heart attack, contact Wuhan Control and request descent to lower level.
cards.audioTextZh: B：突然有 1 名旅客心脏病发作，联系武汉管制，请求下降到较低高度。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, UAL 221, 1 of the passengers suffered from heart attack, request descent to lower level.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，UAL 221，1 名旅客心脏病发作，请求下降到较低高度。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 221, maintain 10400 meters due airspace congestion, reduce speed to Mach 0.75.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 221，因空域拥挤，保持 10400 米，减速至马赫 0.75。
cards.referenceText: Maintain 10400 meters, reduce speed to M.75, UAL 221.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持 10400 米，减速至 M.75，UAL 221。

cards.audioText: B: The flight attendant reported that a passenger is feeling uncomfortable, report it to Wuhan Control and request descent.
cards.audioTextZh: B：乘务员报告有一名旅客身体不适，向武汉管制报告并请求下降。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, UAL 221, the flight attendant reported that a passenger is feeling uncomfortable, request descent.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，UAL 221，乘务员报告有一名旅客身体不适，请求下降。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 221, descend to 6600 meters, level at XSH.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 221，下降至 6600 米，在 XSH 改平。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 6600 meters, level at XSH, UAL 221.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降至 6600 米，在 XSH 改平，UAL 221。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 221, track direct to XSH, follows ZF-2A arrival, expect radar vectors for ILS approach 36 right.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 221，直飞 XSH，执行 ZF-2A 进场，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近跑道 36 右。
cards.referenceText: Track direct to XSH, follows ZF-2A arrival, expect radar vectors for ILS approach 36R, UAL 221.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞 XSH，执行 ZF-2A 进场，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近跑道 36R，UAL 221。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are over ZF, maintaining 6600 meters, you have got information O, contact Wuhan Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在飞越 ZF，保持 6600 米，已收到通播 O，联系武汉进近。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, UAL 221, over ZF, maintaining 6600 meters, information O.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，UAL 221，飞越 ZF，保持 6600 米，收到通播 O。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 221, Wuhan Approach, radar contact, current information is P, descend to and maintain 4200 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 221，武汉进近，雷达识别，当前通播为 P，下降并保持 4200 米。
cards.referenceText: Information P, descend to and maintain 4200 meters, UAL 221.
cards.referenceTextZh: 通播 P，下降并保持 4200 米，UAL 221。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 221, turn left heading 220, expect radar vectors for ILS approach Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 221，左转航向 220，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近跑道 36 右。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 220, expect radar vectors for ILS approach Runway 36R, UAL 221.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 220，预计雷达引导 ILS 进近跑道 36R，UAL 221。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 221, turn right heading 330, descend to 900 meters, cleared for ILS approach Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 221，右转航向 330，下降至 900 米，可以 ILS 进近跑道 36 右。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 330, descend to 900 meters, cleared for ILS approach Runway 36R, UAL 221.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 330，下降至 900 米，可以 ILS 进近跑道 36R，UAL 221。

topics.name: UAL 403 防冰 因重量提前下降

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is UAL 403, you are at Wuhan Airport, before departure, you received the cabin report said that there is ice and snow buildup on the wings, contact Wuhan Ground and tell the controller you want to have ice removed before start up.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 UAL 403，在武汉机场，离场前收到客舱报告，机翼有冰雪堆积，联系武汉地面，告知需要在开车前除冰。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, UAL 403, there is ice and snow buildup on the wings, request de-icing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，UAL 403，机翼有冰雪堆积，请求除冰。

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 403, where do you want to de-ice?
B: Tell the controller you want to de-ice on taxiway Z4.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：UAL 403，你想在哪里除冰？
B：告诉管制员想在滑行道 Z4 除冰。
cards.referenceText: Request de-icing on taxiway Z4, UAL 403.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求在滑行道 Z4 除冰，UAL 403。

cards.audioText: B: Tell the Ground controller you have completed de-icing and you are ready for taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: B：告诉地面管制员你已完成除冰，准备滑行。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, UAL 403, de-icing completed, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，UAL 403，除冰完成，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 403, taxi to holding point Runway 36R via taxiway Z4, A3 and A.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 403，经滑行道 Z4、A3 和 A 滑行至跑道 36 右等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point Runway 36R via taxiway Z4, A3 and A, UAL 403.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 Z4、A3 和 A 滑行至跑道 36R 等待点，UAL 403。

cards.audioText: B: The de-icing fluid is only effective for 30 minutes, tell the Ground controller you need to takeoff before 0835, and request intersection departure from Z4.
cards.audioTextZh: B：除冰液有效时间只有 30 分钟，告诉地面管制你需要在 0835 前起飞，并请求从 Z4 交叉口离场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, UAL 403, the de-icing fluid is only effective for 30 minutes, we need to takeoff before 0835, request intersection departure from Z4.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，UAL 403，除冰液有效时间只有 30 分钟，我们需要在 0835 前起飞，请求从 Z4 交叉口离场。

cards.audioText: B: You have encountered moderate turbulence, ask Guangzhou Control for a higher level.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你遭遇中度颠簸，向广州管制请求更高高度。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, UAL 403, we have encountered moderate turbulence, request a higher level.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州管制，UAL 403，我们遭遇中度颠簸，请求更高高度。

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 403, 10700 meters and 11300 meters are both available, which 1 do you prefer?
B: Tell the controller you want to climb to 10700 meters.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：UAL 403，10700 米和 11300 米都可用，你偏好哪一个？
B：告诉管制员你想爬升至 10700 米。
cards.referenceText: Request climb to 10700 meters, UAL 403.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求爬升至 10700 米，UAL 403。

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 403, radar shows you are a bit higher than your assigned level, check your altitude.
B: Tell the controller you are running into some turbulence.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：UAL 403，雷达显示你略高于指定高度，请检查高度。
B：告诉管制员你正在遭遇颠簸。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, UAL 403, we are running into some turbulence.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州管制，UAL 403，我们正在遭遇颠簸。

cards.audioText: B: Ask Guangzhou Control if there is any turbulence reported from preceding aircraft at 11300 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: B：询问广州管制，前机是否报告 11300 米有颠簸。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, UAL 403, is there any turbulence reported from preceding aircraft at 11300 meters ?
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州管制，UAL 403，前机是否报告 11300 米有颠簸？

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 403, there is no turbulence report at 11300 meters.
B: Tell the controller you want to climb to 11300 meters due turbulence.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：UAL 403，11300 米没有颠簸报告。
B：告诉管制员因颠簸请求爬升至 11300 米。
cards.referenceText: Roger, request climb to 11300 meters due turbulence, UAL 403.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，因颠簸请求爬升至 11300 米，UAL 403。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 403, climb and maintain 11300 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 403，爬升并保持 11300 米。
cards.referenceText: Climb and maintain 11300 meters, UAL 403.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升并保持 11300 米，UAL 403。

cards.audioText: B: Tell Guangzhou Control you request earlier descent because your landing weight exceeds maximum landing weight, and you will request descent now.
cards.audioTextZh: B：告诉广州管制，因为着陆重量超过最大着陆重量，请求提前下降，并请求现在开始下降。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, UAL 403, request earlier descent due our landing weight exceeds maximum landing weight.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州管制，UAL 403，因着陆重量超过最大着陆重量，请求提前下降。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 403, descend to 4500 meters, reach 4500 meters before ATAGA, start descent at own discretion.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 403，下降至 4500 米，在 ATAGA 前达到 4500 米，自主决定开始下降。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 4500 meters, reach 4500 meters before ATAGA, start descent at own discretion, UAL 403.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降至 4500 米，在 ATAGA 前达到 4500 米，自主决定开始下降，UAL 403。

cards.audioText: B: There is an indication of thunderstorm ahead, contact Guangzhou Control and request offset 10 miles right to avoid the weather.
cards.audioTextZh: B：前方有雷暴迹象，联系广州管制，请求向右偏航 10 海里避让天气。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, UAL 403, request offset 10 miles right due CB ahead.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州管制，UAL 403，前方有 CB，请求向右偏航 10 海里。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 403, 10 miles right approved, report clear of weather.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 403，同意向右 10 海里，脱离天气后报告。
cards.referenceText: 10 miles right approved, report clear of weather, UAL 403.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意向右 10 海里，脱离天气后报告，UAL 403。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are clear of whether, report the situation to Guangzhou Control and request direct to TON.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在已脱离天气，向广州管制报告并请求直飞 TON。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, UAL 403, clear of whether, request direct to TON.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州管制，UAL 403，已脱离天气，请求直飞 TON。

topics.name: UAL 831 后客舱异响 慢释压

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is UAL 831, a flight from Wuhan to San Francisco, you have completed push back and start up, contact Wuhan Ground for taxi instructions.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 UAL 831，从武汉飞往旧金山，已完成推出和开车，联系武汉地面获取滑行指令。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, UAL 831, push back and start up completed, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，UAL 831，推出开车完成，请求滑行。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 831, taxi to holding point Runway 04 via taxiway F, A7 and A.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 831，经滑行道 F、A7 和 A 滑行至跑道 04 等待点。
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point Runway 04 via taxiway F, A7 and A, UAL 831.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经滑行道 F、A7 和 A 滑行至跑道 04 等待点，UAL 831。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 831, contact Wuhan Tower on 118.65.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 831，联系武汉塔台118.65。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are at holding point Runway 04, you are ready for departure, contact Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在在跑道 04 等待点，准备离场，联系武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, UAL 831, holding point Runway 04, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，UAL 831，跑道 04 等待点，准备离场。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 831, cleared for takeoff Runway 04, surface wind 060, 10 meters per second.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 831，跑道 04 可以起飞，地面风 060，10 米/秒。
cards.referenceText: Cleared for takeoff Runway 04, UAL 831.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道 04 可以起飞，UAL 831。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are airborne, passing 600 meters, climbing to 1500 meters, contact Wuhan Departure.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在已离地，通过 600 米，爬升至 1500 米，联系武汉离场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, UAL 831, airborne, passing 600 meters, climbing to 1500 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，UAL 831，已离地，通过 600 米，爬升至 1500 米。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 831, cancel SID, direct to HFE, climb to 3900 meters on standard.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 831，取消 SID，直飞 HFE，按标准气压爬升至 3900 米。
cards.referenceText: Cancel SID, direct to HFE, climb to 3900 meters on standard, UAL 831.
cards.referenceTextZh: 取消 SID，直飞 HFE，按标准气压爬升至 3900 米，UAL 831。

cards.audioText: B: During climb, the purser tells you a passenger has heard abnormal noises from the rear cabin, you decide to level off at 2700 meters, advise Wuhan Departure your intention to level off due possible problem in the cabin.
cards.audioTextZh: B：爬升过程中，乘务长告诉你有旅客听到后客舱异常声响，你决定在 2700 米改平，向武汉离场说明因客舱可能存在问题，请求在 2700 米改平。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, UAL 831, a passenger has heard abnormal noises from the rear cabin, request level off at 2700 meters due possible cabin problem.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，UAL 831，有旅客听到后客舱异常声响，因客舱可能存在问题，请求在 2700 米改平。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 831, climb to and maintain 2700 meters, advise intention.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 831，爬升并保持 2700 米，报告意图。
cards.referenceText: Climb to and maintain 2700 meters, UAL 831.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升并保持 2700 米，UAL 831。

cards.audioText: B: The aircraft is leveling, no one else can confirm the noise that the particular passenger heard, you check all the instruments are indicating normally, you decide to continue the flight and request a higher level, call Wuhan Departure.
cards.audioTextZh: B：飞机已改平，没有其他人能确认该旅客听到的声音，各仪表指示正常，你决定继续飞行并请求更高高度，呼叫武汉离场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, UAL 831, all the instruments are indicating normally, request continue the flight and request a higher level.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，UAL 831，各仪表指示正常，请求继续飞行并请求更高高度。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 831, climb to 4500 meters on standard, contact Wuhan Control 120.5.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 831，按标准气压爬升至 4500 米，联系武汉管制120.5。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 4500 meters on standard, 120.5, UAL 831.
cards.referenceTextZh: 按标准气压爬升至 4500 米，120.5，UAL 831。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are maintaining 10700 meters, over HFE, squawking 5316, make initial contact with Shanghai Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在保持 10700 米，飞越 HFE，应答机 5316，首次联系上海管制。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Control, UAL 831, maintaining 10700 meters, over HFE, squawking 5316.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海管制，UAL 831，保持 10700 米，飞越 HFE，应答机 5316。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 831, Shanghai Control, radar contact, proceed direct to VMB.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 831，上海管制，雷达识别，直飞 VMB。
cards.referenceText: Proceed direct to VMB, UAL 831.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞 VMB，UAL 831。

cards.audioText: B: Now you confirm the strange sound from the cabin, your instrument indicates cabin altitude is rising slowly, slow depressurization is suspected, request immediate descent from 10700 meters to 3000 meters. This is an Urgency call.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在确认客舱有异常声音，仪表显示客舱高度缓慢上升，怀疑缓慢释压，请求从 10700 米立即下降至 3000 米。这是紧急呼叫。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Shanghai Control, UAL 831, our instrument indicates cabin altitude is rising slowly, suspect slow depressurization, request immediate descent to 3000 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，上海管制，UAL 831，仪表显示客舱高度缓慢上升，怀疑缓慢释压，请求立即下降至 3000 米。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 831, roger PAN, turn right heading 150, initially descend and maintain 8900 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 831，收到 PAN，右转航向 150，先下降并保持 8900 米。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 150, descend and maintain 8900 meters, UAL 831.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 150，下降并保持 8900 米，UAL 831。

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 831, turn left heading 210, descend to 3300 meters.
B: Read back ATC instructions and request the nearest suitable airport for landing.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：UAL 831，左转航向 210，下降至 3300 米。
B：复诵管制指令，并请求前往最近合适机场着陆。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 210, descend to 3300 meters, request the nearest suitable airport for landing, UAL 831.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向 210，下降至 3300 米，请求最近合适机场着陆，UAL 831。

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 831, the closest airport is Nanjing Airport, current visibility is marginal, I have to check if they can accommodate an aircraft of your size. Hongqiao and Pudong Airport has longer runway and can definitely accommodate your aircraft, advise your intention?
B: Ask radar vector to Shanghai Hongqiao or Pudong Airport which has a better visibility.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：UAL 831，最近的机场是南京机场，当前能见度临界，我需要确认他们能否接收你们这种机型。虹桥和浦东机场跑道更长，肯定可以接收，请报告意图。
B：请求雷达引导至上海虹桥或浦东机场，选择能见度较好的机场。
cards.referenceText: Request radar vector to Shanghai Hongqiao or Pudong Airport which has a better visibility, UAL 831.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求雷达引导至上海虹桥或浦东机场，选择能见度较好的机场，UAL 831。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 831, direct to HSH, expect radar vectors to land at Pudong Airport, contact Shanghai Approach on 128.35.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 831，直飞 HSH，预计雷达引导至浦东机场着陆，联系上海进近128.35。
cards.referenceText: Direct to HSH, expect radar vectors to land at Pudong Airport, 128.35, UAL 831.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直飞 HSH，预计雷达引导至浦东机场着陆，128.35，UAL 831。

topics.name: UAL 182 火山灰 双发失效 一发重启不稳定

cards.audioText: B: Your aircraft call sign is UAL 182, you are at the holding point of Runway 04, call Wuhan Tower you are ready for takeoff.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的航空器呼号是 UAL 182，在跑道 04 等待点，呼叫武汉塔台，报告准备起飞。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, UAL 182, holding point of Runway 04, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，UAL 182，跑道 04 等待点，准备离场。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 182, behind China Southern Boeing 777 on short final, line up behind Runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 182，在短五边 China Southern Boeing 777 后，跟随其后进入跑道 04。
cards.referenceText: Behind CSN B777 on short final, line up behind Runway 04, UAL 182.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跟随短五边 CSN B777 后进入跑道 04，UAL 182。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 182, when airborne, turn right heading 070, climb to 3000 meters, cleared for immediate takeoff Runway 04.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 182，离地后右转航向 070，爬升至 3000 米，跑道 04 可以立即起飞。
cards.referenceText: When airborne, turn right heading 070, climb to 3000 meters, cleared for immediate takeoff Runway 04, UAL 182.
cards.referenceTextZh: 离地后右转航向 070，爬升至 3000 米，跑道 04 可以立即起飞，UAL 182。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are airborne and passing 200 meters, call Wuhan Departure.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在已离地，通过 200 米，呼叫武汉离场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, UAL 182, airborne, passing 200 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，UAL 182，已离地，通过 200 米。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 182, after passing 1200 meters, turn left direct to ZF.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 182，通过 1200 米后左转直飞 ZF。
cards.referenceText: After passing 1200 meters, turn left direct to ZF, UAL 182.
cards.referenceTextZh: 通过 1200 米后左转直飞 ZF，UAL 182。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are in London Control area, FL350, you encountered volcanic ash, tell ATC the situation and request descent, call London Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你现在在伦敦管制区，飞行高度层 350，遭遇火山灰，向 ATC 报告情况并请求下降，呼叫伦敦管制。
cards.referenceText: London Control, UAL 182, we encountered volcanic ash at FL350, request descent.
cards.referenceTextZh: 伦敦管制，UAL 182，我们在 FL350 遭遇火山灰，请求下降。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 182, turn right heading 300, descend to FL290.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 182，右转航向 300，下降至飞行高度层 290。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 300, descend to FL290, UAL 182.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 300，下降至 FL290，UAL 182。

cards.audioText: B: Tell ATC you are still in volcanic ash area, both engines are vibrating highly, but aircraft can still be controlled.
cards.audioTextZh: B：告诉 ATC 你仍在火山灰区域，双发振动严重，但飞机仍可操控。
cards.referenceText: London Control, UAL 182, we are still in volcanic ash area, both engines are vibrating highly, but aircraft can still be controlled.
cards.referenceTextZh: 伦敦管制，UAL 182，我们仍在火山灰区域，双发振动严重，但飞机仍可操控。

cards.audioText: B: During descent, both engines flamed out, make a Distress call and request land at the nearest airport.
cards.audioTextZh: B：下降过程中，双发熄火，发出遇险呼叫并请求在最近机场着陆。
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, London Control, UAL 182, both engines flamed out, request land at the nearest airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，伦敦管制，UAL 182，双发熄火，请求在最近机场着陆。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 182, roger MAYDAY, turn right heading 340.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 182，收到 MAYDAY，右转航向 340。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 340, UAL 182.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 340，UAL 182。

cards.audioText: B: 1 engine was successfully restarted during descent, tell ATC the situation.
cards.audioTextZh: B：下降过程中 1 台发动机成功重启，告诉 ATC 当前情况。
cards.referenceText: London Control, UAL 182, 1 engine was successfully restarted during descent.
cards.referenceTextZh: 伦敦管制，UAL 182，下降过程中 1 台发动机成功重启。

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 182, what's your intention?
B: Tell ATC you still need to land at the nearest airport because the running engine is not stable.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：UAL 182，你的意图？
B：告诉 ATC 因工作发动机不稳定，仍需在最近机场着陆。
cards.referenceText: London Control, UAL 182, request land at the nearest airport due the running engine is not stable.
cards.referenceTextZh: 伦敦管制，UAL 182，因工作发动机不稳定，请求在最近机场着陆。

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 182, continue descent to 9000 feet, expect to land at Beatle Airport.
B: Tell controller you are not familiar with Beatle Airport, request airport information.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：UAL 182，继续下降至 9000 英尺，预计在 Beatle Airport 着陆。
B：告诉管制员你不熟悉 Beatle Airport，请求机场信息。
cards.referenceText: Continue descent to 9000 feet, we are not familiar with Beatle Airport, request airport information, UAL 182.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续下降至 9000 英尺，我们不熟悉 Beatle Airport，请求机场信息，UAL 182。

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 182, Beatle Airport landing Runway 02, elevation 2000 feet, runway 3000 meters long, 45 meters wide, ILS CAT I and II available.
B: Tell ATC you are able to land at this airport.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：UAL 182，Beatle Airport 使用着陆跑道 02，机场标高 2000 英尺，跑道长 3000 米、宽 45 米，可用 ILS CAT I 和 II。
B：告诉 ATC 你可以在该机场着陆。
cards.referenceText: London Control, UAL 182, we are able to land at this airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 伦敦管制，UAL 182，我们可以在该机场着陆。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 182, continue descent to 5000 feet and contact Approach 121.3.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 182，继续下降至 5000 英尺，联系进近 121.3。
cards.referenceText: Continue descent to 5000 feet and contact Approach 121.3, UAL 182.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续下降至 5000 英尺，联系进近 121.3，UAL 182。

cards.audioText: B: Contact Approach, tell them your emergency situation.
cards.audioTextZh: B：联系进近，告知他们你的紧急情况。
cards.referenceText: Approach, UAL 182, we encountered volcanic ash, both engines flamed out, 1 engine was successfully restarted but not stable.
cards.referenceTextZh: 进近，UAL 182，我们遭遇火山灰，双发熄火，1 台发动机已成功重启但不稳定。

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 182, roger your situation, runway is at your 2 o'clock, 10 miles, report airfield in sight.
B: Tell ATC you see the airport.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：UAL 182，收到你的情况，跑道在你 2 点钟方向 10 海里，看到机场后报告。
B：告诉 ATC 你看到机场。
cards.referenceText: Approach, UAL 182, airfield in sight.
cards.referenceTextZh: 进近，UAL 182，已看到机场。

cards.audioText: B: Tell Approach you need emergency services to be ready near the runway.
cards.audioTextZh: B：告诉进近你需要应急服务在跑道附近待命。
cards.referenceText: Approach, UAL 182, request emergency services to be ready near the runway.
cards.referenceTextZh: 进近，UAL 182，请求应急服务在跑道附近待命。

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is UAL 805 on a flight to Guangzhou, you are approaching WXI, maintaining 11000 meters, squawking 6527, contact Zhengzhou Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 UAL 805，飞往广州，正在接近 WXI，保持 11000 米，应答机 6527，联系郑州管制。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, UAL 805, approaching WXI, maintaining 11000 meters, squawking 6527.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州管制，UAL 805，接近 WXI，保持 11000 米，应答机 6527。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 805, radar contact, offset 3 miles right of track, reduce speed to Mach 0.75 due to Wuhan Control restrictions.
