cards.referenceTextZh: 将速度增加至 Mach 0.83 或更大，直飞 PEK，CES 769。

topics.name: CES 529 TCAS机动 备降/返航

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is CES 529, you are maintaining 8400 meters, make an initial contact with Shanghai Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 CES 529，保持 8400 米，与上海管制首次联系。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Control, CES 529, maintaining 8400 meters,.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海管制，CES 529，保持 8400 米。

cards.audioText: CES 529, Shanghai Control, radar contact, climb to 10,400 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 529，上海管制，雷达识别，爬升至 10,400 米。
cards.referenceText: climb to 10400 meters, CES 529. climb to 1400 meters, CES 529.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升至 10400 米，CES 529。爬升至 1400 米，CES 529。

cards.audioText: now you are cruising at 10,400 meters, your instruments indicate left pack has malfunctioned, contact Shanghai Control and request descend to lower levels.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你正以 10,400 米巡航，仪表显示左组件故障，联系上海管制并请求下降至较低高度。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Control, CES 529, maintaining 1400 meters, 10400 meters our instruments indicate left pack has malfunctioned, request descent to lower levels.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海管制，CES 529，正保持 1400 米，10400 米，我们的仪表显示左组件故障，请求下降至较低高度。

cards.audioText: C: CES 529, turn right heading 240, descend to 8900 meters initially.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 529，右转航向 240，先下降至 8900 米。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 240, descend to 8900 meters initially, CES 529.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 240，先下降至 8900 米，CES 529。

cards.audioText: B: During descent, your right pack is overheating, both packs have malfunctioned and request emergency descent, this is a Distress call.
cards.audioTextZh: B：下降中，你的右组件过热，两个组件都故障，请求紧急下降，这是遇险呼叫。
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, Shanghai Control, CES 529, our right pack is overheating, both packs have malfunctioned, request emergency descent.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，上海管制，CES 529，我们的右组件过热，两个组件都故障，请求紧急下降。

cards.audioText: B: During descent, your cabin altitude is rising rapidly, request emergency descent to 3000 meters, this is a Distress call.
cards.audioTextZh: B：下降中，你的客舱高度快速上升，请求紧急下降至 3000 米，这是遇险呼叫。
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, Shanghai Control, CES 529, our cabin altitude is rising rapidly, request emergency descent to 3000 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，上海管制，CES 529，我们的客舱高度快速上升，请求紧急下降至 3000 米。

cards.audioText: C: CES 529, descend to 3000 meters on QNH 1031.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 529，QNH 1031 下降至 3000 米。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 3000 meters on QNH 1031, CES 529.
cards.referenceTextZh: QNH 1031 下降至 3000 米，CES 529。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are maintaining 3000 meters, cabin altitude has resumed to normal, you will cancel Distress, report it to Shanghai Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你保持 3000 米，客舱高度已恢复正常，你将取消遇险，向上海进近报告。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Approach, CES 529, maintaining 3000 meters, the cabin altitude has resumed to normal, cancel Distress.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海进近，CES 529，保持 3000 米，客舱高度已恢复正常，取消遇险。

cards.audioText: B: The cabin crew reports 5 passengers in the cabin are seriously injured during emergency descent, inform the situation to Shanghai Control and request diversion to Hangzhou.
cards.audioTextZh: B：客舱机组报告 5 名旅客在紧急下降中严重受伤，向上海管制通报情况并请求备降杭州。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Control, CES 529, 5 passengers are seriously injured, request divert to Hangzhou.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海管制，CES 529，5 名旅客严重受伤，请求备降杭州。

cards.audioText:
C: CES 529, divert to Hangzhou approved, what assistance do you need?
B: Tell the controller you need ambulances upon arrival.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：CES 529，同意备降杭州，你需要什么协助？
B：告诉管制员抵达时需要救护车。
cards.referenceText: Divert to Hangzhou approved, request ambulances upon arrival, CES 529.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意备降杭州，请求抵达时救护车，CES 529。

cards.audioText: CES 529, roger, ambulance will be ready upon arrival.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 529，收到，救护车将在到达时就位。
cards.referenceText: roger, thanks, CES 529. CES 529
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，谢谢，CES 529。CES 529。

cards.audioText: C: CES 529, turn right heading 180, descend and maintain 2100 meters, QNH 1031, expect ILS approach Runway 06.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 529，右转航向 180，下降并保持 2100 米，QNH 1031，预计 ILS 进近跑道 06。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 180, descend and maintain 2100 meters, QNH 1031, expect ILS approach Runway 06, CES 529.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 180，下降并保持 2100 米，QNH 1031，预计 ILS 进近跑道 06，CES 529。

cards.audioText: B: Now tell Hangzhou Tower about your situation and request priority landing.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在告诉杭州塔台你的情况并请求优先着陆。
cards.referenceText: Hangzhou Tower, CES 529, 5 passengers were seriously injured during emergency descent, request priority landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 杭州塔台，CES 529，5 名旅客在紧急下降中严重受伤，请求优先着陆。

cards.audioText: C: CES 529, straight ILS approach Runway 06, report established.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 529，直线 ILS 进近跑道 06，报告建立。
cards.referenceText: Straight ILS approach Runway 06, report established, CES 529.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直线 ILS 进近跑道 06，报告建立，CES 529。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have established on ILS approach Runway 06.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已建立 ILS 进近跑道 06。
cards.referenceText: Hangzhou Tower, CES 529, established on ILS approach Runway 06.
cards.referenceTextZh: 杭州塔台，CES 529，已建立 ILS 进近跑道 06。

topics.name: CES 209 TCAS机动 备降/返航

cards.audioText: Your call sign is CES 209, you are in Shanghai Control area, you are maintaining 8400 meters, make an initial contact with Shanghai Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是 CES 209，你位于上海管制区，正保持 8400 米，与上海管制首次联系。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Control, CES 209, maintaining 8400 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海管制，CES 209，正保持 8400 米。

cards.audioText: CES 209, Shanghai Control, radar contact, climb to 1400 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 209，上海管制，雷达识别，爬升至 1400 米。
cards.referenceText: climb to 1400 meters, CES 209.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升至 1400 米，CES 209。

cards.audioText: now you are cruising at 1400 meters, your instruments indicate left pack has malfunctioned, contact Shanghai Control and request descend to lower levels.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你正以 1400 米巡航，仪表显示左组件故障，联系上海管制并请求下降至较低高度。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Control, CES 209, maintaining 1400 meters, 10400 meters our instruments indicate our left pack has malfunctioned, request descent to lower levels.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海管制，CES 209，正保持 1400 米，10400 米，我们的仪表显示左组件故障，请求下降至较低高度。

cards.audioText: CES 209, turn right heading 240, descend to 8900 meters initially.

title: OPI
description: 发音 结构 词汇 流利度 理解能力 应对能力

cards.audioText: Have you ever encountered a lightning strike during flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 你在飞行中遇到过雷击吗？
cards.referenceText:
（1）No, I have never encountered a lightning strike because we always take flight training in good weather conditions. 不，我从来没有遇到过雷击，因为我们总是在良好的天气条件下进行飞行训练。

（2）No, I have never encountered a lightning strike during flight. But I know a lightning strike is dangerous, so we should avoid lightning strikes during flight. 不，我在飞行中从未遇到过雷击，但我知道雷击很危险，所以我们应该在飞行中避免雷击。

cards.audioText: In what kind of weather conditions does lightning strike most likely to occur?
cards.audioTextZh: 在什么样的天气条件下最有可能发生雷击？
cards.referenceText:
（1）Based on my knowledge, if we encounter a thunderstorm, we may encounter a lightning strike.
据我所知，如果我们遇到雷暴，我们可能会遇到雷击。
（2）Lightning strike is most likely to occur/happen in CBs or thunderstorms.
雷击最可能发生在积雨云或雷暴中。
（3）Lightning strikes are most likely to occur in thunderstorms and cumulonimbus clouds (CBs) with strong convective currents. They can also happen in snowstorms, dust storms, or near erupting volcanoes. Summer is the peak season due to unstable atmospheric conditions that cause charge imbalances in clouds.
雷击最易发生在有强对流气流的雷暴和积雨云（CB）天气中，也可能出现在暴风雪、沙尘暴或火山喷发附近。夏季是高发季节，此时大气条件不稳定，易导致云层中电荷失衡。

cards.audioText: Why do you think lightning strike is dangerous to flight safety?
cards.audioTextZh: 为什么你认为雷击对飞行安全有危险？
cards.referenceText:
（1）Lightning strike really put a threat on flight safety. If we encounter a lightning strike. We will hear the loud bang and see the flash. It may make the aircraft difficulty to control, influence the electrical system, cause structural damage and passenger injury. we should try our best to avoid lightning strike.
雷击确实对飞行安全构成了威胁。如果我们遭遇雷击。我们会听到砰的一声，看到闪光。这可能会使飞机难以控制，影响电气系统，造成结构损坏和乘客受伤。我们应该尽力避免雷击。
（2）Lightning strike is dangerous to flight safety.
First, it may cause structural damage to aircraft such as fuselage, wings and electronic equipment.
Second, it may cause electrical failure.
Third, it may cause communication and navigation failure.
雷击对飞行安全来说很危险。第一，雷击可能导致飞机结构损坏，比如机身，机翼和电子设备；第二，雷击可能导致电气失效；第三，雷击可能导致通讯失效和导航失效。

cards.audioText: If your aircraft encounter a lightning strike during the flight. What will you do?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果你的飞机在飞行中遭遇雷击。你会怎么做？
cards.referenceText:
（1）First of all, I will calm down and have a good control of the aircraft, maintain the aircraft altitude, airspeed and attitude. Secondly, I will strictly follow the SOP. at the same time, I will advise ATC of our situation, request to deviate to avoid bad weather. If there is structural damage or passenger injury, I will request a priority landing.首先，我会冷静下来，很好地控制飞机，保持飞机的高度、空速和姿态。其次，我将严格遵守SOP。同时，我将向空中交通管制部门报告我们的情况，要求偏离以避免恶劣天气。如果有结构损坏或乘客受伤，我将要求优先降落。
（2）If we encounter lightning strike,
first, we will report our situation to ATC and request change the course/route to avoid lightning strike.
second, we will check if there is any structural damage on board.
If there is any damage to the aircraft, we will request emergency landing and emergency services.
If there is no damage to the aircraft, we will continue our flight.
如果我们遭遇雷击，我们将报告管制我们的情况，请求改变航道避开雷击；然后，我们将检查机上是否有损坏。如果飞机有损坏，我们将请求紧急着陆，请求紧急服务。如果飞机无损坏，我们将继续飞行。
（3）If encountering a lightning strike, I first maintain aircraft control and follow SOPs to execute the checklist. I check for structural or system damage, such as navigation failures. I report the situation to ATC and request diversion to an alternate airport if damage is severe. I also request maintenance inspection after landing.
遭遇雷击后，首先保持飞机控制，遵循标准操作程序（SOP）执行检查单；检查飞机是否有结构或系统损伤（如导航失效）；向空管报告情况，若损伤严重则申请改航至备降机场；落地后请求维修检查。

cards.audioText: How could we avoid the lightning strike? What are the measures that a pilot should take to avoid windshear?
cards.audioTextZh: 我们怎样才能避免雷击？飞行员应该采取哪些措施来避免风切变？
cards.referenceText:
(1)First of all, we should make a full preflight preparation. Before departure, listen to the ATIS and check weather forecast to make a weather analysis. Second, we should always have a good communication with ATC to know the weather on route. Thirdly we should have a good task sharing in the cockpit. The PF should control the aircraft. The PM should monitor the instruments and systems, pay close attention to the outside to visual check the adverse weather. At last, the aircraft should be equipped with advanced equipment such as weather radar to avoid thunderstorm.
首先，我们应该做好充分的飞行前准备。出发前，收听ATIS并查看天气预报，进行天气分析。其次，我们应该始终与空中交通管制部门保持良好的沟通，了解沿途的天气情况。第三，我们应该在驾驶舱内进行良好的任务分担。PF应该控制飞机。项目经理应监控仪器和系统，密切关注外界，目视检查恶劣天气。最后，飞机应配备气象雷达等先进设备，以避免雷暴。
(2)First, we can get the weather information before flight and during flight to avoid flying into to CB or thunderstorm Second, if we encounter lightning strike during flight, we will change the route/course to avoid the lightning strike
 首先，我们可以在飞行前和飞行中获取天气信息，以避免飞入CB或雷暴。其次，如果我们在飞行中遇到雷击，我们将改变路线/航向以避免雷击。
（3）To avoid lightning strikes, preflight I check weather reports and request delays or runway changes if lightning is near the airport. During flight, I monitor the weather radar closely and request deviation from ATC if lightning is detected ahead. I also avoid flying near CBs and thunderstorm areas.
避免雷击的措施：起飞前检查天气报告，若机场附近有雷电，申请延误或更换跑道；飞行中密切监控气象雷达，发现前方有雷电时向空管申请偏离航线；同时避开积雨云和雷暴区域飞行。

cards.audioText: How does lightning strike threaten/affect flight safety?
cards.audioTextZh: 雷击如何威胁/影响飞行安全？
cards.referenceText:
Lightning strike is dangerous to flight safety. First, it may cause structural damage to aircraft such as fuselage, wings and electronic equipment. Second, it may cause electrical failure. Third, it may cause communication and navigation failure.
雷击对飞行安全构成威胁。首先，它可能会对飞机的机身、机翼和电子设备等结构造成损坏。其次，它可能会导致电气故障。第三，它可能会导致通信和导航故障。

Lightning strikes can cause structural damage to the aircraft, such as cracking windshields or damaging control surfaces. Internally, they may lead to system failures, including electrical shorts, navigation/communication malfunctions, or electrical fires. Severe strikes can even ignite fuel tanks, endangering flight safety.
雷击会对飞机造成结构损伤，如风挡破裂、操纵面损坏；内部可能导致系统失效，包括电路短路、导航/通讯故障或电气火灾。严重雷击甚至可能引燃燃油箱，危及飞行安全。

cards.audioText: What damages does lightening bring to the aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh: 闪电会给飞机带来什么损害？
cards.referenceText:
First, lightning strike may cause damage to the aircraft such as fuselage, wings and electronic equipment. Second, lightning strike may cause communication and navigation failure.
首先，雷击可能会对飞机机身、机翼和电子设备等造成损坏。其次，雷击可能会导致通信和导航故障。

cards.audioText: In what weather condition is lightning strike most likely to happened/occur?
cards.audioTextZh: 在什么天气条件下最有可能发生雷击？
cards.referenceText:
Lightning strike is most likely to occur in thunderstorm or CB
雷击最有可能发生在雷暴或CB中

cards.audioText: What would you do if you encounter lightning strike?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果你遇到雷击，你会怎么做？
cards.referenceText:
If we encounter lightning strike, we will report our situation to ATC and request change the course/route to avoid lightning strike. Then we will check if there is any damage on board If there is any damage to the aircraft, we will request emergency landing and emergency services. If there is no damage to the aircraft, we will continue our flight
如果我们遇到雷击，我们将向ATC报告我们的情况，并要求改变航向/路线以避免雷击。然后我们将检查飞机上是否有任何损坏。如果飞机有任何损坏，我们将请求紧急降落和紧急服务。如果飞机没有损坏，我们将继续飞行

cards.audioText: How can pilots reduce the danger of encountering lightning strike?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员如何降低遭遇雷击的危险？
cards.referenceText:
First, we can get the weather information before flight and during flight to avoid flying into to CB or thunderstorm. Second, if we encounter lightning strike during flight, we will change the route/course to avoid the lightning strike.
首先，我们可以在飞行前和飞行中获取天气信息，以避免飞入CB或雷暴。其次，如果我们在飞行中遇到雷击，我们会改变路线/航向以避免雷击。

cards.audioText: What is your suggestion to reduce incidents caused by lightning strike?
cards.audioTextZh: 你有什么建议来减少雷击事件？
cards.referenceText:
First, we can get the weather information before flight and during flight to avoid flying into to CB or thunderstorm. Second, if we encounter lightning strike during flight, we will change the route/course to avoid the lightning strike.
首先，我们可以在飞行前和飞行中获取天气信息，以避免飞入CB或雷暴。其次，如果我们在飞行中遇到雷击，我们会改变路线/航向以避免雷击。

cards.audioText: In which phase does lightning strike usually occur?
cards.audioTextZh: 通常在飞行的哪个时期可能会遭到雷击?
cards.referenceText:
Lightning strike usually occurs during cruise phase (high altitude with CB/thunderstorms) and climb/descent phases when passing through convective clouds. Takeoff/landing phases are less likely but possible if the airport is in a thunderstorm area. It is more frequent in areas with strong atmospheric convection.
雷击通常发生在巡航阶段（高空积雨云/雷暴区域）以及爬升/下降阶段（穿越对流云时）。起飞/着陆阶段可能性较低，但如果机场处于雷暴区域也可能发生，在大气对流强烈的区域更为频繁。

cards.audioText: Have you ever encountered icing condition during flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 你在飞行中遇到过结冰的情况吗？
cards.referenceText:
（1）No, I have never encountered icing during flight.
 不，我在飞行中从未遇到结冰。
（2） No, I have never encountered in-flight icing. But I know in-flight icing is dangerous, it may affect the performance of the aircraft, so we should avoid icing conditions during flight
不，我从未在飞行中遇到结冰。但我知道飞行中结冰是危险的，它可能会影响飞机的性能，所以我们应该在飞行中避免结冰

cards.audioText: What are the Indications in the cockpit for icing condition.
cards.audioTextZh: 驾驶舱内结冰情况的指示是什么。
cards.referenceText:
（1）Actually, I am a student pilot. I fly DA - 40 for flight training. We don't have icing indications, but we can check the weather forecast to know the icing conditions. Besides, we will contact the controller to know the icing Information. What's more, we can visual check the icing condition.
事实上，我是一名学生飞行员。我驾驶DA-40进行飞行训练。我们没有结冰迹象，但我们可以查看天气预报以了解结冰情况。此外，我们将联系控制器了解结冰信息。此外，我们还可以目视检查结冰情况。
（2）As I know, there is no indication of icing conditions in the cockpit. But we can check if there is ice on the windshield or wings. If there is ice on the windshield or wings, we are in icing condition. Besides, if icing occurs, the airspeed may be reduced and engine thrust may be reduced.据我所知，驾驶舱内没有结冰的迹象。但我们可以检查挡风玻璃或机翼上是否有冰。如果挡风玻璃或机翼上有冰，我们就处于结冰状态。此外，如果结冰，空速可能会降低，发动机推力可能会减小。
（3）I fly DA-40, which has no icing indication. I judge icing by visual checks of wings/windshields for ice buildup, monitoring airspeed/altitude changes, and receiving ATC/pilot reports. If air temperature is below 0°C with snow/frost, icing is likely. Large aircraft have ice detectors for direct indication.
我驾驶的DA-40没有积冰指示设备。判断是否积冰的方式包括：目视检查机翼、风挡是否有冰层堆积；监控空速、高度的异常变化；接收空管或其他飞行员的积冰报告；若气温低于0摄氏度且伴随降雪、霜冻，也大概率处于积冰环境。大型飞机则装有冰探测器可直接指示。

cards.audioText: How is in flight icing dangerous for flight safety.
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行中结冰对飞行安全有何危害。
cards.referenceText:
Icing is very dangerous for flight. If we encounter icing during flight, it will degrade our aircraft performance. It will block the pitot tube. And there is abnormal airspeed or altitude indication in the cockpit. If the ice accumulates on the wings. It will decrease the lift and increase the drag. We should try our best to avoid icing.
结冰对飞行非常危险。如果我们在飞行中遇到结冰，会降低我们的飞机性能。它会堵塞皮托管。驾驶舱内空速或高度指示异常。如果冰积聚在翅膀上。它将降低升力并增加阻力。我们应该尽量避免结冰。
（2）icing is dangerous.
First, it may increase the drag and decrease the lift.
Second, it may cause damage to the aircraft and cause flight control problems.
Third, it may cause engine problems such as engine vibration, engine flameout  or engine failure.
Fourth, it may cause airspeed or altitude errors (if pitot tubes are blocked by ice).
fifth, it may cause the aircraft stall.
积冰危险。第一，结冰可能增加阻力，减小升力；第二，结冰可能导致飞机损坏，导致飞行控制问题；第三，积冰可能导致发动机问题，比如发动机熄火。第四，（如果皮托管被冰堵住，）可能导致空速或高度错误。

cards.audioText: What will you do if your aircraft sustains icing during flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果你的飞机在飞行过程中结冰，你会怎么做？
cards.referenceText:
If we encounter icing during flight, I will turn on the pitot heating system. We will advise the controller of our situation and request to change the flight route or flight level to avoid it.
如果我们在飞行中遇到结冰情况，我会开启皮托管加热系统。我们会把自身状况告知管制员，并申请改变飞行路线或飞行高度来避开结冰区域。

cards.audioText: If ice accumulates on the wings. What Will you do?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果机翼上结了冰。你会怎么做？
cards.referenceText:
If we are on the ground, we will request deicing. If we are in the flight, we will advise controller of the situation and request to change flight route or flight level to avoid it.
如果我们在地面上，我们将要求除冰。如果我们在飞行中，我们会通知管制员情况，并要求改变飞行路线或飞行高度以避免这种情况。

If ice accumulates on wings, I’ll activate anti-ice/pitot heating systems immediately. Report to ATC, request level change or deviation to avoid icing areas. Increase thrust to prevent stall. For DA-40, I’ll use hot bleed air, adjust altitude, and ensure no further ice buildup. Before flight, de-ice with fluid and remove ice manually.
机翼积冰后，立即启动防冰系统和皮托管加温功能；向空管报告，申请改变高度或偏离航线避开积冰区域；增大推力防止失速。对于DA-40机型，会利用发动机引气除冰、调整飞行高度，确保不再积冰。起飞前则会喷洒除冰液并手动清除冰层。

cards.audioText: Have you experienced in-flight icing?
cards.audioTextZh: 你经历过机上结冰吗？
cards.referenceText:
No, I have never encountered in-flight icing. But I know in-flight icing is dangerous, it may affect the performance of the aircraft, so we should avoid icing conditions during flight
不，我从未在飞行中遇到结冰。但我知道飞行中结冰是危险的，它可能会影响飞机的性能，所以我们应该在飞行中避免结冰

cards.audioText: Under what condition will icing conditions occur?
cards.audioTextZh: 在什么情况下会出现结冰情况？
cards.referenceText:
Icing occurs when three conditions are met: air temperature below 0°C, aircraft surface temperature below 0°C, and sufficient supercooled droplets in the air. It is more likely in cold weather with high humidity, such as in cumulonimbus clouds (CB), thunderstorm areas or winter flights.
积冰产生需满足三个条件：气温低于0摄氏度、飞机表面温度低于0摄氏度、空气中有足够的过冷水滴。在湿度大的寒冷天气中易出现，如积雨云（CB）、雷暴区域或冬季飞行时。

cards.audioText: Which areas is icing most likely to occur?
cards.audioTextZh: 哪些位置最有可能发生结冰？
cards.referenceText:
Icing is most likely to occur on the fuselage, the wings and the windshield
结冰最有可能发生在机身、机翼和挡风玻璃上

Icing is most likely to occur on aircraft surfaces with leading edges and critical components, such as wings, windshield, engine air intake, pitot tube, static port, radio antenna and landing gear. These areas are directly exposed to supercooled droplets and prone to ice accumulation.
积冰易出现在飞机的前缘部位和关键部件，包括机翼、风挡、发动机进气口、皮托管、静压孔、无线电天线和起落架等，这些部位直接暴露在过冷水滴中，容易积聚冰层。

cards.audioText: Why is icing a threat to flying/flight safety?
cards.audioTextZh: 为什么结冰对飞行/飞行安全构成威胁？
cards.referenceText:
Icing is dangerous because it may affect the performance of the aircraft. First, it may increase the drag and decrease the lift. Second, it may cause damage to the aircraft and cause flight control problems. Third, it may cause engine problems such as engine flameout if ice builds up on the engine fan blades.
结冰是危险的，因为它可能会影响飞机的性能。首先，它可能会增加阻力并减小升力。其次，它可能会对飞机造成损坏并导致飞行控制问题。第三，如果发动机风扇叶片上结冰，可能会导致发动机熄火等发动机问题。

Icing threatens flight safety by altering wing shape, reducing lift by up to 30% and increasing drag by 40%. It can jam flight controls, block pitot tubes (causing inaccurate instruments), ingest into engines (leading to flame-out), and obscure windshields. It also disrupts CG, affecting aircraft stability and increasing stall speed.
积冰会改变机翼形状，使升力降低30%、阻力增加40%，还会卡住操纵面、堵塞皮托管（导致仪表指示不准）、被发动机吸入（引发熄火）、遮挡风挡；同时破坏重心平衡，影响飞机稳定性并提高失速速度，严重威胁飞行安全。

cards.audioText: Do you have any indication in the cockpit to show the airframe icing conditions? If not, how do you know that you are in icing conditions?
cards.audioTextZh: 驾驶舱内是否有任何指示显示机身结冰情况？如果没有，你怎么知道你处于结冰状态？
cards.referenceText:
As I know, there is no indication of icing conditions in the cockpit.
But we can check the windshield or wings. If there is ice on the windshield or wings, we are in icing condition. Besides, if icing occurs, the airspeed may be reduced and rate of climb may be reduced.
据我所知，驾驶舱里没有结冰显示，但我们可以检查风挡和机翼，如果风挡和机翼有冰，我们处在结冰区。此外，如果出现结冰，空速可能减小，爬升率可能减小。

I fly DA-40, which has no icing indication. I judge icing by visual checks of wings/windshields for ice buildup, monitoring airspeed/altitude changes, and receiving ATC/pilot reports. If air temperature is below 0°C with snow/frost, icing is likely. Large aircraft have ice detectors for direct indication.
我驾驶的DA-40没有积冰指示设备。判断是否积冰的方式包括：目视检查机翼、风挡是否有冰层堆积；监控空速、高度的异常变化；接收空管或其他飞行员的积冰报告；若气温低于0摄氏度且伴随降雪、霜冻，也大概率处于积冰环境。大型飞机则装有冰探测器可直接指示。

cards.audioText: If ice accumulates on wings, what will you do?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果机翼上结了冰，你会怎么做？
cards.referenceText:
If ice accumulates on wings, we will report the situation to ATC and request change the altitude to leave the icing areas. Then we will turn on the de-icing and anti-icing system.
如果机翼上结冰，我们将向空中交通管制部门报告情况，并要求改变高度以离开结冰区域。然后我们将打开除冰和防冰系统。

cards.audioText: What kind of de-icing devices are there in the aircraft you fly?
cards.audioTextZh: 你驾驶的飞机上有什么除冰装置？
cards.referenceText:
There are some de-icing systems in my aircraft such as hot air system, electrical heater and de-icing fluid.
我的飞机上有一些除冰系统，如热空气系统、电加热器和除冰液。

cards.audioText:
What do you know about the
anti-ice system in an aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh: 你对飞机上的防冰系统了解多少?
cards.referenceText:
Aircraft anti-ice systems use electrical power or engine hot bleed air to heat critical surfaces (windshield, pitot tube, wing leading edges, engine intakes). It melts ice and evaporates water to prevent buildup. DA-40 uses hot bleed air, while large jets have dual systems for key components to ensure flight safety in icing conditions.
飞机防冰系统利用电力或发动机热引气，对风挡、皮托管、机翼前缘、发动机进气口等关键部位加热，融化冰层并蒸发水分以防止堆积。DA-40采用热引气防冰，大型客机则为关键部件配备双防冰系统，确保在积冰环境下的飞行安全。

cards.audioText:
How many types of ice can you
mention?
What kind of ice do you think is
the most dangerous for flight
safety?
cards.audioTextZh:
你知道多少类型的冰?什么类型的冰对
飞行安全最危险?
cards.referenceText:
Common ice types include rime ice, clear ice, and mixed ice. Clear ice is the most dangerous. It forms when supercooled droplets freeze slowly, creating a smooth, hard layer that alters aerodynamic shape severely, is hard to remove, and can quickly accumulate, leading to loss of lift and control.
常见的积冰类型有霜状冰、明冰和混合冰。其中明冰最危险，它由过冷水滴缓慢冻结形成，冰层光滑坚硬，会严重改变飞机气动外形，且难以清除、堆积速度快，易导致升力丧失和飞机失控。

cards.audioText: Can planes wait a long time to take off after deicing?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞机完成除冰后可以等待很长时间再起飞吗?
cards.referenceText:
No, planes cannot wait long after deicing. Deicing fluid loses effectiveness over time (typically 15-45 mins, depending on weather). Waiting too long allows new ice accumulation, reducing lift and endangering flight. Pilots must take off within the fluid’s holdover time; if exceeded, re-deicing is required.
不可以，飞机完成除冰后不能长时间等待起飞。除冰液的效果有时间限制（通常15-45分钟，取决于天气），等待过久会导致新的积冰形成，降低升力并危及飞行安全。飞行员必须在除冰液的保持时间内起飞，若超时需重新除冰。

cards.audioText: What is the difference between de-icing and anti-icing?
cards.audioTextZh: 除冰和防冰有什么区别？
cards.referenceText:
De-icing removes ice, snow, or frost that has already accumulated on the aircraft surfaces. Anti-icing prevents new ice from forming after de-icing. De-icing is usually done using hot fluid under pressure. Anti-icing uses a thicker fluid that sticks to the surface and absorbs moisture. In practice, most operations use a two-step process: first de-icing to clean the aircraft, then anti-icing to protect it before takeoff. Some fluids combine both functions. Pilots must understand the difference because the holding time starts after the final anti-icing application. Using only de-icing without anti-icing in active precipitation is dangerous.
除冰是清除飞机表面已经积存的冰、雪或霜。防冰是在除冰后防止新冰形成。除冰通常使用加压的热液体。防冰使用较稠的液体，附着在表面并吸收水分。实际运行中，多数操作采用两步流程：先除冰清洁飞机，再防冰为起飞提供保护。部分液体兼具两种功能。飞行员必须理解这一区别，因为保持时间是从最后一次喷洒防冰液后开始计算。在有持续降水的情况下只除冰而不防冰是危险的。

cards.audioText: What is holding time? Why is it important for de-icing and anti-icing?
cards.audioTextZh: 什么是保持时间？为什么它对除冰和防冰很重要？
cards.referenceText:
Holding time is the estimated period during which an anti-icing fluid will protect the aircraft from ice, snow, or frost accumulation. It starts when the final anti-icing application begins and ends when the fluid loses effectiveness. Holding time depends on the fluid type, weather conditions, and precipitation intensity. It is important because if takeoff exceeds the holding time, the aircraft may have new ice contamination on critical surfaces like wings. This reduces lift and increases drag. Pilots must check the holding time on the de-icing certificate. If takeoff is delayed beyond this time, the aircraft must return for re-treatment. Safety depends on respecting holding time.
保持时间是防冰液能够保护飞机防止冰、雪或霜积聚的预估时间段。它从最后一次喷洒防冰液开始时计算，到液体失效时结束。保持时间取决于液体类型、天气条件和降水强度。它之所以重要，是因为如果起飞时间超过了保持时间，飞机的关键表面（如机翼）可能会有新的冰污染，这会降低升力并增加阻力。飞行员必须检查除冰证书上的保持时间。如果起飞延误超过该时间，飞机必须返回重新处理。遵守保持时间关乎安全。

cards.audioText: What are the common types of de-icing and anti-icing fluids? How do they differ?
cards.audioTextZh: 常见的除冰液和防冰液有哪些种类？它们有什么区别？
cards.referenceText:
There are four main fluid types based on SAE standards. Type I is orange and used for de-icing. It is thin, heated, and runs off quickly. It provides very short holding time. Type II is off-white or pale yellow. It is thicker and contains thickeners to stay on surfaces longer. Type III is green and designed for smaller aircraft. Type IV is green and the most common anti-icing fluid for large jets. It is very thick and provides the longest holding time. Type I is for de-icing only. Types II and IV are for anti-icing. Pilots should check which type is used and what the expected holding time is for current weather conditions.
根据 SAE 标准，主要有四种液体类型。I 型为橙色，用于除冰，较稀、经过加热、流失快，保持时间很短。II 型为米白色或淡黄色，较稠，含有增稠剂以便在表面停留更久。III 型为绿色，专为小型飞机设计。IV 型为绿色，是大型喷气机最常用的防冰液，非常稠，保持时间最长。I 型仅用于除冰。II 型和 IV 型用于防冰。飞行员应确认使用了哪种类型以及在当前天气条件下的预期保持时间。

cards.audioText: Who is responsible for deciding whether de-icing or anti-icing is needed before takeoff?
cards.audioTextZh: 谁负责决定起飞前是否需要除冰或防冰？
cards.referenceText:
The pilot in command has the final responsibility for deciding whether de-icing or anti-icing is required. Before takeoff, the captain must check the outside air temperature, visibility, and precipitation. If there is frost, ice, or snow on the wings or control surfaces, de-icing is mandatory. The pilot cannot rely solely on ground crew recommendations. However, the pilot should consult with the airline’s dispatch and ground de-icing personnel for technical advice. Ultimately, if the captain has any doubt about ice contamination, they should request de-icing. Taking off with ice on critical surfaces is illegal and extremely dangerous. The final go/no-go decision belongs to the captain.
机长对决定是否需要除冰或防冰负有最终责任。起飞前，机长必须检查外界温度、能见度和降水情况。如果机翼或操纵面有霜、冰或雪，必须进行除冰。飞行员不能仅依赖地面人员的建议。但飞行员应咨询公司签派和地面除冰人员获取技术建议。最终，如果机长对冰污染有任何疑问，应要求除冰。在关键表面带冰起飞是非法的且极其危险。最终决定权在机长。

cards.audioText: What happens if a pilot exceeds the holding time after applying anti-icing fluid?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果飞行员在喷洒防冰液后超过了保持时间，会发生什么？
cards.referenceText:
If the holding time is exceeded, the anti-icing fluid loses its effectiveness. Ice, snow, or frost may start to accumulate again on the aircraft surfaces, especially on the wings and tail. Contamination on critical surfaces reduces lift, increases drag, and may cause early stall or loss of control. Therefore, the pilot must not take off after exceeding holding time. Instead, the aircraft must return to the de-icing pad for re-treatment. The pilot should inform ATC and ground handling of the delay. During taxi, if snow or freezing rain continues, the pilot may need to request a shorter holding time estimate. Never take off if you are uncertain about the condition of the wings after holding time has expired.
如果超过保持时间，防冰液会失效。冰、雪或霜可能再次在飞机表面积聚，尤其是机翼和尾部。关键表面的污染物会降低升力、增加阻力，可能导致早期失速或失控。因此，飞行员超过保持时间后绝不能起飞。相反，飞机必须返回除冰坪重新处理。飞行员应通知空管和地面服务人员延误情况。在滑行期间，如果雪或冻雨持续，飞行员可能需要请求更短的保持时间估算。如果保持时间过后不确定机翼状况，绝不起飞。

cards.audioText: What type of de-icing or anti-icing fluid should be used in heavy snow conditions?
cards.audioTextZh: 在大雪条件下应使用哪种除冰液或防冰液？
cards.referenceText:
In heavy snow conditions, a two-step process is recommended. First, use heated Type I fluid for de-icing to remove existing snow and ice. Then apply Type IV anti-icing fluid, which provides the longest holding time under severe weather. Type IV is very thick and can withstand heavy snow for a limited period. However, even Type IV has a maximum holding time. If snow accumulation is extreme, the pilot may need to request repeated de-icing just before takeoff. Some operators use Type II as an alternative, but Type IV is preferred for heavy snow. Never use only Type I in active heavy snow because it offers almost no holding time. Always check the fluid’s certified weather conditions.
在大雪条件下，建议使用两步流程。首先使用加热的 I 型液体除冰，清除积雪和冰。然后喷洒 IV 型防冰液，它在恶劣天气下提供最长的保持时间。IV 型液体很稠，能在有限时间内承受大雪。但即使 IV 型也有最长保持时间。如果积雪极端严重，飞行员可能需要在起飞前反复除冰。部分运营商使用 II 型作为替代，但 IV 型是大雪条件下的首选。在持续大雪中绝不要只使用 I 型，因为它几乎没有保持时间。务必检查该液体经认证的天气条件。

cards.audioText: What is windshear?
cards.audioTextZh: 什么是风切变？
cards.referenceText:
（1）Windshear is the sudden change in wind speed and wind direction in a small area. It can make the aircraft lose airspeed and altitude quickly.
风切变是指小范围内风速和风向的突然变化。它可以使飞机迅速失去空速和高度。
（2） windshear is sudden and rapid change in wind speed and wind direction  in a certain time and area .
 风切变是指在一定时间和区域内风速和风向的突然快速变化。

cards.audioText: Where is it most likely to occur?
cards.audioTextZh: 风切变最容易发生在哪里？
cards.referenceText:
Where?
- at seaside airports;
- at high elevation airports

风切变最可能在海边机场和高原机场发生

cards.audioText: Have you ever triggered wind shear warning?
cards.audioTextZh: 你触发过风切变警报吗？
cards.referenceText:
No, I have not triggered a wind - shear warning because I fly the DA - 40 for flight training. It is a small and light training aircraft. Our aircraft doesn't have a wind - shear warning system.
不，我没有触发过风切变警报，因为我驾驶 DA - 40 进行飞行训练。它是一架小型轻型训练飞机。我们的飞机没有风切变警报系统。

cards.audioText: If the wind shear warning is ignored by the pilot, what are the consequences?
cards.audioTextZh:
如果飞行员忽视风切变警告，会有什么后果？
What would be the possible consequences if the wind shear warnings were ignored by pilots?
如果飞行员忽视风切变警告，可能会产生什么后果？
cards.referenceText:
(1)We may encounter wind shear. It is very dangerous. Because wind shear is a sudden change in wind speed and wind direction. It can make the aircraft lose speed and altitude quickly. We encounter wind shear, our aircraft will be difficult to control ,even stall or crash
我们可能会遇到风切变。这非常危险。因为风切变是风速和风向的突然变化。它可以使飞机迅速失去速度和高度。我们遇到风切变，我们的飞机将难以控制，甚至失速或坠毁
(2) If wind shear warnings were ignored/disregarded by pilots, it is very dangerous. First, it may cause the airspeed increased and decreased. Second, it may cause the aircraft to lose altitude, so the aircraft is difficult to control.
风切变警告被忽略，非常危险。第一，风切变会使空速增加或减少；第二，风切变可能导致飞机掉高度。所以，飞机难以控制。

cards.audioText: Does your plane provide wind shear warning to the pilots?
cards.audioTextZh: 你的飞机是否向飞行员提供风切变警告？
cards.referenceText:
I fly DA - 40 for flight training. It is a small and light training aircraft. We don't have wind shear warning on our aircraft. But basis on my knowledge, there is low level wind shear warning system on big commercial aircraft that can provide wind shear warning. On big commercial aircraft, the weather radar and EGPWS can also provide wind shear warning for the pilot.
我驾驶DA-40进行飞行训练。这是一架小型轻型训练飞机。我们的飞机上没有风切变警告。但据我所知，大型商用飞机上有低空风切变预警系统可以提供风切变预警。在大型商用飞机上，气象雷达和EGPWS还可以为飞行员提供风切变预警。

cards.audioText: Why is wind shear a threat to flight safety?
cards.audioTextZh: 为什么风切变对飞行安全构成威胁？
cards.referenceText:
Wind shear is a sudden change in wind speed and wind direction. It can make the aircraft lose airspeed and altitude quickly. If we encounter wind shear, our a/c will be difficult to control, even stall or crash. It is very dangerous. We should try our best to avoid wind shear.
风切变是风速和风向的突然变化。它可以使飞机迅速失去空速和高度。如果我们遇到风切变，我们的空调将难以控制，甚至失速或坠毁。这非常危险。我们应该尽量避免风切变。

cards.audioText: Have you ever encountered wind shear during flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 你在飞行中遇到过风切变吗？
cards.referenceText:
（1）Yes, I once encountered wind shear during a training flight. When it happened, the aircraft's speed and altitude changed abruptly. I immediately followed the procedures: maintained aircraft control, communicated with ATC, and adjusted flight parameters to get out of the dangerous situation.
是的，我在一次训练飞行中遇到过风切变。当它发生时，飞机的速度和高度突然改变。我立即按照程序操作：保持飞机控制，与空中交通管制沟通，调整飞行参数以脱离危险状况 。
(2) No, I haven't encountered wind shear during flight so far. But I've studied relevant 应对 procedures thoroughly. I know if it occurs, I should prioritize aircraft control, report to ATC promptly, and make proper adjustments based on the situation.
不，到目前为止我在飞行中还没遇到过风切变。但我已深入学习了相关应对程序。我知道如果遇到，应优先保持飞机控制，立即向空中交通管制报告，并根据情况做出适当调整 。

cards.audioText: When pilots hear "go around windshear ahead" during approach. How do they perform the wind shear recovery maneuvers?
cards.audioTextZh: 当飞行员在进场过程中听到“绕过前方风切变”时。他们如何进行风切变改成机动？
cards.referenceText:
We will terminate the approach and perform go around, use the maximum engine power, pitch up 15 degrees, maintain configuration and pay more attention to the airspeed, attitude and altitude of the aircraft.
我们将终止进近并进行复飞，使用最大发动机功率，俯仰15度，保持配置，并更加注意飞机的空速、姿态和高度。

On hearing the instruction, immediately push throttle to TOGA thrust. Retract landing gear, adjust flaps to go-around configuration. Pitch up to climb attitude, keep wings level, follow runway heading. Monitor airspeed, altitude and attitude closely. Execute missed approach procedure, climb to designated altitude and report to ATC for further guidance.
听到该指令后，立即将油门推至复飞（TOGA）推力，收起起落架，调整襟翼至复飞构型；抬头至爬升姿态，保持机翼水平，沿跑道航向飞行；密切监控空速、高度和姿态；执行复飞程序，爬升至指定高度并向空管报告，等待进一步指令。

cards.audioText: When pilots encounter wind shear during takeoff roll before V1, what action should they take?
cards.audioTextZh: 当飞行员在V1之前的起飞滑跑过程中遇到风切变时，他们应该采取什么行动？
cards.referenceText:
If the pilots encountered wind shear during takeoff roll before V1 They should shut off the power first. Secondly, use rudder to maintain the aircraft straight on the runway. Thirdly, use the brakes to stop the aircraft on the runway.
如果飞行员在V1之前的起飞滑跑过程中遇到风切变，他们应该先关闭电源。其次，使用方向舵使飞机在跑道上保持笔直。第三，使用刹车将飞机停在跑道上。

cards.audioText: When approaching the rotation speed, wind shear is encountered and speed decreases suddenly, what would you do?
cards.audioTextZh: 当接近抬轮速度时，遇到风切变，速度突然降低，你会怎么做？
cards.referenceText:
Because the aircraft speed passes V1, we must go on takeoff. The PF should use the maximum engine power, pitch up 15 degrees, maintain configuration and pay more attention to the airspeed, attitude and altitude of the aircraft.
因为飞机速度超过V1，我们必须起飞。PF应使用最大发动机功率，俯仰15度，保持配置，并更加注意飞机的空速、姿态和高度。

cards.audioText: During approach, you notice more than one dot deviation from glide slope. What is the reason for that?
cards.audioTextZh: 在进场过程中，你会注意到多个点偏离下滑道。原因是什么？
cards.referenceText:
There are some reasons for this situation. For example, strong low level wind, navigation accuracy downgraded, improper flight control and so on.
这种情况有一些原因。例如，低空强风、导航精度下降、飞行控制不当等。

cards.audioText: Does your aircraft provide wind shear warning to pilots in flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 你的飞机是否为飞行中的飞行员提供风切变警告？
cards.referenceText:
I fly C172, there is no wind shear warning system。But I know there is wind shear warning system in large aircraft such as A320 0r B737. If there is wind shear ahead, we can hear the warning sound, wind shear, wind shear.
我驾驶的是C172，没有风切变预警系统但我知道A320 0r B737等大型飞机上有风切变预警系统。如果前方有风切变，我们可以听到警告声，风切变，风切变。

cards.audioText: Why is wind shear a threat to flight safety?
cards.audioTextZh: 为什么风切变对飞行安全构成威胁？
cards.referenceText:
Wind shear is dangerous to flight safety. First, it may cause the airspeed increased and decreased. Second, it may cause the aircraft to lose altitude, so the aircraft is difficult to control.
风切变对飞行安全有危险。首先，它可能会导致空速增加和减少。其次，它可能会导致飞机失去高度，因此飞机难以控制。

cards.audioText: Why is low Level wind shear more hazardous than high level wind shear?
cards.audioTextZh: 为什么低空风切变比高空风切变更危险？
cards.referenceText:
Low level wind shear is more dangerous than high level wind shear because low level wind shear may cause the aircraft to lose altitude and it is difficult for us to clear the obstacles such as terrains or buildings because the aircraft is too close to the ground.
低空风切变比高空风切变更危险，因为低空风切变可能会导致飞机失去高度，而且由于飞机离地面太近，我们很难清除地形或建筑物等障碍物。

Low-level wind shear (below 2000ft) is especially hazardous because it occurs during takeoff, initial climb, approach or landing. Pilots have insufficient time and altitude to respond and recover. It causes sudden airspeed and altitude loss, leading to stall, structural damage or crash in a short time, threatening crew and passengers' lives.
低空风切变（高度2000英尺以下）格外危险，因其发生在起飞、初始爬升、进近或着陆阶段，飞行员缺乏足够的反应时间和高度进行改出；会导致飞机突然失速、高度骤降，短时间内引发结构损伤或坠机，严重威胁机组和乘客生命安全。

cards.audioText: How do you recover from wind shear if you got wind shear warning in flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果你在飞行中收到风切变警告，你如何从风切变中恢复过来？
cards.referenceText:
If we got wind shear warning during takeoff: we would keep the control of the aircraft and add power to leave wind shear area, If we got wind shear warning during landing, we would go around immediately
如果我们在起飞时收到风切变警告：我们将保持对飞机的控制并增加动力以离开风切变区域，如果我们在着陆时收到风切警告，我们将立即复飞

cards.audioText: What should you do if you encounter wind shear during takeoff?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果起飞时遇到风切变，你该怎么办？
cards.referenceText:
If we encounter wind shear before V1, we will delay takeoff. If we encounter wind shear after V1, we will keep the control of the aircraft and add power to leave the wind shear areas.
如果我们在V1之前遇到风切变，我们将推迟起飞。如果我们在V1之后遇到风切变，我们将保持对飞机的控制，并增加动力以离开风切变区域。

cards.audioText: What effects might wind shear bring to your aircraft performance?
cards.audioTextZh: 风切变对飞机性能有什么影响？
cards.referenceText:
Wind shear has a significant impact on aircraft performance. First, it may cause the airspeed to increase or decrease. Second, it may cause the aircraft to lose altitude.
风切变对飞机性能有很大影响。第一，风切变可能导致空速增加或减小；第二，风切变可能导致飞机掉高度。

cards.audioText: According to previous reports, low level windshear is expected during take off. What's your decision?
cards.audioTextZh: 根据之前的报告，预计起飞期间会有低空风切变。你的决策是什么？
cards.referenceText:
If low - level wind shear is expected during takeoff as per previous reports, here are the decisions: Before the takeoff roll, we can delay takeoff and switch to another runway. During the takeoff roll, if the speed is below V₁, we reject the takeoff; if the speed is above V₁, we continue the takeoff and use maximum power to exit the wind shear area.
根据之前报告，若预计起飞期间有低空风切变，决策如下：起飞滑跑前，可推迟起飞并更换至另一条跑道；起飞滑跑期间，若速度低于 V₁（决断速度 ），就中断起飞；若速度高于 V₁（决断速度 ），则继续起飞，并用最大功率脱离风切变区域 。

cards.audioText: how do pilots determine whether wind shear is encountered?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员如何确定是否遇到风切变？
cards.referenceText:
Pilots can determine if wind shear is encountered through these signs: when airspeed changes by more than 15 knots, there’s a ground speed variation, or vertical speed shifts beyond 500 feet per minute. If such conditions occur, it likely means wind shear has been encountered.
飞行员可通过这些迹象判断是否遇到风切变：当空速变化超过 15 节、存在地速变动，或垂直速度变化超每分钟 500 英尺时，若出现这类情况，大概率是遇到风切变了 。

cards.audioText:
What is wind shear? Why is wind
shear dangerous?
cards.audioTextZh: 什么是风切变?为什么风切变很危险?
cards.referenceText:
Wind shear is the sudden change in wind speed and direction over a short distance, including horizontal and vertical types. It’s dangerous because it causes abrupt airspeed and altitude changes, making aircraft hard to control, increasing pilot workload. It may lead to stall, structural damage or even crash, especially during critical phases like takeoff and landing.
风切变是短距离内风速和风向的突然变化，分为水平风切变和垂直风切变。其危险性在于会导致飞机空速和高度骤变，难以操控，增加飞行员工作负荷，可能引发失速、结构损伤甚至坠机，在起飞、着陆等关键飞行阶段风险更高。

cards.audioText:
What suggestion do you have to
reduce accident caused by wind
shear?
cards.audioTextZh: 你有什么减少风切变危险的建议吗?
cards.referenceText:
To reduce wind shear accidents, preflight check weather forecast, ATIS and NOTAM. Avoid takeoff/landing in wind shear-prone areas. Inflight use weather radar and PIREP, monitor wind changes. Train pilots in wind shear recognition and recovery. Equip aircraft with predictive wind shear systems. ATC provide timely wind shear alerts to pilots.
减少风切变事故的建议：起飞前核查天气预报、自动终端情报服务（ATIS）和航行通告（NOTAM），避开风切变高发区域起降；飞行中使用气象雷达和飞行员报告（PIREP），监控风向变化；加强飞行员风切变识别与改出训练；为飞机配备预测性风切变系统；空管及时向飞行员发布风切变预警。

cards.audioText: How to recover from wind shear?
cards.audioTextZh: 如何从风切变中改出?
cards.referenceText:
To recover from wind shear, immediately execute recovery procedures. Push throttle to maximum (TOGA thrust), pitch up to 15 degrees, maintain configuration. Level wings to maximize climb gradient. Monitor airspeed, altitude and attitude closely. Do not change flaps or landing gear until out of wind shear. After recovery, re-establish normal flight profile.
风切变改出需立即执行以下程序：将油门推至最大（复飞推力），抬头至15度，保持当前构型；机翼水平以最大化爬升梯度；密切监控空速、高度和姿态；脱离风切变前不改变襟翼和起落架状态；改出后重新建立正常飞行姿态。

cards.audioText:
What kind of season or what kind
of area that is most likely to
encounter wind shear?
cards.audioTextZh:
在什么季节或者什么区域你觉得最有可
能遭遇风切变?
cards.referenceText:
Wind shear is most likely in summer (due to thunderstorms, CBs) and near airports, mountainous areas, or coastal regions. Summer’s unstable atmosphere breeds convective weather, while airports/coastal areas have sudden wind changes. Mountainous areas experience wind shear from terrain-induced airflow changes.
风切变最易出现在夏季（雷暴、积雨云多发）以及机场附近、山区、沿海区域。夏季大气不稳定，易引发对流天气；机场和沿海地区风力变化剧烈；山区受地形影响，气流变化易产生风切变。

cards.audioText: What is RVR？
cards.audioTextZh: 什么是 RVR？
cards.referenceText:
RVR stands for runway visual range. It includes the touchdown RVR, mid-point RVR, stop-end RVR.
RVR 是跑道视程（runway visual range）的缩写，它包括接地区跑道视程（touchdown RVR）、跑道中点视程（mid - point RVR）、跑道停止端视程（stop - end RVR） 。

cards.audioText: When and where will you obtain RVR?
cards.audioTextZh: 你会在何时、何处获取跑道视程（RVR）信息？
cards.referenceText:
When the visibility in the airport is less than 1500m, we can get RVR information from the ATIS or the controller.
当机场能见度小于 1500 米时，我们可从自动终端情报服务（ATIS）或管制员处获取 RVR 信息 。

cards.audioText: Does your company allow low visibility takeoff?
cards.audioTextZh: 你们公司允许低能见度起飞吗？
cards.referenceText:
In our flight school, if the visibility is low, or if the visibility is below our minimum, we will wait for weather improvement.
在我们飞行学校，若能见度低，或能见度低于最低标准，我们会等待天气好转 。

cards.audioText: When are low visibility procedures required
cards.audioTextZh: 什么时候需要低能见度程序？
cards.referenceText: 根据规定，如果能见度低于机场运行最低标准，需要低能见度程序。在这种情况下，管制员会告知飞行员正在实施低能见度程序。

cards.audioText: What's your company's policy for departing and landing in low visibility conditions?
cards.audioTextZh: 你们公司在低能见度条件下的起降政策是怎样的？
cards.referenceText:
I’m still a student pilot, so I don’t know the specific policy for departures and landings in low - visibility conditions. But I know the minimum takeoff and landing visibility for a C172 is 1,600 meters.
我还是一名飞行学员，所以不清楚低能见度条件下降落和起飞的具体政策。但我知道 C172 飞机的最低起降能见度是 1600 米。

cards.audioText: How can you avoid runway incursion in low visibility?
cards.audioTextZh: 在低能见度条件下，如何避免跑道侵入？
cards.referenceText:
To avoid runway incursion in low visibility, first, obtain ATC clearance before entering the runway. If in doubt about the clearance, confirm it with ATC. Second, maintain good situational awareness at all times.
要在低能见度条件下避免跑道侵入，首先，进入跑道前需获得空中交通管制（ATC ）许可。若对许可存疑，应向 ATC 确认。其次，始终保持良好的态势感知。

cards.audioText: What caution should pilots pay when taxiing on the taxiway in low visibility?
cards.audioTextZh: 在低能见度条件下，飞行员在滑行道滑行时应注意哪些事项？
cards.referenceText:
When taxiing on the taxiway in low visibility, pilots should maintain good situational awareness, strictly follow ATC instructions, and may request a follow - me car if visibility is extremely poor.
在低能见度条件下于滑行道滑行时，飞行员应保持良好的态势感知，严格遵循空中交通管制（ATC ）指令，若能见度极差，可申请引导车协助。

cards.audioText: How to avoid ground collision in case of low visibility?
cards.audioTextZh: 低能见度条件下，如何避免地面碰撞？
cards.referenceText:
To avoid ground collisions in low visibility, first, taxi slowly and cautiously. Second, strictly follow ATC instructions and maintain good situational awareness.
要在低能见度条件下避免地面碰撞，首先，缓慢且谨慎地滑行。其次，严格遵循空中交通管制（ATC ）指令，保持良好的情景意识。

To avoid ground incidents in low visibility, pilots should follow ATC instructions strictly, read back clearly, taxi slowly, use all lights, monitor frequency and airport charts, request follow-me cars, maintain good cockpit communication, and confirm positions if in doubt. Airports should provide adequate lighting and surface movement radar.
低能见度下避免地面事件的措施包括：严格遵循空管指令，准确复诵，低速滑行，开启所有灯光，监控频率和机场航图，申请引导车，保持良好驾驶舱沟通，有疑问时确认位置。机场应提供充足照明和场面监视雷达。

cards.audioText: In heavy fog, if you miss the correct taxiway, what will you do?
cards.audioTextZh: 大雾中如果错过正确滑行道，你该怎么办？
cards.referenceText:
If we miss the correct taxiway, we will hold position immediately, then report our situation to ATC and request further instructions. If necessary, we may request a follow - me vehicle.
若错过正确滑行道，我们会立即原地待命，随后向空中交通管制（ATC）报告情况并请求进一步指令。如有必要，可申请引导车协助

cards.audioText:
What's the policy in low visibility
situation?
cards.audioTextZh: 低能见度的运行政策是什么?
cards.referenceText:
The low visibility operation (LVO) policy varies by company and airport. During training, if visibility is below 1600m, we suspend training. Civil airports implement LVO when RVR is below 400m, using CAT II/III ILS approach. Pilots must meet qualification requirements, and aircraft need proper equipment. If visibility is below minimum, delay, divert or hold until it improves.
低能见度运行（LVO）政策因公司和机场而异。飞行训练中，能见度低于1600米时暂停训练；民用机场跑道视程（RVR）低于400米时实施LVO，采用二类/三类仪表着陆系统（ILS）进近；飞行员需具备相应资质，飞机需配备合格设备；能见度低于最低标准时，需延误、改航或等待至天气好转。

cards.audioText:
Can you name some consequences
of disorientation under low
visibility?
cards.audioTextZh:
你能说出在低能见度下失去方向的后果
吗?
cards.referenceText:
Disorientation under low visibility may cause runway incursion, ground collision, wrong taxiway entry, missed approach or go-around. It can lead to unstable landing, runway overrun/veer-off, structural damage, and injuries to crew and passengers. In severe cases, it results in flight accidents endangering flight safety.
低能见度下失去方向可能导致跑道入侵、地面相撞、误入滑行道、进近失败或复飞；还可能引发不稳定着陆、跑道冲出/偏出、结构损伤，以及机组和乘客受伤，严重时引发飞行事故，危及飞行安全。

cards.audioText:
How can we reduce runway
incursion during taxi in case of low
visibility?
cards.audioTextZh:
在低能见度下滑行时如何减少跑道入
侵?
cards.referenceText:
To reduce runway incursion under low visibility, taxi at low speed, turn on all lights (especially anti-collision lights). Follow ATC instructions strictly, readback clearly and confirm if in doubt. Use airport charts, request follow-me car if needed. Maintain good cockpit communication and situation awareness, monitor frequency closely.
低能见度下滑行减少跑道入侵的措施：低速滑行，开启所有灯光（尤其是防撞灯）；严格遵循空管指令，清晰复诵，有疑问时及时确认；使用机场航图，必要时申请引导车；保持驾驶舱内良好沟通和情景意识，密切监控通讯频率。

cards.audioText: What are the possible results if the aircraft operates in low visibility?
cards.audioTextZh: 在低能见下运行会产生的结果有哪些?
cards.referenceText:
Operating in low visibility may lead to runway incursion, ground collision, missed taxiways/runways, unstable approach, go-around, delay, or diversion. It reduces situational awareness, increases pilot workload, and raises risks of misjudgment, endangering both ground and flight safety.
低能见度下运行可能导致跑道入侵、地面相撞、滑错滑行道/跑道、不稳定进近、复飞、延误或备降。低能见度会降低情景意识，增加飞行员工作负荷，提升误判风险，危及地面和飞行安全。

cards.audioText: If you taxi to the wrong taxiway in low visibility, what should you do?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果你在低能见度下滑错滑行道,你会怎么做?
cards.referenceText:
If taxiing to the wrong taxiway in low visibility, I will stop the aircraft immediately, turn on all lights (anti-collision lights), report to ATC with my position, request confirmation and further instructions, and ask for a follow-me car if necessary. I will not proceed without ATC clearance to avoid incidents.
若在低能见度下滑错滑行道，我会立即停止飞机，打开所有灯光（防撞灯），向空管报告自身位置，请求确认和进一步指令，必要时申请引导车。在未获得空管许可前不会继续滑行，避免发生事故。

cards.audioText: Have you ever encountered turbulence during the flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行中 你遭遇过颠簸吗？
cards.referenceText:
（1）Yes, I encountered moderate turbulence when flying from XX to XX last year. The aircraft shook badly, but I maintained control and followed procedures. Fortunately, no passengers were injured, and the turbulence subsided after a few minutes. We landed safely at the destination airport.
遇到过。去年从XX飞往XX时，我遭遇了中度颠簸，飞机剧烈摇晃，但我保持住了控制并遵循程序操作。幸运的是没有乘客受伤，颠簸几分钟后平息，我们安全降落在目的地机场。
（2）No, I never encountered a turbulence but I know it’s dangerous to flight...
不，我从未遇到过颠簸，但我知道它对飞行是危险的...

cards.audioText: Do you think turbulence is dangerous to flight safety?
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为颠簸对飞行安全有危险吗？
cards.referenceText:
Yes, I think light turbulence is okay, but severe turbulence is dangerous to flight safety. If we encounter severe turbulence, it makes the aircraft difficult to control, even cause structural damage or passenger injury. We should try our best to avoid severe turbulence.
是的，我认为轻度颠簸没问题，但严重颠簸对飞行安全有危险。如果遭遇严重颠簸，会使飞机难以操控，甚至造成结构损坏或乘客受伤。我们应尽力避开严重颠簸。

cards.audioText: Why is severe turbulence dangerous?
cards.audioTextZh: 为什么严重颠簸很危险？
cards.referenceText:
Severe turbulence is dangerous. First, it may cause structural damage to the aircraft such as fuselage and wings. Second, it may cause the aircraft to be difficult to control. Third, passengers may get injured during turbulence.
严重颠簸很危险。首先，它可能对飞机造成结构损坏，比如机身和机翼。其次，会使飞机难以操控。第三，乘客可能在颠簸中受伤。

Turbulence is dangerous because it makes the aircraft hard to control, possibly leading to loss of speed, altitude, or even structural damage in severe cases. It can also cause injuries to crew and passengers if they are not properly strapped in. Additionally, it may disrupt critical flight phases like takeoff or landing.
颠簸危险是因为它使飞机难以操控，严重时可能导致速度、高度丢失甚至结构损伤；若机组和乘客未系好安全带，易造成人员受伤；此外还可能干扰起飞、着陆等关键飞行阶段。

cards.audioText: What damages may severe turbulence result in?
cards.audioTextZh: 严重颠簸可能会导致哪些损坏？
cards.referenceText:
Severe turbulence may cause structural damage to the aircraft such as fuselage and wings.
严重颠簸可能会对飞机造成结构损坏，比如机身和机翼（的损坏） 。

cards.audioText: What would you do if you have passengers injured due to turbulence?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果有乘客因为颠簸受伤，你将怎么处置？
cards.referenceText:
If the passengers get injured due to turbulence, first, we will ask the flight attendants to offer first aid to the injured passenger. Second, we will make a PA to find a doctor on board. Third, we will report our situation to ATC and request to land at the nearest suitable airport and ask for medical services.
如果乘客因颠簸受伤，首先，我们会让空乘为其提供急救。其次，我们会进行广播，寻找机上的医生。第三，我们会向空中交通管制（ATC）报告情况，申请在最近的合适机场降落并请求医疗服务。

If passengers are injured during turbulence, I first maintain stable flight control. I instruct the cabin crew to provide first aid and find a doctor on board if possible. I then inform ATC of the situation, request priority landing, and arrange for an ambulance to be available upon arrival to ensure timely medical treatment.
若颠簸导致乘客受伤，我首先保持飞机稳定飞行；指示客舱机组对受伤乘客进行急救，尽可能寻找机上医生协助；随后向空管报告情况，申请优先着陆，并安排救护车在落地后待命，确保及时救治。

cards.audioText: What rules should be followed to avoid clear air turbulence?
cards.audioTextZh: 为避免晴空颠簸，应遵循哪些规则？
cards.referenceText:
To avoid clear air turbulence, we should follow these rules: First, regularly monitor weather reports and forecasts, especially for areas prone to clear air turbulence. Second, maintain communication with ATC and follow their instructions on route and altitude adjustments. Third, conduct pre - flight briefings to ensure crew is aware of potential turbulence and response procedures. And when encountering clear air turbulence, report to ATC, request route/altitude change, and inform crew and passengers to fasten seatbelts as supplementary actions.
为避免晴空颠簸，应遵循这些规则：首先，定期监测天气报告和预报，尤其是易发生晴空颠簸的区域。其次，与空中交通管制保持沟通，遵循其关于航线和高度调整的指示。第三，进行飞行前简报，确保机组人员了解潜在颠簸及应对程序。而遭遇晴空颠簸时，向空中交通管制报告、申请改变航线 / 高度并通知机组人员和乘客系好安全带作为补充行动 。

To avoid CAT, preflight collect weather info from NOTAM, ATIS and ATC. Inflight monitor weather radar, PIREP and temperature gaps. Fly at stable altitudes, avoid high-level areas with unstable air. Buckle up passengers and crew. If detected, deviate, change level or detour promptly to stay clear of CAT.
避免晴空颠簸（CAT）需遵循：起飞前从航行通告（NOTAM）、自动终端情报服务（ATIS）和空管收集天气信息；飞行中监控气象雷达、飞行员报告（PIREP）及温差区域；在稳定高度飞行，避开高空不稳定空气区域；提醒机组和乘客系好安全带；发现CAT迹象时，及时偏离航线、改变高度或绕行避让。

cards.audioText: Have you ever encountered turbulence during the flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 你在飞行过程中遇到过颠簸吗？
cards.referenceText:
Yes, I have encountered severe turbulence during my flight training. Once, we flew from Guanghan to Suining, we were caught in severe turbulence when cruising at 1800 m. We maintained control of the aircraft and climbed to 2100 m, then everything was OK.
是的，我在飞行训练期间遇到过严重颠簸。有一次，我们从广汉飞往遂宁，在 1800 米巡航时遭遇严重颠簸。我们保持对飞机的控制，爬升至 2100 米，之后就一切正常了。

cards.audioText: What threat does clear air turbulence pose to flying/flight safety?
cards.audioTextZh: 晴空颠簸对飞行安全有哪些威胁？
cards.referenceText:
Clear air turbulence is extremely dangerous. First, it can't be detected before we fly into it. Second, it may cause structural damage to the aircraft such as fuselage and wings. Third, it may cause the aircraft to be difficult to control and the passengers to get injured.
晴空颠簸极具危险性。首先，在飞入颠簸区域前，它无法被探测到。其次，可能会对飞机造成结构损坏，比如机身和机翼。第三，可能导致飞机难以操控，且乘客受伤。

cards.audioText: How can pilots avoid the danger of turbulence during flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行中，飞行员如何避免颠簸伤害？
cards.referenceText:
There are many things we can do to avoid turbulence. First, we can obtain turbulence reports from other pilots and ATC. Second, if we encounter turbulence during flight, we will report it to ATC and request to change the altitude to avoid turbulence. Besides, we will make a broadcast/PA to inform passengers and cabin crew to remain seated and fasten their seatbelts.
我们可以采取多种措施避免颠簸。首先，我们可以从其他飞行员报告和空中交通管制（ATC）获取颠簸 / 气流报告。其次，若飞行中遭遇颠簸，我们会报告给 ATC 并申请改变高度以避开颠簸。此外，我们会进行广播，通知乘客和客舱机组人员就座并系好安全带。

cards.audioText: Besides turbulence, what bad weather conditions do you think may affect flight safety? How do they influent the flight safety?
cards.audioTextZh: 除了颠簸，还有哪些天气会影响飞行安全，如何影响？
cards.referenceText:
Besides turbulence, there are some other bad weather conditions such as wind shear, icing condition, crosswind, CBs, lightning strike, low visibility and so on.
Wind shear can cause sudden changes in airspeed and altitude, making the aircraft difficult to control, especially during takeoff and landing. Icing can accumulate on the aircraft’s surfaces, altering its aerodynamic characteristics, reducing lift and increasing drag.
 Crosswind can make runway alignment challenging during takeoff and landing, increasing the risk of runway deviation.
CBs (cumulonimbus clouds) often bring severe turbulence, heavy rain, and lightning, posing multiple threats.
Lightning strike may damage aircraft electronics and systems.
Low visibility hinders pilots’ ability to see landmarks, runways, and other aircraft, increasing the risk of collisions and navigation errors.
除了颠簸，还有其他一些不利天气，比如风切变，结冰，侧风，积雨云，雷击，低能见度等。风切变会导致空速和高度突然变化，使飞机难以操控，尤其在起飞和着陆阶段。结冰会在飞机表面堆积，改变其空气动力特性，降低升力并增加阻力。侧风会使起飞和着陆时的跑道对正变得困难，增加跑道偏离风险。积雨云常伴随严重颠簸、强降雨和雷电，带来多重威胁。雷击可能损坏飞机电子设备和系统。低能见度会阻碍飞行员观察地标、跑道和其他飞机，增加碰撞和导航失误风险

cards.audioText: Is turbulence dangerous to flight safety? WHY?
cards.audioTextZh: 颠簸对飞行安全有危险吗？为什么？
cards.referenceText:
(Yes,) Turbulence is dangerous. First, it may cause the aircraft to be difficult to control. Second, it may cause structural damage to the aircraft such as cabin luggage areas and cabin ceiling. Third, it may cause injuries to persons on board. Fourth, it may cause level/altitude deviation.
是的，颠簸是危险的。首先，它可能导致飞机难以操控。其次，可能对飞机造成结构损坏，比如客舱行李舱和客舱天花板。第三，可能导致机上人员受伤。第四，可能造成飞行高度 / 水平偏差。

cards.audioText: Do you have any suggestions on reducing risks of incidents caused by dangerous weather? How can the pilots avoid turbulence/CAT or bad weather?
cards.audioTextZh: 对于降低危险天气导致的事件风险，你有什么建议？飞行员如何避免颠簸/晴空颠簸或恶劣天气？
cards.referenceText:
Before my flight I will make a good preflight preparation, and collect weather information from ATIS, ATC, NOTAM and preceding aircraft. (check weathers reports on my takeoff airport/en-route and destination airport), if there’s a bad weather overhead airport or RWY, I will request to delay or change my takeoff RWY.
During flight I will monitor weather radar and collect weather reports, have good visual check, if there’s a bad weather ahead I will request to change level or deviate to avoid it. If adverse weather conditions exit over the destination airport, I will divert or hold until it improves.
在我飞行前，我会做好充分的飞行前准备，并从ATIS、ATC、NOTAM和前机收集天气信息。（检查我的起飞机场/航路和目的地机场的天气报告），如果机场或跑道上空天气恶劣，我会请求延迟或更改我的起飞跑道。飞行中，我会监控气象雷达并收集天气报告，进行良好的目视检查，如果前方天气恶劣，我会请求改变高度或偏航以避开它。如果目的地机场上空存在不利天气条件，我将改航或等待直到天气好转。

cards.audioText:
What is CAT? Why is CAT extremely
dangerous?
CAT
cards.audioTextZh: 是什么?为什么CAT非常危险?
cards.referenceText:
CAT stands for Clear Air Turbulence. It is extremely dangerous because it occurs in clear air (CAVOK condition) with no visible clouds, making it undetectable and unpredictable. It causes sudden, severe shaking of the aircraft before pilots can issue warnings, potentially leading to structural damage and onboard injuries.
CAT即晴空颠簸（Clear Air Turbulence）。它非常危险是因为发生在晴空环境（CAVOK）中，无可见云层，难以探测和预测；在飞行员发出警告前就会导致飞机突然剧烈摇晃，可能造成结构损伤和机上人员受伤。

cards.audioText: What influence does mountain wave turbulence impose to flight safety?
cards.audioTextZh: 山岳波湍流会对飞行安全造成什么影响?
cards.referenceText:
Mountain wave turbulence causes violent aircraft shaking, making control difficult. It may lead to loss of altitude/speed, structural damage, and injuries to crew/passengers. It also increases pilot workload and risks unstable flight.
山岳波湍流会导致飞机剧烈颠簸，难以操控，可能造成高度/速度丢失、结构损伤以及机组人员和乘客受伤，还会增加飞行员工作负荷并带来飞行不稳定的风险。

cards.audioText: How do you search for cumulonimbus or thunderstorm during flight.
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行中如何搜寻积雨云或雷暴？
cards.referenceText:
First of all, we will maintain communication with ATC to know the cumulonimbus and thunderstorm en route. Secondly, we should have good task sharing in the cockpit. The PF should control the aircraft. The PM should pay close attention to the outside to visually check for cumulonimbus and thunderstorm. At last, we can monitor the weather radar to detect CBs and thunderstorm.
首先，我们会与空中交通管制（ATC）做好沟通，了解航路上积雨云与雷暴的情况。其次，驾驶舱内要做好任务分工，操纵飞机的飞行员（PF）负责控制飞机，监控飞行员（PM）需密切关注外部，目视检查积雨云与雷暴。最后，我们可通过监视气象雷达，来探测积雨云（CBs）和雷暴 。

cards.audioText:
What damage might CB bring to your aircraft?
CB
cards.audioTextZh: 会给飞机带来哪些危害？
cards.referenceText:
（1）CBs really pose a threat to flight safety. If we encounter CBs, it may make the aircraft difficult to control, cause structural damage or injuries to passengers. We should try our best to avoid CBs.
积雨云（CBs）确实对飞行安全构成威胁。若遭遇积雨云，可能使飞机难以操控、造成结构损坏或乘客受伤。我们应尽力避让积雨云。
（2）CB is dangerous because CB is often accompanied by lightning, heavy rain, strong wind and severe turbulence. Lightning strike may cause structural damage to the aircraft, especially to the electronic equipment. Heavy rain may cause low visibility or engine flameout. Strong wind and severe turbulence may make the aircraft difficult to control.
积雨云（CB）很危险，因为它常伴随雷电、强降雨、大风和严重颠簸。雷击可能对飞机造成结构损坏，尤其会影响电子设备。强降雨可能导致能见度降低或发动机熄火。大风和严重颠簸可能使飞机难以操控 。

cards.audioText: Have you ever flown into CB? Why is CB dangerous?
cards.audioTextZh: 你曾飞进过积雨云（CB）吗？积雨云为何危险？
cards.referenceText:
No, I have never flown into CB, but I know CB is dangerous because CB is often accompanied by lightning, heavy rain, strong wind and severe turbulence. Lightning strike may cause structural damage to the aircraft, especially to the electronic equipment. Heavy rain may cause engine flameout. Strong wind and severe turbulence may make the aircraft difficult to control.
没有，我从未飞进过积雨云。但我知道积雨云危险，因为它常伴随雷电、强降雨、大风和严重颠簸。雷击可能对飞机造成结构损坏，尤其会影响电子设备。强降雨可能导致发动机熄火。大风和严重颠簸可能使飞机难以操控 。

No, I haven’t flown into CB. CB is dangerous because it contains multiple hazards: heavy rain, hail, lightning strikes, strong turbulence, and icing. These can make the aircraft hard to control, cause structural damage, system malfunctions, or even engine failure, posing severe threats to flight safety.
我没有飞进过积雨云（CB）。积雨云危险是因为它包含多种危害：大雨、冰雹、雷击、强颠簸和积冰。这些会导致飞机难以操控、结构损伤、系统故障甚至发动机失效，对飞行安全构成严重威胁。

cards.audioText: How is CB displayed on the instrument in the cockpit?
cards.audioTextZh: 驾驶舱仪表上如何显示积雨云（CBs）？
cards.referenceText:
The CBs are displayed in red on the ND/MFD in the cockpit.
积雨云在导航显示器 / 多功能显示器（ND/MFD）上以红色显示 。

CBs are displayed on the on-board weather radar in the cockpit. Typically, they show as red areas, indicating intense precipitation and strong convective activity. Pilots can also detect CBs through visual checks — they appear as dark, towering clouds with a cauliflower-like shape.
积雨云在驾驶舱的机载气象雷达上显示为红色区域，代表强降水和强烈对流活动。

cards.audioText: How do pilots search for CB ahead?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员如何搜寻前方的积雨云（CB）？
cards.referenceText:
We can search for CB ahead with the weather radar, and the CBs are displayed in red on the ND/MFD.
我们可以用气象雷达搜寻前方的积雨云。积雨云会在导航显示器 / 多功能显示器（ND/MFD）上以红色显示 。

cards.audioText: Describe one of the unforgettable flights when encountering CB
cards.audioTextZh: 描述一次遭遇积雨云（CB）时难忘的飞行经历
cards.referenceText:
Sorry, I have never encountered CB. But I know CB is dangerous. If we encounter CB, we will report the situation to ATC and request clearance to go round. Then we will change the course/route. When we are clear of the thunderstorm, we will rejoin the planned route.
抱歉，我从未遭遇过积雨云。但我知道积雨云很危险。若遭遇积雨云，我们会向空中交通管制（ATC）报告情况，申请许可绕飞。随后我们会变更航线。当脱离雷暴影响后，我们会重新加入预定航线 。

cards.audioText:
What should a pilot do if there is
an indication of CBs ahead?
cards.audioTextZh: 当前方有积雨云时,飞行员应该怎么做?
cards.referenceText:
When CBs are indicated ahead, I first report to ATC and request deviation to avoid them. I use the weather radar to confirm their position and extent, then adjust the flight route to offset left or right until clear of the weather. I never fly through CBs and will divert or hold if necessary.
当前方出现积雨云指示时，我首先向空管报告并申请偏离航线避让；通过气象雷达确认积雨云的位置和范围，调整航线向左或向右偏移，直至脱离危险天气。绝不穿越积雨云，必要时改航或等待。

cards.audioText:
How does the on-board weather
radar detect the intensity of
precipitation?
cards.audioTextZh: 机载气象雷达如何检测降水的强度?
cards.referenceText:
On-board weather radar emits microwave pulses that reflect off water droplets or ice crystals in precipitation. The intensity of the reflected signal determines precipitation strength — stronger reflections (displayed as red) indicate heavy precipitation, while weaker ones (green/yellow) mean light to moderate precipitation.
机载气象雷达发射微波脉冲，脉冲遇到降水中的水滴或冰晶后反射。反射信号的强度决定降水强度：强反射（显示为红色）代表强降水，弱反射（绿色/黄色）代表弱至中强度降水。

cards.audioText: What is the main purpose of the weather radar on board?
cards.audioTextZh: 机载气象雷达的主要作用是什么？
cards.referenceText:
The main purpose of the weather radar is to detect hazardous weather ahead, such as thunderstorms, heavy precipitation, hail, and turbulence. It helps pilots avoid dangerous areas by displaying weather returns on the navigation screen. Different colors represent different precipitation intensities — green for light, yellow for moderate, and red for severe. Pilots can use the radar to determine the most effective deviation path, usually upwind of a storm. The radar also helps maintain passenger comfort and fuel efficiency by avoiding unnecessary turbulence. However, pilots must understand its limitations, such as radar shadowing and attenuation. Proper use of weather radar is essential for weather avoidance and flight safety.
气象雷达的主要作用是探测前方危险天气，例如雷暴、强降水、冰雹和颠簸。它通过在导航屏幕上显示气象回波，帮助飞行员避开危险区域。不同颜色代表不同降水强度 —— 绿色为轻度，黄色为中度，红色为重度。飞行员可以利用雷达确定最有效的绕飞路径，通常在雷雨的上风侧。气象雷达还能通过避开不必要的颠簸，提升乘客舒适度并节省燃油。但飞行员必须了解其局限性，如雷达阴影和信号衰减。正确使用气象雷达对避开恶劣天气和保障飞行安全至关重要。

cards.audioText: How do you use weather radar to avoid a thunderstorm?
cards.audioTextZh: 你如何使用气象雷达避开雷雨？
cards.referenceText:
When I see a thunderstorm on weather radar, I first identify the red or magenta areas, which indicate the most severe activity. I never try to fly through or under a thunderstorm. The recommended procedure is to deviate upwind of the storm, because hail and turbulence are usually more severe on the downwind side. I maintain at least 20 nautical miles separation from severe cells. If the radar shows heavy precipitation ahead, I request ATC for deviation and inform the cabin crew. I also adjust the radar tilt to see weather at my flight level and below. Continuous monitoring is important because storms can grow or change direction quickly. Weather radar is a tool, but my eyes and ATC information also help.
当我在气象雷达上看到雷雨时，首先识别红色或品红色区域，这些区域表示最强烈的天气活动。我从不试图从雷雨下方或中间穿过。推荐的做法是向雷雨的上风侧绕飞，因为冰雹和颠簸通常在下风侧更严重。我至少与强雷暴单体保持 20 海里的间隔。如果雷达前方显示强降水，我会请求空管允许偏航，并通知客舱机组。我还会调整雷达俯仰角，以观察我所在高度层及下方的天气。持续监控很重要，因为雷雨可能快速增强或改变方向。气象雷达是工具，但目视观察和空管信息同样有帮助。

cards.audioText: What are the limitations of weather radar?
cards.audioTextZh: 气象雷达有哪些局限性？
cards.referenceText:
Weather radar has several limitations. First, it only detects precipitation, not turbulence directly. Turbulence is inferred from precipitation intensity. Second, radar shadowing occurs when a strong storm blocks the radar beam, hiding weather behind it. Third, attenuation happens in heavy rain, reducing the radar's ability to see beyond the storm. Fourth, the radar cannot detect dry turbulence, clear air turbulence, or volcanic ash. Fifth, the tilt setting must be adjusted correctly; if set too low, it may show ground returns instead of weather. Finally, storms can develop faster than the radar can update. Therefore, pilots should never rely solely on weather radar. They should also use ATC weather reports, onboard lightning sensors, and visual observation. Safety requires multiple sources of information.
气象雷达有若干局限性。第一，它只探测降水，不能直接探测颠簸 —— 颠簸是通过降水强度推断的。第二，当强雷暴阻挡雷达波束时会产生雷达阴影，遮蔽后方的天气。第三，强降雨中会发生信号衰减，降低雷达穿透雷雨后的探测能力。第四，雷达无法探测干性颠簸、晴空颠簸或火山灰。第五，必须正确调整俯仰角设置，如果设得过低，可能显示地面回波而非天气。最后，雷暴的发展速度可能快于雷达的更新速度。因此，飞行员绝不能仅依赖气象雷达，还应结合空管天气报告、机载雷电传感器和目视观察。安全需要多种信息来源。

cards.audioText: How does a thunderstorm develop?
cards.audioTextZh: 雷暴是如何发展形成的？
cards.referenceText:
If there is moist air, swift updraft, and an unstable atmosphere, a thunderstorm will develop.
若存在潮湿空气、强烈上升气流以及不稳定的大气环境，雷暴便会发展形成 。

cards.audioText: What are the stages of thunderstorms?
cards.audioTextZh: 雷暴的发展阶段有哪些？
cards.referenceText:
Thunderstorms always happen in summer. There are three stages of a thunderstorm: developing stage, mature stage, and dissipating stage. During the developing stage, it is full of updraft. During the mature stage, there is rainfall. During the dissipating stage, there are strong downdrafts.
雷暴常发生在夏季。雷暴有三个发展阶段：发展阶段、成熟阶段和消散阶段。在发展阶段，上升气流旺盛；在成熟阶段，会出现降雨；在消散阶段，有强烈的下沉气流 。

Thunderstorms have three stages. The developing stage is full of updrafts, with moisture condensing into water droplets to form storm clouds. The mature stage has both updrafts and downdrafts, accompanied by heavy rain, lightning, and thunder. The dissipating stage features stronger downdrafts, with the storm dying out as warm moist air stops rising.
雷暴分为三个阶段。发展阶段：充满上升气流，水汽凝结成水滴，风暴云逐渐形成；成熟阶段：上升气流与下降气流并存，伴随大雨、雷电；消散阶段：下降气流占主导，暖湿空气停止上升，风暴逐渐减弱直至消失。

cards.audioText: How do pilots go round the thunderstorm during flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行中飞行员如何绕飞雷暴？
cards.referenceText:
For example, if I encounter a thunderstorm during flight, I will advise the controller of our situation and request an offset of 10 miles to the right or left of the track to avoid the thunderstorm.
例如，若我在飞行中遭遇雷暴，会向管制员报告情况，并申请向航迹右侧或左侧偏移 10 海里以避让雷暴 。

cards.audioText: In which season is a thunderstorm most likely to occur?
cards.audioTextZh: 雷暴最有可能在哪个季节发生？
cards.referenceText:
Thunderstorms are most likely to occur in summer.
雷暴最有可能在夏季发生 。

Thunderstorms are most likely to occur in summer. Summer’s high temperature leads to strong convective currents in the air, which easily form cumulonimbus clouds (CBs) — the main source of thunderstorms. They can also occur in spring or autumn in some regions with unstable weather conditions.
雷暴最常见于夏季。夏季气温高，空气对流强烈，易形成积雨云（CB），而积雨云是雷暴的主要成因。在部分地区，春秋季天气不稳定时也可能出现雷暴。

cards.audioText: if there is an indication of thunderstorm, what will you do?
cards.audioTextZh: 若有雷暴迹象，你会怎么做？
cards.referenceText:
If there is an indication of a thunderstorm ahead of us, we will report the situation to ATC and request clearance to go round. Then we will change the course/route. When we are clear of the thunderstorm, we will rejoin the planned route.
若前方有雷暴迹象，我们会向空中交通管制（ATC）报告情况，申请许可绕飞。随后我们会变更航线。当脱离雷暴影响后，我们会重新加入预定航线 。

cards.audioText: If there is a thunderstorm at the airport, what will you do?
cards.audioTextZh: 若机场有雷暴，你会怎么做？
cards.referenceText:
If there is a thunderstorm at the airport and we are still on the ground, we will stop the aircraft and wait for the weather to improve. If we are flying in the air, we will hold to wait for the weather to improve or divert to the alternate airport.
若机场有雷暴且我们仍在地面，会让飞机停场并等待天气好转。若在空中飞行，我们会盘旋等待天气好转，或改航至备降机场 。

If there is a thunderstorm at the airport, I will request to delay departure or change to another runway before flight. During flight, I will ask ATC for holding until the weather improves, or request diversion to an alternate airport. I will never attempt to take off or land in a thunderstorm to avoid hazards like lightning strikes.
若机场附近有雷暴，起飞前我会申请延误起飞或更换跑道；飞行中则向空管申请等待至天气好转，或请求改航至备降机场。绝不会在雷暴中尝试起降，以规避雷击等风险。

cards.audioText: How do you make the weather analysis before each flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 每次飞行前，你们如何进行天气分析？
cards.referenceText:
Before flight, we can get weather information from the dispatching office, ATIS, or ATC. During the preflight briefing, we will discuss the weather information in the briefing room.
飞行前，我们可从签派室、自动终端情报服务（ATIS）或空中交通管制（ATC）获取天气信息。在飞行前简报阶段，我们会在 briefing room（ briefing 一般指飞行前的任务、天气等简报会，可译为 “飞行准备室 / briefing 室” ，若需更明确，也可结合公司习惯，比如 “ briefing 室” 常用作 “飞行准备室” ）讨论天气信息 。

cards.audioText: If you encounter strong crosswind, what will you do?
cards.audioTextZh: 若遇到强侧风，你会怎么做？
cards.referenceText:
If we encounter strong crosswind, I should pay special attention to the aircraft’s airspeed, altitude, and attitude. Because the aircraft can easily drift from the correct flight path and veer off the runway. I will use the “aileron into the wind and opposite rudder” technique to correct for the crosswind.
若遇到强侧风，我会特别关注飞机的空速、高度和姿态。因为飞机很容易偏离正确飞行路径，甚至偏离跑道。我会采用 “上风面副翼配合反向方向舵” 的方法来修正侧风影响 。

we should check crosswind direction/speed, use crabbed or sideslip approach to align the aircraft. Monitor attitude closely, avoid over-maneuvering. Be ready to go around if crosswind exceeds limits. Understand aircraft performance and runway conditions, ensure stable approach, and prioritize safety over forced landing.
我们应确认侧风方向和速度，采用蟹式或侧滑进近修正飞机姿态；密切监控飞行姿态，避免过度操纵；若侧风超限制，随时准备复飞；熟悉飞机性能和跑道状况，确保稳定进近，将安全置于优先地位，不强行着陆。

cards.audioText: If the previous aircraft goes around due to crosswind ,what will you do?
cards.audioTextZh: 若前机因侧风复飞，你会怎么做？
cards.referenceText:
I will first confirm the reason the preceding aircraft went around. If it’s due to crosswind and the crosswind exceeds our company’s limits, I will also initiate a go - around.
我会先确认前机复飞的原因。若因侧风且侧风超过我司规定限制，我也会执行复飞 。

I will request ATC to provide a wind check. If the wind exceeds our limits, I will also initiate a go - around.
我会请求空中交通管制（ATC）提供侧风情况核查。若侧风超过我们的限制，我也会执行复飞 。

If the preceding aircraft goes around due to crosswind, I’ll check real-time wind speed/direction immediately. If it exceeds our aircraft’s limit, I’ll request go around. If within limit, I’ll maintain stable approach, increase monitoring of flight attitude, and be prepared for go around if wind conditions deteriorate.
若前机因侧风复飞，我会立即核实实时风速和风向；若超出本机型侧风限制，申请复飞；若在限制内，保持稳定进近，加强对飞行姿态的监控，一旦风况恶化，随时准备复飞。

cards.audioText: Do you think crosswind landing is very dangerous? why?
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为侧风着陆很危险吗？为什么？
cards.referenceText:
(1) Yes, I think crosswind landing is very dangerous. Because if we encounter crosswind, the aircraft can easily drift from the correct flight path and veer off the runway.
是的，我认为侧风着陆很危险。因为一旦遇到侧风，飞机很容易偏离正确飞行路径，进而偏离跑道。
(2) Yes, of course. Crosswind landing can cause the aircraft to veer off the runway. Or the aircraft’s wingtip may strike the runway surface. Sometimes, the engine could strike the ground. It is very dangerous.
 是的，当然危险。侧风着陆可能导致飞机偏离跑道，或者飞机翼尖可能擦碰到跑道表面，有时发动机还会触地，这些情况都十分危险 。
（3）Yes, crosswind landing is dangerous. Strong crosswind may cause the aircraft to veer off the runway, skid, flip over, suffer tail strike, or damage the engine, wings, and landing gear. It also increases pilot workload for stable approach, and may lead to injuries to crew and passengers if not handled properly.
是的，侧风着陆存在危险。强侧风可能导致飞机偏离跑道、侧滑、倾覆、擦机尾，或损坏发动机、机翼及起落架。它还会增加飞行员稳定进近的工作负荷，若处置不当，可能造成机组和乘客受伤。

cards.audioText: If crosswind is marginal around(relative to) our standard, what will you do?
cards.audioTextZh: 若侧风接近我们的标准临界值，你会怎么做？
cards.referenceText:
(1) If crosswind is marginal relative to our standard, I will decide to go around to ensure flight safety.
 若侧风接近我们的标准临界值，我会决定复飞以保障飞行安全。
(2) If the crosswind is marginal, I will consider the aircraft’s performance, visibility, and runway conditions. I think the best course of action is to go around and divert to the alternate airport.
若侧风处于临界状态，我会考量飞机性能、能见度以及跑道状况。我认为最佳做法是复飞并改航至备降机场 。
（3）For marginal crosswind, preflight I’ll request runway change or delay. During takeoff roll, prepare for possible rejection. During landing, monitor airspeed/altitude precisely, use proper approach techniques, and be ready to go around. Prioritize safety and avoid forced landing in uncertain conditions.
侧风接近限制标准时，起飞前申请更换跑道或延误；起飞滑跑时做好中断起飞准备；着陆时精准监控空速和高度，采用合适的进近技术，随时准备复飞；优先保障安全，不勉强在不确定条件下着陆。

cards.audioText: If you know there is a strong crosswind at the destination airport, what should you be careful about?
cards.audioTextZh: 若你知晓目的地机场有强侧风，需要注意什么？
cards.referenceText:
If I know there is a strong crosswind at the destination airport, I will check the crosswind during the landing phase. If the crosswind exceeds our company’s limits, I will initiate a go - around.
若我知晓目的地机场有强侧风，会在着陆阶段检查侧风情况。若侧风超过我司限制，我会执行复飞 。

If there is a strong crosswind at the destination airport, I will request wind information from ATC. If the wind exceeds our limits, I will consider diverting to an alternate airport.
若目的地机场有强侧风，我会向空中交通管制（ATC）请求侧风信息。若侧风超过我们的限制，我会考虑改航至备降机场 。

cards.audioText: If you notice the strong crosswind exceeds the limits, but your captain insists to land, what will you do?
cards.audioTextZh: 若你发现强侧风超过限制，但机长坚持着陆，你会怎么做？
cards.referenceText:
First, I will communicate with him again to exchange ideas. Second, I will suggest that he follow the SOP (Standard Operating Procedures) and company policy. Finally, if the captain insists on his opinion, I will follow his lead because he is the pilot - in - command.
首先，我会再次与他沟通，交换想法。其次，我会建议他遵循标准操作程序（SOP）和公司政策。最后，若机长坚持自己的意见，我会听从他的指令，因为他是飞行指挥者（机长） 。

cards.audioText: What should flight crew pay attention to when they encounter strong crosswind during landing?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行机组在着陆阶段遇到强侧风时，需要注意什么？
cards.referenceText:
When we encounter strong crosswind during landing, we must pay attention to the wind direction and speed. If the wind speed exceeds the limit, we cannot land. In this situation, we will prepare for a possible go - around.
当我们在着陆阶段遇到强侧风时，必须关注风向和风速。若风速超过限制，我们不能着陆。在此种情况下，我们会为可能的复飞做准备 。

If there is a high crosswind during landing, we should contact ATC and request a wind check. If the crosswind exceeds our operational limits, we will immediately initiate a go - around and hold (orbit) to wait for weather improvement.
若着陆时遭遇强侧风，我们应联系空中交通管制（ATC）并请求侧风数据核查 。若侧风超过运行限制，需立即执行复飞，在空中盘旋等待天气条件改善 。

cards.audioText: If you notice the crosswind exceeds limits, but your captain or first officer insist in landing, what will you do?
cards.audioTextZh: 若你发现侧风超过限制，但机长或副驾驶坚持着陆，你会怎么做
cards.referenceText:
If I encounter this situation, I will ask my crew member to check the wind limits and persuade him to initiate a go - around, because landing in strong crosswind is unsafe.
若遇到这种情况，我会让机组成员核查侧风限制，并劝说他执行复飞，因为强侧风条件下着陆不安全 。

According to SOP, crosswind exceeding limits requires a go-around—any crew member can call "go around" and it must be executed. I’ll communicate with the captain/first officer, explain the risk, and emphasize compliance with regulations. Ultimately, the captain has final authority, but I’ll adhere to safety principles and refuse unsafe operations.
根据标准操作程序（SOP），侧风超出限制必须复飞，任一机组成员均可喊出复飞口令且必须执行。我会与机长或副驾驶沟通，说明风险并强调遵守规章的重要性；最终机长拥有决策权，但我会坚守安全原则，拒绝不安全操作。

cards.audioText:
What might be the consequences
of crosswind landing?
cards.audioTextZh: 侧风着陆的后果是什么?
cards.referenceText:
Crosswind landing may cause the aircraft to veer off/skid on the runway, tail strike, or flip over. It can damage landing gear, engines, and wings. Crew and passengers may suffer injuries due to unstable landing. Severe crosswind can lead to runway overrun or structural damage, endangering flight safety.
侧风着陆可能导致飞机偏离跑道、侧滑、擦机尾甚至翻转；损坏起落架、发动机和机翼；机组与乘客因着陆不稳受伤；严重时引发跑道冲出或结构损伤，危及飞行安全。

cards.audioText:
What is the maximum tailwind that
your aircraft can take off or land?
cards.audioTextZh:
你的飞机能起飞或降落的最大顺风量是
多少?
cards.referenceText:
I fly DA-40, with a maximum tailwind limit of 5 m/s for takeoff and landing. For large aircraft like A320, the tailwind limit is 18 knots. Exceeding this limit increases landing distance, risks overrun/veer-off, so we must change runways, delay or go around.
我驾驶的DA-40机型，起飞和着陆的最大顺风限制为5米/秒。空客A320等大型飞机的顺风限制为18节。超出该限制会增加着陆距离，引发冲出跑道、偏离跑道等风险，需更换跑道、延误或复飞。

cards.audioText: What influence does wind have on airplanes during flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行中风对飞机有什么影响?
cards.referenceText:
Wind has significant influences on aircraft: headwind increases lift but raises fuel consumption; tailwind reduces lift and may extend landing distance; crosswind risks veering/skidding; wind shear causes sudden speed/altitude changes, endangering control; wake turbulence from other aircraft brings instability. Pilots adjust speed, altitude, and attitude to mitigate risks.
