Generally, a runway with length less than 1800m and width 30m/45m is regarded as short and narrow. However, it varies by aircraft type—e.g., B737/A320 need 1500-1800m, while A380 requires over 3000m. High-elevation airports may have longer runways due to thin air.
通常，长度小于1800米、宽度为30米或45米的跑道可被视为短窄跑道。但这因机型而异——例如波音737/空客A320需1500-1800米跑道，而空客A380则需要3000米以上。高原机场因空气稀薄，跑道长度通常更长。

cards.taskTitle: 运行-复杂/特殊机场运行-5
cards.audioText: Are there any risks or threats when pilots operate on short and narrow runways? What are they?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员在短而窄的跑道上飞行时是否存在任何风险或威胁？它们是什么？
cards.referenceText:
Yes, there are some risks/threats/dangers when taking off or landing on short and narrow runways. First, it may cause the aircraft to overrun the runway and cause structural damage to the aircraft/ and injuries to persons on board. Second, it may reduce the safety margin.
是的，在短而窄的跑道上起飞或降落时会有一些风险/威胁/危险。首先，它可能会导致飞机冲出跑道，对飞机造成结构损坏/并对机上人员造成伤害。其次，这可能会降低安全裕度。

Yes. Risks include runway overrun/veer-off, structural damages (e.g., landing gear failure), and crew/passenger injuries due to limited space for takeoff/landing, reduced braking efficiency, and higher operational complexity.
有。风险包括冲出跑道/偏出跑道、结构损伤（如起落架故障），以及因起降空间有限、刹车效率降低和运行复杂度升高导致的机组与乘客受伤。

cards.taskTitle: 运行-复杂/特殊机场运行-6
cards.audioText: When your destination is a high elevation airport, what preparations should you make before takeoff?
cards.audioTextZh:
当你的目的地是高海拔机场时，起飞前你应该做什么准备？

If you are informed to fly high elevation airport, what preparations should you make beforehand?
如果你被通知飞高原机场,你需要做什么准备?
cards.referenceText:
When I fly to the high elevation airport, I will do a lot of preparations before takeoff. First, I will do a good walk around check to ensure the aircraft in good conditions. Second, I will know the airport runway conditions, weather conditions, ground services, arrival and departing procedures of this airport. Third, I will discuss the—possible emergency situations with my crew member, and the procedures to deal with these situations.
当我飞往高海拔机场时，我会在起飞前做很多准备。首先，我会做好巡视检查，确保飞机状况良好。其次，我将了解该机场的跑道状况、天气状况、地面服务、到达和离开程序。第三，我将与我的机组人员讨论可能的紧急情况，以及处理这些情况的程序。

Conduct terrain and weather analysis, calculate MOCA, check aircraft performance (especially engine power), ensure adequate oxygen supply, familiarize with special procedures, and undergo relevant simulator training.
进行地形和气象分析，计算最低超障高度，检查飞机性能（尤其是发动机功率），确保供氧充足，熟悉特殊运行程序，并接受相关模拟机训练。

cards.taskTitle: 运行-复杂/特殊机场运行-7
cards.audioText: If you fly high elevation airport, what preparations should you make before land?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果你在高海拔机场飞行，着陆前应该做什么准备？
cards.referenceText:
（1）答案有歧义When I fly to the high elevation airport, I will do a lot of preparations before takeoff. First, I will do a good walk around check to ensure the aircraft is in good conditions. Second, I will know the airport runway conditions, weather conditions, ground services, arrival and departing procedures of this airport. Third, I will discuss the possible emergency situations with my crew member, and the procedures to deal with these situations.
当我飞往高海拔机场时，我会在起飞前做很多准备。首先，我会进行一次良好的巡视检查，以确保飞机状况良好。其次，我将了解该机场的跑道状况、天气状况、地面服务、到达和离开程序。第三，我将与我的机组人员讨论可能出现的紧急情况，以及处理这些情况的程序。

（2）答案无歧义When landing at a high-elevation airport, we must make thorough preparations due to the reduced air density and altered aircraft performance. This includes carefully calculating the longer landing distance required, monitoring true airspeed rather than indicated airspeed for accurate approach speed, and being vigilant for visual illusions caused by the high terrain and thinner atmosphere. Additionally, they should ensure the oxygen system is functional if operating at high cabin altitudes and review airport-specific procedures and alternate plans to ensure a safe landing.

在高原机场降落时，由于空气密度降低和飞机性能变化，我们必须做好充分准备。这包括仔细计算所需的更长着陆距离，监控真实空速而非指示空速以获得准确的进近速度，并警惕高地形和稀薄大气导致的视觉错觉。此外，如果在高座舱高度运行，他们应确保氧气系统正常工作，并复习机场特定程序和备降计划，以确保安全降落。

cards.taskTitle: 运行-复杂/特殊机场运行-8
cards.audioText: If you decide to go around at a complicated airport, what should you be careful about?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果你决定在一个复杂的机场复飞，你应该注意什么？
cards.referenceText:
I think I must pay attention to the surrounding terrains to avoid collisions. And l will be careful about the wind shear in the mountain areas.
我想我必须注意周围的地形，以避免碰撞。我会小心山区的风切变。

cards.taskTitle: 运行-复杂/特殊机场运行-9
cards.audioText: If you encounter an unexpected abnormal situation at a high elevation airport, how will you handle it?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果你在高海拔机场遇到意外的不正常情况，你会如何处理？
cards.referenceText:
If I encounter this situation, I will try my best to control my aircraft, pay attention to the surrounding terrains to avoid the collisions. At the same time, I will report this situation to ATC, request priority landing.
如果遇到这种情况，我会尽力控制我的飞机，注意周围的地形，避免碰撞。同时，我将向空管报告这一情况，请求优先降落。

Stay calm, maintain aircraft control, follow SOP and QRH. Report to ATC promptly, request necessary assistance (e.g., priority landing), consider diversion to alternate airport, and ensure crew and passenger safety.
保持冷静，维持飞机控制，遵循标准操作程序和快速检查单。立即向空管报告，请求必要援助（如优先降落），考虑改航至备降机场，确保机组和乘客安全。

cards.taskTitle: 运行-复杂/特殊机场运行-10
cards.audioText: If you see the runway, but your GPWS was triggered, what should you do?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果你看到跑道，但你的GPWS被触发了，你该怎么办？
cards.referenceText:
If my GPWS was triggered, must pull up my aircraft, have missed approach and report this situation to ATC.
如果我的GPWS被触发，必须拉起我的飞机，错过进场，并向ATC报告这种情况。

I will immediately follow EGPWS advisory, pull up to avoid terrain, disengage autopilot if needed, set TOGA thrust, and maintain configuration. Report to ATC, confirm aircraft position, and ensure no collision risk before continuing approach.
我会立即遵循近地警告系统的提示，拉升飞机避开地形，必要时断开自动驾驶，设置复飞推力并保持构型。向空管报告情况，确认飞机位置，确保无碰撞风险后再继续进近。

cards.taskTitle: 运行-复杂/特殊机场运行-11
cards.audioText: Compared with sea level airport,what are the differences of aircraft performance of flying high elevation airport?
cards.audioTextZh: 与海平面机场相比，高海拔机场的飞机性能有什么不同？
cards.referenceText:
If the aircraft flies in the high elevation airport, the air is thin, the aircraft engine performance will be reduced. When taking off, the aircraft needs more distance to reach the rotation speed (VR). When landing, the aircraft also needs more distance to reduce the speed.
如果飞机在高海拔机场飞行，空气稀薄，飞机发动机性能会降低。起飞时，飞机需要更长的距离才能达到转速（VR）。着陆时，飞机还需要更远的距离来降低速度。

Due to low air density, aircraft performance at high elevation airports degrades significantly. Engine thrust reduces, takeoff/landing distances lengthen, control response slows, and climbing gradient decreases. More power is needed for the same performance.
由于空气密度低，高海拔机场的飞机性能大幅下降。发动机推力减小，起降距离延长，操控响应变慢，爬升梯度降低，需要更多动力才能达到同等飞行性能。

cards.taskTitle: 运行-复杂/特殊机场运行-12
cards.audioText: Does your company require specific pilot qualifications of flying high elevation airport?
cards.audioTextZh: 你公司是否要求飞行高海拔机场的特定飞行员资格？
cards.referenceText:
Yes According to regulation, the captain must get special high elevation airport qualification, and under 55 years old The copilot must have more than 1200 flight hours.
是的，根据规定，机长必须获得特殊的高海拔机场资格，55岁以下的副驾驶必须拥有1200多个飞行小时。

Yes. Pilots need sufficient flying experience, special ground and simulator training, passing physical examinations, and being under 55 years old. Airlines also require double captains on board for some high elevation flights.
是的。飞行员需具备足够飞行小时数、接受特殊地面和模拟机训练、通过体检且年龄在55岁以下，部分高原航线还要求机组配备双机长。

cards.taskTitle: 运行-复杂/特殊机场运行-13
cards.audioText: Do you know high elevation airport?
cards.audioTextZh: 你知道高原机场吗?
cards.referenceText:
A high elevation airport refers to one with an elevation exceeding 2400m. Due to low air density, it has unique challenges like reduced engine performance, longer takeoff/landing distances, and complicated weather.
高原机场指标高超过2400米的机场。由于空气密度低，其存在发动机性能下降、起降距离延长、气象条件复杂等独特挑战。

cards.taskTitle: 运行-复杂/特殊机场运行-14
cards.audioText: Do you know how to take off and land at high elevation airports?
cards.audioTextZh: 你知道如何在高海拔机场起飞和降落吗?
cards.referenceText:
For takeoff, use maximum thrust, appropriate flap settings, and ensure sufficient runway length. For landing, maintain stable approach, monitor speed closely, and account for reduced braking efficiency. Follow SOP and adapt to low air density.
起飞时使用最大推力、合适的襟翼设置，并确保有足够跑道长度；降落时保持稳定进近，密切监控速度，同时考虑刹车效率下降的情况，严格遵循标准操作程序并适应低空气密度环境。

cards.taskTitle: 运行-复杂/特殊机场运行-15
cards.audioText: Have you ever flown plateau airport?
cards.audioTextZh: 你飞过高海拔机场吗?
cards.referenceText:
No, I haven’t flown plateau airports yet as a student pilot. But I know plateau airports have high elevation (over 2400m), thin air, complex terrain, and adverse weather like wind shear and icing. Aircraft performance degrades, requiring special training and preparations for pilots.
没有，作为飞行学员，我尚未飞过高海拔机场。但我了解高海拔机场标高超过2400米，空气稀薄、地形复杂，且易出现风切变、积冰等恶劣天气。飞机性能会下降，对飞行员有特殊训练和准备要求。

cards.taskTitle: 运行-复杂/特殊机场运行-16
cards.audioText: Is there any special requirements for pilots flying plateau airport?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞高原机场时,对机长有什么特殊要求吗?
cards.referenceText:
Yes, pilots flying plateau airports must meet special requirements: accumulate sufficient flying hours and relevant experience; receive special ground and simulator training on terrain, weather, and aircraft performance degradation; pass a special physical examination; be under 55 years old (for captains); and operate with double captains if necessary.
有，飞高原机场的飞行员需满足特殊要求：积累足够飞行小时数和相关经历；接受关于地形、天气及飞机性能衰减的专项地面和模拟机训练；通过专项体检；机长年龄不超过55岁；必要时执行双机长运行。

cards.taskTitle: 运行-复杂/特殊机场运行-17
cards.audioText: Have you ever takeoff or landing at a complex airport / coastal airport / high elevation airport?
cards.audioTextZh: 你是否曾在复杂机场 / 沿海机场 / 高海拔机场起飞或降落过
cards.referenceText:
Actually, I am a student pilot. I have never takeoff or landing at complex / coastal / high elevation airport.
实际上，我是一名飞行学员。我从未在复杂机场 / 沿海机场 / 高海拔机场起飞或降落过

cards.taskTitle: 运行-复杂/特殊机场运行-18
cards.audioText: What should you be careful about if you takeoff or landing at coastal airport?
cards.audioTextZh: 在沿海机场起飞或降落时，你需要注意些什么
cards.referenceText:
If I takeoff or landing at coastal airport, I should be careful about the changeable weather. Maybe there is thunderstorm or windshear. I should avoid them.
如果我在沿海机场起飞或降落，我需要留意多变的天气。可能会有雷暴或风切变，我应该避开它们

cards.taskTitle: 运行-复杂/特殊机场运行-19
cards.audioText: What should you be careful about if you takeoff or landing at high elevation airport?
cards.audioTextZh: 在高海拔机场起飞或降落时，你需要注意些什么
cards.referenceText:
If I takeoff or landing at high elevation airport, I should be careful about surrounding terrain, the runway length, aircraft weight and I will pay special attention to aircraft airspeed and attitude.
如果我在高海拔机场起飞或降落，我需要留意周边地形、跑道长度、飞机重量，并且会特别关注飞机的空速和姿态

cards.taskTitle: 运行-复杂/特殊机场运行-20
cards.audioText: If you fly a high elevation airport what operations you should do before take off
cards.audioTextZh: 如果你要在高海拔机场飞行，起飞前应执行哪些操作？
cards.referenceText:
If I takeoff or landing at high elevation airport, I should be careful about surrounding terrain, the runway length, aircraft weight and I will pay special attention to aircraft airspeed and attitude.
如果我在高海拔机场起飞或降落，我需要留意周边地形、跑道长度、飞机重量，并且会特别关注飞机的空速和姿态

cards.taskTitle: 运行-复杂/特殊机场运行-21
cards.audioText: Are there unexpected abnormal situation at high elevation airport?
cards.audioTextZh: 在高海拔机场会出现意想不到的异常情况吗？
cards.referenceText:
Yes. We maybe encounter low level windshear, it is very dangerous. If the runway length is not enough or we are too heavy, we may overrun the runway.
是的。我们可能会遇到低空风切变，这非常危险。如果跑道长度不足或者我们（的飞机）过重，就可能冲出跑道。

cards.taskTitle: 运行-复杂/特殊机场运行-22
cards.audioText: What kind of airport can be considered as complex airport?
cards.audioTextZh: 什么样的机场可以被视为复杂机场？
cards.referenceText:
I think many airports can be considered as complicated airports.
First, if the airports have more complicated runways and taxiways, they can be considered as complicated airports. Second, if the airports have more complicated weather conditions and more complicated terrains, they can be considered as complicated airports.
我认为很多机场可能称作复杂机场。第一，如果机场有更复杂跑道，更复杂滑行道，他们可以称作复杂机场；第二，如果机场有更多变的天气或更复杂的地形地貌，他们可以称作复杂机场

cards.taskTitle: 运行-复杂/特殊机场运行-23
cards.audioText: What is high elevation Airport?
cards.audioTextZh: 什么是高海拔机场？
cards.referenceText:
If the airport elevation is above 2400m. It will be considered as a high elevation airport such as the airport in Lasa, Enshi and Tibet.
如果机场海拔在 2400 米以上，就会被视为高海拔机场，比如拉萨、恩施和西藏的机场。

cards.taskTitle: 运行-复杂/特殊机场运行-24
cards.audioText: What is a coastal airport?
cards.audioTextZh: 什么是沿海机场
cards.referenceText:
The airport beside or adjacent to the sea. The ocean or the waters. We call it a coastal airport.
紧邻大海、海洋或水域的机场，我们称之为沿海机场。

cards.taskTitle: 运行-复杂/特殊机场运行-25
cards.audioText: Are there any qualifications required for a pilot to fly a complex airport?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员执飞复杂机场需要具备什么资质吗？
cards.referenceText:
The crew must have class one medical Certification. The pilot should take relevant training and pass simulator test. The captain must have takeoff and landing experience within 3 months at this kind of airport. What's more there must be two captains on board. The pilot in command should not exceed 55 years old.
机组人员必须持有一级体检合格证。飞行员需接受相关培训并通过模拟机测试。机长必须在 3 个月内有该类机场的起飞和着陆经验。此外，机上必须配备两名机长，且责任机长年龄不得超过 55 岁

cards.taskTitle: 运行-复杂/特殊机场运行-26
cards.audioText: What factors may cause the aircraft overrun the runway after landing?
cards.audioTextZh: 哪些因素可能导致飞机着陆后冲出跑道？
cards.referenceText:
There are some reasons for aircraft overrun the runway after landing. For example, overshooting during approach, brakes or thrust reverser malfunction, landing in tailwind, landing on short and narrow runway.
飞机着陆后冲出跑道有多种原因，例如：进近时偏高（偏离正确下滑道）、刹车或反推装置故障、在顺风中着陆、在短窄跑道上着陆等。

Key factors include poor braking action (runway water/icing/snow), unstable approach, flapless landing, tailwind, pilot's inadequate skills, gear-up/belly landing, and exceeding aircraft performance limits.
主要因素包括刹车性能不佳（跑道积水、结冰、积雪）、不稳定进近、无襟翼着陆、顺风、飞行员操作技能不足、未放起落架着陆/机腹着陆以及超出飞机性能限制。

cards.taskTitle: 运行-复杂/特殊机场运行-27
cards.audioText: Have you ever experienced takeoff or landing on the short and narrow runway?
cards.audioTextZh: 你有过在短窄跑道上起飞或降落的经历吗？
cards.referenceText:
I have never takeoff or landing on the short and narrow runway.
我从未在短窄跑道上起飞或降落过。

No, I haven’t. But I have received relevant simulator training. When operating on such runways, I will strictly control speed, ensure sufficient thrust, maintain stable attitude, and follow SOP to avoid overrun or veering off.
没有过，但我接受过相关的模拟机训练。在短窄跑道运行时，我会严格控制速度，确保充足推力，保持稳定姿态，并遵循标准操作程序，避免冲出或偏出跑道。

cards.taskTitle: 运行-复杂/特殊机场运行-28
cards.audioText: What kind of runway may be considered as short and narrow runway?
cards.audioTextZh: 什么样的跑道可以被视为短窄跑道？
cards.referenceText:
For short and narrow runway, it depends on different type of aircraft. For example, if given the same runway, for our DA-40 training, aircraft, it is a normal runway, but for B747 or A320, it may be a short and narrow runway.
对于短窄跑道的界定，取决于飞机的类型。例如，给定同一条跑道，对于我们的 DA-40 训练机而言，它是一条正常跑道，但对于波音 747 或空客 A320 来说，这条跑道可能就属于短窄跑道。

Generally, a runway with length less than 1800m and width 30m/45m is regarded as short and narrow. However, it varies by aircraft type—for example B737/A320 need 1500-1800m, while A380 requires over 3000m. High-elevation airports may have longer runways due to thin air.
通常，长度小于1800米、宽度为30米或45米的跑道可被视为短窄跑道。但这因机型而异——例如波音737/空客A320需1500-1800米跑道，而空客A380则需要3000米以上。高原机场因空气稀薄，跑道长度通常更长。

cards.taskTitle: 运行-复杂/特殊机场运行-29
cards.audioText: Are there any risks or threats when pilot operate on short and narrow runway? what are they?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员在短窄跑道上操作时存在风险或威胁吗？这些风险或威胁是什么？
cards.referenceText:
Yes, there are some risks. If the runway is too short, the aircraft may be run out of the runway. If the runway is too narrow, the aircraft may be veer off the runway.
是的，存在一些风险。如果跑道过短，飞机可能会冲出跑道；如果跑道过窄，飞机可能会偏离跑道。

Yes. Risks include runway overrun/veer-off, structural damages (e.g., landing gear failure), and crew/passenger injuries due to limited space for takeoff/landing, reduced braking efficiency, and higher operational complexity.
有。风险包括冲出跑道/偏出跑道、结构损伤（如起落架故障），以及因起降空间有限、刹车效率降低和运行复杂度升高导致的机组与乘客受伤。

cards.taskTitle: 运行-复杂/特殊机场运行-30
cards.audioText: What is a complicated airport? What is the complicated airport like?
cards.audioTextZh: 什么样的机场可以被称为(be defined as)复杂机场？
cards.referenceText:
I think many airports can be considered as complicated airports.
First, if the airports have more complicated runways and taxiways, they can be considered as complicated airports.
Second, if the airports have more complicated weather conditions and more complicated terrains, they can be considered as complicated airports.
我认为很多机场可能称作复杂机场。第一，如果机场有更复杂跑道，更复杂滑行道，他们可以称作复杂机场；第二，如果机场有更多变的天气或更复杂的地形地貌，他们可以称作复杂机场。

cards.taskTitle: 运行-复杂/特殊机场运行-31
cards.audioText: Have you ever flown to complicated airports? What is a complicated airport?
cards.audioTextZh: 你飞过复杂机场吗?什么是复杂机场?
cards.referenceText:
No, I haven’t. A complicated airport is one with high operational risks, such as high elevation, short/narrow runways, busy traffic, special procedures, adverse weather, or poor navigational conditions.
没有。复杂机场是指运行风险较高的机场，例如高原机场、短窄跑道机场、交通繁忙机场、有特殊程序的机场、气象条件复杂或导航条件不佳的机场。

cards.taskTitle: 运行-复杂/特殊机场运行-32
cards.audioText: Which one do you prefer, complicated airports or simple  airports?
cards.audioTextZh: 你更喜欢哪种，复杂机场还是简单机场？
cards.referenceText:
To be honest, I prefer the simple airports.
老实说，我更喜欢简单机场 。

I prefer simple airports for their stable conditions and lower operational risks. However, flying complicated airports can enhance my skills and situation awareness. I will strictly follow SOP regardless of the airport type to ensure safety.
我更喜欢简单机场，因其运行条件稳定、风险较低。但飞行复杂机场能提升我的飞行技能和情景意识，无论何种机场，我都会严格遵循标准操作程序以确保飞行安全。

cards.taskTitle: 运行-复杂/特殊机场运行-33
cards.audioText: Does your company have route to fly complicated airports?
cards.audioTextZh: 你的公司有飞往复杂机场的航线吗？
cards.referenceText:
I work for Hebei Airline We have routes to fly complicated airports such as the flight from…to…and the flight from…to…
我就职于河北航空。我们有飞往复杂机场的航线，比如从…… 到…… 的航班，以及从…… 到…… 的航班 。

Yes, my company operates routes to some complicated airports, such as high elevation and coastal airports. Before operating these routes, we receive specialized training to master relevant procedures and risks.
是的，我们公司有飞往部分复杂机场的航线，例如高原机场和滨海机场。执行这些航线前，我们会接受专项训练，以掌握相关运行程序和风险点。

cards.taskTitle: 运行-复杂/特殊机场运行-34
cards.audioText: What preparations will you make when you are going to fly high-elevation airports?
cards.audioTextZh: 当你要飞往高海拔机场时，会做哪些准备工作？
cards.referenceText:
When we fly to the high elevation airport, we will do many preparations before takeoff. First, we will do a good walk around check to ensure the aircraft is in good conditions. Second, we will know the airport runway conditions, weather conditions, ground services, arrival and departing procedures of this airport. Third, we will discuss the possible emergency situations with my crew members, and the procedures to deal with these situations.
当我们飞往高海拔机场时，起飞前会做大量准备工作。首先，我们会进行全面的绕机检查，确保飞机状态良好。其次，我们会了解该机场的跑道状况、天气条件、地面服务以及进离场程序 。第三，我们会和机组成员一起讨论可能出现的紧急情况，以及应对这些情况的程序 。

cards.taskTitle: 运行-复杂/特殊机场运行-35
cards.audioText: What will you do if you see the airport below but with EGPWS triggered?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果你看到下方有机场，但增强型近地警告系统（EGPWS）被触发，你会怎么做？
cards.referenceText:
If we have seen the airport but our EGPWS was triggered, we will follow the EGPWS to pull up the aircraft, and make a missed approach, then we will report this situation to ATC
如果我们看到了机场，但增强型近地警告系统（EGPWS）被触发，我们会按照 EGPWS 的提示拉杆使飞机抬头，执行复飞程序，然后我们会向空中交通管制（ATC）报告这一情况 。

I will immediately follow EGPWS advisory, pull up to avoid terrain, disengage autopilot if needed, set TOGA thrust, and maintain configuration. Report to ATC, confirm aircraft position, and ensure no collision risk before continuing approach.
我会立即遵循近地警告系统的提示，拉升飞机避开地形，必要时断开自动驾驶，设置复飞推力并保持构型。向空管报告情况，确认飞机位置，确保无碰撞风险后再继续进近。

cards.taskTitle: 运行-复杂/特殊机场运行-36
cards.audioText: If you will go around in a complicated airport, what will you do?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果你要在复杂机场复飞，你会怎么做？
cards.referenceText:
If we will go around in a compacted airport, we will follow the standard missed approach procedures and consider many factors such as weather conditions, surrounding terrains and so on
如果我们要在复杂机场复飞，我们会遵循标准复飞程序，并且考虑诸多因素，比如天气状况、周边地形等等 。

I should closely monitor terrain and obstacles, follow missed approach procedures strictly, maintain appropriate speed and altitude, communicate with ATC timely, and ensure coordination with cabin crew. Avoid low-altitude operations and adhere to SOP.
需密切监控地形和障碍物，严格遵循复飞程序，保持合适的速度和高度，及时与空管沟通，并确保与客舱机组协同配合。避免低空运行，严格遵守标准操作程序。

cards.taskTitle: 运行-复杂/特殊机场运行-37
cards.audioText:
你公司有运行复杂机场吗？
Are there any complicated airports operated by your company/airline?
cards.referenceText:
I work for Air China.
There are many complicated airports operated by our company such as high-elevation airports (Lhasa Gongga Airport, Jiuzhai Huanglong Airport) and seaside airports so on.
我们公司有很多复杂机场运行，比如拉萨贡嘎机场，九寨黄龙机场等。

cards.taskTitle: 运行-复杂/特殊机场运行-38
cards.audioText: What's the use of EGPWS when flying complicated airports?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞复杂机场，EGPWS有什么用处？
cards.referenceText:
(E)GPWS is (Enhanced) Ground Proximity Warning System.
It is used to avoid the surrounding terrain. If the aircraft is too low to the terrain, we can hear warning sounds, “too low, terrain”, “terrain, pull up”, “too low, gear”.
GPWS是近地警告系统，用来避开周边地形地貌。如果飞机太靠近地形，我们可以听见警告声，“太低，地形”，“地形，拉起”，“地形，起落架”。

cards.taskTitle: 运行-复杂/特殊机场运行-39
cards.audioText: Have you had any complicated airport training in simulator?
cards.audioTextZh: 你在模拟机里面接受过复杂机场的训练吗?
cards.referenceText:
Yes, I have received complicated airport training in the simulator. The training covers operations at airports with short/narrow runways, complex terrain, adverse weather, and special procedures. It focuses on improving situational awareness, mastering approach/landing techniques, and handling emergencies like go-around to ensure safe operations.
是的，我在模拟机中接受过复杂机场训练。训练涵盖短窄跑道、复杂地形、恶劣天气及特殊程序的机场运行，重点提升情景意识、掌握进近/着陆技巧，以及处理复飞等应急情况，确保运行安全。

cards.taskTitle: 运行-复杂/特殊机场运行-40
cards.audioText: How to make a successful landing at a complicated airport?
cards.audioTextZh: 如何在复杂机场成功着陆?
cards.referenceText:
To land successfully at a complicated airport, pilots should: make thorough preflight preparations (familiarize with terrain, weather, and procedures); conduct detailed performance assessment; maintain stable approach with precise speed/attitude control; use appropriate techniques for crosswind or special runways; monitor instruments and ATC instructions closely; and be ready to go around if conditions deteriorate.
要在复杂机场成功着陆，飞行员应：做好充分飞行前准备（熟悉地形、天气和程序）；进行详细性能评估；保持稳定进近，精准控制速度和姿态；针对侧风或特殊跑道使用适当操作技巧；密切监控仪表和空管指令；若情况恶化，随时准备复飞。

cards.audioText:
Can you tell me the fuel quantity your type of aircraft can carry?
Tell me the legal requirements of your aircraft fuel quantity?
cards.audioTextZh:
你能告诉我你所飞机型的飞机可携带燃油量是多少吗？
告诉我你飞机燃油量的法定要求有哪些？
cards.referenceText:
（1）I fly DA-40 for flight training. The maximum fuel quantity is 41 gallon, the usable fuel quantity is 39 gallon.
我驾驶 DA-40 进行飞行训练。其最大燃油量是 41 加仑，可用燃油量是 39 加仑。
（2）The aircraft I fly is C172/CJ-1/A320/B73 The maximum fuel quantity it can carry is…gallons（加仑）.The fuel quantity required for each flight includes the fuel to the destination airport, the fuel to the alternate airport, the fuel to hold and the fuel reserve
我所飞的飞机是 C172/CJ-1/A320/B73（机型 ）。它可携带的最大燃油量是…… 加仑。每次飞行所需燃油量包括飞往目的地机场的燃油、飞往备降机场的燃油、等待燃油以及储备燃油 。

cards.audioText:
What is the maximum fuel quantity your type of aircraft can carry?
What is the maximum fuel quantity that your aircraft can carry?
cards.audioTextZh: 你所飞机型的飞机最大可携带燃油量是多少？你驾驶的飞机最大可携带燃油量是多少？
cards.referenceText:
（1）I fly DA-40 for flight training. The maximum fuel quantity is 41 gallon, the usable fuel quantity is 39 gallon.
我驾驶 DA-40 进行飞行训练。最大燃油量是 41 加仑，可用燃油量是 39 加仑。
（2）The aircraft I fly is C172/CJ-1/A320/B73 The maximum fuel quantity it can carry is…gallons（加仑）．
我驾驶的飞机是 C172/CJ-1/A320/B73（机型 ）。它可携带的最大燃油量是…… 加仑 。

cards.audioText: What factors might be considered in calculating the fuel quantity for each flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 在计算每次飞行的燃油量时，需考虑哪些因素？
cards.referenceText:
There are many factors we should consider to make sure we have sufficient fuel on board. For example, the distance and time of the flight, the aircraft weight, the weather en route, the wind condition and fuel consumption rate and so on.
为确保飞机有充足燃油，我们需考虑诸多因素。比如，飞行距离与时长、飞机重量、航线天气、风况以及燃油消耗率等等 。

cards.audioText: How can pilot determine their endurance in the flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员在飞行中如何确定续航能力？
cards.referenceText:
（1）Pilots calculate fuel endurance based on remaining fuel quantity (monitored via fuel gauge), current fuel consumption rate, flight speed, and altitude. They also refer to flight plan data and adjust for weather factors (e.g., headwind) to estimate remaining flying time.
飞行员通过燃油表监控剩余燃油量，结合当前燃油消耗率、飞行速度和高度计算续航力。同时参考飞行计划数据，并根据天气因素如逆风进行调整，以估算剩余飞行时间。

（2）We can calculate fuel endurance based on the full fuel and fuel used on the ECAM or EICAS. Besides, we can calculate the fuel endurance based on the flight time and the rate of fuel consumption.
我们可以根据电子中央飞机监控系统（ECAM）或发动机指示和机组警告系统（EICAS）上的满油量与已用油量计算燃油续航能力。此外，我们还可以根据飞行时间和燃油消耗率来计算燃油续航能力 。

cards.audioText: How do you refuel your aircraft before each flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 每次飞行前，你如何给飞机加油？
cards.referenceText: Before each flight, the ground mechanics are responsible for refueling. I will check the fuel quantity before flight.每次飞行前，由地面机务负责加油。我会在飞行前检查燃油量 。

cards.audioText: What safety factors should a pilot consider during refueling?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员在加油期间应考虑哪些安全因素？
cards.referenceText:
During refueling, we must make sure the refueling area is cleared and safe, far away from the fire source.
加油期间，我们必须确保加油区域已清空且安全，远离火源 。

During refueling, key safety factors include: turning off electronic devices, ensuring fuel is not contaminated, having fire extinguishers standby, connecting ground wires, and avoiding refueling during thunderstorms or poor visibility.
加油过程中需考虑的安全因素包括：关闭电子设备、确保燃油无污染、备好灭火器、连接接地线，以及避免在雷暴或低能见度条件下加油。

cards.audioText: If you encounter fuel leakage during refueling, what will you do?
cards.audioTextZh: 若在加油期间遇到燃油泄漏情况，你会怎么做？
cards.referenceText:
If I encounter fuel leakage during refueling, I will stop refueling immediately and ask the ground mechanics to check the leakage.
若我在加油期间遇到燃油泄漏情况，我会立即停止加油，并让地面机务检查泄漏情况 。

 I will immediately stop refueling, inform ground staff and ATC, request fire services as a precaution, keep away from fire and electronic devices, have fire extinguishers ready, and wait for maintenance personnel to inspect and handle the leakage.
我会立即停止加油，通知地面人员和空管，预防性请求消防服务，远离火源和电子设备，备好灭火器，等待维修人员检查并处理泄漏问题。

cards.audioText: If you encounter fuel leakage in flight, what will you do?
cards.audioTextZh: 若在飞行中遇到燃油泄漏，你会怎么做？
cards.referenceText:
If I encounter fuel leakage during flight, I will follow the SOP and perform the checklist try to solve the problem. Then advise ATC of our situation, if necessary, I will request divert to the nearest suitable airport and request ground mechanics help to check the leakage.
若我在飞行中遇到燃油泄漏，我会遵循标准操作程序（SOP），执行检查单来尝试解决问题。然后将我们的情况告知空中交通管制（ATC），如有必要，我会申请改航至最近的合适机场，并请求地面机械师协助检查泄漏情况 。

cards.audioText: After refueling, how could you know you have correct amount of fuel on board?
cards.audioTextZh: 加油后，如何确认飞机上燃油量正确？
cards.referenceText:
Firstly, we can visual check the fuel tank. Secondly, we can check the fuel quantity indicator. At last, we can use the fuel dip stick to make sure we have correct amount of fuel on board.
首先，我们可以目视检查燃油箱。其次，我们可以查看燃油量指示器。最后，我们可以使用燃油量油尺，确保飞机上有正确的燃油量 。

cards.audioText:
Could you tell me your company fuel policy?
What is your company's fuel policy?
cards.audioTextZh:
你能讲讲你们公司的燃油政策吗？
你们公司的燃油政策是怎样的？
cards.referenceText:
（1）I have not back to the company yet. But I know our company fuel policy is good, they encourage pilot to save fuel. But in any cases, we must ensure the flight safety first.
我尚未回到公司。但我知道我们公司的燃油政策很不错，鼓励飞行员节约燃油。但在任何情况下，我们都必须首先确保飞行安全。
（2）As I know, the airlines often encourage pilots to save fuel. The pilots who save fuel will be rewarded. That is to say, if the pilots save fuel, they will get more money.
据我所知，航空公司通常鼓励飞行员节约燃油。节约燃油的飞行员会得到奖励。也就是说，如果飞行员节约了燃油，他们会拿到更多钱
（3）My company encourages fuel saving while prioritizing flight safety. Fuel quantity is calculated based on flight plan, weather, weight and balance, diversion, and holding needs. Pilots get bonuses for fuel saving, and we must comply with regulations on minimum fuel and reserve fuel.
我们公司在优先保障飞行安全的前提下鼓励节油。燃油量根据飞行计划、天气、载重平衡、备降和等待需求计算，飞行员节省燃油会有奖励，同时必须遵守最低燃油和储备燃油相关规定。

cards.audioText:
Do you think a high cruising altitude helps reduce fuel consumption? why?
    Do you think cruising at high altitude can reduce fuel consumption, and why? Why is flying at high altitude more fuel-efficient?
     Does aircraft high altitude consume more fuel? Why?
cards.audioTextZh:
你认为高巡航高度有助于降低燃油消耗吗？为什么？
你认为在高空巡航能否降低燃油消耗，原因是什么？为何高空飞行更省油？
飞机在高空飞行会消耗更多燃油吗？为什么？
cards.referenceText:
（1）Yes, I think so. Because at the higher cruising altitude, the more stable the outside air is, the air density is lower, so there is less drag, it will help to reduce fuel consumption.
是的，我认为有助于。因为在更高的巡航高度，外界空气更稳定，空气密度更低，所以阻力更小，有助于降低燃油消耗。
（2）Generally yes. At high altitude, air density is lower, reducing aircraft drag, which helps save fuel. However, fuel consumption is also affected by aircraft limitations, weight, and engine performance. We need to select the optimum cruising altitude instead of blindly flying too high.
通常是可以的。高高度空气密度更低，会减小飞机阻力，从而有助于节省燃油。但燃油消耗还受飞机限制、重量和发动机性能等因素影响，我们需选择最佳巡航高度，而非盲目高飞。

cards.audioText: Do you think pilot play an important role in saving fuel?
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为飞行员在节约燃油方面是否发挥重要作用？
cards.referenceText:
I think pilots play an important role in saving fuel, because the pilot controls the aircraft in most flight operations. If the pilot controls the aircraft too slow or too fast, it will influence the fuel consumption. What's more, pilots can choose the optimum/economical speed, altitude and route to save fuel.
我认为飞行员在节约燃油方面发挥重要作用，因为在大多数飞行操作中，是由飞行员控制飞机的。如果飞行员把飞机控制得太慢或太快，会影响燃油消耗。此外，飞行员可以选择最佳 / 经济的速度、高度和航线来节约燃油 。

cards.audioText: What's your opinion about pilot's role in saving fuel?
cards.audioTextZh: 你对飞行员在节约燃油方面的作用有何看法？
cards.referenceText:
I think pilots play an important role in saving fuel, because the pilot controls the aircraft in most flight operations. If the pilot controls the aircraft too slow or too fast, it will influence the fuel consumption. What's more, pilots can choose the optimum/economical speed, altitude and route to save fuel.
我认为飞行员在节约燃油方面发挥着重要作用，因为在大多数飞行操作中，是由飞行员控制飞机的。如果飞行员把飞机控制得太慢或太快，会影响燃油消耗。此外，飞行员可以选择最佳 / 经济的速度、高度和航线来节约燃油 。

Pilots play a crucial role in fuel saving. Reasonable selection of altitude, speed, and route, smooth maneuvering, and avoiding unnecessary holding or go-arounds can significantly reduce fuel consumption. It not only cuts company costs but also protects the environment, with safety as the top priority.
飞行员在节油中扮演关键角色。合理选择高度、速度和航线，平稳操作，避免不必要的等待或复飞，都能大幅降低燃油消耗。这不仅能降低公司成本，还能保护环境，同时需以安全为首要前提。

cards.audioText: What's your opinion on airline policy of encouraging pilots to save fuel?
cards.audioTextZh: 你对航空公司鼓励飞行员节约燃油的政策有何看法？
cards.referenceText:
I think our company's fuel policy is good. They encourage pilots to save fuel and reduce operation costs. If we follow the fuel policy, we can get rewards.
我认为我们公司的燃油政策很好。它鼓励飞行员节约燃油、降低运营成本。如果我们遵守燃油政策，还能获得奖励 。

It’s a positive policy. Fuel saving reduces company operational costs and is environmentally friendly. However, safety must never be compromised for fuel saving. Pilots should not avoid necessary go-arounds or cut reserve fuel; instead, achieve fuel efficiency through scientific operation and planning.
这是一项积极的政策。节油能降低公司运营成本，且有利于环境保护。但绝不能为了节油而牺牲安全，飞行员不应避免必要的复飞或削减储备燃油，而应通过科学操作和规划实现节油。

cards.audioText: What are the possible consequences of using contaminated fuel?
cards.audioTextZh: 使用受污染燃油可能会产生哪些后果？
cards.referenceText:
If we use contaminated fuel, it will significantly degrade the engine performance, even make the engine flame out or engine failure.
如果我们使用受污染的燃油，会显著降低发动机性能，甚至导致发动机熄火或发动机故障 。

Using contaminated fuel can block fuel filters or pipes, leading to insufficient or interrupted fuel supply. It may cause engine power loss, flame-out, vibration, or even damage to engine components, seriously endangering flight safety.
使用污染燃油会堵塞燃油滤清器或管路，导致燃油供应不足或中断，可能造成发动机功率下降、熄火、振动，甚至损坏发动机部件，严重危及飞行安全。

cards.audioText:
Will water in the fuel have a great effect
on flight safety?
cards.audioTextZh: 燃油中混入水分会对飞行安全产生重大影响吗？
cards.referenceText:
Of course, if there is water in the fuel tank, the water may turn into ice at high altitude and sometimes it will cause the engine surge and engine failure. It’s very dangerous for the flight safety.
会。若油箱中有水，高空环境下水分可能结冰，有时会导致发动机喘振甚至失效，对飞行安全极具威胁。

cards.audioText: According to the regulation, what does "Minimum Fuel" refer to?
cards.audioTextZh: 根据规定，“最低燃油（Minimum Fuel）” 指的是什么？
cards.referenceText:
According to regulations, minimum fuel is not a fuel emergency. It means if there is any further delay, fuel emergency will be declared. For IFR flights, it refers to fuel endurance less than 45 minutes at 3000ft over the destination airport.
根据规定，最低燃油并非燃油紧急情况，而是指若再出现延误，将宣布燃油紧急。对于仪表飞行规则IFR飞行，指在目的地机场上空3000英尺高度时，燃油续航时间不足45分钟。

cards.audioText: How would you report your fuel minimum situation to ATC?
cards.audioTextZh: 你会如何向空中交通管制（ATC）报告最低燃油情况？
cards.referenceText:
I will report to ATC we have "minimum fuel", tell the controller how much fuel we left on board and we cannot be delayed any further. If we need diversion, I will request nearest suitable airport information and weather information to avoid further delay.
我会向 ATC 报告我们处于 “最低燃油” 状态，告知管制员飞机剩余燃油量，以及我们无法再承受延误。若需要改航，我会请求最近合适机场的信息和天气信息，以避免进一步延误 。

cards.audioText: When will you declare fuel emergency?
cards.audioTextZh: 你会在何时宣布燃油紧急情况？
cards.referenceText:
According to our company flight operation manual, if we fly in holding airspeed the fuel endurance for keeping 1500 feet overhead the airport is less than 30 minutes, we should declare fuel emergency and request priority landing.
依据我们公司飞行操作手册，若以等待空速飞行，在机场上空 1500 英尺高度保持飞行的燃油续航时间不足 30 分钟时，我们应宣布燃油紧急情况并申请优先着陆 。

Fuel emergency is declared when the remaining fuel is insufficient to reach the destination or alternate airport, there is serious fuel leakage, changes in clearance force using reserve fuel, or the aircraft has less than 30 minutes of endurance. It requires immediate ATC assistance for priority landing.
当剩余燃油不足以到达目的地或备降机场、出现严重燃油泄漏、航线许可变更导致需使用储备燃油，或飞机续航时间不足30分钟时，需宣布燃油紧急情况，立即请求空管协助优先着陆。

cards.audioText: How do pilots declare fuel emergency?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员如何宣布燃油应急？
cards.referenceText:
The pilots shall declare fuel emergency by stating the remaining fuel on board, fuel endurance in minutes and the intention of priority landing.
需说明机上剩余燃油量、燃油续航时间（以分钟计）及优先着陆的意图。

cards.audioText:
What is the difference between minimum
fuel and emergency fuel?
cards.audioTextZh: 最低燃油（Minimum Fuel）和应急燃油（Emergency Fuel）有何区别？
cards.referenceText:
Minimum fuel is not considered as fuel emergency. It just means that we cannot accept excessive delay. But emergency fuel means the fuel is not enough we must request priority landing.
最低燃油不视为燃油应急状态，仅表示无法接受过长延误；应急燃油则表示燃油不足，必须申请优先着陆。

Minimum fuel is an informational notice to ATC, indicating potential fuel emergency if delayed. Emergency fuel is a distress situation where fuel is insufficient to reach the destination, requiring immediate priority landing with ATC assistance.
最低燃油是向空管发出的提示信息，表明若延误可能引发燃油紧急情况；而紧急燃油是已出现燃油不足以到达目的地的遇险状态，需立即请求空管协助优先着陆。

cards.audioText: What reason might cause fuel shortage on board?
cards.audioTextZh: 哪些原因可能导致飞机上燃油不足？
cards.referenceText:
There are some reasons for fuel shortage on board. For example, fuel leak, diversion, long delay, insufficient fuel quantity before flight.
飞机上燃油不足有多种原因，比如燃油泄漏、改航、长时间延误、飞行前燃油量不足 。

 Fuel shortage can be caused by strong headwinds, fuel leakage, prolonged low-altitude flight, incorrect speed or configuration, excessive holding or go-arounds, miscalculation of fuel quantity during preflight planning, or fuel contamination.
强逆风、燃油泄漏、长时间低空飞行、不当的速度或构型、过多的等待或复飞、飞行前燃油量计算错误以及燃油污染等，都可能导致机上燃油短缺。

cards.audioText:
What are the fuel dumping procedures?
Can you say some details of your aircraft fuel dumping procedures?
cards.audioTextZh:
燃油放油程序有哪些？
你能讲讲你所飞机型燃油放油程序的一些细节吗？
cards.referenceText:
（1）Firstly, I will contact ATC, request climb for dumping fuel and vectors to the fuel dump zone. During the fuel dumping process, the controller will advise other pilots to avoid flying into the fuel dumping area. After fuel-dumping completed, I will inform the ATC and request back to the course.
首先，我会联系空中交通管制（ATC），申请爬升以进行燃油放油，并请求引导至放油区。在燃油放油过程中，管制员会提醒其他飞行员避开放油区域。放油完成后，我会告知 ATC 并申请回到原航线。
（2）First, report to ATC, request clearance to the designated fuel dumping area. Then, follow SOP to activate the dumping system, monitor fuel quantity and aircraft status, and stop dumping once the target weight is reached, ensuring no impact on ground or other aircraft.
首先向空管报告，申请进入指定放油区域的许可；然后遵循标准操作程序启动放油系统，监控燃油量和飞机状态，达到目标重量后停止放油，确保不对地面或其他飞机造成影响。

cards.audioText: Under what circumstances do you need to dump fuel?
cards.audioTextZh: 在哪些情况下需要放油？
cards.referenceText:
（1） Fuel dumping is needed when the aircraft encounters an emergency requiring return or diversion, and its weight exceeds the maximum landing weight. For example, in cases of landing gear failure or belly landing, dumping fuel reduces weight and the risk of fire/explosion.
当飞机遭遇紧急情况需返航或备降，且重量超过最大着陆重量时，需执行放油程序。例如，起落架故障或需机腹着陆时，放油可降低飞机重量，减少起火或爆炸风险。
（2）There are some situations we will dump fuel. First, if the landing weight exceeds the maximum landing weight, we will dump fuel. Second, if we will make an emergency landing such as belly landing, we will dump fuel.
存在一些需放油的情况。其一，若着陆重量超过最大着陆重量，需放油。其二，若要进行紧急着陆（如机腹着陆），需放油 。

cards.audioText: What area are not allowed to dump fuel during flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行中哪些区域不允许放油？
cards.referenceText:
（1）Fuel dumping is not allowed over crowded residential areas, cities, lakes, rivers, forests, or low airspace. These areas have high population density or ecological sensitivity, and dumping fuel may cause pollution, injuries, or accidents.
飞行中不允许在人口密集的居民区、城市、湖泊、河流、森林以及低空空域放油。这些区域人口密度高或生态敏感，放油可能造成污染、人员伤亡或事故。
（2）As I know, fuel dumping is not allowed over the cities and rivers because it may cause air pollution or water pollution and it may influence people's lives.
据我所知，城市和河流上空不允许放油，因为这可能造成空气污染或水污染，还可能影响人们的生活 。

cards.audioText: What assistance do you need from ATC?
cards.audioTextZh: 你需要空中交通管制（ATC）提供哪些协助？
cards.referenceText:
If we have to dump fuel, we need radar vectors from ATC to the dump area.
若我们必须放油，需要 ATC 通过雷达引导我们前往放油区域

cards.audioText: How do you make fuel quality check?
cards.audioTextZh: 你如何进行燃油质量检查？
cards.referenceText:
Before each flight, the pilot is responsible for checking the fuel quality. We will drain an amount of fuel out and check if the color is OK. We must make sure the fuel quality is good. Because if we use contaminated fuel, it will significantly degrade the engine performance, even make the engine flame out or engine failure.
每次飞行前，飞行员负责检查燃油质量。我们会放出一定量燃油，检查其颜色是否正常。必须确保燃油质量良好，因为若使用受污染燃油，会显著降低发动机性能，甚至导致发动机熄火或故障 。

cards.audioText: How to get the loading sheet?
cards.audioTextZh: 如何获取装载单（loading sheet）？
cards.referenceText:
Before departure, we must get the loading sheet from the dispatcher.
起飞前，我们必须从调度派人员（dispatcher）处获取装载单 。

cards.audioText: What are the factors that may influence fuel economy?
cards.audioTextZh: 哪些因素可能影响燃油经济性？
cards.referenceText:
There are many factors that may affect fuel consumption/economy such as weather conditions, airspeed, altitude, the weight of the aircraft, the pilot's flight skills and so on.
有诸多因素可能影响燃油消耗 / 经济性，比如天气条件、空速、高度、飞机重量、飞行员的飞行技能等等 。

Factors include weather conditions (wind, turbulence), airspeed and altitude selection, aircraft weight, piloting skills (smooth maneuvers), wind direction, and aircraft configuration. Optimal altitude and speed, reduced unnecessary maneuvers improve fuel efficiency.
影响因素包括天气条件风、颠簸、空速和高度选择、飞机重量、驾驶技巧平稳操作、风向以及飞机构型。选择最佳高度和速度、减少不必要操作可提升燃油效率。

cards.audioText: What factors should be considered in calculating the fuel quantities for each flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 计算每次飞行燃油量时，应考虑哪些因素？
cards.referenceText:
There are many factors we will consider when calculating the fuel quantities for each flight such as weight and balance, weather conditions, altitude and airspeed and so on.
计算每次飞行燃油量时，我们会考虑诸多因素，比如重量与平衡、天气条件、高度和空速等等 。

cards.audioText: What can pilots do to save fuel?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员如何节油?
cards.referenceText:
Pilots can save fuel by selecting the optimum cruising altitude and speed, requesting direct routes or straight-in approaches, reducing unnecessary maneuvers, avoiding prolonged holding, and maintaining stable flight. Skilled operation and good preflight planning also contribute to fuel efficiency.
飞行员可通过选择最佳巡航高度和速度、申请直飞航线或直线进近、减少不必要操作、避免长时间等待以及保持稳定飞行来节油。熟练的操作和良好的飞行前规划也有助于提升燃油效率。

cards.audioText: If you encounter fuel shortage when going around, what should you do?
cards.audioTextZh: 在复飞阶段你遇到燃油短缺,你会怎么做?
cards.referenceText:
I will immediately inform ATC of the fuel shortage and situation, request priority landing at the nearest suitable airport, simplify flight procedures, avoid unnecessary maneuvers, and monitor fuel quantity closely to ensure safe landing.
我会立即向空管报告燃油短缺情况和当前状态，申请优先降落到最近的合适机场，简化飞行程序，避免不必要操作，密切监控燃油量，确保安全着陆。

cards.audioText: Can you dump fuel at city area?
cards.audioTextZh: 可以在城市区域放油吗?
cards.referenceText:
No. Dumping fuel over city areas is strictly prohibited. It may pollute the environment, endanger ground personnel and property, and cause potential safety hazards. Fuel must be dumped in designated areas such as high altitude over oceans, mountains, or wilderness.
不可以。严禁在城市区域放油，这可能污染环境、危及地面人员和财产安全，存在潜在安全隐患。燃油必须在指定区域，如海洋、山区或荒野上空的高高度进行排放。

cards.audioText: Have you had the experience of refuel?
cards.audioTextZh: 你经历过加油吗?
cards.referenceText:
Yes. During flight training and operations, I have participated in aircraft refueling. Before refueling, we calculate the required fuel quantity based on the flight plan. During refueling, we monitor the process to check for contamination or leakage, and confirm the fuel quantity after refueling.
有过。在飞行训练和运行中，我参与过飞机加油。加油前，我们根据飞行计划计算所需燃油量；加油过程中，监控加油情况，检查燃油是否污染或泄漏；加油后，确认燃油量是否符合要求。

cards.audioText: How many fuel tanks are there on your aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh: 你的飞机上有几个油箱?
cards.referenceText:
I fly the DA-40, which is equipped with two main fuel tanks, one in each wing. For large commercial aircraft like the B737 or A320, there are usually multiple fuel tanks, including wing tanks and a center tank, to meet long-haul flight fuel requirements and maintain weight balance.
我驾驶的DA-40飞机配备两个主油箱，左右机翼各一个。对于波音737、空客A320等大型民航客机，通常设有多个油箱，包括机翼油箱和中央油箱，以满足长途飞行的燃油需求并保持重量平衡。

cards.audioText: What will cause fuel contamination?
cards.audioTextZh: 哪些情况会造成燃油污染?
cards.referenceText:
Fuel contamination can be caused by inadequate preflight inspection, lack of maintenance, improperly filtered fuel supply, and presence of water, sand, or other debris in fuel tanks. Contaminated fuel may block filters, cut off fuel supply, and lead to engine power loss or shutdown.
燃油污染的成因包括飞行前检查不充分、维护不当、燃油供应过滤不达标，以及油箱内混入水、沙子或其他杂物。受污染的燃油可能堵塞过滤器、切断燃油供应，导致发动机动力损失甚至熄火。

cards.audioText: Who is responsible for providing the loading sheet to the flight crew?
cards.audioTextZh: 谁负责向飞行机组提供装载单（loading sheet）？
cards.referenceText:
The dispatcher is responsible for providing the loading sheet to the flight crew.
签派员（dispatcher）负责向飞行机组提供装载单 。

cards.audioText: What's the use of the loading sheet?
cards.audioTextZh: 装载单（loading sheet）有什么用途？
cards.referenceText:
（1）Based on my knowledge, the pilot should consider the aircraft weight and balance. The pilot can get the passenger and cargo information from the loading sheet. It can help the pilot to make pre-flight preparation to make sure the aircraft is well-balanced.
据我所知，飞行员需考虑飞机的重量与平衡。可从装载单获取乘客和货物信息，助力飞行员进行飞行前准备，确保飞机平衡良好。
（2）Loading sheet is very important. We can get some important information about weight and balance from loading sheet such as persons on board (POB), cargos, fuel quantity, CG and so on.装载单十分重要，能从中获取重量与平衡相关的关键信息，比如机上人员（POB）、货物、燃油量、重心（CG）等 。

cards.audioText: What information is included in the loading sheet?
cards.audioTextZh: 装载单（loading sheet）包含哪些信息？
cards.referenceText:
（1）The loading sheet includes a lot of information such as zero fuel weight, CG, POB, fuel on board, take-off weight and so on.
装载单包含诸多信息，如无燃油重量（zero fuel weight）、重心（CG）、机上人员（POB）、机上燃油量（fuel on board）、起飞重量（take - off weight）等。
（2）There is some important information include in the loading sheet such as persons on board (POB), cargos, fuel quantity, CG and so on.
装载单包含一些重要信息，像机上人员（POB）、货物（cargos）、燃油量（fuel quantity）、重心（CG）等 。

cards.audioText: Which department is responsible for the provision of the loading sheet?
cards.audioTextZh: 哪个部门负责提供舱单？
cards.referenceText:
The dispatching office is responsible for providing the loading sheet.
签派室负责提供舱单。

cards.audioText: How do you get the loading sheet?
cards.audioTextZh: 你怎么获取舱单？
cards.referenceText:
We can get the loading sheet from the flight dispatchers.
我们可以从签派室获取舱单。

cards.audioText: What's the use of loading sheet?What information can you get from the loading sheet?
cards.audioTextZh: 舱单的用处是什么？我们可以从舱单获取哪些信息？
cards.referenceText:
Loading sheet is very important. We can get some important information about weight and balance from loading sheet such as persons on board (POB), cargos, fuel quantity, CG and so on.
舱单非常有用，我们可以从舱单中获取一些关于重量与平衡重要信息，比如机上人员（POB），货物，燃油重量，重心等。

cards.audioText: What do you know about the loading sheet? What information is included in the loading sheet?
cards.audioTextZh: 你知道舱单吗?舱单中都有哪些信息?
cards.referenceText:
A loading sheet is used for weight and balance control. It includes flight number, number of persons on board (POB), cargo/baggage weight, fuel quantity (FOB), center of gravity (CG), and takeoff/landing weight. Pilots use it to calculate takeoff data and ensure aircraft stability.
舱单用于重量和平衡控制，包含航班号、机上人员数（POB）、货物/行李重量、燃油量（FOB）、重心（CG）以及起飞/着陆重量。飞行员用它计算起飞数据，确保飞机稳定性。

cards.audioText: What kind of communication equipment do you have in the cockpit?
cards.audioTextZh: 驾驶舱内有哪些通讯设备？
cards.referenceText:
We use the earphone, microphone, VHF, HF to communicate with ATC.
我们使用耳机、麦克风、甚高频（VHF，Very High Frequency ）、高频（HF，High Frequency ）与空中交通管制（ATC，Air Traffic Control ）进行通讯 。

cards.audioText: Does your company provide guidelines for handling communication Failure? Where can you find this kind of information?
cards.audioTextZh: 你公司提供处理通讯双向失效的指导性文件guidelines吗？从哪里获得这些信息？
cards.referenceText:
(1)Yes, we have the communication failure procedure in our flight school. We can find this kind of information in our checklist and SOP.
是的，我们飞行学校有通讯故障程序。我们可以在检查单和标准操作程序（SOP，Standard Operating Procedure ）中找到这类信息 。
(2)Yes, our company provides some guidelines for handling two-way communication failure. We can get these information from EFB or airport details.
嗯，我们公司提供处理双向通讯失效的纲领性文件。我们可以从EFB或机场细则获取相关信息。

cards.audioText: 3. What would you do if you encounter transmitter failure?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果发射机失效，你该怎么办？
cards.referenceText:
(1)First of all, I will follow the SOP and perform the checklist to check the equipment, we will check the earphone, microphone, radio frequency, transmitter again. Secondly, I will squawk 7600. At last, I will fly according to the ATC's instructions because our receiver is still functional.
首先，我会遵循标准操作程序（SOP，Standard Operating Procedure ），执行检查单来检查设备，我们会再次检查耳机、麦克风、无线电频率、发射机。其次，我会设置应答机代码 7600（表示无线电故障 ）。最后，由于我们的接收机仍可正常工作，我会按照空中交通管制（ATC ）的指令飞行 。
(2)If we encounter transmitter failure, we will squawk 7600, and we can squawk ident or make turns to show we can receive the transmissions.
如果我们遭遇发射机失效，我们将设置应答机7600，我们可以按下应答机识别键或者转弯表明我们可以收到信息

cards.audioText: What would you do if you encounter receiver failure?
cards.audioTextZh:
如果接收机失效，你该怎么办？
What are your company procedures to deal with radio failure?
cards.referenceText:
(1)If we encounter receiver failure, we will squawk 7600 and we can transmit blind on the frequency.
如果我们遭遇接收机失效，我们将设置应答机7600，我们可以在频率上盲发。
(2)If we encounter two-way communication failure, we will squawk 7600. And we should follow the last ATC instructions or follow the flight planned route.
如果我们遭遇双向通讯失效，我们将设置应答机7600，表明我们通讯失效，我们应该执行管制最后一条指令。

cards.audioText: What human factors may affect good communication?
cards.audioTextZh: 哪些人为因素会影响良好通讯？
cards.referenceText:
(1)There are some human factors affect good RTF communication. For example, both the pilot and controller don't use the standard words and phrases, they don't speak clearly and loudly. What's worse, if they have any problem or in doubt they don't verify. These factors may affect effective communication.
有一些人为因素会影响良好的地空无线电通话（RTF，Radio Telephony ）通信。例如，飞行员和管制员都不使用标准用语和短语，讲话不清晰、声音不大。更糟糕的是，若他们遇到问题或存在疑问时不进行核实。这些因素可能会影响有效沟通 。
(2)There are some human factors that may affect good communication.
First, if controllers or pilots don’t use standard words, it may affect good communication.
Second, high pilot workload may affect good communication.
Third, wrong frequency setting may affect good communication.
很多人为因素可能影响良好的通讯。第一， 如果管制员或飞行员不使用标准术语，可能影响良好的通讯；第二，飞行员负荷重可能影响良好的通讯；第三，设错频率可能影响良好的通讯。

cards.audioText: What factors might affect the effective communication between the ATC and pilot?
cards.audioTextZh: 哪些因素会影响飞行员与管制员的有效通讯？
cards.referenceText:
(1)There are some human factors affect good RTF communication. For example, both the pilot and controller don't use the standard words and phrases, they don't speak clearly and loudly. What's worse, if they have any problem or in doubt they don't verify. These factors may affect effective communication.
有一些人为因素会影响良好的地空无线电通话（RTF，Radio Telephony）通信。例如，飞行员和管制员都不使用标准用语和短语，他们讲话既不清晰也不大声。更糟糕的是，要是他们遇到问题或存有疑问，也不进行核实。这些因素可能会影响有效沟通 。
(2)There are many factors that may affect effective communication between pilots and controllers First, the radio equipment may affect effective communication between pilots and ATC For example, if there is radio failure such as transmitter failure or receiver failure or two-way failure, it may cause communication failure Second, human factors may affect effective communication between pilots and ATC For example, if the pilots or controllers don’t use standard words and phrases, it may cause misunderstanding or miscommunication很多因素可能影响飞行员与管制员之间的有效通讯。第一，无线电设备可能影响飞行员与管制员之间的有效通讯，比如，如果出现无线电失效，发射机失效或接收机失效或双向失效可能导致通讯失效；第二，人为错误可能飞行员与管制员之间的有效通讯，比如，如果飞行员或管制员不使用标准术语，可能导致通讯失误。
（3）Key factors include poor radio signal quality (due to terrain/mountains), adverse weather, non-standard phraseology, frequency jam, loud background noise, controller accents, and pilots’ English proficiency. These factors may lead to misunderstandings or delayed responses.
主要因素包括无线电信号质量差（地形/山脉影响）、恶劣天气、非标准术语使用、频率拥堵、背景噪音大、管制员口音以及飞行员英语熟练度，这些都可能导致误解或响应延迟。

cards.audioText: What environmental factors will affect good communication?
cards.audioTextZh: 哪些环境因素会影响良好的通信？
cards.referenceText:
There are some environmental factors may affect good communication. For example, loud outside noises, communication equipment malfunction, signal unstable, disturbed by other pilot and so on.
有一些环境因素可能影响良好的通信。例如，外界噪音大、通信设备故障、信号不稳定、受到其他飞行员干扰等等 。

cards.audioText: During your flight operation, which crew member is responsible for the RTF communication with ATC?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞机运行中，哪个机组成员负责无线电陆空通话？
cards.referenceText:
(1)During our flight operation, The PF should control the aircraft, the PM is responsible for the RTF communication with ATC.
在我们的飞行操作过程中，操纵飞行员（PF，Pilot Flying ）应操控飞机，监控飞行员（PM，Pilot Monitoring ）负责与空中交通管制（ATC，Air Traffic Control ）进行地空无线电通话（RTF，Radio Telephony ）通信 。
(2)According to SOP, the First Officer (FO) handles radiotelephony communication with ATC during ground operations, while the Pilot Monitoring (PM/PNF) takes charge during flight. This division ensures the Pilot Flying (PF) can focus on aircraft control, optimizing workload distribution.
根据标准操作程序（SOP），地面运行时由副驾驶（FO）负责与空管的无线电通话，飞行中由监控飞行员（PM/PNF）负责。这种分工能让操纵飞行员（PF）专注于飞机控制，优化工作负荷分配。

cards.audioText: Do you think it is necessary to minimize communication during flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为飞行期间有必要尽量减少通讯吗？
cards.referenceText:
Yes, I think so. Because takeoff and approach are critical phases of the flight. During this stage, there is high pilot workload. Pilot should focus on controlling the aircraft and performing the checklist. So it is necessary to minimize the communication.
是的，我认为有必要。因为起飞和进近是飞行的关键阶段。在这个阶段，飞行员工作负荷大。飞行员应专注于操控飞机和执行检查单。所以有必要尽量减少通讯 。

cards.audioText: What are some of the ways to communicate with ATC?
cards.audioTextZh: 跟管制通讯的方式有哪些？
cards.referenceText:
There are two ways to communicate with ATC.
First, we can communicate with ATC by radios such as HF radios and VHF radios.
Second, we can communicate with ATC by data link.
有两种方法可以和管制通讯。第一，我们可以使用无线电台，比如高频电台，甚高频电台和管制通讯；第二，我们可以使用数据链与管制通讯。

cards.audioText: What can pilots do to improve communication qualities between pilots and controllers? How can you improve communication quality with ATC?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员可以做些什么来改善飞行员与管制员之间的沟通质量？你如何改善与空中交通管制（ATC）的沟通质量？
cards.referenceText:
There are many things we can do to improve the communication between pilots and controllers,
first, we should check the radios to ensure they are working properly/well.
Second, we should follow the communication procedure and use standard words to avoid misunderstanding between pilots and controllers.
Third, we should speak loudly and clearly.
我们可以采取很多措施来改善飞行员与管制员之间的沟通。首先，应检查无线电设备，确保其正常工作。其次，应遵循通讯程序并使用标准用语，避免飞行员与管制员之间产生误解。第三，讲话应清晰、大声 。

Pilots can conduct radio checks to ensure signal clarity, use standard phraseology, speak clearly and loudly, read back instructions correctly, confirm unclear clearances, enhance English proficiency, and stay focused to avoid distractions, ensuring accurate information transmission.
飞行员可通过以下方式提升沟通质量：进行无线电检查确保信号清晰；使用标准术语；清晰大声表达；正确复诵指令；对不明指令及时确认；提升英语水平；保持专注避免分心，确保信息准确传递。

cards.audioText: How do pilots cooperate with ATC to maintain the flight safety?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员如何与空中交通管制（ATC）协作以保障飞行安全？
cards.referenceText:
To maintain flight safety, we should keep good Communication and cooperation with ATC. First, we should follow ATC instructions. Second, if we have some doubt about ATC instructions, we should confirm it with ATC immediately. Third, if we encounter emergency situations, we can report ATC and request emergency landing and emergency services.
为保障飞行安全，我们应与空中交通管制保持良好的沟通与协作。首先，应遵循空中交通管制指令。其次，若对空中交通管制指令存疑，应立即与管制部门确认。第三，若遭遇紧急情况，可向管制部门报告并申请紧急降落及应急服务

cards.audioText: Are there any suggestions to ATC from a pilot point of view? What are they?
cards.audioTextZh: 从飞行员的角度出发，对空中交通管制（ATC）有没有建议？有哪些建议？
cards.referenceText:
Yes, we have some suggestions to ATC. For example, first, the controller should use standard words to avoid misunderstanding. Second, the controller should keep good communication with pilots to ensure flight safety. Third, if the aircraft is emergency situations， the controllers should offer emergency services to the aircraft.
有，我们对空中交通管制有一些建议。比如，首先，管制员应使用标准用语，避免产生误解。其次，管制员应与飞行员保持良好沟通，保障飞行安全。第三，若飞机遭遇紧急情况，管制员应为飞机提供应急服务 。

cards.audioText: When you are in trouble, how can you get help from ATC?
cards.audioTextZh: 当你遇到麻烦时，如何从空中交通管制（ATC）获得帮助？
cards.referenceText:
When we are in trouble, we will report it to ATC immediately and request emergency service such as fire services, medical services and so on.
当我们遇到麻烦时，会立即向空中交通管制报告，并请求消防、医疗等应急服务 。

cards.audioText: Have you ever encountered misunderstanding in Radiotelephony communication?
cards.audioTextZh: 你在无线电通话（Radiotelephony）通信中遇到过误解情况吗？
cards.referenceText:
No, I have never encountered misunderstanding in radiotelephony communication.
没，我在无线电通话通信中从未遇到过误解情况 。

cards.audioText: Have you heard of any incident caused by misunderstanding between the pilot and the controller? Please share the story.
cards.audioTextZh: 你听说过因飞行员与管制员之间误解引发的事件吗？请分享一下相关事例。
cards.referenceText:
Yes, I have heard some accidents caused by misunderstanding between the pilot and the controller. For example, once, the controller instructed the pilot to “descend two four zero zero feet", which means "descend two thousand four hundred feet", but the pilot misunderstood it as "descend to four hundred feed”. As a result, the aircraft crashed into the hill.
听过，我了解到一些因飞行员与管制员误解引发的事故。比如，有一次，管制员指令飞行员 “下降二四零零英尺”，意思是 “下降两千四百英尺”，但飞行员误解为 “下降至四百英尺” 。结果，飞机撞上了山体。

cards.audioText: What are the efficient ways to reduce misunderstanding with each other? How to avoid misunderstanding when communicating with ATC?
cards.audioTextZh: 有哪些有效的方法可以减少彼此间的误解？与空中交通管制（ATC）沟通时如何避免误解？
cards.referenceText:
Yes, there are some efficient ways to avoid misunderstanding between pilots and controllers.
first, we can check the radios to ensure they are working well.
Second, we should follow the communication procedure and use standard words to avoid misunderstanding between pilots and controllers.
Third, if we have some doubt about ATC instructions, we should confirm it with ATC immediately.
Fourth, we should improve our English proficiency.
有，存在一些避免飞行员与管制员之间误解的有效方法。首先，我们可以检查无线电设备，确保其正常工作。其次，应遵循通讯程序并使用标准用语，避免飞行员与管制员之间产生误解。第三，若对空中交通管制指令存疑，应立即与管制部门确认。第四，应提升英语水平 。

cards.audioText: What communication skills will affect smooth communication between pilots and controllers?
cards.audioTextZh: 哪些通讯技巧会影响飞行员与管制员顺畅通讯？
cards.referenceText:
First, if we don’t speak loudly and clearly, it may affect smooth communication.
Second, if we don’t use standard words, it may affect smooth communication.
Third, poor English may affect smooth communication.
第一，如果我们讲话不够大声清晰，可能会影响顺畅通讯；第二，如果我们不使用标准术语，可能影响顺畅通讯；第三，糟糕的英语可能影响顺畅通讯

cards.audioText: What type of aircraft are you flying now? What kind of communication equipment is there on your aircraft? How do you use them?
cards.audioTextZh: 你飞什么机型？你飞机有哪些通讯设备？你怎么使用它们？
cards.referenceText:
I fly... Our aircraft is equipped with several communication devices, including radios, data links, satellite phones, PA (passenger addressing) systems, and interphones. We can communicate with ATC via radios and data links, interact with passengers using the PA system, converse with cabin crew and ground staff through interphones, and stay in touch with our company (dispatchers) by satellite phones.

我飞…… 我们的飞机配备了多种通讯设备，有无线电台、数据链、卫星电话、乘客广播系统和内话系统。我们可通过无线电台和数据链与空中交通管制（ATC）通讯，用乘客广播系统和乘客互动，借助内话系统与空乘及地面人员交流，还能通过卫星电话与公司（签派人员 ）保持联系 。

cards.audioText: What are the two main ways to communicate with ATC?
cards.audioTextZh: 和管制沟通的两种主要方式是？
cards.referenceText:
The two main ways are verbal communication (via VHF/HF radio) and data link communication (e.g., CPDLC). Verbal communication enables real-time interaction, while CPDLC transmits clearances and reports via text messages, which is particularly useful on oceanic routes or when voice communication is poor.
两种主要方式是语音通信（通过甚高频/高频无线电）和数据链通信（如管制员和驾驶员数据链通讯（CPDLC））。语音通信可实时互动，CPDLC通过文本报文传输指令和报告，在跨洋航线或语音通信质量不佳时尤为实用。

cards.audioText: Why is verbal communication especially essential in aviation safety?
cards.audioTextZh: 在民航安全中，为什么说语音交流非常重要？
cards.referenceText:
Verbal communication directly, clearly, and rapidly transmits pilots’ intentions and ATC’s instructions. It allows real-time confirmation of unclear information and effective response to emergencies, avoiding misunderstandings that could lead to risks like loss of separation or runway incursion, thus safeguarding aviation safety.
语音通信能直接、清晰、快速地传递飞行员意图和空管指令，可实时确认不明信息，高效应对紧急情况，避免因误解引发飞行间隔丢失、跑道入侵等风险，对民航安全至关重要。

cards.audioText: What's your company's procedures to deal with radio failure?
cards.audioTextZh: 你们公司应对通信失效的流程是什么？
cards.referenceText:
The procedures include: squawking 7600 to indicate communication failure; following the last ATC instruction and flight plan; attempting to re-establish communication by recycling radios or switching to emergency frequency 121.5; performing blind transmission and position reports; and considering landing as soon as practical based on aircraft and airport conditions.
应对流程包括：应答机编码7600示意通信失效；遵循空管最后指令和飞行计划；通过重启无线电或切换至应急频率121.5尝试重建通信；进行盲目发射和位置报告；根据飞机及机场情况考虑尽快落地（非紧急情况下）。

cards.audioText: If the ATC uses non-standard words in communicating with you, how should you respond?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果管制员用不标准术语和你交流，你会怎么应对？
cards.referenceText:
I will respond with standard radiotelephony phraseology, listen carefully, and read back correctly. If unsure of the instruction, I will politely request confirmation or ask the controller to repeat. I will avoid non-standard expressions to prevent further misunderstandings.
我会用标准无线电通话术语回应，仔细聆听并正确复诵。若对指令有疑问，会礼貌请求确认或请管制员重复，避免使用非标准表述，防止误解加剧。

cards.audioText: If the controller has a heavy accent, what may be the results?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果管制员口音很重，会发生什么后果？
cards.referenceText:
A heavy accent may cause pilots to mishear or misunderstand ATC instructions, leading to incorrect operations (e.g., wrong altitude or route). It may also delay confirmation, jam the frequency, and cause emergency aircraft to miss the optimal response timing.
管制员口音过重可能导致飞行员听错或误解指令，进而做出错误操作（如错误高度、航线）；还可能延误确认流程、造成频率拥堵，使紧急情况下的飞机错失最佳响应时机。

cards.audioText: Are there some suggestion or recommendation to ATC from a pilot point of view? What are they?
cards.audioTextZh: 从飞行员的角度来看，对空中交通管制有什么建议或推荐吗？它们是什么？
cards.referenceText:
Good cooperation between the pilot and ATC is very important for flight safety. During normal operation, they should have good communication. They should use standard words and phrases, speak clearly and loudly. If they have any problem or in doubt, they should verify. What's more, for flight information and weather information, they should advise each other timely. During abnormal situation, the pilot should advise ATC of the situation, the ATC should provide timely assistance for the pilot.
飞行员和空中交通管制部门之间的良好合作对飞行安全非常重要。在正常运行期间，他们应该保持良好的沟通。他们应该使用标准的单词和短语，清晰大声地说话。如果他们有任何问题或疑问，他们应该核实。此外，对于航班信息和天气信息，他们应该及时互相告知。在异常情况下，飞行员应将情况告知空中交通管制，空中交通管制应及时为飞行员提供协助。

cards.audioText: Are there any efficient ways for the pilot and controller to avoid misunderstanding with each other?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员和管制员是否有有效的方法避免相互误解？
cards.referenceText:
Good cooperation between the pilot and ATC is very important for flight safety. During normal operation, they should have good communication. They should use standard words and phrases, speak clearly and loudly. If they have any problem or in doubt, they should verify. What's more, for flight information and weather information, they should advise each other timely. During abnormal situation, the pilot should advise ATC of the situation, the ATC should provide timely assistance for the pilot.
飞行员和空中交通管制部门之间的良好合作对飞行安全非常重要。在正常运行期间，他们应该保持良好的沟通。他们应该使用标准的单词和短语，清晰大声地说话。如果他们有任何问题或疑问，他们应该核实。此外，对于航班信息和天气信息，他们应该及时互相告知。在异常情况下，飞行员应将情况告知空中交通管制，空中交通管制应及时为飞行员提供协助。

cards.audioText: 8. In your opinion, what could the pilot do to improve the quality of RTF communication?
cards.referenceText: Good cooperation between the pilot and ATC is very important for flight safety. During normal operation, they should have good communication. They should use standard words and phrases, speak clearly and loudly. If they have any problem or in doubt, they should verify. What's more, for flight information and weather information, they should advise each other timely. During abnormal situation, the pilot should advise ATC of the situation, the ATC should provide timely assistance for the pilot.

cards.audioText: What communication skills do you think may affect the smooth communication between the pilot and controller? Give some examples
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为哪些沟通技巧可能会影响飞行员和管制员之间的顺畅沟通？举几个例子
cards.referenceText:
In my opinion, first, both the pilot and controller should use the standard words and phrases. Secondly, they should speak clearly and loudly. What's more, if they have any problem or in doubt, they should verify.
在我看来，首先，飞行员和管制员都应该使用标准的单词和短语。其次，他们应该清晰、大声地说话。更重要的是，如果他们有任何问题或疑问，他们应该核实。

cards.audioText:
When an air traffic controller has a strong accent,
what might be the risk?
cards.audioTextZh: 空管人员口音较重可能带来什么风险？
cards.referenceText:
If an air traffic controller has a strong accent, it may cause misunderstanding with the pilots, it’s dangerous for the flight safety.
可能导致飞行员与空管之间产生误解，对飞行安全构成威胁。

cards.audioText:
If ATC uses non-standard phraseology in
communicating with you, how do respond?
cards.audioTextZh: 若空管在通话中使用非标准用语，你会如何回应？
cards.referenceText:
I will readback his instruction for double check and if I have any doubt of the instruction, I will confirm with the controller before further action.
会复诵空管指令以双重确认；若对指令有任何疑问，在采取进一步行动前会向空管确认。

cards.audioText:
Sometimes non-standard phraseologies
may bring threat to flight safety, why?
cards.audioTextZh: 为何非标准通话用语有时会对飞行安全构成威胁？
cards.referenceText:
If ATC or pilots uses non-standard words in communication, it may cause misunderstanding with each other. Sometimes it may lead to accident, such as runway incursion.
若空管或飞行员使用非标准用语，可能导致双方误解，有时会引发事故，如跑道入侵。

cards.audioText: Do you think it is important/necessary to take/this training?
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为参加这次培训重要 / 有必要吗？
cards.referenceText:
Yes. It's very important to take this training. After the training, we can familiar with the procedures, practice how to deal with the abnormal/dangerous goods, suspicious articles, hijack situation, improve skills and enrich our knowledge. What's more, we will have a better communication and cooperation between crew members.
有必要。参加这次培训非常重要。培训后，我们能熟悉流程，练习如何处理异常 / 危险物品、可疑物品、劫机情况，提升技能并丰富知识。而且，机组成员之间能有更好的沟通与协作 。

cards.audioText: Where do you have your recurrent training?
cards.audioTextZh: 你在哪里进行复训？
cards.referenceText:
No, I have not back to the company yet. I have not taken this training yet. Now I still take flight training in the flight school. We have simulator training.
没，我还没回公司呢。也还没参加过这次培训。目前我仍在飞行学校进行飞行训练，会开展模拟机训练 。

cards.audioText: How often do you have your recurrent training? How many hours are you required to complete each time?
cards.audioTextZh: 你多久进行一次复训？每次需要完成多少小时的训练？
cards.referenceText:
In flight school, I take simulator training once a month. Every time, I take training for 3 hours. It depends on our training subject.
在飞行学校，我每月进行一次模拟机训练。每次训练时长为 3 小时，具体时长取决于训练科目 。

cards.audioText: What training subjects do you review in your recurrent training?
cards.audioTextZh: 你在复训中会复习哪些训练科目？
cards.referenceText:
We will train all the normal procedures, such as traffic pattern, holding pattern, precision approach and so on. We also train the abnormal situations, such as abort takeoff, engine failure, hydraulic system failure and so on.
我们会训练所有正常程序，比如起落航线、等待程序、精密进近等等。我们也会训练异常情况，比如中断起飞、发动机故障、液压系统故障等等 。

cards.audioText: In your opinion, which subject is the most difficult for you to deal with? Why?
cards.audioTextZh: 在你看来，哪个科目对你而言最难处理？为什么？
cards.referenceText:
I think engine failure is the most difficult for me. Because our DA - 40 is a single engine aircraft. If we lost engine, we lost power. It is very dangerous situation. There are a lot of procedures and it needs quick mind and quick action. The most important is that it is very hard to choose the right time and right place to make forced landing. I'm not so experienced. So I think it is most difficult for me.
我认为发动机故障对我来说最难。因为我们的 DA - 40 是单发飞机。要是发动机失效，就会失去动力，情况很危险。处理它有很多程序，需要思维敏捷、行动迅速。最重要的是，很难选准迫降的时机和地点。我经验不足，所以觉得这对我来说最难 。

cards.audioText: Do you think it's necessary for the pilots to have recurrent training? Why?
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为飞行员进行复训有必要吗？为什么？
cards.referenceText:
Yes. It's very important to take this training. After the training, we can familiar with the procedures, practice how to deal with the abnormal situation, improve skills and enrich our knowledge. What's more, we will have a better communication and cooperation between crew members.
有必要。参加复训非常重要。复训后，我们能熟悉流程，练习如何应对异常情况，提升技能并丰富知识。而且，机组成员之间能有更好的沟通与协作 。

Pilots need to undergo recurrent training every year for many important reasons. Firstly, flight safety is the top priority of civil aviation. With the passage of time, pilots may forget some operating procedures, emergency disposal methods or professional knowledge. Recurrent training can help them review and consolidate relevant content, ensure that they can proficiently master various skills and knowledge in actual flight and deal with various complex situations. Secondly, aviation technology and regulations are constantly updating and developing. Recurrent training can keep pilots abreast of the latest aviation technologies, operating procedures and regulatory requirements, and adapt to the changes and developments of the aviation industry. In addition, recurrent training can also help pilots find their own weaknesses and deficiencies in flight skills, and conduct targeted training and improvement to continuously improve their professional quality and flight level. Finally, recurrent training is also a mandatory requirement of civil aviation regulations to ensure that each pilot maintains a certain level of professional competence and ensures the safety of civil aviation operations.
飞行员每年都需要进行复训，原因有很多重要方面。首先，飞行安全是民航的重中之重。随着时间的推移，飞行员可能会忘记一些操作程序、应急处置方法或专业知识，复训可以帮助他们复习和巩固相关内容，确保在实际飞行中能够熟练掌握各项技能和知识，应对各种复杂情况。其次，航空技术和法规在不断更新和发展，复训可以让飞行员及时了解最新的航空技术、操作程序和法规要求，适应航空业的变化和发展。此外，复训还能帮助飞行员发现自己在飞行技能方面的薄弱环节和不足，并进行有针对性的训练和改进，不断提升自身的专业素养和飞行水平。最后，复训也是民航法规的强制性要求，以确保每一位飞行员都能保持一定的专业能力水平，保障民航运行的安全。

cards.audioText: What will you do if you are going to land at an unfamiliar airport?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果你要在不熟悉的机场降落，会怎么做？
cards.referenceText:
If we fly to an unfamiliar airport, before flight, we will make good preflight preparation to get important information,such as the weather condition, the runway condition, the taxiways and so on. After landing, if necessary, we will request a follow-me car
若要飞往不熟悉的机场，飞行前我们会做好飞行前准备，获取天气状况、跑道情况、滑行道等重要信息。降落之后，如有需要，我们会申请引导车（follow - me car ）引导 。

I will study airport charts, NOTAM, and ATIS carefully, familiarize with runway conditions, approach procedures, and emergency exits. Communicate with ATC actively, monitor instruments closely, and prepare for possible go-around.
我会仔细研究机场航图、航行通告和自动终端情报服务，熟悉跑道条件、进近程序和紧急脱离道。积极与空管沟通，密切监控仪表，并做好复飞准备。

cards.audioText: Does your airline provide training about new airport?
cards.audioTextZh: 你们航空公司会提供关于新机场的培训吗？
cards.referenceText:
Yes, our company provides some training to help pilots be familiar with new airport. First, we can have simulator flight to the new airport. Second, we will fly with experienced pilots to be familiar with the new airport.
会，我们公司会提供一些培训，帮助飞行员熟悉新机场。首先，我们可以进行飞往新机场的模拟机飞行。其次，会和经验丰富的飞行员一起飞行，以此熟悉新机场 。

Yes, the company provides training for unfamiliar airports, including simulator training, theoretical courses on airport procedures and risks, and briefings by experienced pilots. It helps pilots master relevant skills before operation.
是的，公司会为不熟悉的机场提供训练，包括模拟机训练、关于机场程序和风险的理论课程，以及由资深飞行员进行的专项简报，帮助飞行员在执行航班前掌握相关技能。

cards.audioText: If you are going to land at an unfamiliar airport and you miss the first fast exit, what will you do?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果你要在不熟悉的机场降落，且错过了第一个快速出口，会怎么做？
cards.referenceText:
After landing on an unfamiliar airport, if we miss the first rapid exit, we will report the situation and request further instruction.
在不熟悉的机场降落之后，要是若错过了第一个快速出口，我们会报告情况并请求进一步指令 。

I will stop the aircraft immediately, report to ATC, and request to vacate the runway at the next exit. If the next exit is far, I will ask for permission to backtrack from the current position, ensuring no impact on other traffic.
我会立即停止飞机，向空管报告，并请求从下一个出口脱离跑道。如果下一个出口较远，我会申请从当前位置掉头，确保不影响其他交通运行。

cards.audioText: Where/when did you have Your initial flight training？(simulator training/recurrent training/ transition training /type rating)?
cards.audioTextZh: 你在哪里 / 什么时候进行的初始飞行训练？（模拟机训练 / 复训 / 转机型训练 / 型别等级训练 ）？
cards.referenceText:
I had my initial training in…Flight College/Sub - college in 201X（年份）
我在…… 飞行学院 / 分院进行的初始训练，时间是 201X 年（年份 ）

I started my initial flight training in March last year at Zhanghe Airport. The initial training mainly focused on basic flight skills such as takeoff, landing, straight and level flight, and turning, which laid a solid foundation for my subsequent flight training.
我于去年3月在漳河机场开始了初始飞行训练。初始训练主要围绕起飞、降落、平飞、转弯等基础飞行技能展开，为我后续的飞行训练打下了坚实的基础。

cards.audioText: Could you describe some unforgettable moments of your flight training?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能描述一下飞行训练中一些难忘的时刻吗？
cards.referenceText:
Yes. My first solo flight was one of the most unforgettable moments of my flight training. That was a sunny day. The visibility was good, Wind was calm. It was good for flying. I flew two traffic patterns and made a successful landing.
能。我的首次单飞是飞行训练中最难忘的时刻之一。那是个晴天，能见度良好，风也很平稳，很适合飞行。我飞了两个起落航线，并且成功降落了 。

cards.audioText: What have you learned from your flight instructors?
cards.audioTextZh: 你从飞行教员那里学到了什么？
cards.referenceText:
I have learned many things from my flight instructor. First, I have learned many flight skills from my flight instructor .second, I have learned how to be a responsible man.
我从飞行教员那里学到了很多东西。首先，我从教员那里学到了诸多飞行技能。其次，我学会了如何成为一个有责任心的人 。

I have learned a lot from my flight instructor. First of all, I have mastered solid flight skills and professional knowledge, including various flight operation techniques and emergency disposal methods. Secondly, the instructor has always emphasized the importance of flight safety, teaching me to always put safety first, strictly abide by operating procedures, and not take any chances. In addition, the instructor's rigorous work attitude and calm response in the face of emergencies have also influenced me deeply. He taught me to maintain a good psychological quality during the flight, remain calm and rational when encountering problems, and make correct decisions quickly. Finally, the instructor also taught me the importance of teamwork and effective communication, which is crucial for ensuring flight safety.
我从飞行教员那里学到了很多东西。首先，我掌握了扎实的飞行技能和专业知识，包括各种飞行操作技巧和应急处置方法。其次，教员始终强调飞行安全的重要性，教导我要始终将安全放在首位，严格遵守操作程序，不抱有任何侥幸心理。此外，教员严谨的工作态度和面对突发情况时的沉着应对也深深影响了我。他教会我在飞行过程中要保持良好的心理素质，遇到问题时沉着冷静、理性分析，快速做出正确的决策。最后，教员还教会了我团队协作和有效沟通的重要性，这对于保障飞行安全至关重要。

cards.audioText: How many flight hours in total do you have?
cards.audioTextZh: 你累计总共的飞行时长是多少
cards.referenceText:
I have flown about 200 hours.
我已经飞行了大概 200 小时 。

cards.audioText: what subjects were included in your initial flight training?
cards.audioTextZh: 你的初始飞行训练包含哪些科目？
cards.referenceText:
We have learned many subjects during initial flight training such as local training, cross-country training, high speed approach, staIl, steep turn-and so on.
在初始飞行训练期间，我们学习了很多科目，比如本场训练、转场训练、高速进近、失速、 steep turn（大坡度转弯）等等 。

cards.audioText: What subjects were the most difficult for you during initial training?
cards.audioTextZh: 在初始训练期间，哪些科目对你来说最难？
cards.referenceText:
I think staIl was the most difficult for me because it was difficult to control the aircraft and recover from stall. The aircraft may crash onto the ground．
我认为失速科目对我来说最难，因为很难控制飞机并从失速状态中改出。飞机有可能会坠毁在地面 。

cards.audioText: Can you describe your first solo?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能描述一下你的首次单飞吗？
cards.referenceText:
My first solo flight was one of the most unforgettable moments of my flight training. That was a sunny day. The visibility was good, Wind was calm. It was good for flying. I flew two traffic patterns and made a successful landing.
我的首次单飞是我飞行训练中最难忘的时刻之一。那是一个晴天，能见度良好，风很平稳，非常适合飞行。我飞了两个起落航线，并且成功降落了。

cards.audioText: When was your first solo flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 你的首次单飞是在什么时候
cards.referenceText:
My first solo flight was on May, the first, 201X
我的首次单飞是在 201X 年 5 月 1 日 。

cards.audioText: How was your first solo? Can you say something about it?
cards.audioTextZh: 你的首次单飞怎么样？能讲讲相关情况吗？
cards.referenceText:
Yes. My first solo flight was one of the most unforgettable moments of my flight training. That was a sunny day. The visibility was good, Wind was calm. It was good for flying. I flew two traffic patterns and made a successful landing.
可以。我的首次单飞是飞行训练中最难忘的时刻之一。那天阳光明媚，能见度佳，风力平稳，很适合飞行。我完成了两个起落航线飞行，并且成功着陆。

cards.audioText: What did you learn from your first solo flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 你从首次单飞中学到了什么？
cards.referenceText:
We have learned many things from my first solo flight. First, we should make good preflight preparation to make flight easier and safer. Second, we should follow the checklist and follow SOP to ensure flight safety.
我从首次单飞中学到了很多东西。首先，我们应做好飞行前准备，让飞行更轻松、安全。其次，要遵循检查单并依照标准操作程序（SOP），保障飞行安全 。

cards.audioText: When did you get your private/commercial/instrument pilot license?
cards.audioTextZh: 你什么时候拿到私用 / 商用 / 仪表飞行员执照的？
cards.referenceText:
I got my private/commercial／instrument pilot license on May,1,201X
我在 201X 年 5 月 1 日拿到了私用 / 商用 / 仪表飞行员执照 。

cards.audioText: How many hours have you had in the simulator?
cards.audioTextZh: 你在模拟机上累计飞了多少小时？
cards.referenceText:
I have had about 40 hours in the simulators.
我在模拟机上大概飞了 40 小时

cards.audioText: Why do we need simulator training?
cards.audioTextZh: 我们为什么需要模拟机训练？
cards.referenceText:
Simulator training is necessary for pilots. In the simulator, we can practice many abnormal situations or emergency situations and how to handle it. It can help to improve our flight skills and flight experience.
模拟机训练对飞行员而言很有必要。在模拟机上，我们能够演练诸多异常情况或紧急状况，以及学习如何处置这些情况。这有助于提升我们的飞行技能和飞行经验 。

Simulator training is an indispensable part of flight training, and its importance is reflected in many aspects. Firstly, simulator training can provide a safe training environment. It can simulate various complex and dangerous flight scenarios, such as engine failure, hydraulic system failure, severe weather and other emergency situations, allowing pilots to practice handling methods without actual flight risks, avoiding potential safety hazards and economic losses caused by mistakes in actual flight. Secondly, simulator training has high efficiency and repeatability. Pilots can repeatedly practice the same subject until they master the relevant skills, and can adjust the training difficulty and scenario settings according to their own learning progress and weaknesses, which helps to improve the training effect. In addition, simulator training can also save training costs, reduce the wear and tear of real aircraft and fuel consumption. Finally, simulator training can help pilots familiarize themselves with the aircraft's systems and operating procedures, enhance their situational awareness and emergency response capabilities, and lay a solid foundation for actual flight.
模拟机训练是飞行训练中不可或缺的一部分，其重要性体现在多个方面。首先，模拟机训练能够提供安全的训练环境。它可以模拟各种复杂、危险的飞行场景，如发动机失效、液压系统故障、恶劣天气等应急情况，让飞行员在无实际飞行风险的情况下练习处置方法，避免了在实际飞行中因操作失误而带来的安全隐患和经济损失。其次，模拟机训练具有高效性和可重复性。飞行员可以对同一科目进行反复练习，直到掌握相关技能，并且可以根据自身的学习进度和薄弱环节调整训练难度和场景设置，有助于提高训练效果。此外，模拟机训练还能节省训练成本，减少真实飞机的损耗和燃油消耗。最后，模拟机训练可以帮助飞行员熟悉飞机的系统和操作程序，增强情景意识和应急处置能力，为实际飞行打下坚实的基础。

cards.audioText: What subjects can you practice in the simulators?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能在模拟机上练习哪些科目？
cards.referenceText:
We can practice many subjects in the simulator such as engine failure, engine fire, hydraulic failure, electrical failure, flapless landing and so on.
我们可以在模拟机上练习很多科目，比如发动机故障、发动机起火、液压系统故障、电气系统故障、无襟翼着陆等等 。

cards.audioText: Have you ever practiced any subject related to the  hydraulic system failure? If yes, how do you handle it in the simulator？
cards.audioTextZh: 你有没有练习过任何与液压系统故障相关的科目？如果有，在模拟机上你是如何处置的？
cards.referenceText:
No. we don't have any training related to hydraulic system failure because there is no hydraulic system in C172
没有。我们没有进行过任何与液压系统故障相关的训练，因为塞斯纳 172（C172）飞机没有液压系统 。

Yes, we have special training sessions related to hydraulic system failure in simulator training. When handling hydraulic system failure in the simulator, I first remain calm and quickly confirm the degree and location of the failure through the instrument display and system prompts.
