Then, I strictly follow the emergency procedures in the Quick Reference Handbook (QRH), immediately reduce the aircraft's speed to the appropriate range to reduce the load on the hydraulic system, and at the same time notify the instructor or other crew members of the failure situation. Next, I use the remaining hydraulic system or backup system (if any) to maintain the aircraft's control, adjust the aircraft's attitude and altitude, and choose a suitable alternate airport for diversion. During the whole process, I keep communicating with the instructor, report the aircraft's status and my handling measures in a timely manner, and make corresponding adjustments according to the instructor's guidance to ensure the safe landing of the aircraft.
是的，我们在模拟机训练中有专门关于液压系统失效的练习项目。在模拟机中处理液压系统失效时，我首先保持冷静，通过仪表显示和系统提示快速确认失效的程度和部位。然后严格按照快速检查单QRH中的应急程序，立即将飞机速度降低到合适范围，以减轻液压系统的负荷，同时将失效情况告知教员或其他机组人员。接下来，利用剩余的液压系统或备用系统如有维持飞机的操纵，调整飞机的姿态和高度，并选择合适的备降机场进行改航。整个过程中，我与教员保持沟通，及时报告飞机状态和自己的处置措施，并根据教员的指导做出相应调整，确保飞机安全降落。

cards.audioText: Do you like simulator training?
cards.audioTextZh: 你喜欢模拟机训练吗？
cards.referenceText:
Yes, I like simulator training because simulator training can improve our flight skills.
喜欢，我喜欢模拟机训练，因为它能提升我们的飞行技能 。

cards.audioText:
What are the unforgettable things
during your initial training?
cards.audioTextZh: 在初始训练期间,有哪些难忘的时刻?
cards.referenceText:
The most unforgettable moment during my initial training was my first solo flight. Before the flight, I was very nervous, but under the patient guidance and encouragement of the instructor, I gradually calmed down. During the solo flight, I strictly followed the training requirements and successfully completed the takeoff, cruise, landing and other operations. When the plane landed smoothly on the runway, I felt a strong sense of accomplishment and excitement. This experience not only made me more confident in my flying skills, but also made me deeply realize the importance of careful preparation and calm response in flight.
初始训练期间最难忘的时刻是我的第一次单飞。飞行前，我内心十分紧张，但在教员的耐心指导和鼓励下，我逐渐平静下来。单飞过程中，我严格按照训练要求，成功完成了起飞、巡航、降落等一系列操作。当飞机平稳降落在跑道上时，我心中充满了强烈的成就感和激动之情。这次经历不仅让我对自己的飞行技能更有信心，也让我深刻体会到飞行中细心准备和沉着应对的重要性。

cards.taskTitle: 运行-机场安检与航空安保-1
cards.audioText: What are the purposes of airport security check?
cards.audioTextZh: 机场安检的目的是什么？
cards.referenceText:
Airport security check is used to prevent the dangerous goods and dangerous people entering the airport and the aircraft and ensure the safety of the airport and the aircraft.
机场安检用于防止危险物品和危险人员进入机场及航空器，保障机场和航空器的安全 。

The main purpose of airport security checks is to detect and prevent dangerous goods, weapons, explosives, or other hazardous items from being brought on board. It ensures no threats to flight safety, reduces the cabin crew’s workload, and protects the safety of passengers, crew, and the aircraft.
机场安检的主要目的是排查并阻止危险品、武器、爆炸物等危险物品被带上飞机，确保无威胁飞行安全的因素存在，减轻乘务员工作负荷，保障乘客、机组及航空器的安全。

cards.taskTitle: 运行-机场安检与航空安保-2
cards.audioText: Do you think if necessary to strengthen /improve airport security check?
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为有必要加强 / 改进机场安检吗？
cards.referenceText:
Yes. I think it necessary to strengthen airport security check because airport security check can prevent the dangerous goods and dangerous people entering the airport and the aircraft and ensure the safety of the airport and the aircraft.
有必要。我认为有必要加强机场安检，因为机场安检能够阻止危险物品和危险人员进入机场及航空器，保障机场和航空器的安全。

cards.taskTitle: 运行-机场安检与航空安保-3
cards.audioText: Do you think security check on the catering staff is necessary
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为对航空配餐人员进行安检有必要吗？
cards.referenceText: 恩，我认为对配餐人员安检有必要，因为这可以防止危险品和危险人物进入机场和飞机，从而确保飞行安全。

cards.taskTitle: 运行-机场安检与航空安保-4
cards.audioText: What can airports and airlines do to improve/strengthen the air security?
cards.audioTextZh: 机场和航空公司可以采取哪些措施来改善 / 加强航空安全？
cards.referenceText:
The airport can use/introduce more advanced systems and equipment to improve the airport security check. Besides, the airport management department can offer more training to the staff and improve their knowledge and skills. Airlines can offer more training to the pilots and flight attendants to improve their knowledge and skills of dangerous goods and terrorist attack.
机场可以采用 / 引入更先进的系统和设备，以改进机场安检工作。此外，机场管理部门可以为员工提供更多培训，提升他们的知识与技能。航空公司可以为飞行员和空乘人员开展更多培训，增强他们在危险物品识别及应对恐怖袭击方面的知识与技能 。

Airports and airlines can adopt advanced security equipment, enhance ground staff training, strengthen cooperation with police and fire departments, improve management systems, and raise security awareness among passengers and staff. Strictly implement security protocols for all personnel and cargo boarding the aircraft.
机场和航空公司可配备先进安检设备、加强地勤人员培训、深化与公安消防部门的合作、完善管理制度、提升乘客和员工的安全意识；对所有登机人员及货物严格执行安检流程。

cards.taskTitle: 运行-机场安检与航空安保-5
cards.audioText: Do you think airport security has been improved in the past decade?
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为过去十年机场安检有所改进吗？
cards.referenceText:
I think the airport security check has been improved in the last decade. First, the passengers and their baggage have to be scanned/checked again and again before boarding the aircraft. Second, more advanced systems and equipment have been used/introduced to improve the airport security check. Third, more rules and regulations have been made to improve the airport security check. For example, the extra lithium battery is not allowed to bring onboard.
我认为过去十年机场安检有所改进。首先，乘客及其行李在登机前需反复接受扫描 / 检查。其次，更先进的系统和设备已被用于 / 引入以改进机场安检。第三，已制定更多规章制度来完善机场安检。例如，禁止随身携带额外的锂电池 。

cards.taskTitle: 运行-机场安检与航空安保-6
cards.audioText: With the development of civil aviation, do you have any suggestions for airport management?
cards.audioTextZh: 随着民用航空的发展，你对机场管理有什么建议吗？
cards.referenceText:
Yes, I have some suggestions for airport management. The airport management department can use/introduce more advanced systems and equipment to improve the airport security check. Besides, the airport management can offer more training to staff and improve their knowledge and skills.
有，我对机场管理有一些建议。机场管理部门可以采用 / 引入更先进的系统和设备，来改进机场安检工作。此外，机场管理方可以为员工提供更多培训，提升他们的知识与技能 。

cards.taskTitle: 运行-机场安检与航空安保-7
cards.audioText: What are your suggestions for improving the AirPort management?
cards.audioTextZh: 你对改进机场管理有哪些建议？
cards.referenceText:
I have some suggestions for airport management.
first, The airport  can use/introduce more advanced systems and equipment to improve the airport security check.
second, the airport can offer/provide more training to the staff and improve their knowledge and skills.
我对机场管理有一些建议。首先，机场可以采用 / 引入更先进的系统和设备，来改进机场安检工作。其次，机场可以为员工提供更多培训，提升他们的知识与技能 。

cards.taskTitle: 运行-机场安检与航空安保-8
cards.audioText: what measures can be taken to prevent terrorist attack from happening?
cards.audioTextZh: 可以采取哪些措施防止恐怖袭击的发生？
cards.referenceText:
There are many things we can do to prevent terrorist activity(attack) from happening.
First, we can improve airport security check to prevent terrorists and dangerous goods from entering the airport and aircraft.
Second, both pilots and cabin crew can improve their skills to fight against/with the terrorists or hijackers.
可以做很多事情防止恐怖活动发生。第一，我们可以提高机场安保防止恐怖分子和危险品进入机场和飞机；第二，飞行员和客舱人员可以提高反恐或反劫机技能。

cards.taskTitle: 运行-机场安检与航空安保-9
cards.audioText: What can the airport security do to prevent terrorist activities on the aircraft? How to improve airport security check?
cards.audioTextZh: 机场安检可采取哪些措施防范飞机上的恐怖活动？如何改进机场安检流程？
cards.referenceText:
They should use more advanced equipment to detect dangerous goods, illegal weapons, and drugs to prevent terrorist activities. Security check staff should receive more training and strictly follow SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures) when conducting security checks.
他们应使用更先进的设备检测危险物品、非法武器和毒品，以此防范恐怖活动。安检人员应接受更多培训，并严格遵循标准操作程序（SOPs）开展安检工作 。

cards.taskTitle: 运行-机场安检与航空安保-10
cards.audioText: Do you think the good security has been improved in the last decade? Why?
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为过去十年机场安检是否有所改进？为什么？
cards.referenceText:
Yes, I think so. Security check staff have taken more training, and they use advanced equipment to detect dangerous goods, illegal weapons, and drugs. Terrorist activities have become increasingly rare.
是的，我认为有改进。安检人员接受了更多培训，而且他们使用先进设备检测危险物品、非法武器和毒品。恐怖活动也变得越来越少了 。

cards.audioText: During night flying, What kind of runway equipment Could help you land safely?
cards.audioTextZh: 夜间飞行时，哪些跑道设备能帮助你安全着陆？
cards.referenceText:
There are runway centerline lighting, runway edge lighting, PAPI (Precision Approach Path Indicator) lights, approach lights, and so on. They could help us land safely.
有跑道中心线灯、跑道边灯、精密进近航道指示器（PAPI）灯、进近灯等等。它们能帮助我们安全着陆。

cards.audioText: What is the difference between the day flight and Night flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 白天飞行和夜间飞行有什么区别？
cards.referenceText:
1）Actually, the night flight is exactly the same as the day flight, except that we cannot see the outside. During day flight, we can see everything clearly, and we visually check the landmarks, terrain and foreign objects. But during night flight, we cannot see the landmarks clearly, and we are more dependent on the lights and instruments. What's more, it is easy to have illusions during night flight.
实际上，夜间飞行和白天飞行基本一样，只是我们看不见（外界 ）。白天飞行时，我们能清楚看到一切，会目视检查地标、地形和异物。但夜间飞行时，我们无法清晰看到地标，更依赖灯光和仪表。而且，夜间飞行时容易产生错觉。
（2）There are some differences between day flight and night flight. During day flight, we have better visual reference. During night flight, it's difficult to have visual contact with the runway, and we have to use ground equipment to help us land safely.
白天飞行和夜间飞行存在一些差异。白天飞行时，我们有更好的目视参考。夜间飞行时，难以目视看清跑道，得借助地面设备辅助安全着陆

cards.audioText: In night flight, what equipment can help you to land safely on airport?
cards.audioTextZh: 夜间飞行时，哪些设备能帮助你在机场安全着陆？
cards.referenceText:
In night flight, there is some ground equipment we can use to help us land safely at the airport, such as approach lights, ILS (Instrument Landing System), NDB (Non - directional Beacon), and VOR (VHF Omnidirectional Range).
夜间飞行时，有一些地面设备可用于帮助我们在机场安全着陆，比如进近灯、仪表着陆系统（ILS）、无方向信标（NDB）和甚高频全向信标（VOR） 。

cards.audioText: What do you know about runway light system?
cards.audioTextZh: 你知道哪些跑道灯光系统?
cards.referenceText:
Common runway light systems include runway edge lights, centerline lights, threshold lights, touchdown zone lights, PAPI (Precision Approach Path Indicator), and approach lights. These lights enhance visibility at night or in low-visibility conditions to guide takeoff and landing.
常见的跑道灯光系统包括跑道边灯、中心线灯、入口灯、 touchdown区灯、精密进近航道指示器（PAPI）和进近灯光。这些灯光在夜间或低能见度条件下提升可视性，为起降提供引导。

cards.audioText: What are the functions of the runway light system?
cards.audioTextZh: 跑道灯光系统的作用是什么?
cards.referenceText:
Runway light systems improve visibility of runway boundaries, centerline, and approach path, especially at night or in low-visibility weather (e.g., fog, rain). They help pilots judge position, altitude, and glide slope, ensuring accurate alignment and safe takeoff/landing.
跑道灯光系统的作用是提升跑道边界、中心线和进近航道的可视性，尤其在夜间或低能见度天气（如雾、雨）下。帮助飞行员判断飞机位置、高度和下滑道，确保精准对准跑道并安全起降。

cards.audioText: If you abort takeoff due to engine fire, what will you do?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果因发动机起火中断起飞，你会怎么做？
cards.referenceText:
（1）I will perform the abort takeoff procedure: first, shut off the engine power. Second, use the rudder to keep the aircraft straight on the runway. Third, apply the brakes to stop the aircraft on the runway. We may need to conduct an evacuation on the runway if necessary.
我会执行中断起飞程序，首先关闭动力。其次，用方向舵保持飞机在跑道上直线滑行。第三，使用刹车让飞机在跑道上停下。我们可能需要在跑道上进行撤离。
（2）First, we should cooperate to complete the abort takeoff checklist. Second, inform ATC of the situation and request emergency services. Third, cabin crew should follow the captain’s instructions, comfort passengers, and prepare them for evacuation. Finally, the captain should make a PA to tell passengers to calm down and follow cabin crew instructions for evacuation.
首先，我们应协同配合完成检查单。其次，应将情况告知空中交通管制（ATC）并请求应急服务。第三，客舱机组人员应听从机长指令，安抚乘客并让乘客做好撤离准备。最后，机长应进行广播，告知乘客冷静并听从客舱机组人员的撤离指令。

cards.audioText: If bird ingestion happens to you during initial climb, how will you deal with the situation?
cards.audioTextZh: 在初始爬升阶段遭遇发动机吸入鸟（鸟击发动机 ），你会如何处置这种情况？
cards.referenceText:
If I encounter a bird strike during initial climb, first, I will stay calm and do my best to control the aircraft, trying to maintain airspeed, attitude, and altitude. Secondly, I will follow the SOP (Standard Operating Procedure) and execute the relevant checklist for bird strike. At last, I will advise ATC of our situation and request to come back to land or land at the nearest suitable airport.
如果在初始爬升阶段遭遇鸟击发动机，首先，我会保持冷静，尽力控制飞机，尝试维持空速、姿态和高度。其次，我会遵循标准操作程序（SOP）并执行检查单。最后，我会将情况告知空中交通管制（ATC），申请返航着陆或在最近的合适机场降落。

cards.audioText: What may cause a pilot to reject takeoff.
cards.audioTextZh: 哪些情况可能导致飞行员中断起飞？
cards.referenceText:
There are several reasons that may cause a pilot to reject takeoff. For example, another aircraft crossing the runway, landing gear problems, tire burst, bird strike, and so on.
有一些导致中断起飞的原因。例如，有飞机穿越跑道、起落架故障、轮胎爆破、鸟击等等。

Abort takeoff before V1 if encountering master warning activation, system failure (engine, hydraulic, electrical), abnormal noise/vibration, tire issues, slow acceleration, takeoff configuration error, fire warning, wind shear alert, or any condition threatening flight safety.
在V1速度前，若出现主警告激活、系统故障（发动机、液压、电气）、异常噪音/振动、轮胎问题、加速缓慢、起飞构型错误、火警警告、风切变警报或任何威胁飞行安全的情况，应中断起飞。

cards.audioText: Please tell me the procedure for rejected takeoff.
cards.audioTextZh: 请告诉我中断起飞的程序。
cards.referenceText:
I fly the DA - 40 aircraft. Our rejected takeoff procedure is to first shut off the power. Secondly, use the rudder to maintain the aircraft straight on the runway. Thirdly, use the brakes to stop the aircraft on the runway.
我驾驶 DA - 40 飞机，我们的中断起飞程序是首先关闭动力。其次，用方向舵保持飞机在跑道上直线滑行。第三，使用刹车让飞机在跑道上停下。

For light aircraft (for example DA-40), reduce throttle to idle, apply brakes firmly to stop. For large aircraft, the captain calls "stop", reduces throttle, applies maximum brakes, deploys speed brakes and thrust reverse, maintains runway centerline. After stopping, report to ATC and inform passengers/crew.
轻型飞机（如DA-40）：将油门收至慢车，用力刹车停稳；大型飞机：机长喊“停止”，收油门，施加最大刹车，放出减速板和反推，保持跑道中心线；停稳后向空管报告并通知乘客/机组。

cards.audioText: What are the possible consequences of rejecting takeoff after V1?
cards.audioTextZh: 在速度达到 V1 后中断起飞，可能会产生哪些后果？
cards.referenceText:
If we reject takeoff after V1, we may run out of the runway, even cause structural damage or passenger injury. It is very dangerous.
如果在速度达到 V1 后中断起飞，我们可能会冲出跑道，甚至造成飞机结构损坏或乘客受伤。这非常危险。

Aborting takeoff after V1 is extremely dangerous. The aircraft may not have enough runway to stop, leading to runway overrun, structural damage (landing gear, fuselage), tire burst, or even fire/explosion. Crew and passengers face high risk of injuries or fatalities.
超过V1后中断起飞极具危险性。飞机可能没有足够跑道停稳，导致跑道冲出、结构损伤（起落架、机身）、轮胎爆裂，甚至起火/爆炸，机组和乘客面临高伤亡风险。

cards.audioText: If the aircraft ingests some foreign objects during takeoff rolling, what would you do?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果飞机在起飞滑跑阶段吸入异物，你会怎么做？
cards.referenceText:
If we encounter this situation during takeoff rolling, we will abort takeoff immediately if the aircraft speed before V1. We will shut off the power first and use the rudder to maintain the aircraft straight on the runway. At last, use the maximum brakes to stop the aircraft on the runway. If the aircraft speed passes V1, we must go on takeoff. Then advise ATC of our situation and request land as soon as possible to check the damage.
如果在起飞滑跑阶段遇到这种情况，若飞机速度在 V1（决策速度 ）之前，我们会立即中断起飞。首先关闭动力，并用方向舵保持飞机在跑道上直线滑行。最后，使用最大刹车让飞机在跑道上停下。若飞机速度超过 V1，我们必须继续起飞。之后，将情况告知空中交通管制（ATC），并申请尽快着陆以检查损坏情况。

cards.audioText: what will you do when the warning alerts are triggered during takeoff?
cards.audioTextZh: 起飞阶段触发警告警报时，你会怎么做？
cards.referenceText:
If we encounter this situation during takeoff rolling, we will abort takeoff immediately if the aircraft speed before V1. We will shut off the power first and use the rudder to maintain the aircraft straight on the runway. At last, use the maximum brakes to stop the aircraft on the runway.If the aircraft speed passes V1, we must go on takeoff. Then advise ATC of our situation and request land as soon as possible to check the damage.
如果在起飞滑跑阶段遇到这种情况，若飞机速度在 V1（决策速度 ）之前，我们会立即中断起飞。首先关闭动力，并用方向舵保持飞机在跑道上直线滑行。最后，使用最大刹车让飞机在跑道上停下。若飞机速度超过 V1，我们必须继续起飞。之后，将情况告知空中交通管制（ATC），并申请尽快着陆以检查损坏情况。

cards.audioText: What is the reason for executing an aborted takeoff? Under what circumstances should you reject takeoff?
cards.audioTextZh: 执行中断起飞的原因是什么？在哪些情况下你应该中断起飞？
cards.referenceText:
There are some possible reasons for rejecting takeoff. First, if we encounter engine problems (such as engine failure or engine fire) during takeoff, we will reject takeoff. Second, if we have landing gear problems (such as a burst tire/tire blown out) during takeoff, we will reject takeoff. Third, if there is a runway incursion (such as a vehicle crossing the runway) during takeoff, we will reject takeoff.
中断起飞有一些可能的原因。首先，如果遇到发动机问题，比如发动机失效或发动机起火，我们会中断起飞。其次，如果起落架出现问题，比如轮胎爆破 / 爆胎，我们会中断起飞。第三，如果发生跑道入侵情况，比如有车辆穿越跑道，我们会中断起飞。

cards.audioText: What are the procedures of rejecting takeoff? How to make a successful rejected takeoff? What should you do if the speed is after V1 and you have to abort takeoff?
cards.audioTextZh: 中断起飞的程序有哪些？如何成功执行中断起飞？若速度超过  V1，后必须中断起飞，你该怎么做？
cards.referenceText:
In case of a rejected takeoff, I will take immediate actions to stop the aircraft on the runway. First, I will retard the thrust lever/reduce power to idle and use maximum brakes. Second, I will raise/extend the speedbrakes and ground spoilers; third, I will use maximum reverse thrust. Meanwhile, I will use the rudder pedals to maintain directional control of the aircraft.
若需中断起飞，我会立即采取行动让飞机在跑道上停下。首先，我会将推力杆拉回慢车（把动力减小到慢车状态 ）并使用最大刹车。其次，我会升起 / 放出减速板和地面扰流板；第三，我会使用最大反推。同时，我们会用方向舵踏板保持对飞机的方向控制。

cards.audioText: What may cause pilot go around?
cards.audioTextZh: 哪些情况可能导致飞行员复飞？
cards.referenceText:
There are some reasons for going around. For example, runway not in sight, no contact at minimum, windshear, localizer fluctuation and so on.
复飞有一些原因。例如，看不到跑道、在最低标准时未建立有效联系、遭遇风切变、航向台信号波动等等。

cards.audioText: What are you procedures for going around?
cards.audioTextZh: 你的复飞程序是什么
cards.referenceText:
Push throttle to TOGA (takeoff/go-around) thrust, retract landing gear, adjust flaps to go-around configuration, pitch up to climb attitude, follow runway heading, climb to designated altitude per missed approach procedure, and report to ATC.
将油门推至复飞（TOGA）推力，收起起落架，调整襟翼至复飞构型，抬头至爬升姿态，沿跑道航向飞行，按复飞程序爬升至指定高度，并向空管报告。

cards.audioText: When pilots hear "go around, windshear ahead" during approach, how do they perform the wind shear recovery maneuvers?
cards.audioTextZh: 进近阶段飞行员听到 “复飞，前方有风切变” 时，如何执行风切变改出机动？
cards.referenceText:
We will go around immediately. Press TOGA, use full power, pitch up 15 degrees, maintain configuration till recovered from windshear and pay close attention to speed, altitude and vertical speed.
我们会立即复飞。按压起飞 / 复飞（TOGA）电门，使用全推力，机头向上仰 15 度，保持当前形态直至脱离风切变影响，同时密切关注速度、高度和垂直速度。

cards.audioText: In what situation would you decide to go around?
cards.audioTextZh: 在什么情况下会复飞?
cards.referenceText:
Go around is required if crosswind/tailwind exceeds limits, unstable approach, high-speed approach, runway incursion, landing gear malfunction, system failure, poor visibility, or ATC instruction.
当侧风/顺风超过限制、不稳定进近、高速进近、跑道入侵、起落架故障、系统失效、能见度差或收到空管指令时，需执行复飞。

cards.audioText: If the aircraft is above the glide slope one dot blow one thousand feet, does the pilot need to go around?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果你的飞机在1000英尺以下时,高于下滑道1点,你觉得飞行员需要复飞吗?
cards.referenceText:
Not necessarily. The pilot can attempt to correct gently if the deviation is controllable, speed is normal, and runway is visible. If correction fails or other unsafe conditions exist (for example low visibility), go around immediately.
不一定。如果偏差可控、速度正常且能看到跑道，飞行员可尝试温和修正；若修正无效或存在其他不安全因素（如低能见度），需立即复飞。

cards.audioText: Have you ever experienced long delays before? If yes, would you tell me what had happened?
cards.audioTextZh: 你之前经历过长时间延误吗？如果有，能讲讲发生了什么事吗？
cards.referenceText:
(1) Yes. I have encountered a long delay as a passenger. Last time I took a flight from Yichang to Haikou, the flight was delayed for 2 hours due to flow control.
有过。我作为乘客时遭遇过长时间延误。上次我乘坐从宜昌到海口的航班，因流量控制，航班延误了 2 小时。
(2) Yes, I have experienced long delays during a flight. Once, I flew from…to…, there was a thunderstorm at the destination airport…, and we were delayed for about half an hour.
有，我在飞行中经历过长时间延误。有一次，我执行从…… 到…… 的飞行任务，目的地机场出现雷暴……，我们延误了约半小时 。

cards.audioText: What are the possible causes of delays?
cards.referenceText:
（1）There are some reasons for delays, for example, adverse weather, air traffic congestion, military activities, flow control, and so on.
航班延误有一些原因，比如恶劣天气、空中交通拥堵、军事活动、流量管制等等 。
（2）There are many possible reasons for delays. First, bad weather may cause delays. For example, if there is a thunderstorm near the airport, we have to delay our departure or approach. Second, if there is a mechanical problem, we will be delayed. Third, if there is flow control or a VIP flight, we will be delayed. Fourth, if there is an emergency aircraft ahead of us, we have to give way/priority to it and will be delayed.
航班延误有诸多可能原因。首先，恶劣天气可能导致延误，比如机场附近有雷暴时，我们就得推迟起飞或进近。其次，若飞机存在机械故障，会造成延误。第三，出现流量管制或要客航班时，会产生延误。第四，若前方有紧急航班，我们需为其让行 / 优先保障，进而导致延误 。
（3）Main causes include adverse weather, air traffic flow control, military activities, ground services (de-icing/refueling/cargo loading), aircraft malfunctions, pilot's inadequate preparation, and passenger-related issues (slow boarding/security checks).
主要原因包括恶劣天气、空中交通流量控制、军事活动、地面服务（除冰、加油、货物装载）、飞机故障、飞行员准备不足以及乘客相关问题（登机/安检缓慢）。

cards.audioText: Do long delays occur more frequently at big airport? Why?
cards.audioTextZh: 大型机场的长时间延误发生得更频繁吗？为什么？
cards.referenceText:
Yes, long delays often occur at big airports. Because there are more aircraft, more passengers, and more procedures at big airports.
是的，大型机场常出现长时间延误。因为大型机场的飞机更多、乘客更多，且运行流程更繁杂 。

cards.audioText: What are your suggestions for reducing delays?
cards.audioTextZh: 对于减少航班延误，你有哪些建议？
cards.referenceText:
In my opinion, as pilots, we should make thorough preflight preparations to familiarize ourselves with the airport and procedures. For air traffic controllers, they should communicate timely with pilots. For airlines, they should optimize flight scheduling to reduce delays. For airport staff, they should cooperate well with pilots. For the government, it should build more airports and make full use of airspace to reduce delays.
在我看来，作为飞行员，我们应做好充分的飞行前准备，熟悉机场和操作流程。对于空中交通管制员，他们应及时与飞行员沟通。对于航空公司，应优化航班调度以减少延误。对于机场工作人员，要与飞行员做好协作。对于政府部门，应修建更多机场并充分利用空域来减少延误 。

cards.audioText: What do you think about airlines compensating passengers after long delays?
cards.audioTextZh: 你如何看待航空公司在长时间延误后对乘客进行补偿这件事？
cards.referenceText:
I think it depends on different situations. There are many reasons for delays, for example, adverse weather, air traffic congestion, military activities, flow control, and so on. If the delay is really caused by the airline’s fault, they should compensate passengers. If the delay is caused by natural reasons such as adverse weather, it is not necessary to compensate passengers.
我认为这要视不同情况而定。航班延误有诸多原因，比如恶劣天气、空中交通拥堵、军事活动、流量管制等等。若延误确实是航空公司过错导致的，就应补偿乘客。要是延误由恶劣天气等自然原因造成，就没必要补偿乘客 。

cards.audioText:
In your opinion, what could the airlines' or the airport personnel do to reduce the chances of flight delays?
In your opinion, what could the airline and the airport personnel do to reduce delay?
cards.audioTextZh:
在你看来，航空公司或机场工作人员可以采取哪些措施来降低航班延误的概率？
在你看来，航空公司和机场工作人员能做些什么来减少延误？
cards.referenceText:
For the airline, it should optimize flight scheduling to reduce delays. For the airport staff, they should cooperate well with pilots.
对于航空公司而言，应优化航班调度以减少延误。对于机场工作人员，要与飞行员做好协作 。

Measures include improving ATC/ground staff efficiency, optimizing flight routes (e.g., RNAV/CDFA), enhancing airport facilities, pilot's better preflight preparation and skill training, strengthening communication between ATC and pilots, and timely weather updates.
措施包括提高空管/地面人员工作效率、优化飞行航线（如区域导航/连续下降最后进近）、完善机场设施、飞行员做好飞行前准备并提升技能、加强空管与飞行员的沟通，以及及时更新天气信息。

There are many measures that can be taken to reduce delays. First, airlines can make thorough preflight preparations to reduce delays caused by mechanical problems or adverse weather. Second, the government can open more airspace to civil aircraft. Third, RVSM (Reduced Vertical Separation Minimum) can be implemented to increase airspace capacity.
有很多措施可用于减少延误。首先，航空公司可做好充分的飞行前准备，降低因机械故障或恶劣天气导致的延误。其次，政府可开放更多空域给民用航空。第三，可实施最小垂直间隔（RVSM）程序来提升空域容量 。

cards.audioText: What may cause flow control?
cards.audioTextZh: 哪些情况可能导致流量管制？
cards.referenceText:
There are many reasons for flow control. First, bad weather such as thunderstorms may cause flow control. Second, military activities may cause flow control. Third, VIP flights or emergencies may cause flow control.
流量管制的成因有很多。首先，雷暴等恶劣天气可能引发流量管制。其次，军事活动可能导致流量管制。第三，要客航班或紧急情况可能造成流量管制 。

cards.audioText: In what airports are you most likely to encounter flow control?
cards.audioTextZh: 在哪些机场你最可能遇到流量管制？
cards.referenceText:
We are most likely to encounter flow control at major international airports such as Beijing Capital International Airport and Shanghai Hongqiao International Airport, because a large number of aircraft take off and land there every day.
我们最可能在大型国际机场遇到流量管制，比如北京首都国际机场、上海虹桥国际机场，因为这些机场每天有大量飞机起降 。

 Large international airports, airports with complex weather or frequent military activities, busy hub airports with heavy traffic, and airports facing unexpected disruptions (e.g., delays, runway issues) are most prone to flow control.
大型国际机场、天气复杂或军事活动频繁的机场、交通繁忙的枢纽机场以及遭遇突发干扰如延误、跑道问题的机场最容易遭遇流控。

cards.audioText: What can be done to reduce flow control?
cards.audioTextZh: 可以采取哪些措施来减少流量管制？
cards.referenceText:
There are many measures we can take to reduce flow control. First, we can maintain good communication and cooperation to mitigate flow control. Second, we can implement RVSM (Reduced Vertical Separation Minimum) to increase airspace capacity and reduce flow control. Third, we can adopt more advanced ATC (Air Traffic Control) systems, equipment, or procedures to cut down on flow control.
我们可以采取诸多措施来减少流量管制。首先，保持良好的沟通与协作，以缓解流量管制。其次，实施最小垂直间隔（RVSM）程序，提升空域容量，减少流量管制。第三，采用更先进的空中交通管制（ATC）系统、设备或程序，降低流量管制发生概率 。

Optimize flight routes and navigation methods (e.g., RNAV), improve ATC work efficiency, enhance cooperation between airlines and ATC, update airport facilities, apply advanced approach procedures, and strengthen weather forecasting and traffic management.
优化飞行航线和导航方式如区域导航RNAV、提高空管工作效率、加强航空公司与空管的协作、更新机场设施、采用先进进近程序、强化天气预报和交通管控。

cards.audioText: If your passengers have boarded, yet your aircraft has been delayed for more than one hour, what are you going to do?
cards.audioTextZh: 若乘客已登机，但飞机延误超一小时，你会怎么做？
cards.referenceText:
As a captain, I will make a PA announcement to calm the passengers and inform them of the reason for the delay. Additionally, I will instruct the cabin crew to provide more meals and drinks to the passengers and assist in keeping them calm.
作为机长，我会进行广播安抚乘客，并告知他们延误原因。此外，我会指示客舱乘务组为乘客提供更多餐食和饮品，协助安抚乘客情绪 。

I will coordinate with cabin crew to keep passengers informed of the delay reason and latest updates, offer food/drinks, maintain cabin order, and communicate with ATC/dispatcher to accelerate the departure. Ensure passengers' basic needs are met to ease dissatisfaction.
我会协调客舱乘务员向乘客告知延误原因及最新动态，提供餐饮服务，维持客舱秩序，并与空管/签派员沟通加快起飞进度，确保乘客基本需求得到满足，缓解不满情绪。

cards.audioText: What do you think of the policy that airlines compensate passengers after long delays?
cards.audioTextZh: 你如何看待航空公司在长时间延误后对乘客进行补偿的政策？
cards.referenceText:
Compensation is reasonable if the delay is due to airline factors (mechanical issues, poor management). But it’s unnecessary for force majeure (bad weather, military activities). Airlines can offer cash, accommodation, or alternative flights to minimize passenger losses.
如果延误是由航空公司因素导致（机械故障、管理不善），补偿是合理的；但对于不可抗力因素（恶劣天气、军事活动），则无需补偿。航空公司可提供现金、住宿或改签服务，以减少乘客损失。

cards.audioText: Have you ever encountered delays more than one hour?
cards.audioTextZh: 你经历过延误超过一小时吗?
cards.referenceText:
Yes. Last year, when flying to Singapore Changi Airport, we held en-route due to bad weather, resulting in a one-hour delay. Also, during training at Yichang Airport, ground congestion caused a two-hour delay for our training flight.
经历过。去年飞往新加坡樟宜机场时，因天气原因我们在空中等待，导致延误一小时；此外，在宜昌机场训练时，地面交通拥堵导致我们的训练航班延误两小时。

cards.audioText: Do you think more delays happened in large airport or small airport and why?
cards.audioTextZh: 你觉得大机场延误的多还是小机场延误的多?为什么?
cards.referenceText:
More delays occur in large airports. They have more aircraft, congested airspace, longer taxiways, heavy ATC workload, massive passenger/baggage handling, and more VIP flights, leading to frequent flow control.
大机场的延误更多。大机场飞机数量多、空域拥挤、滑行道长、空管工作负荷大、旅客与行李处理量庞大，且VIP航班较多，因此流量控制更为频繁。

cards.audioText: What may happen if pilot failed to assess the landing performance?
cards.audioTextZh: 若飞行员未能评估着陆性能，可能会发生什么情况？
cards.referenceText:
If a pilot fails to assess the landing performance, they may not know the runway conditions and runway length. This is very dangerous.
如果飞行员未能评估着陆性能，他们可能不了解跑道状况和跑道长度，这十分危险 。

cards.audioText: Do you make takeoff/landing assessment for each flight? What factors will you consider when making the performance assessment?
cards.audioTextZh: 你们会为每个航班做起飞 / 着陆评估吗？进行性能评估时会考虑哪些因素？
cards.referenceText:
Yes, we have to make takeoff and landing assessments for each flight. We have to consider many factors, such as runway conditions, runway length, braking action, flap position, wind, temperature, and so on.
会的，我们必须为每个航班做起飞和着陆评估。要考虑诸多因素，比如跑道状况、跑道长度、刹车效能、襟翼位置、风向风力、温度等等 。

cards.audioText: What kind of failure will influence the landing performance?
cards.audioTextZh: 哪些故障会影响着陆性能？
cards.referenceText:
There are many failures that may influence the landing performance. For example, engine failure, hydraulic system failure, jammed flaps, brake malfunction, and so on.
有很多故障可能会影响着陆性能，比如发动机故障、液压系统故障、襟翼卡阻、刹车故障等等 。

cards.audioText: What are the consequences of overweight landing?
cards.audioTextZh: 超重着陆会产生哪些后果？
cards.referenceText:
If we make an overweight landing, we may run off the runway. This is very dangerous and could even cause structural damage or passenger injuries.
如果进行超重着陆，飞机可能会冲出跑道。这十分危险，甚至可能造成飞机结构损坏或乘客受伤 。

cards.audioText: If you made hard landing how would you explain this to your boss?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果发生重着陆，你会如何向你的上司解释？
cards.referenceText:
I would explain the reasons for the hard landing in detail, including factors like adverse weather conditions, unexpected runway changes, or aircraft system responses. I’d also sincerely apologize, take responsibility, and outline specific improvement measures—such as additional training on landing techniques or preflight risk assessments—to ensure it doesn’t happen again.
我会详细说明重着陆的原因，包括恶劣天气状况、突发的跑道变化或飞机系统反应等因素。我还会诚恳道歉、承担责任，并列出具体的改进措施 —— 比如接受额外的着陆技术培训或加强飞行前风险评估 —— 以确保此类情况不再发生。

cards.audioText: Under what circumstances will pilot make overweight landing?
cards.audioTextZh: 在什么情况下飞行员会进行超重着陆
cards.referenceText:
For example, if we encounter engine fire after takeoff, we must land as soon as possible. But we cannot dump fuel and we don't have time to burn fuel, we have to make overweight landing.
例如，若起飞后遭遇发动机起火，我们必须尽快着陆。要是既无法放油，又没时间消耗燃油，就只能进行超重着陆 。

cards.audioText:
Do you know the maximum landing weight of the
aircraft you are flying?
cards.audioTextZh: 你知道所驾驶飞机的最大着陆重量吗？
cards.referenceText:
Yes, I fly a 320, the maximum landing weight is 64500kg kilogram.
知道。我驾驶 A320，其最大着陆重量为 64500 千克。

cards.audioText:
What are the ways for pilots to reduce landing weight
in flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行中，飞行员可通过哪些方式降低着陆重量？
cards.referenceText:
First, we can enter a holding pattern to burn fuel to reduce the weight. Second, we can dump some fuel to reduce the weight.
一是进入等待程序消耗燃油以减重；二是进行空中放油减重。

cards.audioText:
After you make an overweight landing,
will you submit report to your company?
And what would you report?
cards.audioTextZh: 执行超重着陆后，是否会向公司提交报告？需报告哪些内容？
cards.referenceText:
Yes, I will hand in a written report to our company. I will explain the reason for overweight landing and what we have done to ensure flight safety.
会提交书面报告。报告中需说明超重着陆的原因及为保障飞行安全所采取的措施。

cards.audioText: What are the factors of overweight or heavy landing?
cards.audioTextZh: 什么因素会导致重着陆?
cards.referenceText:
Factors include unstable approach, excessive landing speed, improper flare technique, tailwind, poor runway braking action, overweight aircraft, and mishandling of crosswinds.
因素包括不稳定进近、着陆速度过大、拉平技巧不当、顺风、跑道刹车性能差、飞机超重以及侧风处置不当。

cards.audioText: Which phases of flight does a tail strike often happen? why?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞机尾部擦地（擦尾）通常发生在飞行的哪些阶段？为什么？
cards.referenceText:
Tail strikes often happen during takeoff and landing. Because during these phases, the aircraft is either about to lift off or touch down. If we don’t have good control of the aircraft, the tail may strike the ground.
擦尾情况常发生在起飞和着陆阶段。因为在这两个阶段，飞机要么即将离地升空，要么即将接地降落，要是对飞机控制不当，尾部就可能擦碰到地面 。

cards.audioText: According to your understanding, what are the possible reasons to cause a tail strike?
cards.audioTextZh: 根据你的理解，可能导致尾部擦地（擦尾）的原因有哪些？
cards.referenceText:
There are some reasons for a tail strike, for example, strong wind shear, improper flight control, miscalculation of the CG (Center of Gravity) position, and so on.
擦尾的原因有多种，比如强风切变、飞行操纵不当、重心（CG）位置计算错误等等 。

Causes include improper maneuver (excessive rotation rate, early flare), unstable approach, incorrect stabilizer trim, mishandling of crosswinds, over-rotation during go-around, CG miscalculation, and strong wake turbulence.
原因包括操纵不当（抬头率过大、拉平过早）、不稳定进近、安定面配平错误、侧风处置不当、复飞时过度抬头、重心计算失误以及强尾流颠簸。

cards.audioText: Do you think a tail strike will damage the aircraft and injure the passengers?
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为尾部擦地（擦尾）会损坏飞机并使乘客受伤吗？
cards.referenceText:
Yes, I think so. A tail strike can damage the aircraft and injure passengers.
是的，我认为会。擦尾可能会损坏飞机，还可能让乘客受伤 。

cards.audioText: Do you have any effective ways to avoid a tail strike?
cards.audioTextZh: 你有没有避免尾部擦地（擦尾）的有效方法？
cards.referenceText:
First of all, pilots should be cautious about wind shear, as it’s very dangerous. Secondly, maintain smooth and proper attitude control of the aircraft. Thirdly, pilots should accurately calculate the CG (Center of Gravity) position.
首先，飞行员要对风切变保持警惕，因为风切变十分危险。其次，要平稳、恰当控制飞机姿态。第三，飞行员得准确计算重心（CG）位置 。

Pilots should undergo sufficient simulator training, master proper rotation and flare techniques, follow SOP, monitor speed and attitude closely, maintain stable approach, manage CG correctly, and avoid adverse weather like turbulence.
飞行员应接受充分的模拟机训练，掌握正确的抬头和拉平技巧，遵循SOP，密切监控速度和姿态，保持稳定进近，正确管理重心，并避开颠簸等恶劣天气。

cards.audioText: Do you know anything about tail strike? Or have you heard any incident about tail strike?
cards.audioTextZh: 你了解尾部擦地（擦尾）相关情况吗？或者你听说过任何擦尾事件吗？
cards.referenceText:
Yes, I know. I heard of a tail strike incident. It occurred at our flying school. A student pilot had a tail strike during landing due to improper control.
是的，我了解。我听说过一起擦尾事件，发生在我们飞行学校。一名飞行学员因操纵不当，在着陆时发生了擦尾。

cards.audioText: Have you ever encountered tail strike during flight？
cards.audioTextZh: 你在飞行过程中遇到过尾部擦地（擦尾）情况吗？
cards.referenceText:
No, I have never encountered tail strike during flight.
没有，我在飞行中从未遇到过擦尾情况。

cards.audioText: What damages will tail strike bring to an aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh: 尾部擦地（擦尾）会给飞机造成哪些损坏？
cards.referenceText:
A tail strike may cause damage to the aircraft’s fuselage and tail.
擦尾可能会对飞机的机身和尾部造成损坏。

cards.audioText: What should pilots do to avoid tail strike?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员应采取哪些措施避免尾部擦地（擦尾）情况？
cards.referenceText:
We can take several measures to avoid a tail strike. First, we should improve our flight skills. For example, we shouldn’t pull up the aircraft excessively during takeoff or landing. Second, we need to maintain proper weight and balance. Third, during preflight preparations, we should obtain accurate weather information.
我们可以采取多项措施来避免擦尾。首先，要提升飞行技能，比如在起飞或着陆阶段，不能过度拉杆使飞机抬头。其次，需保持飞机合适的重量与平衡。第三，飞行前准备阶段，要获取准确的气象信息 。

Pilots should undergo sufficient simulator training, master proper rotation and flare techniques, follow SOP, monitor speed and attitude closely, maintain stable approach, manage CG correctly, and avoid adverse weather like turbulence.
飞行员应接受充分的模拟机训练，掌握正确的抬头和拉平技巧，遵循SOP，密切监控速度和姿态，保持稳定进近，正确管理重心，并避开颠簸等恶劣天气。

cards.audioText: What are the consequences of tail strike?
cards.audioTextZh: 擦机尾的后果是什么?
cards.referenceText:
Tail strike causes substantial damage to the aft fuselage and pressure bulkhead, leading to costly repairs and schedule disruptions. Improper repairs may result in catastrophic failure later. It can also damage landing gear and threaten flight safety.
擦机尾会对机身后部和压力舱壁造成严重损伤，导致高昂的维修费用和航班延误；维修不当可能引发后续灾难性故障，还可能损坏起落架，威胁飞行安全。

Tail strike causes substantial damage to the aft fuselage and aft pressure bulkhead, which is time-consuming and expensive to repair. It may lead to schedule disruption, structural fatigue, and even catastrophic failure if repaired improperly. In severe cases, it can damage landing gear or engines, endangering flight safety during takeoff/landing.
擦机尾会对机身后部和后压力舱壁造成严重损坏，维修耗时且成本高昂。可能导致航班延误、结构疲劳，若维修不当还可能引发灾难性故障。严重时会损坏起落架或发动机，危及起飞/着陆阶段的飞行安全。

cards.audioText: If you encountered tail strike, what should you do?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果你遇到擦机尾,你会怎么做?
cards.referenceText:
Maintain aircraft control first, assess damage via instruments and visual check. Report to ATC, declare emergency if necessary.After landing, record the incident in the logbook and arrange maintenance inspection.
首先保持飞机控制，通过仪表和目视检查评估损伤；向空管报告，必要时宣布紧急状态；落地后将事件记录在飞行记录本中，并安排维修检查。

cards.audioText: Do you think tail strike only occurs on big aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为只有大飞机才会遭遇擦机尾吗?
cards.referenceText:
No, tail strike is not limited to big aircraft. Small aircraft can also experience it during takeoff, landing, or go-around if pilots make improper maneuvers like excessive rotation, unstable approach, or mishandling crosswind. Factors like incorrect CG calculation or poor simulator training also increase the risk, regardless of aircraft size.
不，擦机尾并非仅限于大飞机。小型飞机若飞行员操作不当，如抬头过度、进近不稳定、侧风处置失误，在起飞、着陆或复飞阶段也可能发生擦机尾。无论飞机大小，重心计算错误或模拟机训练不足等因素也会增加该风险。

cards.audioText: What is the pitch angle beyond which will lead to tail strike on your plane?
cards.audioTextZh: 在你所飞的飞机上,俯仰角度超过多少会导致擦机尾?
cards.referenceText:
I fly DA-40, and its tail strike pitch angle limit is around 12-15 degrees. Exceeding this angle during takeoff rotation or landing flare may cause the tail to hit the ground. Specific limits vary by aircraft type; pilots must adhere to the aircraft flight manual (AFM) and SOP to avoid excessive pitch.
我飞的是DA-40，其擦机尾俯仰角度限制约为12-15度。起飞抬轮或着陆拉平时超过该角度，可能导致机尾触地。具体限制因机型而异，飞行员必须遵守飞机飞行手册（AFM）和标准操作程序（SOP），避免俯仰角度过大。

cards.audioText: Do you think the captain and first officer should eat the same food?
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为机长和副驾驶应该吃一样的食物吗？
cards.referenceText:
No, the captain and first officer should eat different meals at staggered times to avoid foodborne illness.
不，机长和副驾驶应食用不同餐食，且错时进餐，以此避免食物中毒（食源性疾病） 。

No, they can't. To avoid both being incapacitated due to food poisoning, which endangers flight safety, the captain and co-pilot are arranged to have different meals simultaneously. This is a strict regulation to ensure at least one pilot can maintain normal operation.
不会。为避免两人因食物中毒同时失能而危及飞行安全，机长和副驾会被安排同时食用不同餐食。这是保障至少一名飞行员能维持正常操作的严格规定。

cards.audioText: Do you think the security check on the catering staff is necessary?
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为对航食工作人员进行安全检查有必要吗？
cards.referenceText:
Yes, it’s necessary. Because it helps ensure food safety and prevent potential security threats, including terrorist activities.
有必要。因为这有助于保障航食安全，防范包括恐怖活动在内的潜在安全威胁 。

cards.audioText: Do you like in-flight catering?
cards.audioTextZh: 你喜欢机上餐食吗？
cards.referenceText:
No, I don't like it. It's not delicious.
不，我不喜欢。机上餐食不好吃。

cards.audioText: How do you like in-flight catering? What do you think of in-flight catering?
cards.audioTextZh: 你觉得机上餐食怎么样？你对机上餐食有什么看法？
cards.referenceText:
I think in - flight catering is okay. We have several choices. I like in - flight catering.
我觉得机上餐食还不错，有几种选择可选，我喜欢机上餐食。

cards.audioText: Does the captain share the same food with the copilot? Why?
cards.audioTextZh: 机长和副驾驶会吃同样的食物吗？为什么？
cards.referenceText:
No, the captain doesn’t share the same food with the copilot. If they eat the same food, it may cause both pilots to become incapacitated.
不会，机长和副驾驶不会吃同样的食物。如果两人食用相同食物，可能会导致两名飞行员都失能 。

No. To avoid both being incapacitated due to food poisoning, which endangers flight safety, the captain and co-pilot are arranged to have different meals simultaneously. This is a strict regulation to ensure at least one pilot can maintain normal operation.
不会。为避免两人因食物中毒同时失能而危及飞行安全，机长和副驾会被安排同时食用不同餐食。这是保障至少一名飞行员能维持正常操作的严格规定。

cards.audioText: What is wake turbulence? How is the wake turbulence generated?
cards.audioTextZh: 什么是尾流？尾流是如何产生的？
cards.referenceText:
Every airplane generates wake turbulence, which poses a threat to flight safety. Due to the pressure differential across the wing, wake vortices form around the wingtips. The heavier the aircraft, the stronger the wake vortices. Additionally, in good weather conditions, wake turbulence persists longer.
每架飞机都会产生尾流，尾流对飞行安全存在威胁。由于机翼上下存在压力差，会在机翼尖端周围形成尾流涡旋。飞机重量越大，尾流涡旋越强。此外，在天气良好时，尾流持续的时间更长 。

Wake turbulence is turbulent air generated by preceding aircraft, mainly from wingtip vortices. It forms when air flows around the wings during flight, spreading outward, upward and then sinking. Larger aircraft, higher speed and calm wind conditions can cause stronger and longer-lasting wake turbulence.
尾流是前机飞行时产生的紊乱气流，主要由翼尖涡流形成。飞机飞行时，空气绕机翼流动，产生向外、向上扩散后下沉的气流，即尾流。机型越大、飞行速度越快、风速越小时，产生的尾流越强且持续时间越长。

cards.audioText: Is wake turbulence dangerous to the flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 尾流对飞行有危险吗？
cards.referenceText:
I think wake turbulence is dangerous to a flight. If we encounter wake turbulence, there will be a slight roll on one side and a stronger roll on the other side. This makes our aircraft difficult to control and may even cause passenger injuries or loss of aircraft control. We should do our best to avoid wake turbulence.
我认为尾流对飞行有危险。如果遭遇尾流，飞机一侧会有小幅倾斜，另一侧倾斜幅度更大。这会让飞机难以操控，甚至可能导致乘客受伤或飞机失控。我们应尽力避让尾流 。

Wake turbulence endangers flight safety by making the following aircraft hard to control or even lose control. It can cause altitude and heading loss, reduced aircraft performance, structural damage, and injuries to crew and passengers. In severe cases, it may lead to aircraft crash, especially during takeoff, landing or climb phases.
尾流会导致后续飞机难以操控甚至失控，造成高度和航向丢失、飞机性能下降、结构损伤，还可能导致机组和乘客受伤，严重时引发坠机事故，在起飞、着陆或爬升阶段威胁尤为突出。

cards.audioText: When would you expect to encounter wake turbulence? How would you avoid it?
cards.audioTextZh: 你预计会在什么情况下遇到尾流？会如何避让？
cards.referenceText:
1 If we get too close to the preceding aircraft, we may encounter wake turbulence. To avoid it, we must maintain adequate separation from the preceding aircraft. Additionally, we should wait at least 2 minutes after a departing aircraft.
若与前方飞机距离过近，就可能遇到尾流。为避让尾流，必须与前方飞机保持足够间隔。另外，在前机起飞后，应至少等待 2 分钟（再进入相关空域） 。
2 When you takeoff or land behind a medium or large heavy aircraft, you encounter wake turbulence. Pilots should keep safe separation with preceding aircraft. If a heavy aircraft is just taking off or landing ahead, the pilot behind must wait at least 3 minutes. If a medium aircraft is ahead, the pilot behind must wait no less than 2 minutes.
在中大型重型飞机后方起飞或着陆时，可能遭遇尾流 turbulence。飞行员应与前机保持安全间隔：若前机为重型飞机且刚起飞或着陆，后方飞行员需等待至少 3 分钟；若前机为中型飞机，需等待不少于 2 分钟。

cards.audioText: How does wake turbulence threaten flight safety?
cards.audioTextZh: 尾流会如何威胁飞行安全？
cards.referenceText:
If we fly into the wake turbulence generated by a preceding aircraft, it may make the aircraft difficult to control and cause it to lose altitude.
若飞入前方飞机产生的尾流中，可能会使飞机难以操控，还会导致飞机掉高度 。

Wake turbulence endangers flight safety by making the following aircraft hard to control or even lose control. It can cause altitude and heading loss, reduced aircraft performance, structural damage, and injuries to crew and passengers. In severe cases, it may lead to aircraft crash, especially during takeoff, landing or climb phases.
尾流会导致后续飞机难以操控甚至失控，造成高度和航向丢失、飞机性能下降、结构损伤，还可能导致机组和乘客受伤，严重时引发坠机事故，在起飞、着陆或爬升阶段威胁尤为突出。

cards.audioText: How to avoid wake turbulence?
cards.audioTextZh: 如何避让尾流？
cards.referenceText:
We can keep enough separation from the preceding aircraft to avoid the wake turbulence.
我们可与前方飞机保持足够间隔来避让尾流。

To avoid wake turbulence, ATC must maintain standard separation. Pilots follow separation rules: wait 3 minutes after a heavy aircraft, 2 minutes after a medium one. Monitor frequency, avoid flying behind large aircraft closely, and request ATC for proper spacing. During takeoff/landing, keep a safe distance from preceding aircraft.
避免尾流的措施包括：空管执行标准间隔调配；飞行员严格遵守间隔规则（重型机后等待3分钟，中型机后等待2分钟）；密切监控通讯频率，避免紧跟大型飞机飞行；向空管申请合理间隔；起飞和着陆阶段与前机保持安全距离。

cards.audioText:
What should you do if you have
been caught in wake turbulence?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果你飞进尾流,你会怎么做?
cards.referenceText:
If caught in wake turbulence, maintain aircraft control calmly, avoid over-maneuvering. Keep stable speed and altitude, monitor flight attitude closely. Inform ATC promptly. If turbulence is severe, reduce thrust appropriately, keep wings level, and ensure passengers and crew are strapped in to prevent injuries.
飞进尾流后，应冷静保持飞机控制，避免过度操纵；维持稳定速度和高度，密切监控飞行姿态；及时告知空管；若颠簸剧烈，适当减小推力，保持机翼水平，确保机组和乘客系好安全带以防止受伤。

cards.audioText: What is Standard callout?
cards.audioTextZh:
什么是标准喊话（Standard callout）？
What does standard callout mean?
标准喊话是什么意思？
cards.referenceText:
Standard callouts are predefined words and phrases used by flight crew members. For example, during takeoff, the Pilot Flying (PF) controls the aircraft, while the Pilot Monitoring (PM) makes callouts such as “Flaps checked”, “V1”, and “Rotate [speed in knots]”.
标准喊话是飞行机组人员使用的预先规定好的标准化用语。例如，起飞阶段，操纵飞机的飞行员（PF）负责操控飞机，监控飞行员（PM）需进行标准喊话，如 “襟翼已检查”“V1 速度”“抬轮 [×× 节]” 。
Standard callout means using a fixed set of words and phrases to communicate critical information in the cockpit. It ensures every pilot uses the same terms in the same situation, reducing confusion. Typical callouts include “80 knots”, “1000 feet”, “500 feet”, “minimums”, “runway in sight”. Standard callouts help both pilots monitor status and make coordinated decisions. They are a key part of SOP and CRM. Airlines publish standard callout lists in their operation manuals.
标准喊话是指在驾驶舱内使用固定用语传递关键信息，确保所有飞行员在相同场景下用词统一，减少混淆与误解。典型喊话如：80 节、1000 英尺、500 英尺、最低高度、跑道可见等。标准喊话有助于两名飞行员共同监控状态、协同决策，是 SOP 标准程序与 CRM 机组资源管理的核心组成部分。航空公司在运行手册中明确发布标准喊话清单。

cards.audioText: What's the standard call-out during flaps extension?
cards.audioTextZh: 襟翼放出过程中的标准喊话是什么？
cards.referenceText:
The Pilot Flying (PF) controls the aircraft, while the Pilot Monitoring (PM) should make a call - out such as: “Check speed, altitude, and flap position.”
操纵飞机的飞行员（PF）负责操控飞机，监控飞行员（PM）应进行如下标准喊话：“检查速度、高度及襟翼位置。”

cards.audioText: Is stand callout important?
cards.audioTextZh: 标准喊话重要吗？
cards.referenceText:
Yes, it is very important. It serves as a cross - check, helping to reduce human error and ensure flight safety.
重要，它非常关键。标准喊话起到交叉检查的作用，有助于减少人为差错，保障飞行安全 。

topics.name: 飞行记录本与手册文件

cards.taskTitle: 运行-飞行记录本与手册文件-1
cards.audioText: Who is responsible for filling flight logbook?
cards.audioTextZh: 谁负责填写飞行记录本？
cards.referenceText:
(1) The captain is responsible for filling the logbook.
机长负责填写记录本。
 (2) According to the Standard Operating Procedure (SOP), the Pilot Monitoring (PM) is normally responsible for filling in the flight logbook.
按照标准操作程序（SOP），监控飞行员（PM）通常负责填写飞行记录本

cards.taskTitle: 运行-飞行记录本与手册文件-2
cards.audioText: Are there any requirements on filling flight logbook?
cards.audioTextZh: 填写飞行记录本有要求吗？
cards.referenceText:
(1) Nowadays, we use cloud - based systems to record training information. In the past, after training, we would record the time, training subject, and the name of the flight instructor.
如今，我们使用基于云端的系统记录训练信息。过去，训练结束后，我们会记录时间、训练科目以及飞行教员的姓名。
(2) According to the SOP, the flight logbook should be filled in during the cruise phase or after landing (with engines shut down and parking brakes set). During ground movement or while changing flight levels, flight crew should not fill in the flight logbook. Additionally, entries in the flight logbook should be neat, clear, and correct. (If necessary, flight logbook data and fault records should be checked.)
 根据标准操作程序（SOP），飞行记录本应在巡航阶段或着陆后（发动机关闭且设置好停留刹车时）填写。在地面移动期间或飞行高度改变过程中，飞行机组人员不应填写飞行记录本。此外，飞行记录本的填写内容应整洁、清晰且准确。（如有必要，应对飞行记录本的数据和故障记录进行检查。 ）

cards.taskTitle: 运行-飞行记录本与手册文件-3
cards.audioText: What items should the flight crew check on the maintenance logbook?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行人员检查维修日志应该检查哪些内容？
cards.referenceText:
They should check the date, the malfunctioning part, the maintenance items, and so on.
他们应检查日期、故障部件、维修项目等内容 。

cards.taskTitle: 运行-飞行记录本与手册文件-4
cards.audioText: When do flight crew check maintenance logbook?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行人员什么时候检查维修日志？
cards.referenceText:
(1) Before each flight, ground mechanics are responsible for preparing the maintenance logbook. Finally, the captain will conduct a cross - check and sign their name in the logbook.
每次飞行前，地面机械师负责准备维修日志。最后，机长会进行交叉检查，并在日志中签字。
(2) During the preflight cockpit system check, the flight crew will check the maintenance logbook.
在飞行前驾驶舱系统检查期间，飞行机组会检查维修日志。

cards.taskTitle: 运行-飞行记录本与手册文件-5
cards.audioText: Why do flight crew check it before flight?（
cards.audioTextZh:
维修日志）
飞行机组为何要在飞行前检查维修日志？
cards.referenceText:
(1) The flight crew must ensure that all parts of the aircraft are airworthy.
飞行机组必须确保飞机的所有部件适航。
(2) The flight crew need to check the maintenance logbook to understand the aircraft’s condition and confirm that the aircraft meets Minimum Equipment List (MEL) requirements, ensuring the aircraft is airworthy.
飞行机组需要检查维修日志，了解飞机状态，并确认飞机符合最低设备清单（MEL）要求，确保飞机适航 。

cards.taskTitle: 运行-飞行记录本与手册文件-6
cards.audioText: When do you use the normal checklist?
cards.audioTextZh: 你们何时使用正常检查单？
cards.referenceText:
During normal operations, we use the normal checklist. For example, when preparing for pushback, we follow the pushback checklist, and when preparing to taxi, we follow the taxi checklist.
在正常运行期间，我们会使用正常检查单。例如，准备推出时，我们会遵循推出检查单；准备滑行时，我们会遵循滑行检查单 。

cards.taskTitle: 运行-飞行记录本与手册文件-7
cards.audioText: How do the crew members cooperate with each other to do the checklist?
cards.audioTextZh: 机组人员如何配合完成检查单
cards.referenceText:
(1) They should cooperate well to complete the checklist. The Pilot Flying (PF) controls the aircraft, while the Pilot Monitoring (PM) runs through the checklist. Simultaneously, the PF verifies and conducts a cross - check.
 他们应良好配合来完成检查单。操纵飞机的飞行员（PF）操控飞机，监控飞行员（PM）同步执行检查单流程。同时，PF 进行核实并开展交叉检查。
(2) Usually, the PM (Pilot Monitoring) reads and executes the checklist, while the PF (Pilot Flying) confirms each item and monitors the aircraft. They cross-check to ensure accuracy. For critical steps, verbal confirmation is required to avoid human errors and maintain operational consistency.
通常由监控飞行员（PM）朗读并执行检查单，操纵飞行员（PF）确认每一项并监控飞机状态，双方交叉检查确保准确。关键步骤需口头确认，避免人为失误，保持操作一致性。

cards.taskTitle: 运行-飞行记录本与手册文件-8
cards.audioText: Are there any other technical manuals or handbooks in your cockpit? Can you name a few?
cards.audioTextZh: 你驾驶舱有技术手册吗？你能列举一些吗？
cards.referenceText:
Yes, the cockpit is equipped with essential manuals: AFM (Aircraft Flight Manual), FCOM (Flight Crew Operations Manual), QRH (Quick Reference Handbook), MEL (Minimum Equipment List), and aeronautical/approach charts. They guide normal/abnormal operations and ensure compliance with regulations.
有，驾驶舱配备必要手册：飞机飞行手册（AFM）、机组操作手册（FCOM）、快速检查单（QRH）、最低设备清单（MEL）以及航图和进近图。它们为正常/非正常操作提供指导，确保符合规章要求。

cards.taskTitle: 运行-飞行记录本与手册文件-9
cards.audioText: Are there manuals in English or in Chinese? Do you prefer to read the English version or the translated Chinese version?
cards.audioTextZh: 这些手册是英文的还是中文的？你喜欢原版英文的手册还是翻译纸质的手册？
cards.referenceText:
Our manuals are available in both English and Chinese. However, I prefer to read the original English manuals. This is because they can save time, help improve our English proficiency, and ensure flight safety. Additionally, there may be translation errors in the Chinese versions, which could potentially impact flight safety.
我们的手册有英文版和中文版。不过，我更喜欢读原版英文手册。因为这样可以节省时间、有助于提升英语水平，还能保障飞行安全。此外，中文版手册可能存在翻译误差，有可能影响飞行安全 。

cards.taskTitle: 运行-飞行记录本与手册文件-10
cards.audioText: Is it possible that paper manuals may be replaced by the electrical files?
cards.audioTextZh: 纸质手册可能被电子文件所取代吗？
cards.referenceText:
(1) I don’t think so. I believe paper manuals are very convenient to use.
我认为不会。我觉得纸质手册使用起来很方便。
 (2) I don’t think paper manuals will be replaced by electronic manuals. This is because paper manuals can be used at any time, even in the event of an electrical failure. In other words, if there is an electrical failure, electronic manuals will become unusable.
我认为纸质手册不会被电子手册取代。因为纸质手册随时可用，即便发生电气故障时也能使用。也就是说，若出现电气故障，电子手册就无法使用了 。
（3）Unlikely to be fully replaced. Electronic manuals are convenient for daily use, but paper manuals are irreplaceable in power failures or system malfunctions. Airlines usually retain both to ensure redundancy, balancing efficiency and safety in various flight scenarios.
不太可能被完全取代。电子手册便于日常使用，但纸质手册在断电或系统故障时不可或缺。航空公司通常两者并存以确保冗余，在不同飞行场景中平衡效率与安全。

cards.taskTitle: 运行-飞行记录本与手册文件-11
cards.audioText: Can you introduce your normal checklist?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能介绍一下你们的正常检查单吗
cards.referenceText:
Yes. Our normal checklist includes: pushback checklist, taxi checklist, approach checklist, and so on.
可以。我们的正常检查单包含：推出检查单、滑行检查单、进近检查单等 。

cards.taskTitle: 运行-飞行记录本与手册文件-12
cards.audioText: Do you often consult these manuals or handbooks in flight?Are they convenient to use?
cards.audioTextZh: 你经常查阅这些手册吗？他们用起来方便吗？
cards.referenceText:
Yes, we often consult/read the manuals or handbooks during flight.
(Before flight, we consult/read the Aircraft Flight Manual to know the performance of the aircraft. )
In normal situations, we will use normal checklists
In emergency situations, we will use QRH and SOP to ensure flight safety.
是的，我们经常查阅飞行手册。飞行前，我们查阅飞机飞行手册了解飞机性能。在正常情况下，我们使用正常检查单。在紧急情况下，我们使用QRH和MEL确保飞行安全。

Yes, I consult them regularly. Before flight, AFM is used to confirm aircraft performance. During normal flights, standard checklists are followed. In emergencies or abnormal situations, QRH and MEL are crucial for quick, correct responses, ensuring flight safety and compliance.
是的，我会定期查阅。飞行前，查阅飞机飞行手册（AFM）确认飞机性能；正常飞行中遵循标准检查单；紧急或非正常情况下，快速检查单（QRH）和最低设备清单（MEL）是快速正确应对的关键，保障飞行安全和合规性。

cards.taskTitle: 运行-飞行记录本与手册文件-13
cards.audioText: Which do you prefer to read the paper manuals or the electronic files?
cards.audioTextZh: 纸质手册和电子手册，你更喜欢哪一个？
cards.referenceText:
I prefer to read electronic manuals because it’s easy for us to find whatever we want and it can save some room/space for pilots.
我更喜欢阅读电子手册，因为我们可以使用搜索功能，轻松找到我们想要的东西，同时它能节省空间。

cards.taskTitle: 运行-飞行记录本与手册文件-14
cards.audioText: Could you please introduce your normal checklists to me?When do you use your normal checklist? What are included in normal checklist?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能给我们介绍一下正常检查单吗？你们什么时候使用检查单？检查单都包括哪些内容？
cards.referenceText:
Normal Checklists are used in normal situations to check the important （critical/significant） items of the aircraft and ensure flight safety. There are many normal checklists such as pre-startup checklist, taxiing checklist, pre-takeoff checklist, after-takeoff checklist, landing checklist and so on.
正常检查单用于正常情况下检查飞机的重要部件确保飞行安全，他包括许多正常检查单，比如，开车前检查单，滑行检查单，起飞前检查单，起飞后检查单，着陆检查单等。

Normal checklists include preflight, takeoff, cruise, approach, and landing items. Contents cover system checks (engines, hydraulics), configuration settings (flaps, landing gear), and instrument verifications. They are used at key flight phases to ensure standard operations and avoid omissions.
正常检查单包括飞行前、起飞、巡航、进近和着陆等项目，内容涵盖系统检查（发动机、液压系统）、构型设置（襟翼、起落架）和仪表校验。在飞行关键阶段使用，确保操作标准化，避免遗漏。

Normal checklists ensure no critical steps are missed during each flight phase (such as preflight, takeoff, landing). They standardize operations, reduce human errors, enhance crew coordination, and maintain flight safety by verifying system status and configurations.
正常检查单的作用是确保飞行各阶段（如飞行前、起飞、着陆）不遗漏关键步骤，标准化操作流程，减少人为差错，加强机组协同，并通过核实系统状态和构型保障飞行安全。

cards.taskTitle: 运行-飞行记录本与手册文件-15
cards.audioText: Compared with paper manuals, what are the advantages and disadvantages of electronic manuals?
cards.audioTextZh: 与纸质手册相比,电子手册的优缺点有哪些?
cards.referenceText:
Advantages: Portable, easy to update, searchable, and integrates multiple documents, saving time. Disadvantages: Dependent on electricity, vulnerable to system malfunctions. Pilots may over-rely on devices, and data security risks exist. Paper manuals are more reliable in power failures.
优点：便携、易更新、可检索，整合多种文档，节省时间。缺点：依赖电力，易受系统故障影响；飞行员可能过度依赖设备，存在数据安全风险。纸质手册在断电时更可靠。

cards.taskTitle: 运行-飞行记录本与手册文件-16
cards.audioText: What is the function of the flight logbook?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行记录本的功能是什么？
cards.referenceText:
A flight logbook is a key document recording flight-related information. Its functions include documenting flight training subjects, training duration, flight instructor signatures, departure/landing time, fuel quantity (FOB), number of persons on board (POB), cargo details, and aircraft malfunctions (if any), serving as an important basis for training, operation, and maintenance.
飞行记录本是记录飞行相关信息的核心文件，功能包括记录飞行训练科目、训练时长、飞行教员签字、起降时间、燃油量（FOB）、机上人员数（POB）、货物信息以及飞机故障（如有），是训练、运行和维护的重要依据。

cards.taskTitle: 运行-飞行记录本与手册文件-17
cards.audioText: Which one do you think is more difficult, the English manual or the Chinese manual?
cards.audioTextZh: 你觉得哪一个更难，英文手册还是中文手册？
cards.referenceText:
It depends on personal proficiency. English manuals use professional aviation terminology and fixed expressions, which may be challenging for non-native speakers. Chinese manuals are more accessible in language, but the accuracy of technical translations is crucial. Mastery of both is essential for safe flight operations.
取决于个人熟练度。英文手册使用专业航空术语和固定表达，对非母语者可能存在难度；中文手册语言更易理解，但技术翻译的准确性至关重要，熟练掌握两者对飞行安全运行都必不可少。

cards.taskTitle: 运行-飞行记录本与手册文件-18
cards.audioText: What kind of manuals should be carried during the flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 在飞行中需要携带的手册都有哪些?
cards.referenceText:
Manuals carried during flight include Aircraft Flight Manual (AFM), Flight Crew Operations Manual (FCOM), Quick Reference Handbook (QRH), Minimum Equipment List (MEL), aeronautical charts, and approach charts. They guide normal and emergency operations.
飞行中需携带的手册包括飞机飞行手册（AFM）、机组操作手册（FCOM）、快速检查单（QRH）、最低设备清单（MEL）、航图和进近图等，为正常及应急运行提供指导。

cards.taskTitle: 运行-飞行记录本与手册文件-19
cards.audioText: Do you have to check the maintenance log book?
cards.audioTextZh: 你们需要检查维修记录本吗?
cards.referenceText:
Yes, checking the maintenance logbook is mandatory. It records past aircraft malfunctions, maintenance actions, and unresolved issues. This helps pilots understand the aircraft’s condition, make safe operational decisions, and ensure compliance with airworthiness requirements.
是的，检查维修记录本是必须的。该记录本记录了飞机过往的故障情况、维修措施及未解决的问题，帮助飞行员了解飞机状态，做出安全运行决策，并确保符合适航要求。

cards.taskTitle: 运行-开槽跑道与湿滑道面-1
cards.audioText: As a part of your pre-flight planning/preparation, how do you determine the runway is grooved?
cards.audioTextZh: 作为飞行前计划 / 准备的一部分，你们如何确定跑道是否有刻槽？
cards.referenceText:
We can check the airport information to determine if the runway is grooved.
我们可以查阅机场资料来确定跑道是否有刻槽 。

During pre-flight planning, I obtain runway information from ATIS, NOTAM, ATC reports, or airport charts. Pilot reports (PIREP) also help confirm if the runway is grooved.
飞行前计划阶段，我会通过自动终端情报服务（ATIS）、航行通告（NOTAM）、空管报告或机场航图获取跑道信息，确定其是否为带槽跑道。其他飞行员的报告（PIREP）也能提供参考。

cards.taskTitle: 运行-开槽跑道与湿滑道面-2
cards.audioText: If there is standing water on the runway, what will you be careful about?
cards.audioTextZh: 若跑道上有积水，你们需要注意什么？
cards.referenceText:
（1）If there is standing water on the runway, we should check the braking action. The runway may be slippery, so we need to maintain good directional control of the aircraft.
若跑道上有积水，我们应检查刹车效能。跑道可能湿滑，因此要保持对飞机良好的方向控制 。
（2）If there is standing water on the runway, the braking action is reduced and hydroplaning might happen. During landing we shall use recommended speed to touch down, and use the maximum thrust reverse. When the speed is slowed down, then use the brakes.
跑道积水会降低刹车效果，可能引发滑水现象。着陆时，需按推荐速度接地，使用最大反推；待速度降低后，再使用刹车。
（3）I will pay attention to reduced braking efficiency and increased hydroplaning risk. I’ll adjust approach speed to be lower, maintain stable attitude, avoid abrupt braking or steering, extend landing distance, and be prepared for go-around if conditions deteriorate.
我会注意刹车效率下降和水滑风险增加。降低进近速度，保持稳定姿态，避免急剧刹车或转向，预留更长的着陆距离，若情况恶化则做好复飞准备。

cards.taskTitle: 运行-开槽跑道与湿滑道面-3
cards.audioText: What is the purpose of grooving the runway?
cards.audioTextZh: 跑道开槽的目的是什么？
cards.referenceText:
The purpose of grooving the runway is to drain rainwater, reduce the risk of aircraft hydroplaning after heavy rain, and increase the friction between the runway and the aircraft tires, so as to improve the braking performance and ground handling characteristics of the aircraft.
跑道开槽的目的是排出雨水，减少飞机在大雨后滑水的风险，增加跑道与飞机轮胎之间的摩擦力，从而提高飞机的刹车性能和地面操控特性。

cards.taskTitle: 运行-开槽跑道与湿滑道面-4
cards.audioText: Is a grooved runway effectively dry?
cards.audioTextZh: 开槽跑道能视为有效干燥吗？
cards.referenceText:
No. However, the landing distance on a wet, grooved runway is remarkably reduced, almost to the point of being dry until the water depth exceeds 0.1 inch or if there is any slush.
不能。然而，潮湿的开槽跑道上的着陆距离会显著缩短，几乎达到干燥跑道的水平，除非水深超过 0.1 英寸或存在任何雪泥。

cards.taskTitle: 运行-开槽跑道与湿滑道面-5
cards.audioText: How does grooving the runway improve aircraft braking performance?
cards.audioTextZh: 跑道开槽如何改善飞机刹车性能？
cards.referenceText:
Grooving the runway can quickly drain the surface water, keep the contact surface between the tire and the runway dry, increase the friction coefficient, so that the brake can play a better role, and reduce the landing roll distance.
跑道开槽可以快速排走表面积水，保持轮胎与跑道的接触面干燥，增大摩擦系数，使刹车能更好地发挥作用，缩短着陆滑跑距离。

cards.taskTitle: 运行-开槽跑道与湿滑道面-6
cards.audioText: What are the advantages of grooved runways?
cards.audioTextZh: 带槽跑道的优势是什么?
cards.referenceText:
Grooved runways drain water quickly to reduce hydroplaning risk, maintain friction between tires and runway surface (even in wet conditions), improve braking efficiency, and enhance landing/takeoff safety by preventing aircraft skidding or veering off.
带槽跑道的优势包括：快速排水，减少水滑风险；即使在潮湿条件下也能保持轮胎与跑道表面的摩擦力；提升刹车效率；防止飞机滑行或偏出跑道，增强起降安全性。

cards.taskTitle: 运行-开槽跑道与湿滑道面-7
cards.audioText: Will grooving the runway affect the runway friction in winter?
cards.audioTextZh: 跑道开槽会影响冬季跑道摩擦力吗？
cards.referenceText:
Generally, it will not have a negative impact. According to the actual measurement results, the grooved runway has a beneficial effect on the aircraft braking performance without negatively affecting the runway friction in winter.
一般不会产生负面影响。根据实际测量结果，开槽跑道对飞机刹车性能有有益作用，且不会对冬季跑道摩擦力产生负面影响。

cards.taskTitle: 运行-开槽跑道与湿滑道面-8
cards.audioText: Does a grooved runway have the same hydroplaning resistance as a dry runway?
cards.audioTextZh: 开槽跑道的防滑水性能与干燥跑道相同吗？
cards.referenceText:
No. Although the grooved runway can significantly reduce the risk of hydroplaning, it is still affected by water depth. When the water depth exceeds a certain value (such as 0.1 inch), the anti - hydroplaning performance will decline, while the dry runway has no such problem.
不同。尽管开槽跑道能显著降低滑水风险，但仍受水深影响，当水深超过一定值（如 0.1 英寸）时，防滑水性能会下降，而干燥跑道不存在此问题。

cards.taskTitle: 运行-开槽跑道与湿滑道面-9
cards.audioText: Can grooved runways be used for all types of aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh: 开槽跑道适用于所有类型的飞机吗？
cards.referenceText:
Yes, grooved runways are suitable for all types of aircraft, from small general - aviation aircraft to large commercial airliners, because it can improve the safety of aircraft landing and take - off under wet conditions, which is of universal significance.
是的，开槽跑道适用于所有类型的飞机，从小型通用航空飞机到大型商业客机，因为它能提高飞机在潮湿条件下起降的安全性，具有普遍意义。

cards.taskTitle: 运行-开槽跑道与湿滑道面-10
cards.audioText: What is the principle of runway grooving to reduce hydroplaning?
cards.audioTextZh: 跑道开槽减少滑水的原理是什么？
cards.referenceText: The principle is to quickly drain the water on the runway surface through the grooves, so that the water cannot form a continuous water film between the tire and the runway, reducing the buoyancy of the water film to the tire, and ensuring that the tire can maintain good contact with the runway, thereby reducing the risk of hydroplaning.（原理是通过槽将跑道表面的水快速排出，使水无法在轮胎与跑道之间形成连续水膜，减小水膜对轮胎的浮力，保证轮胎能与跑道保持良好接触，从而降低滑水风险。

cards.taskTitle: 运行-开槽跑道与湿滑道面-11
cards.audioText: Are there any special maintenance requirements for grooved runways?
cards.audioTextZh: 开槽跑道有特殊的维护要求吗？
cards.referenceText:
Grooved runways need to regularly check the wear and blockage of the grooves to ensure that the grooves can play a normal drainage role. At the same time, pay attention to whether there are cracks or damages at the groove edges, and repair them in time to avoid further expansion of damages.
开槽跑道需要定期检查槽的磨损情况和堵塞情况，确保槽能正常发挥排水作用。同时，注意槽边缘是否有裂缝或损坏，及时进行修补，避免损坏进一步扩大。

cards.taskTitle: 运行-开槽跑道与湿滑道面-12
cards.audioText: Will the grooved runway have an impact on the tire wear of the aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh: 开槽跑道会对飞机轮胎磨损产生影响吗？
cards.referenceText:
Grooved runways may cause more obvious wear on aircraft tires than non - grooved runways, because the tires are in contact with the grooved surface, and the friction force is more concentrated in some areas, but this wear is within the acceptable range, and the improvement of safety is more important.
开槽跑道可能会比非开槽跑道对飞机轮胎造成更明显的磨损，因为轮胎与开槽表面接触，摩擦力在某些区域更为集中，但这种磨损在可接受范围内，且安全性的提升更为重要。

cards.taskTitle: 运行-开槽跑道与湿滑道面-13
cards.audioText: Can the grooved runway be used normally when there is snow or ice?
cards.audioTextZh: 开槽跑道在有积雪或结冰时能否正常使用？
cards.referenceText: The grooved runway can be used normally when there is snow or ice, but the airport needs to carry out normal de - icing and snow - removal operations. The grooves can help to a certain extent to prevent the accumulation of snow and ice, but they cannot completely replace the de - icing and snow - removal work.开槽跑道在有积雪或结冰时可以正常使用，但机场需要进行正常的除冰和除雪作业。槽能在一定程度上帮助阻止冰雪堆积，但不能完全取代除冰除雪工作。

cards.taskTitle: 运行-开槽跑道与湿滑道面-14
cards.audioText: How does the grooved runway affect the aircraft's ground effect?
cards.audioTextZh: 开槽跑道对飞机的地面效应有影响吗？
cards.referenceText:
The grooved runway has little direct impact on the aircraft's ground effect. The ground effect is mainly related to the height of the aircraft from the ground, the speed, and the aircraft's aerodynamic shape, etc. The groove of the runway mainly affects the friction and drainage between the tire and the runway, and has little influence on the aerodynamic characteristics of the aircraft in the ground effect.
开槽跑道对飞机的地面效应影响较小。地面效应主要与飞机离地面的高度、速度以及飞机的气动外形等有关，跑道的槽主要影响轮胎与跑道之间的摩擦和排水，对处于地面效应中的飞机气动特性影响不大。

cards.taskTitle: 运行-开槽跑道与湿滑道面-15
cards.audioText: Can the grooved runway reduce the aircraft's take - off and landing noise?
cards.audioTextZh: 开槽跑道能降低飞机起降噪音吗？
cards.referenceText:
The grooved runway has little effect on reducing aircraft take - off and landing noise. Its main function is to improve the friction coefficient and drainage performance, and has little to do with noise reduction.
开槽跑道对降低飞机起降噪音作用不大。其主要功能是提高摩擦系数和排水性能，与降噪关系不大。

cards.taskTitle: 运行-开槽跑道与湿滑道面-16
cards.audioText: If the braking effect on the grooved runway is poor, what should the pilot do?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果在开槽跑道上刹车效果不佳，飞行员应怎么做？
cards.referenceText:
The pilot should provide a PIREP when the braking action advisories are in effect or anytime the actual braking action is less than good, and at the same time, consider taking measures such as going - around, holding or diverting according to the specific situation to ensure flight safety.
当刹车效果 advisory（提示）生效或实际刹车效果不佳时，飞行员应提供飞行员报告，同时根据具体情况考虑采取复飞、等待或改航等措施，以确保飞行安全。

cards.taskTitle: 运行-开槽跑道与湿滑道面-17
cards.audioText: In what direction should the runway grooves be arranged?
cards.audioTextZh: 跑道槽应按什么方向布置？
cards.referenceText:
The grooves on the runway should be perpendicular to the runway centerline, which is conducive to quickly draining the water on the runway surface to both sides. At the high - speed exit taxiways, the direction of the grooves should be beneficial to pavement drainage.
跑道槽应垂直于跑道中心线布置，这样有利于将跑道表面的水快速排向两侧。在快速出口滑行道处，槽的方向应利于道面排水。

cards.taskTitle: 运行-开槽跑道与湿滑道面-18
cards.audioText: Are there any special inspection requirements for grooved runways?
cards.audioTextZh: 开槽跑道有特殊的检查要求吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, in addition to the normal runway inspection items, grooved runways also need to check the integrity of the grooves, whether there is blockage, and whether the depth and width of the grooves meet the requirements. Any damage or blockage of the grooves may affect the performance of the runway, and timely maintenance and repair are required.有，开槽跑道除了常规的跑道检查项目外，还需检查槽的完整性，是否有堵塞情况，以及槽的深度和宽度是否符合要求等。槽的任何损坏或堵塞都可能影响跑道性能，需要及时进行维护和修复。

cards.taskTitle: 运行-开槽跑道与湿滑道面-19
cards.audioText:
Do you often check to see if a runway is
grooved during your preflight planning?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行前准备阶段，是否经常检查跑道是否为刻槽跑道？
cards.referenceText:
Yes, each preflight preparation we will check if the runway is grooved. It is very important, because the brake action of the grooved runway is better. It also helps to drain off the water.
是的，每次飞行前都会检查。这很重要，因为刻槽跑道的刹车效果更好，且有助于排水。

cards.taskTitle: 运行-开槽跑道与湿滑道面-20
cards.audioText: Do you check whether the runway is good in your daily flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 在日常飞行中,你会检查跑道是否良好吗?
cards.referenceText:
Yes, I do. Checking runway conditions is a crucial part of preflight preparation and inflight monitoring to ensure safe takeoff and landing, which is required by SOP (Standard Operating Procedures).
会的。检查跑道状况是飞行前准备和飞行中监控的关键环节，以确保起飞和着陆安全，这是标准操作程序SOP的要求。

cards.taskTitle: 运行-开槽跑道与湿滑道面-21
cards.audioText: As a part of your pre-flight planning, how do you determine whether the runway is good?
cards.audioTextZh: 做为飞行计划的一部分,你如何确定跑道状况是否良好?
cards.referenceText:
I obtain runway information from ATIS, NOTAM, ATC, and pilot reports. I check details like runway surface condition (e.g., wet, icy, grooved), braking action, length, width, and any obstacles to confirm it meets the aircraft's operational requirements.
我通过自动终端情报服务ATIS、航行通告NOTAM、空管和其他飞行员报告获取跑道信息，检查跑道表面状况如潮湿、结冰、槽纹、刹车效应、长度、宽度及是否有障碍物，确认其符合飞机运行要求。

cards.audioText: If ATC asks you to hold at aholding fix, what'll you do?
cards.audioTextZh: 若空中交通管制（ATC）要求你在等待点等待，你会怎么做？
cards.referenceText:
I will follow the controller’s instructions to enter the hold. At the same time, I will confirm the holding altitude, the inbound track, left or right pattern, and outbound time.
我会遵照管制员的指令进入等待程序。同时，确认等待高度、入航航迹、向左或向右的等待航线模式，以及出航时间 。

cards.audioText: If you need to join a holding pattern, what information do you need?
cards.audioTextZh: 若你需要加入等待航线，需要了解哪些信息？
cards.referenceText:
I will advise ATC of our situation and request to join the holding pattern. I will confirm the holding fix, holding altitude, inbound track, left or right - hand pattern, and outbound time.
我会将我方情况告知空中交通管制（ATC）并申请加入等待航线。随后，确认等待点、等待高度、入航航迹、左向或右向等待航线模式，以及出航时间 。

cards.audioText:
If ATC request you to hold at a significant
fix, and what should you do?
cards.audioTextZh: 若空管要求在重要定位点等待，你会怎么做？
cards.referenceText:
We need to confirm with ATC, ask ATC the reasons for holding, how long is the holding. If we are required to hold more than 20 minutes, we need to check fuel endurance.
需向空管确认等待原因和等待时长；若要求等待超过 20 分钟，需检查燃油续航能力。

cards.audioText: Do you often carry out radio check with ATC in flight? Usually when do you need to carry out the radio check?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行中你会经常与空中交通管制（ATC）进行无线电检查吗？通常在什么情况下需要进行无线电检查？
cards.referenceText:
Yes, sometimes we carry out radio checks with ATC in flight. Normally, before pushback and start - up, and when we first contact ATC, we conduct radio checks.
是的，飞行中我们有时会与空中交通管制（ATC）进行无线电检查。一般来说，在推出、启动前，以及首次与 ATC 建立联系时，我们会进行无线电检查 。

cards.audioText: How do you carry out the radio check? Would you please give me a detailed explanation?
cards.audioTextZh: 你们如何进行无线电检查？能否详细说明一下流程？
cards.referenceText:
(1) First of all, I will check that the earphone and microphone are working properly. Then I will set the correct frequency and ask the controller, “12345. How do you read me?” We will make sure we hear each other loud and clear.
首先，我会检查耳机和麦克风工作是否正常。随后设置正确频率，并向管制员呼叫：“12345，你听我信号如何？” 我们要确保双方能清晰、响亮地听到彼此声音。
 (2) When we are required to check the radios, we will follow the procedure as follows: “Wuhan Ground, CCA, radio check on [frequency]. How do you read me?” We will repeat the procedure until the communication is loud and clear.
当需要进行无线电检查时，我们会按如下流程操作：“武汉地面，中国国际航空（CCA），在 [频率] 上进行无线电检查，你听我信号如何？” 我们会重复该流程，直至通信清晰、响亮 。

cards.audioText: When do you need to have radio check in your flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行中你们在什么情况下需要进行无线电检查？
cards.referenceText:
When we have initial contact with ATC, we will conduct a radio check with ATC. Besides, if the readability is below standard, we will check the radios.
当我们与空中交通管制（ATC）首次建立联系时，会与 ATC 进行无线电检查。此外，若通信清晰度未达标准，我们也会检查无线电设备 。

A radio check is needed during initial contact with ATC on the ground if signal quality is poor, before key flight phases (e.g., takeoff, approach), or when communication is unclear, ensuring reliable interaction with ATC throughout the flight.
在地面初次联系空管且信号质量不佳时、关键飞行阶段（如起飞、进近）前，或通信不清晰时，需要进行无线电检查，确保飞行全程与空管的通信可靠。

cards.audioText: Have you ever encountered radio failure?
cards.audioTextZh: 你曾遇到过无线电故障吗？
cards.referenceText:
No, I have never encountered radio failure.
没有，我从未遇到过无线电故障。

cards.audioText: What would you do if you had radio failure? What is your company's procedures regarding failure?
cards.audioTextZh: 若遇到无线电故障，你会如何处理？贵公司针对（无线电 ）故障的处置程序是怎样的？
cards.referenceText:
First, we will squawk 7600 to indicate we have a communication failure. Second, we should follow the last instruction given by ATC. Third, we will follow the SOP (Standard Operating Procedure), recycle the radios and re - establish communication with ATC. If possible, we may switch to the emergency frequency.
首先，我们会设置应答机编码 7600，表明出现通信故障。其次，遵循空中交通管制（ATC）给出的最后一条指令。第三，按照标准操作程序（SOP），重启无线电设备并重新与 ATC 建立通信。如有可能，我们会切换到应急频率 。

The procedures include: squawking 7600 to indicate communication failure; following the last ATC instruction and flight plan; attempting to re-establish communication by recycling radios or switching to emergency frequency 121.5; performing blind transmission and position reports; and considering landing as soon as practical based on aircraft and airport conditions.
应对流程包括：应答机编码7600示意通信失效；遵循空管最后指令和飞行计划；通过重启无线电或切换至应急频率121.5尝试重建通信；进行盲目发射和位置报告；根据飞机及机场情况考虑尽快落地（非紧急情况下）。

cards.audioText: During flight operations, who is responsible for radiotelephony (RTF) communication with ATC?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行操作期间，谁负责与空中交通管制（ATC）进行无线电电话（RTF）通信？
cards.referenceText:
During flight, the pilot not flying (PNF) is responsible for radiotelephony (RTF) communication with ATC.
飞行期间，不操纵飞机的飞行员（PNF，Pilot Not Flying ）负责与空中交通管制（ATC）进行无线电电话（RTF）通信 。

According to SOP, the First Officer (FO) handles radiotelephony communication with ATC during ground operations, while the Pilot Monitoring (PM/PNF) takes charge during flight. This division ensures the Pilot Flying (PF) can focus on aircraft control, optimizing workload distribution.
根据标准操作程序（SOP），地面运行时由副驾驶（FO）负责与空管的无线电通话，飞行中由监控飞行员（PM/PNF）负责。这种分工能让操纵飞行员（PF）专注于飞机控制，优化工作负荷分配。

cards.audioText:
What does "I read you five" mean?
“
cards.audioTextZh: 我听你5个”是什么意思？
cards.referenceText:
It means the radio signal is perfectly clear. In aviation radiotelephony, “I read you five” indicates the highest readability level (5), meaning the transmission is loud, clear, and free of interference.
意思是无线电信号完全清晰。在航空无线电通话中，“I read you five”表示信号清晰度达到最高等级（5级），即传输声音洪亮、清晰且无干扰。

cards.audioText: What do you do when the radio is unstable?
cards.audioTextZh: 当无线电不稳定时,你会怎么处置?
cards.referenceText:
First, I will check the radio equipment and antenna for malfunctions. Then, switch to an alternate frequency or adjust the radio settings. If communication is still poor, use standard phraseology to communicate briefly, request radar vectors from ATC, and squawk 7600 if necessary. Maintain situational awareness and prepare to divert if communication fails completely.
首先检查无线电设备和天线是否故障，切换至备用频率或调整设备设置；若通信仍不佳，使用标准术语简洁沟通，向空管请求雷达引导，必要时应答机编码7600；保持情景意识，若通信完全失效，准备改航备降。

cards.audioText: Under what circumstances should the flight crew make a PA?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行机组人员应在何种情况下进行广播（PA，Public Address 的缩写 ）？
cards.referenceText:
There are some reasons for making a PA. For example, if we execute an emergency evacuation, the Captain should make a PA to tell passengers to calm down and follow the cabin crew's instructions for evacuation.
翻译：进行广播有一些原因。例如，若我们要执行紧急撤离，机长应进行广播，告知乘客冷静下来，并听从客舱机组人员的撤离指令 。

cards.audioText: If your captain or first officer is incapacitated in flight, will you make a PA?
cards.audioTextZh: 若飞行中机长或副驾驶失能，你会进行广播（PA）吗？
cards.referenceText:
If the captain or first officer is incapacitated in flight, we won't make a PA because it may make the passengers in the cabin panic and out of control.
翻译：如果机长或副驾飞行中失能，我们不会做乘客广播，因为这会使客舱乘客恐慌、失控。

cards.audioText: How will you tell the cabin crew in this situation?
cards.audioTextZh: 在这种情况下，你如何告诉空乘？
cards.referenceText:
If the captain or first officer is incapacitated in flight, I will take the control of the aircraft and use the interphone to tell the cabin crew to offer first aid to him or her. Then I will report our situation to ATC and request land at the nearest suitable airport and medical services upon arrival.
翻译：如果机长或副驾飞行中失能，我会操纵好飞机，使用内话系统告诉空乘，给他或她提供急救。然后，我会报告管制，请求最近合适机场着陆，请求医疗服务到场。

cards.taskTitle: 运行-旅客异常情况处置-1
cards.audioText: get anxious during long delay
cards.referenceText:
First of all, I will make a PA to explain the reason for delay/diversion. Secondly, I will ask cabin crew to provide some food and drinks. At last, I will keep informing the PAX of the latest flight information.
首先，我会进行广播（PA ），解释延误 / 备降的原因。其次，我会让客舱乘务员提供一些食物和饮品。最后，我会持续向乘客（PAX ）通报最新的航班信息 。

cards.taskTitle: 运行-旅客异常情况处置-2
cards.audioText: complain about the diversion
cards.referenceText:
First of all, I will make a PA to explain the reason for delay/diversion. Secondly, I will ask cabin crew to provide some food and drinks. At last, I will keep informing the PAX of the latest flight information.
首先，我会进行广播，解释延误 / 备降的原因；其次，我会安排客舱乘务员提供餐食和饮品；最后，我会持续向乘客通报最新的航班信息 。

cards.taskTitle: 运行-旅客异常情况处置-3
cards.audioText: PAX get ill feel uncomfortable/suffer from heart attack/get injured during turbulence
cards.referenceText:
First of all, I will ask the cabin crew to give them first aid and take good care of him. Secondly, I will advise ATC of our situation, if necessary, I will request divert to the nearest suitable airport and medical assistance.
首先，我会让客舱乘务员对其进行急救并悉心照料；其次，我会将情况告知空中交通管制（ATC），如有必要，我会申请备降最近的合适机场并请求医疗援助 。

cards.taskTitle: 运行-旅客异常情况处置-4
cards.audioText: drunk(unruly) PAX on board in flight
cards.referenceText:
I will ask the air marshal to keep him away from other PAX. If he is being unruly, I will let the air marshal restrain him and monitor him.
我会让空警将其与其他乘客隔离开。若他行为不端，我会让空警对其进行约束并监视 。

cards.taskTitle: 运行-旅客异常情况处置-5
cards.audioText: fight between the PAX
cards.referenceText:
I will ask the cabin crew to communicate with them to stop the fight. If they don't listen and keep fighting, I will ask the air marshal to restrain them. After landing, I will request the airport police to take them away.
我会让客舱乘务员沟通，让他们停止斗殴。若不听劝阻继续斗殴，我会让空警约束他们。着陆后，我会要求机场警方将他们带走 。

cards.taskTitle: 运行-旅客异常情况处置-6
cards.audioText: refuse to check his oversized baggage/turn off his mobile
cards.referenceText:
