In contrast, many other large jets are products of foreign aviation giants with mature technical systems and industrial chains. Secondly, in terms of design positioning, the C919 is mainly positioned for short to medium-haul routes, with a maximum range of about 5,555 kilometers and a maximum passenger capacity of 190, which is more in line with the market demand for short to medium-haul routes in China and other regions. Some other large jets may have a wider range of design positioning, including long-haul large aircraft with larger passenger capacity and longer range. Thirdly, in terms of technical configuration, the C919 adopts a series of advanced technologies and materials to improve fuel efficiency and operational economy, such as advanced aerodynamic design, lightweight materials and efficient engines. Although other large jets also have similar technical characteristics, there may be differences in specific technical parameters and configuration schemes due to different design concepts and market positioning. Finally, in terms of market positioning, the C919 will first focus on the domestic and Asian markets, gradually expand to the international market, while other mature large jets have a wider market coverage and more stable customer groups globally.
C919与其他大飞机的不同之处体现在多个方面。首先，在自主研发与知识产权方面，C919是中国具有自主知识产权的大型民用飞机，涉及大量国内自主研发的技术和零部件，对于推动中国航空产业链的发展具有重要意义。而其他许多大飞机是国外航空巨头的产品，拥有成熟的技术体系和产业链。其次，在设计定位上，C919主要定位于短中程航线，最大航程约5555公里，最大载客量190人，更符合中国及周边地区短中程航线的市场需求。其他一些大飞机的设计定位则更为广泛，包括载客量更大、航程更远的远程大型飞机。再次，在技术配置上，C919采用了一系列先进技术和材料，以提高燃油效率和运营经济性，如先进的气动设计、轻量化材料和高效发动机等。虽然其他大飞机也具备类似的技术特点，但由于设计理念和市场定位的不同，在具体的技术参数和配置方案上可能存在差异。最后，在市场定位上，C919将首先聚焦国内和亚洲市场，逐步向国际市场拓展，而其他成熟的大飞机在全球范围内拥有更广泛的市场覆盖和更稳定的客户群体。

cards.taskTitle: 其它-航空发展与新技术-16
cards.audioText:
Do you know which domestic
airlines operate the C919?
cards.audioTextZh: 你知道哪些国内航空公司运营C919客机吗?
cards.referenceText:
As of now, several domestic airlines have started operating the C919 airliner. For example, China Eastern Airlines is one of the first airlines to operate the C919. It took delivery of the first C919 aircraft and opened the first commercial flight route. In addition, Air China, China Southern Airlines and other major domestic airlines have also signed purchase agreements with COMAC and will gradually introduce and operate the C919 airliner in the future. With the continuous improvement of the C919's production capacity and airworthiness certification, more domestic airlines are expected to join the ranks of operating the C919, promoting the widespread application of this domestic large aircraft in the civil aviation market.
截至目前，已有多家国内航空公司开始运营C919客机。例如，中国东方航空公司是首批运营C919的航空公司之一，它接收了首架C919飞机，并开通了首条商业航线。此外，中国国际航空公司、中国南方航空公司等国内主要航空公司也已与中国商飞签订了采购协议，未来将逐步引进并运营C919客机。随着C919产能的不断提升和适航认证的逐步完善，预计会有更多国内航空公司加入到C919的运营行列中，推动这款国产大飞机在民航市场的广泛应用。

cards.taskTitle: 其它-航空发展与新技术-17
cards.audioText: What do you know about SAF?
cards.audioTextZh: 什么是 SAF（可持续航空燃油）？
cards.referenceText:
SAF stands for Sustainable Aviation Fuel. It is a type of aviation fuel made from renewable sources such as used cooking oil, agricultural waste, animal fats, or even household garbage. Unlike traditional jet fuel which comes from crude oil, SAF reduces carbon dioxide emissions by up to 80% over its lifecycle. SAF can be blended with conventional jet fuel and used in existing aircraft engines without modification. Currently, most aircraft can operate with a blend of up to 50% SAF. Airlines are increasingly using SAF to reduce environmental impact and meet international climate goals. The main challenges are limited supply and higher cost.
SAF 即可持续航空燃油，由废餐饮油、农业废弃物、动物脂肪、生活垃圾等可再生原料制成。与传统原油基航油不同，SAF 全生命周期可减碳最高 80%，可与常规航油混合，无需改装即可用于现役发动机。目前多数飞机可使用最高 50% 比例的 SAF 混合油。航空公司广泛使用 SAF 以降低环境影响、实现气候目标。主要挑战是供应有限、成本较高。

cards.taskTitle: 其它-航空发展与新技术-18
cards.audioText: What are the main advantages of SAF compared to traditional jet fuel?
cards.audioTextZh: 与传统喷气燃料相比，SAF 的主要优势是什么？
cards.referenceText:
SAF has several advantages over traditional jet fuel. First, it significantly reduces carbon dioxide emissions by up to 80% over its lifecycle, helping aviation fight climate change. Second, SAF produces fewer particulates and sulfur oxides, resulting in cleaner engine exhaust and improved local air quality around airports. Third, SAF can be blended with conventional fuel and used in existing aircraft engines without modifications. Fourth, it is compatible with current refueling infrastructure. Fifth, using waste materials promotes circular economy. The main issues are higher cost and limited supply.
SAF 相较传统航油优势明显：全生命周期减碳最高 80%，助力应对气候变化；颗粒物与硫氧化物排放更低，机场周边空气质量更好；可直接掺混使用，无需改装发动机与加油设施；兼容现有储运系统；使用废弃物原料有利于循环经济。当前主要问题是成本更高、供应有限。

cards.taskTitle: 其它-航空发展与新技术-19
cards.audioText: What are the current limitations or challenges of using SAF in commercial aviation?
cards.audioTextZh: 在当前商业航空中使用 SAF 有哪些局限或挑战？
cards.referenceText:
The main challenges of SAF are cost and supply. SAF is currently two to four times more expensive than traditional jet fuel. Production capacity is limited with few refineries worldwide. Feedstock availability is also a challenge – collecting enough used cooking oil or agricultural waste is difficult at scale. Certification and testing take time. Blending limits are up to 50% now, while 100% SAF is under test. Transportation and storage need careful management to avoid contamination. Investment and technology are improving quickly.
SAF 主要挑战是成本与供应：价格是传统航油的 2-4 倍；全球炼厂少，产能有限；原料收集难度大；认证与测试周期长；目前多数发动机最大掺混比例 50%，纯 SAF 仍在试验；运输与储存需严格管理防污染。相关投资与技术正在快速进步。

cards.taskTitle: 其它-航空发展与新技术-20
cards.audioText:
What is the role of SAF in achieving the aviation industry's net-zero emission target?
SAF
cards.audioTextZh: 在实现航空业净零排放目标中扮演什么角色？
cards.referenceText:
SAF plays a critical role in aviation's net-zero emission target. IATA has committed to net-zero by 2050, and SAF is expected to contribute about 65% of emission reductions. Unlike electric or hydrogen aircraft needing new designs, SAF can be used in today's fleet without modifications, making it the most immediate solution. Achieving net-zero needs massive investment: SAF will rise from ~1% now to over 60% by 2050. Governments and airlines are expanding refineries, lowering costs, and increasing feedstock supply. SAF is the most important solution for decarbonization.
SAF 是航空业实现净零排放的核心方案。IATA 承诺 2050 年净零碳排放，SAF 预计贡献约 65% 减排量。与需全新设计的电动 / 氢能飞机不同，SAF 可直接用于现有机队，是最即时可行的方案。实现净零需要大规模投资：SAF 占比将从目前约 1% 提升至 2050 年的 60% 以上。各国与航空公司正扩建炼厂、降低成本、增加原料供应。SAF 是航空脱碳最重要的解决方案。

cards.taskTitle: 其它-当前位置与工作背景-1
cards.audioText: What's your position? / Would you please introduce your work background?
cards.audioTextZh: 你的职位是什么？/ 能否介绍一下你的工作背景？
cards.referenceText:
I am a student pilot. I take flight training at Jiutian Flight School. I fly the DA - 40 for flight training. I have built up 100 flying hours. Now I only have my private pilot license.
我是一名飞行学员，在九天飞行学校接受飞行训练，驾驶 DA - 40 进行飞行训练，已积累 100 个飞行小时，目前仅持有私人飞行员执照 。

cards.taskTitle: 其它-当前位置与工作背景-2
cards.audioText: What type of aircraft are you flying now? / How many type ratings have you had?
cards.audioTextZh: 你目前驾驶的是哪种机型？/ 你已获得多少种机型等级资质？
cards.referenceText:
I am a student pilot. I take flight training at Jiutian Flight School. I fly the DA - 40 for flight training. I have built up 100 flying hours. Now I only hold my private pilot license.
我是一名飞行学员，在九天飞行学校接受飞行训练，驾驶 DA - 40 开展飞行训练，已积累 100 个飞行小时，目前仅持有私人飞行员执照 。

cards.taskTitle: 其它-当前位置与工作背景-3
cards.audioText: When/ Where did you take the transition training? What type of aircraft did you fly in The transition training? High performance training?
cards.audioTextZh: 你何时 / 何地进行的转机型训练？转机型训练中你驾驶的是哪种机型？高性能训练（相关情况）呢？
cards.referenceText:
I have not taken the transition training yet. Now I take flight training at Jiutian Flight School. I fly the DA - 40 for flight training. I have built up 100 flying hours. Now I only hold my private pilot license.
我尚未进行转机型训练。目前我在九天飞行学校接受飞行训练，驾驶 DA - 40 开展飞行训练，已积累 100 个飞行小时，现在仅持有私人飞行员执照 。

cards.audioText: Have you took any radiotelephone communication course?
cards.audioTextZh: 你修过无线电电话通信课程吗？
cards.referenceText:
Yes, I have.
是的，我修过。

cards.audioText: Do you think it is necessary to take such course?
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为修这样一门课程有必要吗？
cards.referenceText:
Yes, I think it is necessary to take such a course. Because we learn standard phraseology and RTF (Radio Telephony) communication procedures. They are very important in communications between pilots and air traffic controllers.
是的，我认为修这样一门课程有必要。因为我们会学习标准用语以及无线电通话（RTF）通信程序。这些在飞行员与空中交通管制员的通信中至关重要 。

cards.audioText: Do you have any Aviation English course? What are they?
cards.audioTextZh: 你修过航空英语相关课程吗？都有哪些？
cards.referenceText:
Yes, I have taken some Aviation English courses, such as the ICAO course, ATPL course, Reading course, Listening course, Oral English course, and so on.
修过，我修了一些航空英语课程，像国际民用航空组织（ICAO）课程、航空运输飞行员执照（ATPL）课程、阅读课程、听力课程、英语口语课程等等 。

cards.audioText: What's the difference between everyday general English and Aviation English?
cards.audioTextZh: 日常通用英语和航空英语之间的区别是什么？
cards.referenceText:
In my opinion, Aviation English emphasizes standard words and phrases, as well as standard communication procedures, to avoid misunderstandings between pilots and ATC. It is more accurate, concise, and clear.
在我看来，航空英语强调标准词汇和短语，以及标准通信程序，以此避免飞行员与空中交通管制员（ATC）之间出现误解。它更加准确、简洁、清晰 。

cards.audioText: Have you ever learned any courses about radiotelephony communication in English?
cards.audioTextZh: 你学过任何关于英语无线电电话通信的课程吗？
cards.referenceText:
Yes, I have learned the course about radiotelephony communication in English during ground training.
学过，我在地面训练期间学过英语无线电电话通信课程 。

cards.audioText: What have you learned from this course?
cards.audioTextZh: 你从这门课程中学到了什么？
cards.referenceText:
I have learned many things from this course. First, I have learned the communication procedures between pilots and controllers. Second, I have learned that we should use the standard words and phrases to avoid misunderstanding. Third, I have learned that we should speak loudly and clearly．
我从这门课程中学到了很多东西。首先，我了解了飞行员与管制员之间的通信程序。其次，我懂得了应该使用标准词汇和短语来避免误解。第三，我知道了说话要响亮、清晰 。

cards.audioText: What are the differences between radiotelephony (RTF) English and general daily used English?
cards.audioTextZh: 无线电通话（RTF）英语和一般日常使用的英语有什么区别？
cards.referenceText:
There are some differences between radiotelephony English and general daily used English. In radiotelephony communication, we should use standard words without misunderstanding. In daily used communication, we can use any words and we can use body language to help understanding.
无线电通话英语和一般日常使用的英语存在一些区别。在无线电通话交流中，我们应使用不会产生误解的标准词汇。在日常交流中，我们可以使用任意词汇，还可以借助肢体语言辅助理解 。

cards.audioText: Do you think it's difficult to communicate with ATC in English?
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为用英语与空中交通管制员（ATC）交流困难吗？
cards.referenceText:
Yes, I think it's easy to communicate with ATC in English in normal situations. But in emergency situations, it's a little difficult to communicate with ATC.
是的，我认为在正常情况下，用英语与空中交通管制员交流很容易。但在紧急情况下，与空中交通管制员交流就有点困难了 。

cards.audioText:
How do you improve your aviation English
communication skills?
cards.audioTextZh: 你如何提升航空英语沟通能力？

cards.audioText:
How long have you been learning
English?
Have you received any training
related English?
cards.audioTextZh: 你学习英语多长时间了?你接受过任何英语训练吗?
cards.referenceText:
I have been learning English for more than 15 years. During my flight training, I have received professional aviation English training, including radio communication, aviation terminology and interview English, which has laid a solid foundation for my aviation career.
我学习英语已经有15年多了。在飞行训练期间，我接受过专业的航空英语培训，包括无线电通讯、航空术语和面试英语等，为我的航空职业生涯打下了坚实的基础。

cards.audioText: Do you like this type of aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh: 你喜欢这种型号的飞机吗？
cards.referenceText:
Yes, I like it. It has good performance and is easy to control. What's more, it's the first aircraft I fly as a pilot, so I like it.
喜欢，它性能不错，也容易操控。而且，这是我作为飞行员驾驶的第一种飞机，所以我喜欢它 。

cards.audioText: How do you like your flight instructor? What have you learn from your flight instructor?
cards.audioTextZh: 你觉得你的飞行教员怎么样？你从飞行教员那里学到了什么？
cards.referenceText:
My flight instructor is very kind, warm - hearted/nice and professional. Not only does he teach me aeronautical knowledge, but also flight techniques. He is very strict. I’ve learned a lot from him.
我的飞行教员很友善、热心 / 人很好且很专业。他不仅教我航空知识，还传授飞行技巧。他要求很严格，我从他身上学到了很多 。

I have learned a lot from my flight instructor. First of all, I have mastered solid flight skills and professional knowledge, including various flight operation techniques and emergency disposal methods. Secondly, the instructor has always emphasized the importance of flight safety, teaching me to always put safety first, strictly abide by operating procedures, and not take any chances. In addition, the instructor's rigorous work attitude and calm response in the face of emergencies have also influenced me deeply. He taught me to maintain a good psychological quality during the flight, remain calm and rational when encountering problems, and make correct decisions quickly. Finally, the instructor also taught me the importance of teamwork and effective communication, which is crucial for ensuring flight safety.
我从飞行教员那里学到了很多东西。首先，我掌握了扎实的飞行技能和专业知识，包括各种飞行操作技巧和应急处置方法。其次，教员始终强调飞行安全的重要性，教导我要始终将安全放在首位，严格遵守操作程序，不抱有任何侥幸心理。此外，教员严谨的工作态度和面对突发情况时的沉着应对也深深影响了我。他教会我在飞行过程中要保持良好的心理素质，遇到问题时沉着冷静、理性分析，快速做出正确的决策。最后，教员还教会了我团队协作和有效沟通的重要性，这对于保障飞行安全至关重要。

cards.audioText: Can you say something about your first solo? What's the most unforgettable experience during your career?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能讲讲你的首次单飞吗？你职业生涯中最难忘的经历是什么？
cards.referenceText:
I took my first solo flight last year. That day was good for flying — the sky was clear, visibility was okay, and the wind was calm. At the beginning, I felt a bit nervous. My flight instructor encouraged me, saying I could make it. I controlled the aircraft and flew 3 traffic patterns. It’s an unforgettable experience in my life.
我去年进行了首次单飞。那天很适合飞行 —— 天空晴朗，能见度不错，风力平稳。一开始我有点紧张，飞行教员鼓励我，说我能行。我操控飞机，完成了 3 个起落航线飞行。这是我人生中难忘的经历 。

cards.audioText: What type of aircraft do you fly? Can you introduce your aircraft systems?
cards.audioTextZh: 你驾驶哪种型号的飞机？能介绍一下飞机的系统吗？
cards.referenceText:
I fly the C172. It has several aircraft systems, such as the electrical system, flight control system, landing gear, communication and navigation systems. Additionally, there are the hydraulic system, pressurization system, air conditioning system, and oxygen system.
我驾驶 C172 飞机。它配备有多个系统，比如电气系统、飞行控制系统、起落架、通信与导航系统。此外，还有液压系统、增压系统、空调系统和氧气系统 。
I currently fly the DA-40, a single-engine propeller aircraft mainly used for flight training. It can accommodate 4 people, has excellent gliding performance, long endurance, light weight and a long service life. It also requires a short takeoff and landing distance, making it very suitable for local circuit training and cross-country training for student pilots.
我目前飞行的机型是DA-40，它是一款单引擎螺旋桨飞机，主要用于飞行训练。该机型可容纳4人，滑翔性能出色，续航时间长，重量轻且使用寿命久，起飞和降落所需距离较短，非常适合飞行学员进行本场起落训练和转场训练。

cards.audioText: Do you use control column or side stick in your aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh: 你的飞机上用的是驾驶杆（control column）还是侧杆（side stick）？
cards.referenceText:
I fly C172, I use control column.
我驾驶 C172 飞机，用的是驾驶杆 。

cards.audioText: What are the advantages or disadvantages of control column/side stick?
cards.audioTextZh: 驾驶杆 / 侧杆有哪些优缺点？
cards.referenceText:
There are some advantages of the control column. Control columns control the aircraft via mechanical or hydraulic mechanisms, so we can feel that we are controlling the aircraft ourselves. However, there are some disadvantages too. Control columns take up more room in the cockpit, and we may feel stressed.
驾驶杆有一些优点，它通过机械或液压机构操控飞机，所以我们能切实感受到自己在控制飞机。不过，它也有缺点，在驾驶舱内占据的空间较大，而且我们（飞行员 ）可能会感到操作压力 。

cards.audioText: If you are given a chance to choose any type of aircraft to fly, will you choose Boeing or Airbus?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果给你机会选择驾驶任意机型，你会选波音还是空客的飞机？
cards.referenceText:
If I have a chance to choose, I will choose Airbus. Because Airbus aircraft use side sticks, so we’ll have more space and feel more comfortable. Besides, Airbus uses fly - by - wire technology, which can reduce our workload.
如果有机会选，我会选空客的飞机。因为空客飞机用侧杆，这样驾驶舱空间更大，我们（飞行员 ）也会更舒适。而且，空客采用电传操纵技术，能减轻我们的工作负担 。

cards.audioText: What are the differences between Boeing aircraft and Airbus?
cards.audioTextZh: 波音飞机和空客飞机有哪些区别？
cards.referenceText:
There are some differences between Boeing aircraft and Airbus aircraft. First, Boeing aircraft use control columns, while Airbus aircraft use side sticks. Second, Boeing aircraft are controlled by hydraulic - mechanical mechanisms, while Airbus aircraft are controlled by fly - by - wire systems.
波音飞机和空客飞机存在一些区别。首先，波音飞机采用驾驶杆（control columns ），而空客飞机使用侧杆（side sticks ）。其次，波音飞机由液压机械机构操控，空客飞机则通过电传操纵系统（fly - by - wire systems ）进行控制 。

cards.audioText: What are the technological advantages and disadvantages of the aircraft you fly now?
cards.audioTextZh: 你目前驾驶的飞机在技术方面有哪些优缺点？
cards.referenceText:
I fly the C172. It is our training aircraft during initial training. It is easy to control. However, it can only fly below 3,000m, and it can only stay airborne for about five hours.
我驾驶的是 C172 飞机，它是我们初始训练阶段用的教练机，容易操控。但它的飞行高度只能在 3000 米以下，而且续航时间大概只有五小时左右 。

cards.audioText: How many passengers can your aircraft accommodate?
cards.audioTextZh: 你的飞机能搭载多少乘客？
cards.referenceText:
I fly the C172. It can accommodate 2 passengers.
我驾驶的是 C172 飞机，它能搭载 2 名乘客 。

cards.audioText: How many types of aircraft are there in your fleet?
cards.audioTextZh: 你们机队中有多少种型号的飞机？
cards.referenceText:
In our fleet, there is only one type of aircraft C172 /A320 /B737.
我们机队中只有一种型号的飞机，即 C172/A320/B37

cards.audioText: How many kinds of type ratings do you have now? What are they?
cards.audioTextZh: 你目前有多少种型别等级（资格）？分别是什么？
cards.referenceText:
Now I have 3 type - ratings.
single engine land 单发陆地
multi - engine land 多发陆地
A320/B737                                                  目前我有 3 种型别等级（资格），分别是：
单发陆地（适用于单发、在陆地起降飞机的型别等级 ）
多发陆地（适用于多发、在陆地起降飞机的型别等级 ）
A320/B737（对应空客 A320、波音 B737 机型的型别等级，代表具备驾驶这些特定民航客机的资格 ）

cards.audioText: Please compare the aircraft you fly in your company and the aircraft you have flown in the flight school
cards.audioTextZh: 请对比你在公司驾驶的飞机和你在飞行学校飞过的飞机
cards.referenceText:
In the flight school, I fly the C172 (C172, SR20, PA44). They are the training aircraft in our initial flight training. They are easy to control.
In the company, I will fly the A320 (A320, B737). They are large commercial aircraft. They are more advanced. They may improve the aircraft performance, reduce our workload and make our flight easier and safer.
在飞行学校，我飞塞斯纳 172（C172、SR20、PA44 可选 ）。它们是我们初始飞行训练的训练用机。它们易于操控。
在公司，我将飞空客 A320（A320、B737 可选 ）。它们是大型商用飞机。它们更先进，能够提升飞机性能、减轻我们的工作负担，让飞行更轻松、安全。

cards.audioText: What is your opinion about large commercial aircraft designed and manufactured in China?
cards.audioTextZh: 你对中国自主设计和制造的大型商用飞机有什么看法？
cards.referenceText:
So far, there are some large commercial aircraft designed and made in China, such as ARJ - 21, C919. They are equipped with advanced equipment and systems and they can make our flight safe and comfortable. We feel very proud of them and we are looking forward to flying them.
迄今为止，有一些大型商用飞机是由中国自主设计和制造的，比如 ARJ - 21、C919 。它们配备了先进的设备和系统，能够保障我们飞行的安全与舒适 。我们为这些飞机感到无比骄傲，并且都盼望着能驾驶它们飞行 。

cards.audioText:
Where did you learn flying, at home or
abroad?
cards.audioTextZh: 你在哪里学习的飞行,在国内还是国外?
cards.referenceText:
I learned flying in China. The flight school I attend has complete training facilities and professional instructors, which can provide systematic and standardized flight training, helping me lay a solid foundation for my flying skills.
我在国内学习飞行。我所在的飞行学校拥有完善的训练设施和专业的教员，能够提供系统、规范的飞行训练，帮助我扎实掌握飞行技能。

cards.audioText:
Can you tell me something about
your flight school?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能告诉我你的航校吗?
cards.referenceText:
My flight school is located in a city with convenient transportation and superior geographical conditions. It has a professional teaching team composed of experienced flight instructors and ground teachers. The school is equipped with a large number of advanced training aircraft and simulators, and has a complete set of training courses covering theoretical knowledge, flight skills and emergency disposal. It attaches great importance to the safety and quality of training, and has trained a large number of outstanding aviation professionals for the industry.
我的飞行学校位于一座交通便利、地理条件优越的城市。学校拥有一支由经验丰富的飞行教员和地面教员组成的专业教学团队，配备了大量先进的训练飞机和模拟机，并且拥有涵盖理论知识、飞行技能和应急处置等方面的完整训练课程。学校非常注重训练安全和质量，为行业培养了大批优秀的航空人才。

cards.audioText: How are you today? How's everything going today?
cards.audioTextZh: 你今天过得怎么样？今天一切都还好吗？
cards.referenceText:
I'm good! Thank you for asking!
我挺好的！谢谢你的关心！

cards.audioText: How's the weather like today? Do you think today is a good day for flying? Do you like the weather today?
cards.audioTextZh: 今天天气怎么样？你觉得今天是适合飞行的好天气吗？你喜欢今天的天气吗？
cards.referenceText:
Yes, today is a good day for flying. The sky is clear, visibility is OK, wind calm. We have lovely sunshine. It is a good day for flying.
是的，今天是适合飞行的好天气。天空晴朗，能见度良好，风力平稳。阳光很宜人。是个适合飞行的好日子。
No, it is not a good day for flying. The sky is overcast, visibility is poor, it is windy/ rainy/ cloudy/ foggy.
不，今天不是适合飞行的好天气。天空阴沉，能见度差，还有风 / 下雨 / 多云 / 有雾。

cards.audioText: How did you come/get here today? How did you come to the test center? Did you drive yourself here today?
cards.audioTextZh: 你今天是怎么来这儿的？你是怎么来考试中心的？你今天是自己开车来的吗？
cards.referenceText:
I came here by taxi.
我是坐出租车来这儿的。
I came to the test center by subway today. It was convenient and punctual, avoiding traffic jams on the road.
我今天是乘坐地铁来考试中心的。既方便又准时，避免了路上的交通拥堵。

cards.audioText: Did you have a good sleep last night?
cards.audioTextZh: 昨天休息得好吗?
cards.referenceText:
Yes, I had a sound sleep last night. I went to bed early to ensure I was energetic for today's test.
是的，我昨晚睡得很好。为了保证今天考试精力充沛，我很早就休息了。

cards.audioText:
What are you going to do after
this test?
cards.audioTextZh: 这次考试结束后,你会干什么?
cards.referenceText:
after this test, I plan to review the knowledge points related to the test, summarize my shortcomings, and at the same time continue to practice my aviation English oral skills to prepare for future flight work.
考试结束后，我打算回顾一下考试相关的知识点，总结自己的不足，同时继续练习航空英语口语，为今后的飞行工作做准备。

cards.audioText:
Do you want to work in foreign
airlines?
cards.audioTextZh: 你想在外航工作吗?
cards.referenceText:
Yes, I am willing to work in foreign airlines. It can allow me to experience different aviation cultures and management models, improve my cross-cultural communication skills and comprehensive professional capabilities.
是的，我愿意在外航工作。这能让我体验不同的航空文化和管理模式，提升自己的跨文化沟通能力和综合专业素养。

cards.audioText:
In your opinion, what are the
challenges of working in a foreign
airline?
cards.audioTextZh: 在你看来,在外航工作有哪些挑战?
cards.referenceText:
In my opinion, the challenges of working in a foreign airline mainly include overcoming language barriers to ensure smooth communication with colleagues and air traffic controllers; adapting to different aviation regulations and operating procedures; and adjusting to different cultural backgrounds and work rhythms to integrate into the team quickly.
在我看来，在外航工作的挑战主要包括：克服语言障碍，确保与同事和空管的沟通顺畅；适应不同的航空法规和操作程序；以及调整自身以适应不同的文化背景和工作节奏，快速融入团队。

cards.audioText: What's your company's logo?
cards.audioTextZh: 你们公司的logo是什么?
cards.referenceText:
As a student pilot who hasn't officially joined an airline yet, I don't have a company logo corresponding to my current status. However, I have a certain understanding of the logos of many well-known airlines. For example, the logo of Air China is a phoenix pattern, symbolizing auspiciousness and nobility.
作为一名尚未正式加入航空公司的飞行学员，我目前还没有对应的公司logo。但我对许多知名航空公司的logo有一定的了解，比如中国国际航空公司的logo是凤凰图案，象征着吉祥与高贵。

cards.audioText: Do you think the ICAO English test is difficult? Which part is the most difficult for you?
cards.audioTextZh: 你觉得ICAO英语测试难吗?你觉得哪一部分最难?
cards.referenceText:
I think the ICAO English test is challenging but manageable. For me, the most difficult part is the interactive communication (e.g., discussing complex emergency scenarios). It requires fluent expression, accurate aviation terminology, and quick response to the examiner’s questions. I’ve been practicing by simulating conversations and learning professional vocabulary to improve.
我认为国际民航组织（ICAO）英语测试有挑战性但可以应对。对我来说，最难的部分是互动交流（如讨论复杂紧急情景），这需要流利的表达、准确的航空术语，以及对考官问题的快速回应。我一直在通过模拟对话和学习专业词汇来提升这方面能力。

cards.audioText: What's your current position?/Would you please introduce your working/study background.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的现任职位是什么？/ 能否请你介绍一下你的工作 / 学习背景？
cards.referenceText:
示例 1（工作背景 ）：I'm a pilot trainee. I've been studying flight theory and practical skills at flight school for [X] years, and now I'm preparing for formal flight operations.
我是一名飞行学员。我已在飞行学校学习飞行理论和实操技能 [X] 年，目前正为正式飞行任务做准备。
示例 2（学习背景 ）：I'm a student majoring in Aeronautical Engineering. I study courses like Aircraft Design, Aerodynamics, and Aviation Safety at the university, aiming to contribute to the aviation industry in the future.
我是航空工程专业的学生。我在大学学习飞机设计、空气动力学、航空安全等课程，期望未来为航空业做贡献。

cards.audioText: Are you a captain or first officer?
cards.audioTextZh: 你是机长还是副驾驶？
cards.referenceText:
示例 1：I'm a first officer. I'm gaining experience and working towards becoming a captain in the future.
我是副驾驶。我正在积累经验，期望未来成为一名机长。

示例 2：I'm a captain. I'm responsible for leading the flight crew and ensuring the safety of every flight.
我是机长。我负责带领飞行机组，保障每次飞行的安全。

cards.audioText: How many flying hours have you flown/built up/had/accumulated?
cards.audioTextZh: 你已经积累了多少飞行小时数？
cards.referenceText:
I have accumulated [X] flying hours. Through these hours, I've gained rich experience in different flight scenarios.
我已积累了 [X] 个飞行小时数。通过这些时长，我在不同飞行场景中积累了丰富经验。
Up to now, I have accumulated more than 150 flight hours, including local circuit training, cross-country training and instrument flight training, which have continuously improved my flying skills and emergency response capabilities.
到目前为止，我已经积累了150多个飞行小时，包括本场起落训练、转场训练和仪表飞行训练等，这些飞行经历让我的飞行技能和应急处置能力不断提升。

cards.audioText: What type of aircraft are you flying now?/Do you like it?/Why?
cards.audioTextZh: 你现在驾驶的是什么型号的飞机？/ 你喜欢它吗？/ 为什么？
cards.referenceText:
Yes, I like it. Because it is the first aircraft I fly. What's more, it has good performance and it is easy to control.
是的，我喜欢它。因为这是我驾驶的第一架飞机。而且，它性能不错，也容易操控。

cards.audioText: In which airline are you working for?
cards.audioTextZh: 你在哪家航空公司工作？
cards.referenceText:
Now I am a student pilot. In the future I will work for Kunming Airlines.
目前我是一名飞行学员。未来我会在昆明航空工作。
I am currently a student pilot and have not yet officially joined any airline. I am actively preparing for various assessments and examinations, hoping to join a reputable airline in the future and embark on my career as a professional pilot.
我目前还是一名飞行学员，尚未正式加入任何航空公司。我正在积极准备各项考核和考试，希望未来能够加入一家知名的航空公司，开启我的职业飞行员生涯。

cards.audioText: What type of aircraft have you flown?
cards.audioTextZh: 你飞过哪些型号的飞机？
cards.referenceText:
I have flown Cessna 172, DA - 40, Citation, King Air, Hawker - 800.
我飞过塞斯纳 172、钻石 DA - 40、赛斯纳 Citation（奖状系列 ）、比奇空中国王、豪客 800 这些机型。

cards.audioText: How many years have you been a pilot?/How many years have you worked for your company?
cards.audioTextZh: 你当飞行员多少年了？/ 你在这家公司工作多少年了？
cards.referenceText:
About 2 years.
大概 2 年了。

cards.audioText: How many type ratings have you ever had?
cards.audioTextZh: 你曾获得过多少种型别等级（资格）？
cards.referenceText:
I have flown da 40, da 42. It is a single engine land a/c, da 42 is a multi-engine high performance a/c.
我飞过钻石 DA40、钻石 DA42 。DA40 是单发陆地飞机，DA42 是多发高性能飞机

cards.audioText: When/where did you take the high performance training? What type of aircraft did you fly during the high performance training?
cards.audioTextZh: 你何时 / 何地参加的高性能飞行训练？在高性能飞行训练期间，你驾驶的是什么型号的飞机？
cards.referenceText:
I have not taken this training yet. Now I still take flight training in the flight school. I fly DA - 40 for flight training.
我还未参加过这项训练。目前我仍在飞行学校进行飞行训练，训练时驾驶的是 DA - 40 飞机。

cards.audioText: Do you like your company logo?
cards.audioTextZh: 你喜欢你公司的标志吗？
cards.referenceText:
Yes, I like it. Our company logo is a shape of Dove, it also looks like a beautiful cloud. It means freedom, peace, lucky and happiness. It is beautiful.
是的，我喜欢。我们公司的标志是鸽子的形状，看起来也像一朵漂亮的云。它象征着自由、和平、幸运和幸福。它很美。

cards.audioText: Where do you come from?/Where is your hometown?/Can you say something about your hometown? Could you introduce some good places?/What's your favorite city?
cards.audioTextZh: 你来自哪里？/ 你的家乡是哪里？/ 能讲讲你的家乡吗？可以介绍些好地方吗？/ 你最喜欢的城市是哪个？
cards.referenceText:
I think my hometown is a good place. My hometown is Xi'an in Shaanxi province. It is located in the north of China.
我觉得我的家乡是个好地方。我的家乡是陕西省的西安，它位于中国北方。

cards.audioText: Where are you living now?/How is the traffic there?
cards.audioTextZh: 你现在住在哪里？/ 那里的交通情况怎么样？
cards.referenceText:
Now I'm living in Xi'an. The traffic is busy, there is a traffic jam. Maybe because it is a big city.
我现在住在西安。交通很繁忙，会有堵车情况。可能因为它是一座大城市吧。

cards.audioText: Which one do you like better, your hometown or the city you're living now?
cards.audioTextZh: 你更喜欢哪个，你的家乡还是你现在居住的城市？
cards.referenceText:
I love my hometown. Because I grew up there and I'm familiar with everything there. Besides, my family still stay in my hometown.
我热爱我的家乡。因为我在那里长大，对那里的一切都很熟悉。此外，我的家人仍留在我的家乡。

cards.audioText:
Where did you receive your high
performance flight training?
cards.audioTextZh: 你在哪里接受的高性能飞行训练？
cards.referenceText:
I received high performance flight training at [name of flight school/training center], which included theoretical courses, simulator training, and actual flight practice.
我在[飞行学校/训练中心名称]接受了高性能飞行训练，包括理论课程、模拟机训练和实际飞行练习。

cards.audioText:
What type of aircraft did you fly
during high performance training?
cards.audioTextZh: 你在高性能飞行训练中驾驶的是哪种机型？
cards.referenceText:
During high performance training, I flew  [name of aircraft]， which is a single-propeller training aircraft suitable for mastering high-performance flight skills.
高性能飞行训练期间，我驾驶的是[飞机名称]，这是一款适用于掌握高性能飞行技能的单螺旋桨训练机。

cards.audioText:
How many flying hours did you
accumulate during high performance
training?
cards.audioTextZh: 你在高性能飞行训练中积累了多少飞行小时？
cards.referenceText:
I accumulated [X] flying hours during high performance training, covering key training subjects such as takeoff, landing, and emergency disposal.
我在高性能飞行训练期间积累了[X]飞行小时，涵盖起飞、着陆、应急处置等关键训练科目。

cards.audioText:
Are you a student pilot or a first
officer?
cards.audioTextZh: 你是飞行学员还是副驾驶?
cards.referenceText: I am a student pilot currently undergoing flight training.我是一名正在接受飞行训练的飞行学员。

cards.audioText:
Where is your hometown? What is
your hometown famous for?
cards.audioTextZh:
你的家乡在哪里?你的家乡以什么闻
名?
cards.referenceText: My hometown is Chengdu, Sichuan Province. It is famous for delicious Sichuan cuisine like hot pot and mapo tofu, as well as iconic attractions such as Chengdu Research Base of Giant Panda Breeding.我的家乡在四川省成都市。它以火锅、麻婆豆腐等美味的川菜，以及成都大熊猫繁育研究基地等标志性景点而闻名。

cards.audioText:
What's the weather like in your
hometown?
cards.audioTextZh: 你家乡的天气如何?
cards.referenceText: The weather in my hometown is mild and humid. Summers are not extremely hot and winters are relatively warm, with abundant rainfall mainly in summer and autumn.我家乡的天气温和湿润。夏季不太炎热，冬季相对温暖，降水主要集中在夏秋季。

cards.audioText:
Could you please make a comparison
between your hometown and the city
you live?
cards.audioTextZh:
你可以比较下你的家乡和你现在居住的
城市吗?
cards.referenceText: My hometown is a laid-back city with a strong cultural atmosphere and slow pace of life, while the city I live in now is a bustling aviation hub with faster work rhythm and more convenient transportation networks, especially in terms of air travel.我的家乡是一座悠闲的城市，文化氛围浓厚，生活节奏缓慢；而我现在居住的城市是繁忙的航空枢纽，工作节奏更快，交通网络更便捷，尤其是航空出行方面。

cards.audioText:
Can you name some interesting
places in your hometown?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能说出你家乡一些有趣的地方吗?
cards.referenceText: Interesting places in my hometown include Chengdu Research Base of Giant Panda Breeding, where you can see cute giant pandas; Jinli Ancient Street, which showcases traditional Sichuan customs; and Dujiangyan Irrigation System, a world cultural heritage with brilliant ancient engineering.我家乡有趣的地方有成都大熊猫繁育研究基地，在那里可以看到可爱的大熊猫；锦里古街，展现了四川传统民俗；还有都江堰水利工程，一项有着辉煌古代工程技术的世界文化遗产。

cards.audioText:
What's your favorite means of
transportation?
cards.audioTextZh: 你最喜欢的交通方式是什么?
cards.referenceText: My favorite means of transportation is by air. It is fast and efficient, especially for long-distance travel, and it also allows me to experience the charm of aviation firsthand.我最喜欢的交通方式是飞机。它快捷高效，尤其是长途旅行时，还能让我亲身感受航空的魅力。

cards.audioText:
Do you think purchasing a car is
necessary in your hometown?
cards.audioTextZh: 你觉得在你的家乡有必要买车吗?
cards.referenceText:
I think it depends on personal needs. For families living in suburban areas or with frequent travel needs to remote places, a car is more convenient; but for those living in the downtown with convenient public transportation, purchasing a car may not be necessary.
我觉得这取决于个人需求。对于居住在郊区或经常需要前往偏远地区的家庭来说，汽车会更方便；但对于居住在市中心、公共交通便利的人来说，买车可能就不是必需的。

cards.audioText:
Have you ever been abroad?
Which place do you want to visit
most?
cards.audioTextZh: 你出过国吗?你最想去的是什么地方?
cards.referenceText:
No, I haven't been abroad yet. The place I want to visit most is the United States, as it has many world-renowned aviation museums and advanced aviation training institutions, which I hope to visit to learn about advanced aviation technology and concepts.
我还没有出过国。我最想去的地方是美国，因为那里有许多世界著名的航空博物馆和先进的航空培训机构，希望能去学习了解先进的航空技术和理念。

cards.audioText:
Have you ever flown the
international flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 你飞过国际航班吗?
cards.referenceText:
No, I haven't flown an international flight yet. At present, my flight experience is mainly focused on domestic training flights. However, I have learned relevant knowledge about international flight operations during theoretical study, and I look forward to having the opportunity to fly international routes and accumulate relevant experience after becoming a professional pilot.
我还没有飞过国际航班。目前我的飞行经历主要集中在国内的训练飞行。不过在理论学习中，我已经学习了国际航班运行的相关知识，期待成为职业飞行员后，有机会执飞国际航线，积累相关经验。

cards.audioText: Does your company have any international routes?
cards.audioTextZh: 你们公司有任何国际航线吗?
cards.referenceText:
Yes, my company operates several international routes connecting major cities worldwide. These routes require compliance with international aviation regulations, proficiency in English radio communication, and familiarity with foreign airport procedures and weather characteristics.
是的，我们公司运营多条连接全球主要城市的国际航线。这些航线要求遵守国际民航规则，熟练掌握英语无线电通讯，并熟悉境外机场的运行程序和气象特点。

cards.audioText: Which do you prefer, the international routes or domestic routes?
cards.audioTextZh: 你更喜欢哪一个,国际航线还是国内航线?
cards.referenceText:
I appreciate both. International routes offer opportunities to experience different cultures and aviation environments, while domestic routes have more familiar procedures and stable weather. Regardless, I strictly follow SOP to ensure flight safety.
两者我都很认可。国际航线能让人体验不同的文化和航空环境，而国内航线的运行程序更熟悉、气象条件更稳定。无论哪种航线，我都会严格遵循标准操作程序（SOP）确保飞行安全。

cards.audioText: Do you prefer long haul routes or short haul routes?
cards.audioTextZh: 你是喜欢长航线还是短航线?
cards.referenceText:
I don’t have a strong preference. Long-haul routes require better physical fitness and fatigue management, while short-haul routes demand quick adaptation to frequent takeoffs and landings. Both help improve skills, and I focus on safe operation in all scenarios.
我没有强烈的偏好。长航线需要更好的体能和疲劳管理能力，而短航线要求快速适应频繁的起降。两种航线都能提升飞行技能，我会专注于在所有场景下安全运行。

cards.audioText: What's your hobby?
cards.audioTextZh: 你的爱好是什么？
cards.referenceText:
示例 1（飞行相关爱好 ）
I like flying model planes. It helps me understand aircraft better and feels like a mini version of real flight.
我喜欢飞航模。它能帮我更了解飞机，而且感觉就像真实飞行的迷你版。
示例 2（通用爱好 ）
My hobby is reading books, especially those about aviation history. It broadens my knowledge of the industry.
我的爱好是读书，尤其是关于航空历史的书。这能拓宽我对这个行业的认知。

cards.audioText: Do you have any hobbies?
cards.audioTextZh: 你有什么爱好吗？
cards.referenceText:
示例 1（航空关联爱好 ）
Yes, I do. I love flying drones. It lets me experience the fun of flight from a different perspective and practice my control skills.
有呀，我喜欢飞无人机。它能让我从不同视角体验飞行乐趣，还能练习操控技巧。
示例 2（通用爱好 ）
Sure! I’m into hiking. It allows me to get close to nature and enjoy beautiful scenery, which relaxes me a lot.
当然！我喜欢徒步旅行。这能让我亲近自然、欣赏美景，特别放松。

cards.audioText: What do you like to do if you are not flying?
cards.audioTextZh: 不飞行的时候，你喜欢做什么？
cards.referenceText:
示例 1（航空关联活动 ）
I enjoy studying aviation history. Reading stories about early pilots and classic aircrafts helps me appreciate the industry’s development more.
我喜欢研究航空历史。阅读早期飞行员和经典飞机的故事，能让我更了解这个行业的发展。
示例 2（日常休闲 ）
When not flying, I like to cook. Trying new recipes and making delicious meals is a relaxing way to spend my time.
不飞行时，我喜欢做饭。尝试新食谱、做美味菜肴，是很放松的消遣方式。

cards.audioText: What do you like to do during spare time/free time?
cards.audioTextZh: 你在业余时间喜欢做什么？
cards.referenceText:
I like swimming and running very much. They can train me to have a strong body and have a quick mind.
我很喜欢游泳和跑步。它们能锻炼我拥有强壮的身体和敏捷的思维。

cards.audioText: Do you like travelling?
cards.audioTextZh: 你喜欢旅行吗？
cards.referenceText:
Yes, I like traveling.
是的，我喜欢旅行。

cards.audioText: Have you ever been abroad?/Have you ever been to any foreign countries?
cards.audioTextZh: 你出过国吗？/ 你去过哪些外国国家？
cards.referenceText:
Yes, I have been to Australia, America, Japan and South Africa.
是的，我去过澳大利亚、美国、日本和南非。

cards.audioText: Do you like music?
cards.audioTextZh: 你喜欢音乐吗？
cards.referenceText:
Yes. I like music.
是的，我喜欢音乐。

cards.audioText: Do you like seeing films/watching movies?
cards.audioTextZh: 你喜欢看电影吗？
cards.referenceText:
Yes, I like watching movies. They let me experience different stories.
是的，我喜欢看电影。它们能让我体验不同的故事。

cards.audioText: What type of movie do you like best?
cards.audioTextZh: 你最喜欢哪种类型的电影？
cards.referenceText:
I like action, comedy, horror, romance, documentaries and cartoons. As long as it’s a good movie, I love it.
我喜欢动作片、喜剧片、恐怖片、爱情片、纪录片和动画片。只要是好电影，我都喜欢。

cards.audioText: What's your favorite movie?
cards.audioTextZh: 你最喜欢的电影是什么？
cards.referenceText:
I like Sully very much. It tells the story of Captain Sully’s successful river ditching after a bird strike causes engine failure. He’s a hero.
我非常喜欢《萨利机长》（Sully ）。它讲述了萨利机长在鸟击导致引擎失效后，成功在河面迫降的故事。他是个英雄。

cards.audioText: Who is your favorite movie star?
cards.audioTextZh: 你最喜欢的电影明星是谁？
cards.referenceText:
I like Tom Cruise. He’s handsome, charming, and amazing in Mission: Impossible.
我喜欢汤姆・克鲁斯。他帅气迷人，在《碟中谍》里的表现超精彩。

cards.audioText: Do you like reading?/What's your favorite book?
cards.audioTextZh: 你喜欢阅读吗？/ 你最喜欢的书是什么
cards.referenceText:
Yes, I like reading. My favorite book is To Kill a Mockingbird — it’s full of wisdom.
是的，我喜欢阅读。我最喜欢的书是《杀死一只知更鸟》—— 充满智慧。

cards.audioText: Do you like doing sports/outdoor activities? What's your favorite sport? How often do you do sports? Who is your favorite sport star?
cards.audioTextZh: 你喜欢做运动 / 户外活动吗？你最喜欢的运动是什么？你多久做一次运动？你最喜欢的体育明星是谁？
cards.referenceText:
Yes, I like sports — swimming and running are my favorites, as they build my strength and sharp mind. I do them daily/twice a week, and I admire Kobe Bryant, though he sadly died in a helicopter crash.
是的，我喜欢运动 —— 游泳和跑步是我的最爱，因为它们塑造我的力量与敏捷思维。我每天 / 一周做两次，还很敬佩科比・布莱恩特，尽管他不幸在直升机坠毁事故中离世。

cards.audioText: Do you often use computer? Do you think computer has changed people's life?
cards.audioTextZh: 你经常用电脑吗？你认为电脑改变人们的生活了吗？
cards.referenceText:
Yes, I often use a computer. It definitely has changed our lives — we now work, watch movies, play games, and search for info daily, making it an essential part of life.
是的，我经常用电脑。它确实改变了我们的生活 —— 我们现在每天用它工作、看电影、打游戏、查资料，让它成了生活中必不可少的一部分。

cards.audioText: What type of music do you like best?/What's your favorite music?
cards.audioTextZh: 你最喜欢哪种音乐类型？/ 你最喜欢的音乐是什么
cards.referenceText:
I like blues, jazz, pop, light music, folk, and rock. As long as it’s good, I love it.
我喜欢蓝调、爵士乐、流行乐、轻音乐、民谣和摇滚。只要是好音乐，我都喜欢。

I prefer light music. Its gentle melody and soothing rhythm relax my mind and relieve stress after training. It creates a quiet atmosphere, helping me focus while reading or thinking. Cheerful light music also lifts my mood— it’s perfect for my daily life and study, bringing positive energy.
我最喜欢轻音乐。它旋律柔和、节奏舒缓，能在训练后放松身心、缓解压力；还能营造安静氛围，帮助我在阅读或思考时集中注意力。欢快的轻音乐还能改善心情，非常适合我的日常生活和学习，带来正能量。

cards.audioText: Who is your favorite singer?
cards.audioTextZh: 你最喜欢的歌手是谁？
cards.referenceText:
I like Jay Zhou. I think his music is very touching and beautiful.
我喜欢周杰伦（Jay Zhou ）。我觉得他的音乐非常动人且美妙。

cards.audioText: How often do you go to the cinema?
cards.audioTextZh: 你多久去一次电影院？
cards.referenceText:
About twice a month.
大概一个月两次。

cards.audioText: Do you like shopping online/surfing on Internet? Which website do you usually visit?/Why?
cards.audioTextZh: 你喜欢网购 / 上网冲浪吗？你常访问哪个网站？/ 为什么？
cards.referenceText:
Yes, I like shopping online. I often visit Taobao. Because the goods are cheap and cheerful. What's more, the transportation is very fast.
是的，我喜欢网购。我常逛淘宝。因为商品物美价廉，而且物流也很快。
My favorite website is the official website of CAAC (Civil Aviation Administration of China). It provides authoritative aviation regulations, safety notices, and industry updates. As a pilot, it helps me stay compliant with rules and grasp the latest policies, which is crucial for professional development and flight safety.
我最喜欢的网址是中国民用航空局（CAAC）的官方网站。它提供权威的航空法规、安全通告和行业动态。作为飞行员，这有助于我遵守规则、掌握最新政策，对职业发展和飞行安全至关重要。

cards.imageAlt: 夜航驾驶舱航空场景图片

cards.audioText: What hazards do we have during night flying?
cards.audioTextZh: 夜间飞行有哪些危险？
cards.referenceText: The main risks are reduced visibility, cockpit workload, spatial disorientation, and difficulty judging terrain or clouds. These risks may reduce safety margins and increase crew workload, so pilots should monitor the aircraft carefully and be ready to take conservative action.
cards.referenceTextZh: 主要风险包括能见度降低、驾驶舱工作负荷增加、空间定向困难以及地形和云的判断变难。这些风险会降低安全裕度并增加机组工作负荷，因此飞行员应认真监控飞机状态，并准备采取保守处置。

cards.audioText: What preparations will you make before a night flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 夜航前你会做哪些准备？
cards.referenceText: I would brief the threat, check the relevant aircraft systems and performance, coordinate with ATC and the crew, and follow the checklist. If safety is not assured, I would delay, discontinue, reject, go around, or divert as appropriate.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我会完成威胁简令，检查相关飞机系统和性能，与管制和机组协同，并执行检查单。如果安全无法保证，我会根据情况选择延误、中止、拒绝起飞、复飞或备降。

cards.imageAlt: 机翼积冰航空场景图片

cards.audioText: Please describe what you can see in this picture
cards.audioTextZh: 请描述你在这张图片中看到的内容。
cards.referenceText: In this picture, I can see a situation related to Wing ice contamination. The key points are loss of lift, increased drag, higher stall speed, and possible control problems. It is important for the crew to recognize the risk early, keep good communication, and follow standard operating procedures.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在这张图片中，我看到的是与机翼积冰有关的情况。关键点包括升力下降、阻力增加、失速速度提高以及可能的操纵困难。机组应及早识别风险，保持良好沟通，并按照标准操作程序处置。

cards.audioText: What risks will ice on the wing surface bring to flight safety?
cards.audioTextZh: 机翼表面积冰会给飞行安全带来哪些风险？
cards.referenceText: The main risks are loss of lift, increased drag, higher stall speed, and possible control problems. These risks may reduce safety margins and increase crew workload, so pilots should monitor the aircraft carefully and be ready to take conservative action.
cards.referenceTextZh: 主要风险包括升力下降、阻力增加、失速速度提高以及可能的操纵困难。这些风险会降低安全裕度并增加机组工作负荷，因此飞行员应认真监控飞机状态，并准备采取保守处置。

cards.audioText: What should you do if you find ice or frost on the wing before departure?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果离场前发现机翼上有冰或霜，你应该怎么做？
cards.referenceText: This situation is related to Wing ice contamination. I would identify the threat, communicate clearly, follow the checklist, and choose the safest option according to aircraft status and operating conditions.
cards.referenceTextZh: 这种情况与机翼积冰有关。我会识别威胁，清楚沟通，执行检查单，并根据飞机状态和运行条件选择最安全的方案。

cards.imageAlt: 夜间跑道起飞航空场景图片

cards.audioText: What preparations should be done before taking off from this runway at night?
cards.audioTextZh: 夜间从这条跑道起飞前应做哪些准备？
cards.referenceText: I would brief the threat, check the relevant aircraft systems and performance, coordinate with ATC and the crew, and follow the checklist. If safety is not assured, I would delay, discontinue, reject, go around, or divert as appropriate.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我会完成威胁简令，检查相关飞机系统和性能，与管制和机组协同，并执行检查单。如果安全无法保证，我会根据情况选择延误、中止、拒绝起飞、复飞或备降。

cards.audioText: What potential risks might there be during night take - off from this view?
cards.audioTextZh: 从这个视角看，夜间起飞可能有哪些潜在风险？
cards.referenceText: The main risks are runway lights, correct performance calculation, departure briefing, and careful monitoring of runway alignment. These risks may reduce safety margins and increase crew workload, so pilots should monitor the aircraft carefully and be ready to take conservative action.
cards.referenceTextZh: 主要风险包括检查跑道灯光、核实性能计算、完成离场简令并仔细监控跑道方向。这些风险会降低安全裕度并增加机组工作负荷，因此飞行员应认真监控飞机状态，并准备采取保守处置。

cards.audioText: What other runway lighting facilities do you know?
cards.audioTextZh: 你还知道哪些其他跑道灯光设施？
cards.referenceText: This situation is related to Night runway takeoff. I would identify the threat, communicate clearly, follow the checklist, and choose the safest option according to aircraft status and operating conditions.
cards.referenceTextZh: 这种情况与夜间跑道起飞有关。我会识别威胁，清楚沟通，执行检查单，并根据飞机状态和运行条件选择最安全的方案。

cards.imageAlt: 飞机接近风险航空场景图片

cards.audioText: If you are the captain, what should you do when encountering a situation where these two aircraft seem to be in close proximity?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果你是机长，遇到两架飞机看起来距离很近的情况时应该怎么做？
cards.referenceText: In this picture, I can see a situation related to Aircraft proximity. The key points are loss of separation, wake turbulence, runway incursion, and misunderstanding of ATC instructions. It is important for the crew to recognize the risk early, keep good communication, and follow standard operating procedures.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在这张图片中，我看到的是与飞机接近风险有关的情况。关键点包括间隔丧失、尾流影响、跑道侵入以及误解管制指令。机组应及早识别风险，保持良好沟通，并按照标准操作程序处置。

cards.audioText: What factors may cause that situations?
cards.audioTextZh: 哪些因素可能导致这种情况？
cards.referenceText: Possible factors include loss of separation, wake turbulence, runway incursion, and misunderstanding of ATC instructions. Human factors, weather, aircraft condition, airport environment, and communication problems may also contribute to the situation.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可能因素包括间隔丧失、尾流影响、跑道侵入以及误解管制指令。人的因素、天气、飞机状态、机场环境以及沟通问题也可能共同导致这种情况。

cards.imageAlt: 起落架异常航空场景图片

cards.audioText: Is the landing gear of this aircraft retracted on the ground? What could be the possible reasons and consequences?
cards.audioTextZh: 这架飞机的起落架是否在地面收起？可能的原因和后果是什么？
cards.referenceText: The main risks are mechanical failure, unsafe gear indication, maintenance error, and serious structural damage. These risks may reduce safety margins and increase crew workload, so pilots should monitor the aircraft carefully and be ready to take conservative action.
cards.referenceTextZh: 主要风险包括机械故障、不安全起落架指示、维修差错以及严重结构损伤。这些风险会降低安全裕度并增加机组工作负荷，因此飞行员应认真监控飞机状态，并准备采取保守处置。

cards.imageAlt: 冬季起飞前运行航空场景图片

cards.audioText: What flight pre - takeoff preparations should you make if you encounter this situation?
cards.audioTextZh: 遇到这种情况时，起飞前你应做哪些飞行准备？
cards.referenceText: I would brief the threat, check the relevant aircraft systems and performance, coordinate with ATC and the crew, and follow the checklist. If safety is not assured, I would delay, discontinue, reject, go around, or divert as appropriate.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我会完成威胁简令，检查相关飞机系统和性能，与管制和机组协同，并执行检查单。如果安全无法保证，我会根据情况选择延误、中止、拒绝起飞、复飞或备降。

cards.audioText: What challenges will pilots face in such weather conditions?
cards.audioTextZh: 在这种天气条件下飞行员会面临哪些挑战？
cards.referenceText: The main risks are contaminated surfaces, low visibility, reduced braking action, and de-icing requirements. These risks may reduce safety margins and increase crew workload, so pilots should monitor the aircraft carefully and be ready to take conservative action.
cards.referenceTextZh: 主要风险包括道面污染、低能见度、刹车效应降低以及除冰需求。这些风险会降低安全裕度并增加机组工作负荷，因此飞行员应认真监控飞机状态，并准备采取保守处置。

cards.audioText: How should pilots prepare to avoid such situations?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员应如何准备以避免这种情况？
cards.referenceText: I would brief the threat, check the relevant aircraft systems and performance, coordinate with ATC and the crew, and follow the checklist. If safety is not assured, I would delay, discontinue, reject, go around, or divert as appropriate.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我会完成威胁简令，检查相关飞机系统和性能，与管制和机组协同，并执行检查单。如果安全无法保证，我会根据情况选择延误、中止、拒绝起飞、复飞或备降。

cards.imageAlt: 高高原机场航空场景图片

cards.audioText: What is the high - elevation airport?
cards.audioTextZh: 什么是高高原机场？
cards.referenceText: A high-elevation airport is an airport located at a high altitude above sea level. Because the air is thinner, aircraft performance, approach planning, and landing distance must be checked very carefully.

cards.referenceTextZh: 可能因素包括起飞重量大、抬轮技术不当、重心偏后以及性能计算错误。人的因素、天气、飞机状态、机场环境以及沟通问题也可能共同导致这种情况。

cards.imageAlt: 地面保障事故航空场景图片

cards.audioText: What factors may lead to that situation?
cards.audioTextZh: 哪些因素可能导致这种情况？
cards.referenceText: Possible factors include poor communication, unsafe equipment positioning, weak marshalling, and ramp congestion. Human factors, weather, aircraft condition, airport environment, and communication problems may also contribute to the situation.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可能因素包括沟通不畅、设备停放不安全、引导不足以及机坪拥堵。人的因素、天气、飞机状态、机场环境以及沟通问题也可能共同导致这种情况。

cards.audioText: How to avoid such accidents from happening?
cards.audioTextZh: 如何避免此类事故发生？
cards.referenceText: In this picture, I can see a situation related to Ground service accident. The key points are poor communication, unsafe equipment positioning, weak marshalling, and ramp congestion. It is important for the crew to recognize the risk early, keep good communication, and follow standard operating procedures.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在这张图片中，我看到的是与地面保障事故有关的情况。关键点包括沟通不畅、设备停放不安全、引导不足以及机坪拥堵。机组应及早识别风险，保持良好沟通，并按照标准操作程序处置。

cards.imageAlt: 积雪和结冰污染航空场景图片

cards.audioText: What risks will snow and ice on aircraft surfaces bring to flight safety?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞机表面积雪和结冰会给飞行安全带来哪些风险？
cards.referenceText: The main risks are loss of lift, higher drag, inaccurate airspeed indications, and possible control difficulty. These risks may reduce safety margins and increase crew workload, so pilots should monitor the aircraft carefully and be ready to take conservative action.
cards.referenceTextZh: 主要风险包括升力损失、阻力增大、空速指示不准以及可能操纵困难。这些风险会降低安全裕度并增加机组工作负荷，因此飞行员应认真监控飞机状态，并准备采取保守处置。

cards.audioText: How can ice contamination on wings affect the flight safety?
cards.audioTextZh: 机翼冰污染会如何影响飞行安全？
cards.referenceText: This situation is related to Snow and ice contamination. I would identify the threat, communicate clearly, follow the checklist, and choose the safest option according to aircraft status and operating conditions.
cards.referenceTextZh: 这种情况与积雪和结冰污染有关。我会识别威胁，清楚沟通，执行检查单，并根据飞机状态和运行条件选择最安全的方案。

cards.audioText: Under that situation,what should pilots do to make sure the flight safety?
cards.audioTextZh: 在这种情况下，飞行员应做什么来确保飞行安全？
cards.referenceText: This situation is related to Snow and ice contamination. I would identify the threat, communicate clearly, follow the checklist, and choose the safest option according to aircraft status and operating conditions.
cards.referenceTextZh: 这种情况与积雪和结冰污染有关。我会识别威胁，清楚沟通，执行检查单，并根据飞机状态和运行条件选择最安全的方案。

cards.imageAlt: 鸟击航空场景图片

cards.audioText: Please describe what you can observe in this photograph.
cards.audioTextZh: 请描述你在这张照片中能观察到的内容。
cards.referenceText: In this picture, I can see a situation related to Bird strike. The key points are bird strike, volcanic ash, hail, severe turbulence, or foreign object ingestion in flight. It is important for the crew to recognize the risk early, keep good communication, and follow standard operating procedures.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在这张图片中，我看到的是与鸟击有关的情况。关键点包括鸟击、火山灰、冰雹、严重颠簸或空中外来物吸入。机组应及早识别风险，保持良好沟通，并按照标准操作程序处置。

cards.audioText: As captain,if you encounter that situation,how will you handle it?
cards.audioTextZh: 作为机长，如果遇到这种情况，你会如何处置？
cards.referenceText: I would brief the threat, check the relevant aircraft systems and performance, coordinate with ATC and the crew, and follow the checklist. If safety is not assured, I would delay, discontinue, reject, go around, or divert as appropriate.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我会完成威胁简令，检查相关飞机系统和性能，与管制和机组协同，并执行检查单。如果安全无法保证，我会根据情况选择延误、中止、拒绝起飞、复飞或备降。

cards.audioText: What external factors in the air can trigger that situation?
cards.audioTextZh: 空中哪些外部因素可能触发这种情况？
cards.referenceText: Possible factors include bird strike, volcanic ash, hail, severe turbulence, or foreign object ingestion in flight. Human factors, weather, aircraft condition, airport environment, and communication problems may also contribute to the situation.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可能因素包括鸟击、火山灰、冰雹、严重颠簸或空中外来物吸入。人的因素、天气、飞机状态、机场环境以及沟通问题也可能共同导致这种情况。

cards.imageAlt: 山区夜间进近航空场景图片

cards.audioText: What weather conditions will further reduce visibility during night landing on such terrain airports?
cards.audioTextZh: 在这类地形机场夜间着陆时，哪些天气条件会进一步降低能见度？
cards.referenceText: This situation is related to Night terrain approach. I would identify the threat, communicate clearly, follow the checklist, and choose the safest option according to aircraft status and operating conditions.
cards.referenceTextZh: 这种情况与山区夜间进近有关。我会识别威胁，清楚沟通，执行检查单，并根据飞机状态和运行条件选择最安全的方案。

cards.audioText: What are the functions of the runway lights?
cards.audioTextZh: 跑道灯光有哪些功能？
cards.referenceText: The main benefit is improved situational awareness. Compared with the older method, it gives pilots clearer information, better monitoring, and more time to make safe decisions.
cards.referenceTextZh: 主要好处是提升态势感知。与较旧的方式相比，它能给飞行员更清晰的信息、更好的监控能力，并为安全决策争取更多时间。

cards.audioText: What pre-descent briefings help pilot handle night approach risks
cards.audioTextZh: 下降前哪些简令有助于飞行员处理夜间进近风险？
cards.referenceText: The main risks are low cloud, rain, fog, terrain shadow, and limited visual references. These risks may reduce safety margins and increase crew workload, so pilots should monitor the aircraft carefully and be ready to take conservative action.
cards.referenceTextZh: 主要风险包括低云、降雨、雾、地形阴影以及目视参照有限。这些风险会降低安全裕度并增加机组工作负荷，因此飞行员应认真监控飞机状态，并准备采取保守处置。

cards.imageAlt: 地面火灾应急航空场景图片

cards.audioText: Please describe the emergency scene you see in this picture.
cards.audioTextZh: 请描述你在图片中看到的紧急场景。
cards.referenceText: In this picture, I can see a situation related to Ground fire emergency. The key points are fuel, hot brakes, leaking fluids, ground equipment, and delayed emergency response. It is important for the crew to recognize the risk early, keep good communication, and follow standard operating procedures.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在这张图片中，我看到的是与地面火灾应急有关的情况。关键点包括燃油、热刹车、液体泄漏、地面设备以及应急响应延迟。机组应及早识别风险，保持良好沟通，并按照标准操作程序处置。

cards.audioText: What factors increase the risk of that situation
cards.audioTextZh: 哪些因素会增加这种情况的风险？
cards.referenceText: The main risks are fuel, hot brakes, leaking fluids, ground equipment, and delayed emergency response. These risks may reduce safety margins and increase crew workload, so pilots should monitor the aircraft carefully and be ready to take conservative action.
cards.referenceTextZh: 主要风险包括燃油、热刹车、液体泄漏、地面设备以及应急响应延迟。这些风险会降低安全裕度并增加机组工作负荷，因此飞行员应认真监控飞机状态，并准备采取保守处置。

cards.audioText: If you operate an aircraft parked near this malfunctioning burning aircraft, what actions will you take to stay safe?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果你操作的飞机停在这架故障起火飞机附近，你会采取哪些行动保证安全？
cards.referenceText: I would brief the threat, check the relevant aircraft systems and performance, coordinate with ATC and the crew, and follow the checklist. If safety is not assured, I would delay, discontinue, reject, go around, or divert as appropriate.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我会完成威胁简令，检查相关飞机系统和性能，与管制和机组协同，并执行检查单。如果安全无法保证，我会根据情况选择延误、中止、拒绝起飞、复飞或备降。

title: 故事复诵
description: 发音 结构 词汇 流利度 理解能力

cards.audioText: AFR123 crashed at Singapore Changi Airport during takeoff. The tower controller instructed the crew to takeoff on Runway 02L, but the crew lined up runway 02R and began their takeoff rolling. The aircraft overran the runway and crashed. Crew members and 110 passengers were killed, and the co-pilot was badly wounded. According to the investigation, there were three reasons for the accidents. First of all, the crew didn't use effective methods to verify their position. Secondly, the crew forgot to check whether they were on the correct runway or not. Finally, the crew members' idle chatting during the taxi resulted the loss of situation awareness.
cards.audioTextZh: AFR123在新加坡樟宜机场起飞期间坠毁。塔台管制员指示机组从02L跑道起飞，但机组却在02R跑道对正并开始起飞滑跑。飞机冲出跑道并坠毁。机组成员和110名乘客遇难，副驾驶严重受伤。调查显示，这起事故有三个原因。首先，机组没有采用有效方法确认自己所在的位置。其次，机组忘记检查自己是否位于正确的跑道。最后，机组成员在滑行期间闲聊，导致情景意识丧失。

cards.audioText: An A320 collided with a B737 during taxi. The right ailerons of B737 was severely damaged but A320 only had minor damage on left wing. Luckily, there were no injuries. After receiving taxi instruction, the A320 began to pass the B737 from the right side. The captain of A320 thought they had enough room. But unfortunately, two aircraft collided together. Both captains reported the collision immediately. Because the Boeing aircraft was damaged seriously, fuel leakage was reported and fire services were required. Fortunately, the fuel leak didn't develop into fire. The crew of the Boeing aircraft complained that they just parked stationary with the parking brakes when they were hit.
cards.audioTextZh: 一架A320在滑行期间与一架B737相撞。B737的右副翼严重受损，而A320的左翼仅轻微受损。幸运的是，没有人员受伤。收到滑行指令后，A320开始从B737右侧通过。A320机长认为有足够空间可以通过，但两架飞机不幸发生碰撞。两位机长立即报告了相撞情况。由于波音飞机受损严重，机组报告发生燃油泄漏并请求消防救援。幸运的是，泄漏的燃油没有起火。波音飞机机组表示，他们被撞时一直设置着停留刹车，停在原地。

cards.audioText: A pilot of Air China airline told us an event with landing gear problem. After normal push-back, start-up and taxi, he requested takeoff. However, he was instructed to hold short of the runway in order to give way to ACA702 on final. ACA702 declared emergency because of landing gear problem. ACA702 asked for a low pass. The controller verified the landing gear was still in up position. Then ACA702 requested a touch and go to jar the jammed gear. Unfortunately, the landing gear still couldn't be extended. So, ACA702 had to make a belly landing on a foamed runway. There were no casualties except some minor injuries.
cards.audioTextZh: 国航的一名飞行员告诉了我们一起关于起落架问题的事件。在正常的推出、开车和滑行后，他请求起飞。然而，他被指示在跑道外等待，以便给五边的ACA702让路。不过，ACA702因为起落架问题宣布进入紧急状态，并且请求低空通场，管制员证实起落架仍在收上位。然后ACA702请求飞一个连续起飞去把起落架震动下来。但是，起落架仍然没放下来。因此，ACA702必须要做一个机腹着陆，并且跑道要铺泡沫。除了一些人员受到轻伤外，没有人员伤亡。

cards.audioText: When the pilot initially contacted the tower controller, he was told the Runway Visual Range was 500 m. The pilot executed a missed approach because of no contact at minima. Then, he was given radar vectors for a second ILS approach. In the second approach, the controller issued landing clearance at outer marker. One minute later, the controller observed the airplane was leaving the glide path on the radar display and issued missed approach instructions again. There was no further reply from the pilot. The airplane impacted a building and crashed. According to the investigation, the poor visibility made the pilot nervous and he misunderstood the missed approach instructions and made a wrong turn. (113 words)
cards.audioTextZh: 当飞行员最初联系塔台管制员时，他被告知跑道视程为500米。由于最低高度跑道不可见，飞行员执行了复飞。之后，管制员雷达引导进行第二次盲降进近。在第二次进近中，管制员在外指点标处发布了着陆许可。一分钟后，管制员在雷达屏幕上观察到飞机正在偏离下滑道，所以他再次发出复飞指令。后来再没有收到飞行员的回复。飞机撞上建筑物，坠毁了。据调查，低能见度让飞行员变得非常紧张，他误解了复飞指令，转弯出现失误。

cards.audioText: A Delta Airline aircraft departed from Shanghai to Seoul. It carried 256 passengers and 13 crew members on board. During takeoff rolling, an unknown foreign object was sucked into port engine and the engine fire warning light illuminated. Then the flight crew declared an emergency right after airborne and completed the emergency checklist procedure. Through good communication, the controller understood the flight crew wanted to return to land. But the pilot had to dump fuel before landing because the aircraft was overweight to land. So the controller vectored the aircraft to the dumping area. After circling over the sea and dumping fuel for almost one hour, the plane returned to land safely (112 words)
cards.audioTextZh: 达美航空一架飞机从上海飞往首尔。机上载有256名乘客和13名机组人员。在起飞滑跑过程中，左发吸进不明异物，发动机火警警示灯亮起。随后，机组人员在升空后立即宣布紧急情况，并完成了紧急检查单程序。通过沟通，管制员了解到机组人员想要返回着陆。但由于飞机超重，飞行员不得不在降落前放油。所以管制员引导飞机到了放油区。在海上盘旋并放了近一个小时的油后，飞机安全降落。

cards.audioText: The crew of flight 523 found a traffic 20 miles at FL294 right ahead of the airplane on TCAS at FL290 near LAMEN.The captain reported to Shanghai Control immediately, but the controller responded that there was no indication on his radar screen and there had not been any flight advisory. The captain then instructed the crew to turn left and found the conflicting traffic closing to the flight path and a TCAS warning was initiated. The crew then immediately turns right for avoidance, disengage the autopilot and descended to a lower altitude. The crew reported to the controller about the conflict after the conflict had been cleared.
cards.audioTextZh: 523号航班在LAMEN附近以FL290飞行时，机组通过TCAS发现飞机正前方20海里处有一架位于FL294的航空器。机长立即向上海管制报告，但管制员回应称，雷达屏幕上没有相关显示，此前也没有收到任何飞行情报。随后，机长指示机组左转，并发现冲突航空器正不断接近本机航迹，TCAS警告随即触发。机组立即右转避让，断开自动驾驶并下降到较低高度。冲突解除后，机组向管制员报告了此次冲突。

cards.audioText: An United aircraft experienced an in-flight engine fire during departure climb from New York City. During the return to the departure airport, the nose landing gear failed to extend, and the flight crew was instructed to execute a go-around, during which the crew extended the nose gear using the emergency procedure. The flight crew conducted an emergency landing, and the 2 flight crew members, 3 flight attendants, and 138 passengers deplaned on the runway. No occupant injuries were reported, but the airplane sustained substantial damage from the fire. The NTSB determines that the probable cause of this accident was the inappropriate manual engine-start procedure used by maintenance personnel. (108 words)
cards.audioTextZh: 美联航一架飞机，在从纽约起飞爬升时，飞机发动机起火。在返回起飞机场期间，前起落架未能放出，空管指示机组人员执行复飞，在此期间，机组人员使用紧急程序放下了前起落架。之后，机组人员执行了紧急降落，2名机组人员、3名空乘人员和138名乘客在跑道上下机。没有乘客受伤，但飞机在火灾中遭受了重大损失。美国国家运输安全委员会认为，这起事故的可能原因是维修人员使用了不适当的手动启动引擎的程序。

cards.audioText: A China Southern aircraft lost a left upper wing trailing edge panel during cruise at FL270. Initially, ATC received a pilot report that the flight crew had experienced "light chop". The flight was en route from Greenyard to Blueyard Airport. The broken panel struck the window of passenger row 19ABC and cracked only the outer portion of the window. Pressurization was not lost. The flight crew continued on to Blueyard. Upon approach to Blueyard, ATC instructed the flight crew to expedite for separation. the flight crew informed ATC that they could not increase their airspeed due to possible airframe damage. The flight landed safely. There were 174 passengers and 6 crew members with no reported injuries. (116 words)
cards.audioTextZh: 中国南方航空一架飞机在FL270巡航时，左翼上表面的一块后缘面板脱落。最初，空中交通管制收到飞行员报告称，机组当时遭遇了“轻度颠簸”。该航班正从Greenyard机场飞往Blueyard机场。脱落的面板击中了19ABC排乘客的舷窗，仅使舷窗外层开裂，飞机没有失压。机组继续飞往Blueyard机场。飞机进近Blueyard机场时，空中交通管制为建立间隔指示机组加快速度；机组告知管制员，由于机体可能受损，他们无法提高空速。航班最终安全着陆。机上共有174名乘客和6名机组人员，没有人员受伤报告。

cards.audioText: An Airbus 320 collided with an ERJ 145 during taxi in the run-up area of runway 19. The right aileron of the ERJ was seriously damaged; the left winglet of the Airbus had minor damage. There were no injuries. The captain of the Airbus reported that he was positioned to the right of the ERJ.ATC cleared him for departure, which required him to taxi past the ERJ.He stated that he checked the proximity of the ERJ, and it looked like he could clear it and then felt the impact. The captain notified ATC of the collision. Airport fire crews responded, but there was no fuel leak or fire. (110 words)
cards.audioTextZh: 一架空客320在19号跑道的试车区滑行时与一架ERJ145相撞。ERJ右副翼严重受损；这架空客飞机的左小翼有轻微损坏。没有人员伤亡。空客机长报告说，他的位置在ERJ的右侧。管制允许他们起飞，要求他们滑行通过ERJ。他说他检查了ERJ的附近区域，看起来空间足够让飞机通过，可是没想到还是撞上了。机长向管制通报了相撞事件。机场消防人员做出了反应，但没有发生燃油泄漏或火灾。

cards.audioText: 10. Before the first ILS approach, the pilot was advised that the runway visual range was 600 feet, then he was given a landing clearance. The pilot declared a missed approach and was given radar vectors for a second ILS approach. After turning inbound on the localizer, the pilot was advised the runway visual range and then cleared to land. When the tower controller observed the airplane turning to the south of the runway, she issued missed approach instructions. There was no further reply from the pilot. The airplane impacted a tall tree and collided on the ground. According to the investigation, the pilot misinterpreted the missed approach instructions by making the right turn and then led to the accident. (119 words)
cards.audioTextZh: 在第一次盲降进近前，飞行员被告知跑道视距为600英尺，然后他得到了着陆许可。飞行员宣布复飞，并得到雷达引导进行第二次盲降进近。在转向对准航向道后，飞行员被告知跑道视距，然后获准着陆。塔台管制员观察到飞机转向跑道南面时，发布了复飞指令。飞行员没有进一步的答复。飞机撞上了一棵大树，撞向地上。据调查，飞行员错误理解了复飞指令，右转导致了事故。

cards.audioText: 11. A Boeing 757 and a Bombardier were seriously damaged when the tails of both airplanes collided during the pushback. The flight crew of the Bombardier reported that they were in a stopped position and their ground crew was in the process of disconnecting the tug. Company maintenance personnel stated they were pushing the 757 back and did not see the Bombardier. Communication recordings between ground control and both airplanes revealed that the 757 was cleared for pushback from gate 80. Later, the Bombardier was cleared to push back from gate 79. The ground controller did not advise either aircraft of simultaneous adjacent pushback operations and did not forecast a traffic conflict. (111 words)
cards.audioTextZh: 一架波音757和一架庞巴迪飞机在推出过程中尾部相撞，两架飞机均严重受损。庞巴迪机组报告称，碰撞发生时，他们的飞机已经停住，地面人员正在断开牵引车。航空公司维修人员表示，他们正将757向后推出，没有看到庞巴迪飞机。地面管制与两架飞机之间的通信录音显示，757获准从80号机位推出；随后，庞巴迪飞机获准从79号机位推出。地面管制员没有向任何一架飞机通报相邻机位同时推出的情况，也没有预见到交通冲突。

cards.audioText: 12. Air France 551 departed runway 15R and over flew United 83 at Atlantic Airport. The tower controller had cleared United 83 to land on runway 10 when the aircraft was about 6 miles on final approach. Simultaneously, ATC cleared Air France 551 for takeoff on runway 15R.Air France 551 was on taxiway when the takeoff clearance was issued. The pilots rotated at taxiway and over flew United 83 at the intersection of runways 10 and 15R.United 83 exited runway 10 afterwards. The main cause of this incident is local controller's failure of maintaining awareness of the situation and failing to provide the appropriate separation between the two aircraft on intersecting runways. (113 words)
cards.audioTextZh: 法国航空551号航班从15R跑道起飞，并在大西洋机场上空飞越美联航83号航班。当美联航83号航班在10号跑道最后进近约6海里处时，塔台管制员已许可其在10号跑道着陆。与此同时，空中交通管制许可法国航空551号航班从15R跑道起飞。起飞许可发布时，法国航空551号航班位于滑行道上。该航班在滑行道附近抬前轮，并在10号与15R跑道交叉口上方飞越美联航83号航班。随后，美联航83号航班脱离10号跑道。事件的主要原因是本场管制员未能保持情景意识，也未能为在相交跑道上运行的两架飞机提供适当间隔。

cards.audioText: The Piper and Cessna pilots were inbound to the same airport. The Cessna pilot was directed to enter a left downwind, then flew south before turning southwest. The Piper pilot was also directed to enter a left downwind. The controller noticed two VFR targets close to one another. Assuming the target on a southwest heading was a VFR helicopter when it was actually the Cessna. The controller issued conflict traffic to the southbound aircraft, assuming it was the Cessna pilot when it was actually the Piper pilot, and the Cessna pilot acknowledged the traffic call. Later, the Piper pilot informed the controller of the collision and declared an emergency. (109 words)
cards.audioTextZh: 一架派珀和一架塞斯纳都在飞往同一机场。塞斯纳飞行员被指示加入左三边，随后先向南飞行，再转向西南。派珀飞行员也被指示加入左三边。管制员注意到两个目视飞行规则目标彼此接近。他误以为向西南飞行的目标是一架目视飞行规则直升机，而实际上那是塞斯纳；他又向南行航空器通报了冲突交通，以为该航空器是塞斯纳，实际上却是派珀，而塞斯纳飞行员确认收到了这份交通通报。随后，派珀飞行员通知管制员两机已经相撞，并宣布紧急状态。

cards.audioText: 14. When SIA128 was approaching the airspace of Chicago center area control, the controller instructed the flight crew to change radio frequency for the next sector on 132.1. The first officer acknowledged the frequency change and read back the correct frequency. However, the flight crew did not contact ATC on the new frequency. Because the controllers in the receiving units were preparing for a shift change, they didn't know that flight 128 did not establish radio contact, 30 minutes later, the controller at the next sector identified SIA128 on the radar. Although they attempted to establish contact with the airplane by calling the company dispatcher, they got no response from the pilots. The controller finally regained contact with SIA128 on the emergency frequency 50 minutes later.
cards.audioTextZh: 当新航128接近芝加哥中心区管制空域时，管制员指示机组人员将无线电频率调到下一个扇区132.1。副驾驶确认了频率的变化，并把正确的频率复诵了出来。然而，机组人员并没有在新的频率上联系到管制员。由于接收的人员正在准备换班，他们不知道128航班没有建立联系，30分钟后，下一个扇区的管制员在雷达上识别出了新航128。虽然他们试图通过呼叫公司调度员与飞机建立联系，但没有得到飞行员的回应。50分钟后，管制员终于通过紧急频率与新航128重新取得了联系。

cards.audioText: Landing light signal could provide useful information to controllers. One day, a B757 vacated runway 36L via taxiway A9 after landing. It was then cleared to cross runway 36R.But it stopped taxiing on taxiway A9 between runway 36L and runway 36R.The tower controller attempted to contact the pilot but received no reply. He saw the aircraft landing lights were also off. This made him believe that the B757 had a radio failure and had not received the clearance to cross runway 36R.So he issued takeoff clearance to A320 on runway 36R.Suddenly, the controller noticed the B757's lights came on and it began to move. Realizing the risk of runway incursion, he canceled A320's takeoff clearance immediately.
cards.audioTextZh: 着陆灯可以作为信号向管制员发送有用信息。一天，一架B757在降落后经由滑行道A9脱离36左跑道。随后飞机获准穿越36右跑道。但它在36左和36右跑道之间的A9滑行道上停止滑行。塔台管制员试图联系飞行员但没有得到回复。他看到飞机着陆灯也关闭了。他猜想B757遇无线电故障，没有收到穿越36右跑道的许可，所以他给A320发布了起飞许可，使用跑道36右。突然，管制员注意到B757的着陆灯亮了并开始移动。管制员意识到跑道有被入侵的危险，于是立即取消了A320的起飞许可。

cards.audioText: It was a foggy day, Flight 626 was cleared to taxi to runway 36R.Later, the ground controller gave start-up clearance to a Cessna pilot. Then he requested Flight 626 to contact Tower controller. From then on, those two aircraft were on two different frequencies. The Cessna started to taxi, but the pilot entered wrong taxiway. The ground controller did not realize it and cleared the Cessna to continue taxi. At the same the active runway 36R.Unfortunately, the two aircraft collided, all people on board died. (114 words)
cards.audioTextZh: 那天有雾，626航班获准滑到36R跑道。后来，地面管制员给了塞斯纳飞行员开车许可。然后他要求626航班联系塔台管制员。从那时起，这两架飞机在两个不同的频率上飞行。塞斯纳飞机开始滑行，但飞行员进入了错误的滑行道。地面管制员没有意识到这一点，允许塞斯纳继续滑行。与此同时，塔台管制员批准626航班起飞。当626航班在跑道上滑跑时，塞斯纳越过跑道等待标志，进入活动跑道36R。不幸的是，两架飞机相撞，机上人员全部遇难。

cards.audioText: 17. The tower controller cleared Flight 145 to land on runway 22. But he forgot the arriving aircraft when he cleared Flight 101 to take off from the intersecting runway 16. After Flight 145 touched down, the ground radar system alerted. The controller tried to instruct Flight 145 to stop short of runway 16. However, the aircraft just managed to stop in the middle of the intersection. It was impossible for Flight 101 to abort takeoff. So Flight 101 made an early liftoff and flew over Flight 145. The two aircraft missed colliding by only 50 feet. There were no injuries or damage to either aircraft. But it was regarded as the most serious incident of this kind.
cards.audioTextZh: 塔台管制员允许145航班降落在22号跑道上。但是当他允许101航班从16号交叉跑道起飞时，他忘记了即将进场的飞机。145航班着陆后，地面雷达系统发出警报。管制员试图指示145航班在16号跑道外停止。然而，飞机只是在跑道交叉口的中间停了下来。101航班无法中止起飞。所以101航班提前离地飞，从145航班上方飞过。两架飞机只差50英尺就撞上了。两架飞机都没有人员伤亡或损坏。但这被认为是这类事件中最严重的一次。

cards.audioText: When an Flight 815 was approaching the terminal area of its destination, the flight crew contacted the Approach and requested ILS approach for runway 12. Because of the tailwind conditions, the controller advised the pilot to make a circling approach for runway 30. But the flight crew insisted to land on runway 12 and the controller cleared them to land on that runway. The runway was wet and the braking action was not good. During landing, the aircraft skidded to the right side of the runway. The fuselage was broken into three pieces, the right engine and right main gear were separated from the aircraft. No one was killed, but many passengers suffered from serious injuries.
cards.audioTextZh: 当815航班接近目的地终端区时，机组人员联系进近，要求盲降进近12号跑道。由于顺风，管制员建议飞行员在30号跑道作盘旋进近。但是机组人员坚持降落在12号跑道上，管制员允许他们降落在那条跑道上。跑道很湿，刹车效果也不好。在着陆时，飞机滑到跑道的右侧。机身断成三块，右发动机和右主起落架与飞机分离。没有人死亡，但许多乘客受了重伤。

cards.audioText: Flight 456 with 152 passengers and 9 crews was flying to land at Tokyo Airport. When it was transferred from Tokyo Control to Tokyo Approach, the pilot was instructed to proceed to DA to hold because of traffic congestion. During the holding, the pilot was informed that the local weather was deteriorating and the controller suggested the crew to divert to the alternate, but the pilot reported that their fuel was not enough. So the controller vectored the crew to land at runway 34R. Unfortunately, the pilot couldn't stabilize on the localizers due wind shear. The aircraft went around and made a second approach. Later, it crashed into a hillside due to fuel shortage.
cards.audioTextZh: 456号航班载有152名乘客和9名机组人员，正在飞往东京机场着陆。当该航班从东京区调移交给东京进近时，由于空中交通拥堵，飞行员被指示飞往DA点等待。在等待期间，飞行员获悉当地天气正在恶化，管制员建议机组备降，但飞行员报告剩余燃油不足。因此，管制员对机组实施雷达引导，使其在34R跑道着陆。遗憾的是，由于风切变，飞行员无法使飞机在航向道上稳定下来。飞机复飞后进行了第二次进近。随后，飞机因燃油不足撞上山坡。

cards.audioText: A Boeing 747 performed the flight from Taiwan to Hongkong carrying 206 passengers and 19 crew members on board. It broke up and crashed, killing all those on board. It is the deadliest air disaster in Taiwan. After careful investigation, scientists found the full story of the crash. About 20 years ago, the plane landed heavily and damaged the skin on its tail. Instead of replacing the whole skin in accordance with the maintenance guidelines, the airlines only covered the area with a piece of aluminum plate and painted it. This cause a buildup of metal fatigue in the area. For the following 22 years, maintenance crews had not noticed anything unusual.
cards.audioTextZh: 一架波音747从台湾飞往香港，机上载有206名乘客和19名机组人员。飞机解体坠毁，机上人员全部遇难。这是台湾最严重的空难。经过仔细调查，科学家们发现了坠机的全部经过。大约20年前，这架飞机遭遇重着陆，机身蒙皮受损。航空公司没有按照维护指南更换整个蒙皮，而是只用一块铝板覆盖了该区域并进行了喷漆。这导致该区域的金属疲劳。在接下来的22年里，维修人员没有注意到任何异常。

cards.audioText: Jiuzhai Huanglong Airport, also known as Jiuzhaigou Airport, is an airport in Songpan County, Sichuan province. It is one of the highest airport in the world with an altitude of 3448 meters. There are breathtaking mountain ranges on both sides of the axis of the runway, and the highest Xuebao peak is the main peak of Minshan Mountain, more than 18000 feet above the sea level. The terrain is complex and wind changes rapidly near the airport. So it is considered one of the most difficult airports to fly to in China. But those who fly over here are also amazed by the beautiful scenery. Due to the high elevation, some passengers may experience symptoms of altitude sickness.
cards.audioTextZh: 九寨黄龙机场，又被称为九寨沟机场，是四川省松潘县的一个机场。它是世界上海拔最高的机场之一，海拔3448米。跑道轴线两侧有令人惊叹的山脉，最高的雪豹峰是岷山的主峰，海拔超过18000英尺。机场附近地形复杂，风的变化迅速，所以它被认为是中国最难飞到的机场之一，但那些飞到这里的人也会被美丽的风景惊艳到。由于海拔高，一些乘客可能会出现高原反应的症状。

cards.audioText: A Pakistan flight reported the failure of the left hand engine. The crew shut the engine down and continued descending, some time later, they declared Mayday and shortly afterwards radio and radar contact was lost. The aircraft was unable to maintain heading and turned left before impact with the ground. And all occupants of the aircraft perished in the crash. The investigation into the crash showed that the accident was caused by technical factors and was not caused by human error. The flight crew faced an very complex technical error, that had never occurred before. Due to maintenance irregularities, a turbine blade fractured causing further damage, that made it impossible to control the aircraft.
cards.audioTextZh: 一架巴基斯坦航班报告左发动机失效。机组关闭该发动机并继续下降；一段时间后，他们宣布MAYDAY，不久后无线电和雷达联系中断。飞机无法保持航向，在撞击地面前向左转弯，机上所有人员均在坠机事故中遇难。事故调查显示，事故由技术因素造成，并非人为错误。飞行机组面对的是一种此前从未发生过的、非常复杂的技术故障。由于维修不规范，一片涡轮叶片断裂并造成进一步损坏，使飞机最终无法操纵。

cards.audioText: A Boeing 747 was on final approach to runway 26. After the aircraft went around from very low height, it did not climb out to safety altitude and impacted terrain about 1100 meters past the runway. The cause of the accident was the missing control of the crew over the aircraft position in relation to the glide slope during the automatic approach. The flight was conducted at night in the weather conditions, which is suitable for ICAO CAT II landing. And as a result, the go-around was not taken in due time and the aircraft had a significant deviation from the established approach chart, which led to the controlled flight into terrain.
cards.audioTextZh: 一架波音747正在对26号跑道实施最后进近。飞机从极低高度复飞后，未能爬升至安全高度，并在越过跑道约1100米处撞地。事故原因是，在自动进近过程中，机组未能监控飞机相对于下滑道的位置。航班在夜间飞行，当时的天气条件适用于ICAO II类（CAT II）着陆。结果，机组没有及时复飞，且飞机严重偏离规定的进近航图，最终导致可控飞行撞地。

cards.audioText: A Cargo Boeing 747 with 7 crew and cargo of military vehicles, has crashed shortly after takeoff. Afghan Authorities immediately denied claims that the crash was the result of enemy activities. Several observers on the ground reported the aircraft had just lifted off and was climbing through approximately 1200 feet when it's nose sharply rose. The aircraft appeared to have stalled and came down. According to a listener on frequency, the crew reported the aircraft stalled due to a possible load shift. The NTSB determined that the probable cause of this accident was inadequate procedures for restraining special cargo loads. The cargo moved after and damaged hydraulic systems and horizontal stabilizer components.
cards.audioTextZh: 一架载有7名机组人员、装载军用车辆的波音747货机在起飞后不久坠毁。阿富汗当局立即否认坠机由敌对活动造成。多名地面目击者报告称，飞机刚刚离地，爬升通过大约1200英尺时，机头突然急剧上仰。飞机似乎发生失速，随后坠落。据一名监听该频率的人称，机组报告飞机可能因载荷移位而失速。美国国家运输安全委员会（NTSB）认定，这起事故的可能原因是特殊货物载荷的系留程序不充分。货物随后发生移动，损坏了液压系统和水平安定面部件。

cards.audioText: Flight 60 encountered moderate turbulence at 9000 feet during descending to Dallas. According to NTSB, as the flight began its descent, the captain illuminated the seat belt sign and made a public address reminding passengers to buckle up. Then the airplane entered a band of small cumulus clouds and experienced 10-15 seconds of moderate turbulence. The flight attendants were conducting their final cabin safety checks then, so 7 flight attendants received minor injuries, one passenger, who ignored the seat-belt sign and instructions, injured his left ankle. The aircraft continued for a landing on Dallas without further incident. The flight crew requested paramedics to meet the airplane at the gate. Finally, the passenger was transported to the hospital.
cards.audioTextZh: 60号航班在下降前往达拉斯期间，于9000英尺遭遇中度颠簸。据美国国家运输安全委员会（NTSB）称，飞机开始下降时，机长点亮安全带指示灯，并通过客舱广播提醒乘客系好安全带。随后，飞机进入一片小积云带，经历了10至15秒的中度颠簸。当时，乘务员正在进行最后的客舱安全检查，因此7名乘务员轻伤；另有一名无视安全带指示灯和相关指示的乘客左脚踝受伤。飞机继续飞往达拉斯并安全着陆，未再发生其他事件。飞行机组请求急救人员在登机口接机，最终该名乘客被送往医院。

cards.audioText: A flight with 98 passengers, encountered smoke in cockpit shortly after departure. The aircraft was cleared to FL340 and was about to contact Area Control when The crew declared an emergency, then the captain elected to hand over pilot flying duties to the first officer in order to give his attention to the overall management of the situation. Both pilots put on their oxygen masks, and begun the descent and preparations to evacuate the aircraft on the runway. Finally the aircraft landed safely.6 injured passengers received medical assistance after landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 一架载有98名乘客的航班在起飞后不久，驾驶舱出现烟雾。这架飞机被允许飞往高度层340,正要与区域管制中心联系时，驾驶舱机组人员闻到了烟味。经过一番讨论，他们决定返回出发机场。机组人员宣布了紧急情况，然后机长选择将飞行员的飞行职责交给副驾驶，以便让他关注局势的整体管理。两名飞行员都戴上了氧气面罩，开始下降，准备在跑道上撤离。最后飞机安全着陆了。6名受伤乘客在着陆后接受了医疗救助。

cards.audioText: An Airbus with 146 passengers and 5 crew, encountered turbulence during climbing from FL320 to FL340, causing injuries to 24 passengers and 3 cabin creW.
